documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Includes, but is not limited to, input, judgment, assumption and method used in measuring liability, and change in input, judgment, and assumption. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceProductAndServiceExtensibleList
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates product and service for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceReinsuranceRecoverableAfterAllowance
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Reinsurance Recoverable, after Allowance
documentation: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, recoverable under reinsurance for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceRemeasurementGainLoss
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Remeasurement Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of remeasurement gain (loss) on present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from application of revised benefit ratio as of contract issue date. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceRollForward
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceSegmentExtensibleList
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Segment [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates segment that includes present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provision of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceTableTextBlock
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from application of revised benefit ratio as of contract issue date. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceWeightedAverageDuration
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Weighted-Average Duration
documentation: Weighted-average duration of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provision of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceWeightedAverageInterestAccretionRate
standard_label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Weighted-Average Interest Accretion Rate
documentation: Original weighted-average discount rate at contract issue date used to measure present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

name: AdditionalOtherLiabilitiesDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Additional Other Liabilities Disclosure [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: AdditionalPaidInCapital
standard_label: Additional Paid in Capital
documentation: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

name: AdditionalPaidInCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Additional Paid in Capital [Abstract]

name: AdditionalPaidInCapitalCommonStock
standard_label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
documentation: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

name: AdditionalPaidInCapitalMember
standard_label: Additional Paid-in Capital [Member]
documentation: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders.

name: AdditionalPaidInCapitalPreferredStock
standard_label: Additional Paid in Capital, Preferred Stock
documentation: Value received from shareholder in nonredeemable preferred stock-related transaction in excess of par value, value contributed to entity and value received from other stock-related transaction. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer. Excludes common stock.

name: AdditionsToContractHoldersFunds
standard_label: Additions to Contract Holders Funds
documentation: The cash inflow from a segregated fund account during the period.

name: AdditionsToNoncurrentAssets
standard_label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Total expenditures for additions to long-lived assets other than financial instruments, long-term customer relationships of a financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition costs, and deferred tax assets of the reportable segment; if the amount: (a) is included in the determination of segment assets reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) is otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in the deter

name: AdditionsToOtherAssetsAmount
standard_label: Additions to Other Assets, Amount
documentation: Amount of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

name: AdditionsToOtherAssetsDescription
standard_label: Additions to Other Assets, Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Explanation of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

name: AdequatelyCapitalizedMember
standard_label: Prompt Corrective Action Category, Adequately Capitalized [Member]
documentation: Adequately capitalized category under prompt corrective action framework.

name: AdjustableRateLoansMember
standard_label: Adjustable Rate Loans [Member]
documentation: Loan where the rate is adjusted, moving higher or lower according to changes in a specified reference rate.

name: AdjustableRateResidentialMortgageMember
standard_label: Adjustable Rate Residential Mortgage [Member]
documentation: Loan to purchase or refinance residential real estate (for example, but not limited to, a home) in which the interest rate is periodically adjusted according to changes in a specified reference rate.

name: AdjustmentForAmortization
standard_label: Amortization
documentation: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

name: AdjustmentForAmortizationAbstract
standard_label: Amortization [Abstract]

name: AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompanyTransactionsGrossOfTax
standard_label: Adjustment for Long-Term Intra-Entity Transaction, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

name: AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompanyTransactionsNetOfTax
standard_label: Adjustment for Long-Term Intra-Entity Transaction, after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

name: AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompanyTransactionsNetOfTaxAbstract
standard_label: Adjustment for Long-Term Intra-Entity Transaction, after Tax [Abstract]

name: AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompanyTransactionsTaxBenefitExpense
standard_label: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Tax Benefit (Expense) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Tax effect of current period adjustment resulting from gains and losses on intercompany foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, that is, settlement is not planned or anticipated in the foreseeable future. Applies when the entities to the transaction are consolidated, combined, or accounted for by the equity method in the reporting entity's financial statements. Reported in equity as part of accumulated other comprehensive income.

name: AdjustmentForLongTermIntercompanyTransactionsTaxExpenseBenefit
standard_label: Adjustment for Long-Term Intra-Entity Transaction, Tax Expense (Benefit)
documentation: Amount of tax expense (benefit) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

name: AdjustmentOfWarrantsGrantedForServices
standard_label: Adjustment of Warrants Granted for Services
documentation: Adjustment for noncash service expenses paid for by granting of warrants.

name: AdjustmentPlantCapacity
standard_label: Adjustment Plant Capacity (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the amount of adjustment recorded for the variance between the theoretical cost of power generation used in a standard costing model compared to the actual cost of generating the power used for production or operational purposes or, similarly, the adjustment for the variance between the amount of theoretical pipeline capacity versus actual quantities produced.

name: AdjustmentToAdditionalPaidInCapitalConvertibleDebtInstrumentIssuedAtSubstantialPremium
standard_label: Adjustment to Additional Paid-in Capital, Convertible Debt Instrument Issued at Substantial Premium
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid-in capital (APIC) from recognition of substantial premium at which convertible debt instrument is issued.

name: AdjustmentToAdditionalPaidInCapitalIncomeTaxEffectFromShareBasedCompensationNet
standard_label: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-Based Compensation, Net (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit (deficiency) associated with an share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: AdjustmentToAdditionalPaidInCapitalIncomeTaxEffectFromShareBasedCompensationNetAbstract
standard_label: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-Based Compensation, Net [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: AdjustmentsForChangeInAccountingPrincipleAxis
standard_label: Change in Accounting Principle, Type [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of change in accounting principle. Excludes change from amendment to accounting standards.

name: AdjustmentsForErrorCorrectionDomain
standard_label: Error Correction, Type [Domain]
documentation: Type of error correction.

name: AdjustmentsForNewAccountingPrincipleEarlyAdoptionMember
standard_label: Adjustments for New Accounting Principle, Early Adoption [Member] (Deprecated 2021)
documentation: Early adoption of sources of change to generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) in the United States. The FASB released the FASB Accounting Standards Codification as the authoritative source of literature effective for interim and annual periods ending after September 15, 2009. As part of the Codification process, the FASB issues Accounting Standards Updates to amend the Codification but otherwise the Accounting Standards Updates are not authoritative in their own right. All previous acco

name: AdjustmentsForNewAccountingPronouncementsAxis
standard_label: Accounting Standards Update [Axis]
documentation: Information by amendment to accounting standards.

name: AdjustmentsNoncashItemsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities
standard_label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Noncash Item
documentation: Amount of expense (income) and loss (gain) in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

name: AdjustmentsNoncashItemsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Noncash Item [Abstract]

name: AdjustmentsOfRetainedEarningsAndAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDueToApplicationOfMeasurementDateProvisionsAbstract
standard_label: Adjustments of Retained Earnings and Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Due to Application of Measurement Date Provisions [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: AdjustmentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
documentation: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital [Abstract]

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalConvertibleDebtWithConversionFeature
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalCounterpartyDefaultPeriodOfDefaultEffectOnEquity
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Counterparty Default, Period of Default, Effect on Equity (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The effect on equity related to the amount of default related expense recognized in earnings in the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalCounterpartyDefaultSubsequentPeriodChangesEffectOnEquity
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Counterparty Default, Subsequent Period Changes, Effect on Equity (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: For periods subsequent to the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default, the effect on equity related to the amount of change during the period in the fair value of the entity's shares or the change in probable recoveries associated with the share-lending arrangement that is probable of default.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalDividendsInExcessOfRetainedEarnings
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
documentation: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalEquityComponentOfConvertibleDebt
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
documentation: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalEquityComponentOfConvertibleDebtSubsequentAdjustments
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt, Subsequent Adjustments
documentation: The amount of subsequent adjustments to additional paid in capital for convertible financial instruments where a component of equity and a component of debt are recognized.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalIncomeTaxDeficiencyFromShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Deficiency from Share-Based Compensation (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax deficiency associated with a share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalIncreaseInCarryingAmountOfRedeemablePreferredStock
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
documentation: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalMarkToMarket
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalOther
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
documentation: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalReallocationOfMinorityInterest
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Reallocation of Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Change in additional paid in capital as a result of a reallocation of a subsidiary's stockholders' equity to noncontrolling interest due to the subsidiary issuing stock. This reallocation is from a capital transaction.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalShareBasedCompensationEmployeeStockPurchaseProgramRequisiteServicePeriodRecognition
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
documentation: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalShareBasedCompensationNonvestedSharesRequisiteServicePeriodRecognition
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Shares, Requisite Service Period Recognition (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the amount of recognized equity-based compensation related to nonvested shares during the period, that is, the amount recognized as expense in the income statement (or as asset if compensation is capitalized).

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalShareBasedCompensationRestrictedStockUnitsRequisiteServicePeriodRecognition
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Increase for Cost Recognition
documentation: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for restricted stock unit under share-based payment arrangement.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalShareBasedCompensationStockOptionsRequisiteServicePeriodRecognition
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Increase for Cost Recognition
documentation: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for option under share-based payment arrangement.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationAndExerciseOfStockOptions
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationOtherLongtermIncentivePlansRequisiteServicePeriodRecognition
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Other, Increase for Cost Recognition
documentation: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement, classified as other.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionAbstract
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition [Abstract]

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalSharebasedCompensationRequisiteServicePeriodRecognitionValue
standard_label: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
documentation: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStockIssuedIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
documentation: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStockIssuedOwnshareLendingArrangementIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
documentation: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStockSplit
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
documentation: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalTaxEffectFromShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-Based Compensation (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a tax benefit associated with share-based compensation plan other than an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes, but is not limited to, excess tax benefit.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalTerminationOfSCorporationElection
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Termination of S Corporation Election (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from undistributed earnings on the date of S Corporation election termination.

name: AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalWarrantIssued
standard_label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
documentation: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

name: AdjustmentsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities
standard_label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of expense (income); loss (gain); increase (decrease) in liability and (increase) decrease in asset used in operating activity; and cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other; in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

name: AdjustmentsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity [Abstract]

name: AdministrationOfTheTreasuryBelgiumMember
standard_label: Administration of the Treasury, Belgium [Member]
documentation: Designated tax department of the government of Belgium.

name: AdministrativeFeePayable
standard_label: Administrative Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of fee payable for administrative service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, and overhead costs.

name: AdministrativeFeesAmountPaid
standard_label: Administrative Fees, Amount Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount paid to managing member or general partner, affiliate of managing member or general partner, or affiliate of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP) for administrative services provided to the LLC or LP, for example, but not limited to, salaries, rent, or other overhead costs.

name: AdministrativeFeesDescription
standard_label: Administrative Fees, Description
documentation: Description of the nature of payments to a managing member or general partner, affiliate of a managing member or general partner, or affiliate of a limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP) for administrative services provided to the LLC or LP, for example, but is not limited to, salaries, rent, or other overhead costs. Includes a description of the services performed and the amount reimbursed for such services.

name: AdministrativeFeesExpense
standard_label: Administrative Fees Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for administrative fee from service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, or overhead cost.

name: AdministrativeServiceMember
standard_label: Administrative Service [Member]
documentation: Administrative assistance, including, but not limited to, accounting, tax, legal, regulatory filing, and share registration of managed fund and investment account of independent third party, and related and affiliated entity.

name: AdministrativeServicesRevenue
standard_label: Administrative Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of revenue from providing administrative services, including, but not limited to, accounting, tax, legal, regulatory filing, and share registration activities of managed funds and investment accounts of independent third parties and related and affiliated entities.

name: AdmissionMember
standard_label: Admission [Member]
documentation: Right or permission to enter. Includes, but is not limited to, entrance to park, ride, attraction, theater, sporting event, and movie.

name: AdmissionsRevenue
standard_label: Admissions Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from admissions (for example, tickets to parks, rides and attractions, theaters, sporting events, and movies), as well as patient admissions.

name: AdoptionOfSFAS158EmployersAccountingForDefinedBenefitPensionAndOtherPostretirementPlansAbstract
standard_label: Adoption of FAS 158, Employers' Accounting for Defined Benefit Pension and Other Postretirement Plans [Abstract] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)

name: AdvancePaymentsByBorrowersForTaxesAndInsurance
standard_label: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
documentation: Carrying amount of accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate governmental agency or vendor on behalf of the borrower.

name: AdvancePaymentsByBorrowersForTaxesAndInsuranceRelatedText
standard_label: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance Related Text (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Additional information disclosed regarding advance payments by borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe).

name: AdvancePaymentsByBorrowersForTaxesAndInsuranceSummary
standard_label: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance Summary [Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate governmental agency(ies) or vendor(s) on behalf of the borrower.

name: AdvancePaymentsNettedAgainstClaimReceivable
standard_label: Advance Payments Netted Against Claim Receivable
documentation: Amount of advance payments received on the contract before its termination shown as a deduction from the claim receivable related to a termination of a contract.

standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Franchise Notes Receivable [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from written payment obligation owed by franchisee to franchisor.

name: AllowanceForFranchiseReceivablesMember
standard_label: Allowance for Franchise Receivables [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: A valuation allowance for fees and other amounts owed by franchisees to the franchisor that are expected to be uncollectible.

name: AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionCapitalizedInterestMember
standard_label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Interest [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) is a component of construction costs representing net cost of borrowed funds used during the period of construction. This element pertains to certain regulated industries, such as public utilities.

name: AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionInvestingActivities
standard_label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
documentation: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

name: AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionPolicy
standard_label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for AFUDC (for example, component of PPE, credit to income statement), information regarding the inclusion in rates (only capitalized if its inclusion in rates is probable) and description of AFUDC (for example, represents the cost of capital used during construction).

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossRecoveryOfBadDebts
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Loss, Recovery of Bad Debts
documentation: Amount of recovery of loans and lease receivables which had previously been fully or partially written-off as bad debts.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesAdjustmentsNet
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Adjustments, Other
documentation: Amount of other addition (reduction) in allowance reserve for credit loss.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesAdjustmentsNetAbstract
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Adjustments, Net [Abstract] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesForeignCurrencyTranslation
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Foreign Currency Translation
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from converting allowance reserve for credit loss to currency of reporting entity from amount denominated or measured in a different currency, which decreases (increases) the allowance for loan and lease losses.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesLoansAcquired
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Loans Acquired
documentation: Amount of addition to allowance reserve for credit loss arising from purchase of loan and lease portfolios.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesLoansSold
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Loans Sold
documentation: Amount of reduction of allowance reserve for credit loss arising from sale of loan and lease portfolios.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Loan and Lease Loss [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from loan and lease portfolio.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of allowance reserve for credit loss.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesProvisionForLossGross
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the gross amount charged against earnings during the period as credit losses (bad debt expense) based on review of the loan and lease portfolio and application of the methodology for estimating credit losses.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesProvisionForLossNet
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the amount charged against earnings during the period as bad debt expense, net of recoveries of previously expensed credit losses.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesProvisionForLossNetAbstract
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Net [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRealEstate
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Real Estate
documentation: The reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified fixed maturity real estate loans as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of that loan portfolio.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRealEstateMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Loan and Lease Loss, Real Estate [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from loan and lease real estate portfolio.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRecoveriesOfBadDebts
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Recoveries of Bad Debts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Reflects a reduction in bad debt expense attributable to collections of loans and lease receivables which had previously been fully or partially charged off as bad debts.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRollForward
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesWriteOffs
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Writeoff
documentation: Amount of loans and leases that have been written off from both loan receivables and allowance reserve for credit loss.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesWriteoffsNet
standard_label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Writeoff, Net
documentation: Amount, after recoveries, of loans and leases that have been written-off.

name: AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesWriteoffsNetAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery [Abstract]

name: AllowanceForLoansAndLeasesReceivableMember
standard_label: Allowance for Loans and Leases Receivable [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The allowance for loan and lease losses represents the reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified loans and leases, as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of the loan portfolio as of the balance sheet date. For banks, disclose currently required allocated transfer risk reserves. Include carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations determined to be appropriate.

name: AllowanceForLossesOnFinanceReceivablesMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Loss on Finance Receivable [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of investment in contractual right to receive money on demand or on fixed or determinable date recognized as asset in creditor's statement of financial position.

name: AllowanceForNotesAndLoansReceivableCurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

name: AllowanceForNotesAndLoansReceivableNoncurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

name: AllowanceForNotesReceivable
standard_label: Allowance for Notes, Loans and Financing Receivable (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: For an unclassified balance sheet, the valuation allowance relating to a written agreement to receive money (at a specified future date(s), consisting of principal as well as any accrued interest) for the portion that is expected to be uncollectible.

name: AllowanceForNotesReceivableMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Notes Receivable [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from written agreement to receive, at specified future date, money consisting of principal and accrued interest.

name: AllowanceForPromotionsMember
standard_label: Allowance for Promotions [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: A provision (charged either as a reduction of revenue or as an expense such as cost of sales) to relate the costs of certain customer discounts and rewards for the associated revenue. Accruals for trade and sales promotions are recorded primarily at the time a product is sold to the customer based on expected levels of performance. Settlement of these liabilities typically occurs in subsequent periods.

name: AllowanceForReceivableFromInsuranceProviderMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Receivable from Insurance Provider [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable for insurance proceeds.

name: AllowanceForReinsuranceRecoverableMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Reinsurance Recoverable [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of recoverable from reinsurer for paid and unpaid claims and claim settlement expense.

name: AllowanceForSalesReturnsMember
standard_label: Allowance for Sales Returns [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: A valuation allowance for the amount of products sold that the entity expects to be returned by the purchaser.

name: AllowanceForTradeReceivablesMember
standard_label: Allowance for Trade Receivables [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: A valuation allowance for amounts due to an Entity for the sale of goods or services in the normal course of business that are expected to be uncollectible.

name: AllowanceForUncollectibleAccountsTimeSharingReceivablesSoldWithRecourseMember
standard_label: Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts, Time Sharing Receivables Sold with Recourse [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Allowance for uncollectible accounts on receivables sold with recourse that originated with real estate time sharing transactions.

name: AllowanceForUncollectibleAccountsTimeSharingTransactionsMember
standard_label: Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts, Time Sharing Transactions [Member] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Allowance for uncollectible accounts relating to real estate time sharing receivables.

name: AllowanceForUncollectibleAgencyLoansMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Uncollectible Agency Loan [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from money lent to government agency.

name: AllowanceForUncollectibleCustomersLiabilityForAcceptances
standard_label: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

name: AllowanceForUncollectibleCustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Uncollectible Customer's Liability for Acceptances [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from customer for short-term negotiable time draft drawn on and accepted by financial institution (banker's acceptance).

name: AllowanceForUncollectibleDeductiblesMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Uncollectible Deductible [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from insured party for deductible portion of claim.

name: AllowanceForUncollectiblePremiumsReceivableMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Allowance, Uncollectible Premium Receivable [Member]
documentation: Allowance for portion expected to be uncollectible of receivable from writing and issuing insurance policy.

name: AlternativeDisclosureOnProductiveWells
standard_label: Alternative Disclosure on Productive Wells (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: For those unusual situations in which gross and net data cannot be applied, alternative disclosure that adequately describes the registrant's productive wells.

name: AlternativeEnergyMember
standard_label: Alternative Energy [Member]
documentation: Power generated from source other than fossil fuel. Source includes, but is not limited to, ethanol, biomass, solar, geothermal, and wind power.

name: AlternativeExcessNetCapital
standard_label: Alternative Excess Net Capital
documentation: The amount of net capital in excess of the alternative minimum required net capital.

name: AlternativeExcessNetCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Alternative Excess Net Capital [Abstract]

name: AlternativeInvestment
standard_label: Alternative Investment
documentation: Fair value of investment other than investment in equity security, investment in debt security and equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Example includes, but is not limited to, investment in hedge fund, venture capital fund, private equity fund, and real estate partnership or fund.

name: AlternativeInvestmentChangeInValuationTechnique
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Change in Valuation Technique [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether valuation technique or approach changed for measuring alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentChangeInValuationTechniqueReasonExtensibleList
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Change in Valuation Technique, Reason [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates reason valuation technique or approach changed for measuring alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAndNavExtensibleList
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level and NAV [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level, within fair value hierarchy and fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient, of alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentMeasurementInput
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Measurement Input
documentation: Value of input used to measure alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentMeasurementInputExtensibleList
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Measurement Input [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates measurement input for alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentTypeExtensibleList
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentValuationTechniqueExtensibleList
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Valuation Technique [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates valuation technique for measuring alternative investment.

name: AlternativeInvestmentsFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Alternative Investment, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Fair value of investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes measurement of net asset value as estimate of fair value.

name: AlternativeInvestmentsFairValueDisclosureInputs
standard_label: Alternative Investments, Fair Value Disclosure, Inputs (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions (inputs) used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: AlternativeInvestmentsFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Alternative Investments, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: AlternativeNetCapitalRequirement
standard_label: Alternative Net Capital Requirement (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Total net capital requirement computed under the alternative method allowed under regulatory reporting requirements.

name: AlternativeNetCapitalRequirement1
standard_label: Alternative Net Capital Requirement
documentation: Amount of net capital requirement computed under the alternative method allowed under regulatory reporting requirements.

name: AlternativeNetCapitalRequirementAbstract
standard_label: Alternative Net Capital Requirement [Abstract]

name: AlternativePresentationLessorLeaseIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Lease Income, Lessor, Alternative Presentation [Abstract]

name: AmericasMember
standard_label: Americas [Member]
documentation: Continents of North and South America.

name: AmortizationAndDepreciationOfDecontaminatingAndDecommissioningAssets
standard_label: Amortization and Depreciation of Decontaminating and Decommissioning Assets
documentation: The current period expense charged against earnings on decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale to allocate or recognize the cost of the assets over their useful lives.

name: AmortizationExpensePerDollarOfGrossRevenue
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense Per Dollar of Gross Revenue
documentation: Amount of amortization expense per dollar of gross revenue from production in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

name: AmortizationExpensePerEquivalentUnitOfProductionOrPerDollarOfGrossRevenueLineItems
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: AmortizationExpensePerPhysicalUnitOfProduction
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense Per Unit of Production
documentation: Amount of amortization expense per equivalent physical unit of production in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

name: AmortizationExpensePerUnitOfProductionByCostCenterAxis
standard_label: Cost Center [Axis]
documentation: Information by cost center.

name: AmortizationExpensePerUnitOfProductionTable
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about amortization expense per equivalent physical unit of production and per dollar of gross revenue from production for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

name: AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffordableHousingProjectInvestments
standard_label: Investment, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Amount
documentation: Amount of investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffordableHousingProjectInvestmentsAmortization
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Amortization Expense
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

name: AmortizationOfAboveAndBelowMarketLeases
standard_label: Amortization of above and below Market Leases
documentation: Amount of non-cash amortization of intangible asset (liability) for above and below market leases.

name: AmortizationOfAcquiredIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Amortization of Acquired Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of acquired intangible assets. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by (used in) operations using the indirect method.

name: AmortizationOfAcquisitionCosts
standard_label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
documentation: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

name: AmortizationOfAdvanceRoyalty
standard_label: Amortization of Advance Royalty
documentation: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of the advance royalties. These royalties are paid in one accounting period, but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization. For example, royalties that are required to be paid in advance of production from a mineral, oil, or gas property and amortized over the period of right to produce these items.

name: AmortizationOfBelowMarketLease
standard_label: Amortization of Below Market Lease
documentation: Amount of amortization of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

name: AmortizationOfCapitalizedValueOfBusinessAcquiredAsset
standard_label: Amortization of Capitalized Value of Business Acquired Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Represents total amortization expense with respect to capitalized value of business asset acquired (present value of future profits) reflected in the income statement for the period, generally on the same basis for amortization of deferred policy acquisition costs.

name: AmortizationOfDebtDiscountPremium
standard_label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
documentation: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

name: AmortizationOfDeferredCharges
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Charges
documentation: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

name: AmortizationOfDeferredChargesAbstract
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Charges [Abstract]

name: AmortizationOfDeferredHedgeGains
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Hedge Gains
documentation: The amount of expense charged against earnings by an Entity to record deferred gains and losses on hedge instruments. Examples include gain on economic hedges, amortization of gain on designated fair value hedge and so forth.

name: AmortizationOfDeferredLeasingFees
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Leasing Fees (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those act

name: AmortizationOfDeferredLoanOriginationFeesNet
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
documentation: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

name: AmortizationOfDeferredPropertyTaxes
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Property Taxes
documentation: The amount of amortization charged against earnings during the period for deferred property taxes.

name: AmortizationOfDeferredSalesCommissions
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
documentation: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

name: AmortizationOfDeferredSalesCommissionsMember
standard_label: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale.

name: AmortizationOfESOPAward
standard_label: Amortization of ESOP Award
documentation: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

name: AmortizationOfFinancingCosts
standard_label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
documentation: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

name: AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndDiscounts
standard_label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
documentation: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

name: AmortizationOfFinancingCostsAndDiscountsAbstract
standard_label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts [Abstract]

name: AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Amortization Expense
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: AmortizationOfIntangiblesNonproductionMember
standard_label: Amortization of Intangibles, Nonproduction [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate expense charged against earnings (but not to cost of sales or services) to allocate the costs of intangible assets in a systematic and rational manner to the periods expected to benefit by the use of such assets.

name: AmortizationOfLeaseIncentives
standard_label: Amortization of Lease Incentives (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Amount of amortization of lease incentive costs incurred by the lessor for the benefit of the lessee.

name: AmortizationOfLeasedAsset
standard_label: Amortization of Leased Asset (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized leases. This element may apply to energy companies that lease mineral producing properties and to other enterprises that capitalize property, plant, or equipment obtained through capital leases.

name: AmortizationOfMortgageServicingRightsMSRs
standard_label: Amortization of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
documentation: The periodic amortization (in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss) of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

name: AmortizationOfNuclearFuelLease
standard_label: Amortization of Nuclear Fuel
documentation: Amount of amortization of nuclear fuel.

name: AmortizationOfPowerContractsEmissionCredits
standard_label: Amortization of Power Contracts Emission Credits
documentation: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized costs related to purchasing power, fuel, or emission credits. These items may be purchased in one accounting period but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization.

name: AmortizationOfRateDeferral
standard_label: Amortization of Rate Deferral
documentation: The periodic expense to reduce the value of the rate deferral asset that is created when utilities under bill customers during periods of rate increases by deferring rate increases. These customers eventually pay higher rates to repay the utility for the rate deferral.

name: AmortizationOfRegulatoryAsset
standard_label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
documentation: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

name: AmortizationOfRegulatoryAssetMember
standard_label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic realization of the capitalized cost of regulatory assets.

name: AmortizationOfValueOfBusinessAcquiredVOBA
standard_label: Amortization of Value of Business Acquired (VOBA)
documentation: The adjustment that represents the periodic charge against earnings to reduce the value of business acquired (VOBA) over the expected life of the underlying insurance contracts. VOBA reflects the estimated fair value of a life insurance business in force and represents the portion of the cost to acquire the business that is allocated to the value of the right to receive future cash flows from insurance contracts existing at the date of acquisition. Such value is the present value of the actuaria

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfFairValueHedge
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Period over which adjustments to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item are amortized upon discontinuation of the fair value hedge.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfFairValueHedge1
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Period of amortization for adjustment to carrying amount of interest-bearing hedged item upon discontinuation of fair value hedge, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfForeignCurrencyFairValueHedge
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Specifies the period over which adjustments to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item are amortized upon discontinuation of the foreign currency fair value hedge.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfForeignCurrencyFairValueHedge1
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Period of amortization for adjustment to carrying amount of interest-bearing hedged item upon discontinuation of foreign currency fair value hedge, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfInterestRateFairValueHedge
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Period over which adjustments to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item are amortized upon discontinuation of the interest rate fair value hedge.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfInterestRateFairValueHedge1
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Period of amortization for adjustment to carrying amount of interest-bearing hedged item upon discontinuation of interest rate fair value hedge, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskFairValueHedge
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Period over which adjustments to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item are amortized upon discontinuation of the price risk fair value hedge.

name: AmortizationPeriodOfDeferredGainLossOnDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskFairValueHedge1
standard_label: Amortization Period of Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Period of amortization for adjustment to carrying amount of interest-bearing hedged item upon discontinuation of price risk fair value hedge, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: AmountAvailableForDividendDistributionWithApprovalFromRegulatoryAgencies
standard_label: Amount Available for Dividend Distribution with Approval from Regulatory Agencies (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of dividends that can be declared or paid with approval of relevant regulatory agencies.

name: AmountAvailableForDividendDistributionWithoutAffectingCapitalAdequacyRequirements
standard_label: Amount Available for Dividend Distribution without Affecting Capital Adequacy Requirements
documentation: The amount of dividends that can be declared or paid without affecting the banking or savings institution's regulatory capital position.

name: AmountAvailableForDividendDistributionWithoutPriorApprovalFromRegulatoryAgency
standard_label: Amount Available for Dividend Distribution without Prior Approval from Regulatory Agency (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of dividends that may be paid or declared in any calendar year without prior approval of regulatory agencies.

name: AmountOfDeferredCostsRelatedToLongTermContracts
standard_label: Amount of Deferred Costs Related to Long-Term Contracts
documentation: Amount of deferred costs for long-term contracts and programs. Includes, but is not limited to, initial tooling costs and deferred production costs.

name: AmountOfDilutiveSecuritiesESOPConvertiblePreferredStock
standard_label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, ESOP Convertible Preferred Stock
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: AmountOfEmbeddedRegulatoryLiability

name: AmountOfImpairmentToCarryingAmountOfRegulatoryAssets

name: AmountOfRegulatoryAssistanceReceived1

name: AmountOfRegulatoryCostsNotYetApproved

name: AmountRecognizedInNetPeriodicBenefitCostAndOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) and Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax

name: AmountRecognizedInNetPeriodicBenefitCostAndOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTaxAbstract

name: AncillaryFeeIncomeGeneratedByServicingFinancialAssetsAmount

documentation: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

name: AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleWithAllowanceForCreditLossNoncontrollingInterestMember
standard_label: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, with Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
documentation: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

documentation: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without allowance for credit loss, attributable to parent.
