documentation: Revenue recognized in the period for (1) performance (incentive) fees based on the investment results achieved for management of certain institutional accounts and hedge funds, (2) schedule-based fees earned for management of mutual funds and closed-end funds, based either on average daily net assets or on a combination of the average daily net assets and gross income, and (3) other investment management and advisory fees.

name: AssetManagementFees1
standard_label: Asset Management Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of fixed fee revenue for the management of an investment fund portfolio. Excludes investment advisory, distribution and servicing, and performance fees.

name: AssetManagementFeesAbstract
standard_label: Investment Advisory, Management and Administrative Fees [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: AssetManagementIncomeMember
standard_label: Asset Management Income [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing fees received from asset management activities.

name: AssetManagementMember
standard_label: Asset Management [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Services and products provided and used to manage contract holders' assets.

name: AssetNotPledgedAsCollateralAndAssetPledgedAsCollateralWithoutRightMember
standard_label: Asset Not Pledged as Collateral and Asset Pledged as Collateral without Right [Member]
documentation: Asset not pledged as collateral and asset pledged as collateral for which secured party (transferee) does not have right to sell or repledge by contract or custom.

name: AssetNotPledgedAsCollateralMember
standard_label: Asset Not Pledged as Collateral [Member]
documentation: Asset not pledged as collateral.

name: AssetOrLiabilityFromTransfersOfFinancialAssetsHavingNoReasonableEstimateOfFairValueAtCarryingValue
standard_label: Asset or Liability from Transfers of Financial Assets Having No Reasonable Estimate of Fair Value, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The carrying amount of the listed assets obtained or liabilities incurred.

name: AssetOrLiabilityFromTransfersOfFinancialAssetsHavingNoReasonableEstimateOfFairValueDescriptionOfItems
standard_label: Asset or Liability from Transfers of Financial Assets Having No Reasonable Estimate of Fair Value, Description of Items (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This contains a description of those certain assets obtained or liabilities incurred in transfers of financial assets during the period for which it is not practicable to estimate the fair value.

name: AssetOrLiabilityFromTransfersOfFinancialAssetsHavingNoReasonableEstimateOfFairValueNameDomain
standard_label: Asset or Liability from Transfers of Financial Assets Having No Reasonable Estimate of Fair Value, Name [Domain] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This contains the name of the certain asset obtained or liability incurred in transfers of financial assets during the period for which it is impracticable to estimate fair value.

name: AssetOrLiabilityFromTransfersOfFinancialAssetsHavingNoReasonableEstimateOfFairValueReasonWhyNotEstimated
standard_label: Asset or Liability from Transfers of Financial Assets Having No Reasonable Estimate of Fair Value, Reason why Not Estimated (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This contains the reasons why it is not practicable to estimate the fair value of the listed asset obtained or liability incurred.

name: AssetPledgedAsCollateralMember
standard_label: Asset Pledged as Collateral [Member]
documentation: Asset pledged as collateral.

name: AssetPledgedAsCollateralWithRightMember
standard_label: Asset Pledged as Collateral with Right [Member]
documentation: Asset pledged as collateral for which secured party (transferee) has right to sell or repledge by contract or custom.

name: AssetPledgedAsCollateralWithoutRightMember
standard_label: Asset Pledged as Collateral without Right [Member]
documentation: Asset pledged as collateral for which secured party (transferee) does not have right to sell or repledge by contract or custom.

name: AssetRecoverableGasCostsMember
standard_label: Asset Recoverable Gas Costs [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of gas costs.

name: AssetRecoveryDamagedPropertyCostsCurrent
standard_label: Asset Recovery Damaged Property Costs, Current (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the reserved funds established by a utility from customer payments to cover the repair costs of damages from major storms, which repairs are expected to be incurred within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: AssetRecoveryDamagedPropertyCostsNoncurrent
standard_label: Asset Recovery Damaged Property Costs, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the reserved funds established by a utility from customer payments to cover the repair costs of damages from major storms, which repairs are expected to be incurred beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: AssetReportingCurrencyDenominatedValue
standard_label: Asset, Reporting Currency Denominated, Value
documentation: The reporting currency-denominated asset value.

name: AssetRetirementObligation
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation
documentation: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

name: AssetRetirementObligationAbstract
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation [Abstract]

name: AssetRetirementObligationAccretionExpense
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
documentation: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

name: AssetRetirementObligationCashPaidToSettle
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Cash Paid to Settle
documentation: Amount of cash paid during the period to settle an asset retirement obligation. Amounts paid to settle an asset retirement obligation are generally included in the operating section of the Statement of Cash Flows.

name: AssetRetirementObligationCostsMember
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation Costs [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs for the retirement of long-lived assets.

name: AssetRetirementObligationCurrent
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
documentation: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

name: AssetRetirementObligationDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation Disclosure [Abstract]

name: AssetRetirementObligationDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for an asset retirement obligation and the associated long-lived asset. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

name: AssetRetirementObligationFairValueNotEstimable
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Fair Value, Not Estimable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether fair value of asset retirement obligation cannot be reasonably estimated.

name: AssetRetirementObligationForeignCurrencyTranslation
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the Increase or Decrease in the amount of asset retirement obligations for the period associated with foreign currency translation (to the extent that the entity accounts for the foreign currency effects as a separate component of the change in the liability).

name: AssetRetirementObligationForeignCurrencyTranslationGainLoss
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) asset retirement obligations.

name: AssetRetirementObligationLegallyRestrictedAssetsFairValue
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Legally Restricted Assets, Fair Value
documentation: Carrying amount of an asset that is legally restricted for purposes of settling an asset retirement obligation.

name: AssetRetirementObligationLiabilitiesIncurred
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
documentation: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

name: AssetRetirementObligationLiabilitiesSettled
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
documentation: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

name: AssetRetirementObligationPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset retirement obligations.

name: AssetRetirementObligationRevisionOfEstimate
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Revision of Estimate
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset retirement obligation from changes in the amount or timing of the estimated cash flows associated with the settlement of the obligation.

name: AssetRetirementObligationRollForwardAnalysisRollForward
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Roll Forward Analysis [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: AssetRetirementObligationsAndEnvironmentalCostPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation and Environmental Cost [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for legal obligation associated with retirement of long-lived asset that results from acquisition, construction, or development or from normal operation of long-lived asset, and environmental remediation liability from improper or other-than-normal operation of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, timing of recognition and whether obligation is measured on discounted basis.

name: AssetRetirementObligationsDescription
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Description
documentation: A general description of the asset retirement obligations and the associated long-lived assets. Description may include the terms of the legal restriction.

name: AssetRetirementObligationsLiabilityNotRecognized
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Liability Not Recognized (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Description of an asset retirement obligation for which a liability has not been recognized because fair value cannot be reasonably estimated and the reasons why fair value cannot be reasonably estimated.

name: AssetRetirementObligationsNoncurrent
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
documentation: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

name: AssetRetirementObligationsNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: AssetRetirementObligationsPolicy
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligation [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for legal obligation associated with retirement of long-lived asset that results from acquisition, construction, or development or from normal operation of long-lived asset. Excludes environmental remediation liability from improper or other-than-normal operation of long-lived asset, obligation arising in connection with leased property that meets definition of lease payments or variable lease payments and from plan to sell or otherwise dispose of a long-lived ass

name: AssetRetirementObligationsSignificantChanges
standard_label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Significant Changes (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of the significant increases or decreases in the carrying amount of the asset retirement obligation during the period, such as changes in significant assumptions used to calculate the carrying amount of the asset retirement obligation.

name: AssetUnderConstructionMember
standard_label: Asset under Construction [Member]
documentation: Asset in process of being built.

name: Assets
standard_label: Assets
documentation: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

name: AssetsAbstract
standard_label: Assets [Abstract]

name: AssetsAndAssociatedLiabilitiesAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowingsByTypeAxis
standard_label: Assets and Associated Liabilities Accounted for as Secured Borrowings by Type [Axis] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The carrying amount and classification of assets and liabilities recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

name: AssetsAndAssociatedLiabilitiesOfTransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowingsLineItems
standard_label: Assets and Associated Liabilities of Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: AssetsAndLiabilitiesLesseeAbstract
standard_label: Assets and Liabilities, Lessee [Abstract]

name: AssetsAndLiabilitiesLessorAbstract
standard_label: Assets and Liabilities, Lessor [Abstract]

name: AssetsAverageOutstanding
standard_label: Assets, Average Outstanding
documentation: Average amount outstanding of interest-earning and noninterest-earning assets.

name: AssetsAverageOutstandingAbstract
standard_label: Assets, Average Outstanding [Abstract]

name: AssetsCurrent
standard_label: Assets, Current
documentation: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

name: AssetsCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Assets, Current [Abstract]

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlock
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block
documentation: The sum of cash, cash equivalents, investments and other assets allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockAbstract
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block [Abstract]

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockAccruedInvestmentIncome
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Accrued Investment Income
documentation: Amount of accrued investment income held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockCashAndCashEquivalents
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Cash and Cash Equivalents
documentation: Cash and highly liquid, safe investments that can be readily converted into cash (cash equivalents) allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockDeferredTaxAssetNet
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Deferred Tax Asset, Net
documentation: Amount, after valuation allowance and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset pertaining to the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockEquitySecuritiesAtFairValue
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Equity Securities, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of equity securities allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockEquitySecuritiesAvailableForSaleAtFairValue
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Equity Securities, Available-for-Sale, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Fair value of equity securities designated as available for sale, which are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockFixedMaturitiesHeldToMaturityAtAmortizedCost
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Fixed Maturities, Held-to-Maturity, at Amortized Cost
documentation: Carrying amount of investments in debt securities that are deemed to be held to maturity that are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockFixedMaturityAvailableForSaleAtFairValue
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Fixed Maturity, Available-for-Sale, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of investments in debt securities that are deemed to be available for sale that are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block. Change in fair of such securities is a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockIncomeTaxReceivable
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Income Tax Receivable
documentation: Amount of tax refunds receivable held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockInvestments
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Investments
documentation: Amount of investments held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Investments [Abstract]

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockMortgageLoansOnRealEstate
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Mortgage Loans on Real Estate
documentation: Carrying amount of investments in mortgage loans on real estate allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockOtherClosedBlockAssets
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Closed Block Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Other assets allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockOtherClosedBlockAssets1
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Closed Block Assets
documentation: Amount of other assets held by the closed block. Excludes other investments.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockOtherInvestments
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Investments
documentation: Amount of other investments held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockOtherInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Investments [Abstract]

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockOtherLongTermInvestments
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Long-Term Investments
documentation: Amount of other long-term investments held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockOtherShortTermInvestments
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Short-Term Investments
documentation: Amount of other short-term investments held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockPolicyLoans
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Policy Loans
documentation: Carrying amount of loans to policy holders secured by benefits under insurance policies that are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockPremiumsAndOtherReceivablesNet
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Premiums and Other Receivables, Net
documentation: Amount, after the allowance for doubtful accounts, of premium and other receivables held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockRealEstate
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Real Estate
documentation: Real estate investments allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockShortTermInvestments
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Short-Term Investments
documentation: Short-term investments allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockTradingSecuritiesDebt
standard_label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Trading Securities, Debt
documentation: Amount of investments in debt securities classified as trading that are held by the closed block.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionAssetNameDomain
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Asset Name [Domain] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The name of the long-lived asset disposed of in the current period.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionByAssetAxis
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition by Asset [Axis] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Represents the assets disposed of by a method other than sale, in the period of disposition.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionGainLossOnDisposition
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The loss or gain included in earnings during the period resulting from the disposal of an asset through a means other than through sale, such as abandonment, spin-off, and expropriation.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionGainLossOnDisposition1
standard_label: Long-Lived Asset, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Gain (Loss) from Disposal
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from disposal other than by sale of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange or distribution to owner in spinoff.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionIncomeStatementClassificationOfGainLossOnDisposal
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Income Statement Classification of Gain (Loss) on Disposal (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Where a reader of the financial statements can find the loss on disposal of the long-lived asset in the income statement or statement of operations. This disclosure is not needed if it is readily apparent on the face of the income statement where the loss on disposal is included.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionLineItems
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition [Line Items] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionMethodOfDisposal
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Method of Disposal (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: A detail of the method of disposition of the long-lived asset (for example, abandonment, distribution in a spin-off).

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionSegmentClassification
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Segment Classification (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The segment in which the disposed long-lived asset was previously reported. This is not applicable if an Entity has no reportable segments.

name: AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInPeriodOfDispositionTextBlock
standard_label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the disposed asset, the gain (loss) realized at the time of disposition of the asset and the income statement classification thereof, the method of disposal (for example, abandonment, distribution in a spin-off) and the segment classification of the disposed asset.

name: AssetsFairValueAdjustment
standard_label: Assets, Fair Value Adjustment
documentation: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an asset could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

name: AssetsFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

name: AssetsFairValueDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

name: AssetsFairValueDisclosureNonrecurring
standard_label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Nonrecurring (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the aggregate of the assets reported on the balance sheet at period end measured at fair value on a nonrecurring basis by the entity. This element is intended to be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements.

name: AssetsFairValueDisclosureRecurring
standard_label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Recurring (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the aggregate of the assets reported on the balance sheet at period end measured at fair value on a recurring basis by the entity. This element is intended to be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements.

name: AssetsHeldByInsuranceRegulators
standard_label: Assets Held by Insurance Regulators
documentation: Carrying amount of cash and investment securities on deposit with state regulatory authorities in connection with capital requirements.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleAtCarryingValue
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Represents the sum of the carrying value of all the Assets Held-for-Sale at the balance sheet date.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleAtCarryingValueAbstract
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, at Carrying Value [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: AssetsHeldForSaleCapitalLeasedAssetsNet
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Capital Leased Assets, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Property, net of accumulated depreciation and amortization, that was originally acquired subject to a financing arrangement classified as a capital lease for accounting and financial reporting purposes which is held for sale apart from normal operations and anticipated to be sold in less than one year.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleCurrent
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Current (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Current assets (normally turning over within one year or one business cycle if longer) that are held for sale apart from normal operations and anticipated to be sold within one year.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Current [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: AssetsHeldForSaleLongLived
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Long Lived (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Long-lived assets that are held for sale apart from normal operations and anticipated to be sold in less than one year.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleLongLivedAbstract
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Long Lived [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: AssetsHeldForSaleLongLivedFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Sale, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of assets classified as held for sale.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleMember
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale [Member] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Long lived assets, including, if applicable, disposal assets to be sold that meet the criteria for "held for sale" assets.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroup
standard_label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
documentation: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupAbstract
standard_label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group [Abstract]

name: AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupCurrent
standard_label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current
documentation: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current [Abstract]

name: AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupCurrentOther
standard_label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other, Current
documentation: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupOther
standard_label: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other
documentation: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

name: AssetsHeldForSaleOtherNoncurrent
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Other, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Other assets that are held for sale apart from normal operations, not otherwise included elsewhere in the taxonomy and which are anticipated to be sold in less than one year, but by their nature which are not considered current (originally classified based on not being realized or converted to working capital within one year of the date of the statement of financial position or operating cycle, if longer).

name: AssetsHeldForSalePropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Assets Held-for-sale, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Property, plant and equipment that is held for sale apart from normal operations and anticipated to be sold in less than one year.

name: AssetsHeldInTrust
standard_label: Asset, Held-in-Trust
documentation: The total amount of cash and securities held by third party trustees pursuant to terms of debt instruments or other agreements as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, which can be used by the trustee only to pay the noncurrent portion of specified obligations.

name: AssetsHeldInTrustAbstract
standard_label: Asset, Held-in-Trust [Abstract]

name: AssetsHeldInTrustCurrent
standard_label: Asset, Held-in-Trust, Current
documentation: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate within one year of the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

name: AssetsHeldInTrustNoncurrent
standard_label: Asset, Held-in-Trust, Noncurrent
documentation: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate more than one year from the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

name: AssetsHeldUnderCapitalLeasesMember
standard_label: Assets Held under Capital Leases [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Long lived property, plant or equipment assets held by a lessee through a capital lease arrangement.

name: AssetsLeasedToOthersMember
standard_label: Assets Leased to Others [Member] (Deprecated 2021)
documentation: Long lived, depreciable property, plant or equipment held for lease to others under contractual agreements meeting the criteria for operating lease classification.

name: AssetsMember
standard_label: Assets [Member]
documentation: Asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

name: AssetsNeededForImmediateSettlementAggregateFairValue
standard_label: Assets Needed for Immediate Settlement, Aggregate Fair Value
documentation: The aggregate fair value of assets needed to immediately settle the derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

name: AssetsNet
standard_label: Net Assets
documentation: Amount of net assets (liabilities).

name: AssetsNetAbstract
standard_label: Net Assets [Abstract] (Deprecated 2023)

name: AssetsNoncurrent
standard_label: Assets, Noncurrent
documentation: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: AssetsNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Assets, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: AssetsNoncurrentOtherThanNoncurrentInvestmentsAndPropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Assets, Noncurrent, Other than Noncurrent Investments and Property, Plant and Equipment
documentation: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets, excluding property, plant, and equipment and other property and investments, that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. name: AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseLineItems

name: AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMarketValue

name: AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMaturityPeriodsAxis

documentation: Information by maturity period remaining for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements. Element name and standard label in Maturity [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] [date measure] [Member] or Maturity Greater Than [low end numeric value] [date measure] [Member] or Maturity Less Than [high end numeric value] [date measure] [Member] formats.

name: AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseRepurchaseLiability
standard_label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Repurchase Liability
documentation: Amount, including accrued interest, to be repaid to counterparty to repurchase agreement when carrying amount or market value if higher, of security or other asset sold under repurchase agreement exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

name: AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseTypeDomain
standard_label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Type [Domain]
documentation: This is the type of such assets (for example, US Treasury Obligations, US Government agency obligations and loans, and so forth). name: AssetsUnderManagementCarryingAmount

documentation: Liability as of the balance sheet date for the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims and claim adjustment expense relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date for those liabilities owed to another party as a result of assuming another insurer's primary obligation.

name: AssumedPremiumsEarned

name: AssumedPremiumsWrittenPropertyAndCasualty
standard_label: Assumed Premiums Written, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Premiums assumed for all property and casualty insurance assumed from other insurers as a result of reinsurance arrangements.

documentation: Amount of amortization income for leases with a finite life acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: BelowMarketLeaseAmortizationIncomeRollingYearThree
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Rolling Year Three
documentation: Amount of amortization income for leases with a finite life acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: BelowMarketLeaseAmortizationIncomeRollingYearTwo
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Rolling Year Two
documentation: Amount of amortization income for leases with a finite life acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: BelowMarketLeaseAmortizationIncomeYearFive
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Five
documentation: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: BelowMarketLeaseAmortizationIncomeYearFour
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Four
documentation: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: BelowMarketLeaseAmortizationIncomeYearThree
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Three
documentation: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: BelowMarketLeaseAmortizationIncomeYearTwo
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Two
documentation: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: BelowMarketLeaseFutureAmortizationIncomeTableTextBlock
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Future Amortization Income [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the amount of amortization income expected to be recorded in succeeding fiscal years for leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

name: BelowMarketLeaseGross
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Gross
documentation: Amount before amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

name: BelowMarketLeaseNet
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Net
documentation: Amount after amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

name: BelowMarketLeaseNetAbstract
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Net [Abstract]

name: BelowMarketLeaseNetAmortizationIncomeFiscalYearMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Net, Amortization Income, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: BelowMarketLeaseNetAmortizationIncomeRollingMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Net, Amortization Income, Rolling Maturity [Abstract]

name: BelowMarketLeasePeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Below Market Lease, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

name: BelowMarketLeaseRollForward
standard_label: Below Market Lease [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: BelowMarketLeasesMember
standard_label: Below Market Leases [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate.

name: BeneficialInterest
standard_label: Beneficial Interest Liability
documentation: Obligation reflecting another party's right to economic interests in another entity or trust under a contractual right. For example, an investor may purchase a beneficial interest in a securitization transaction.

name: BeneficialInterestSecuredByPrepayableFinancialInstrumentsLastOfLayerAmortizedCost
standard_label: Beneficial Interest, Portfolio Layer Method, Amortized Cost
documentation: Amortized cost of beneficial interest secured by financial instrument, used to designate hedging relationship in which hedged item is expected to be outstanding for designated hedge period.

name: BeneficialOwnerMember
standard_label: Beneficial Owner [Member]
documentation: Any person who, directly or indirectly, through any contract, arrangement, understanding, relationship, or otherwise has shares of the entity with 1) voting power which includes the power to vote, or to direct the voting of, such security, and/or 2) investment power which includes the power to dispose, or to direct the disposition of, such security.

name: BenefitClaimsInExcessOfRelatedPolicyholderBalances
standard_label: Benefit Claims in Excess of Related Policyholder Balances (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Expenses related to payments to policyholders that do not represent a return of policyholders balances.

name: BenefitsLossesAndExpenses
standard_label: Benefits, Losses and Expenses
documentation: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

name: BenefitsLossesAndExpensesAbstract
standard_label: Benefits, Losses and Expenses [Abstract]

name: BilledAndUnbilledContractClaimsSubjectToUncertaintyAbstract
standard_label: Billed and Unbilled Contract Claims Subject to Uncertainty [Abstract]

name: BilledContractReceivables
standard_label: Billed Contracts Receivable
documentation: Amounts due for billed services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the Company and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts billed to customers under contracts or programs but not paid as of the balance sheet date.

name: BilledRevenuesMember
standard_label: Billed Revenues [Member]
documentation: Billed amounts due for services rendered or products shipped. This element is distinct from Billed contracts receivables because this is based on noncontract transactions.

name: BillingsInExcessOfCost
standard_label: Billings in Excess of Cost
documentation: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method.

name: BillingsInExcessOfCostAbstract
standard_label: Billings in Excess of Cost [Abstract]

name: BillingsInExcessOfCostCurrent
standard_label: Billings in Excess of Cost, Current
documentation: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized within one year or one opera

name: BillingsInExcessOfCostNoncurrent
standard_label: Billings in Excess of Cost, Noncurrent
documentation: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized more than one year or one op

name: BinderCosts
standard_label: Binder Costs (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Cost of binder, a material used to bind aggregates, used during the reporting period. Usually bitumen and bitumen blends.

name: BinderSalesRevenue
standard_label: Binder Sales Revenue (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from sale of binder, a material used to bind bitumen or aggregates. One use of binders is as a component of hot rolled asphalt roadways.

name: BinomialModelMember
standard_label: Valuation Technique, Binomial Pricing Model [Member]
documentation: Valuation technique estimating price of option using binomial pricing model.

name: BlackScholesMertonModelMember
standard_label: Valuation Technique, Black-Scholes-Merton Model [Member]
documentation: Valuation technique estimating price of option using Black-Scholes-Merton model.

name: BoardMemberCompensationContractsMember
standard_label: Board Member Compensation Contracts [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Contracts securing the services of board members, which may define the period of employment, the nature of the business relationship, and the nondisclosure and noncompete restrictions.

name: BoardOfDirectorsChairmanMember
standard_label: Board of Directors Chairman [Member]
documentation: Leader of the entity's board of directors who presides over board meetings and other board activities. The chairman is often the chief executive officer as well, and in such a case would be the entity's highest ranking officer.

name: BondFutureMember
standard_label: Bond Future [Member]
documentation: Standardized contract to buy or sell a bond on a specified date at a predetermined price.

name: BondOptionMember
standard_label: Bond Option [Member]
documentation: Option contract in which the underlying asset is a bond.

name: BondsMember
standard_label: Bonds [Member]
documentation: Debt security, in which the authorized issuer owes the holder a debt and is obliged to repay the principal and interest (the coupon).

name: BorrowedFunds
standard_label: Borrowed Funds (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of all debt, including all short-term borrowings, long-term debt, collateralized financings, and capital lease obligations.

name: BorrowingsMember
standard_label: Borrowings [Member]
documentation: Obligations to pay to another in accordance with an expressed or implied agreement.

name: BorrowingsToFinanceLeveragedBuyout
standard_label: Borrowings to Finance Leveraged Buyout (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Total borrowings to finance leveraged buyout transaction.

name: BorrowingsToFinanceLeveragedBuyoutAbstract
standard_label: Borrowings to Finance Leveraged Buyout [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: BorrowingsUnderGuaranteedInvestmentAgreements
standard_label: Borrowings under Guaranteed Investment Agreements
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the obligations to contract holders to provide to them an agreed upon rate of return pursuant to the terms of the underlying contract. These contracts represent lending by the contract holders to the entity in return for a guaranteed (primarily fixed) interest rate until maturity, unless called earlier if the contracts provide that option to the contract holders (usually institutions). There is little or no insurance risk for the entity.

name: BreakpointDiscountRefund
standard_label: Breakpoint Discount Refund (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount of potential refunds due to customers from the sale of front-end loaded mutual funds, resulting from disbursement of inappropriate breakpoint discounts.

name: BreedingAndProductionAnimalsMember
standard_label: Breeding and Production Animals [Member]
documentation: Animals maintained to create offspring or to produce goods to be sold for profit.

name: BridgeLoan
standard_label: Bridge Loan
documentation: Short-Term financing which is expected to be paid back relatively quickly, such as by a subsequent longer-term loan. Also called swing loan or bridge financing.

name: BridgeLoanMember
standard_label: Bridge Loan [Member]
documentation: Financing which is expected to be replaced by a medium to long-term loan. The loan "bridges" the gap in time when otherwise no financing would be in place.

name: BroadcastersLicenseAgreementCommitmentsDescription
standard_label: Broadcasters License Agreement Commitments, Description
documentation: A description of the commitments for license agreements that have been executed but were not reported because they do not meet the conditions for recording a liability.

name: BrokerAndExpenseOffsetArrangementsAbstract
standard_label: Broker and Expense Offset Arrangements [Abstract]

name: BrokerDealerLiabilitiesAbstract

name: BrokerServiceArrangementExpenseIncrease
standard_label: Broker Service Arrangement, Expense, Increase
documentation: Amount of increase in expense that would have been incurred if paid for directly and not under broker service arrangement.

name: BrokerServiceArrangementExpenseIncreaseStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Broker Service Arrangement, Expense, Increase, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase in expense that would have been incurred if not under broker service arrangement and paid for directly.

name: BrokerageCommissionsRevenue
standard_label: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
documentation: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

name: BrokeredNaturalGasMarginCosts
standard_label: Brokered Natural Gas Margin Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Costs incurred in brokering natural gas, a result of buying and selling natural gas in back-to-back transactions, during the reporting period.

name: BrokeredNaturalGasMarginRevenue
standard_label: Brokered Natural Gas Margin Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue related to brokering natural gas. The entity realizes brokered margin as a result of buying and selling natural gas in back-to-back transactions.

name: BrokersAndDealersAbstract
standard_label: Brokers and Dealers [Abstract]

name: BrokersAndDealersDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Broker-Dealer Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for financial services, specifically for brokers and dealers, for the accounting period and at the balance sheet date. name: BuildingAndBuildingImprovementsMember
standard_label: Building and Building Improvements [Member]
documentation: Facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities and any addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, for example, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

name: BuildingImprovementsMember
standard_label: Building Improvements [Member]
documentation: Addition, improvement, or renovation to a facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities.

name: BuildingMember
standard_label: Building [Member]
documentation: Facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities.

name: BuildingsAndImprovementsGross
standard_label: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
documentation: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

name: BusinessAcquisitionAcquireeDomain

name: BusinessAcquisitionAxis
standard_label: Business Combination [Axis]
documentation: Information by business combination or series of individually immaterial business combinations.

name: BusinessAcquisitionContingentConsiderationAccountingTreatment
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, Accounting Treatment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of the accounting treatment that will be followed if the contingency occurs.

name: BusinessAcquisitionContingentConsiderationAtFairValue
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fair value, as of the acquisition date, of potential payments under the contingent consideration arrangement including cash and shares.

name: BusinessAcquisitionContingentConsiderationAtFairValueCurrent
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, at Fair Value, Current (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Current portion of the fair value as of the acquisition date of potential payments under the contingent consideration arrangement, including cash and shares as applicable.

name: BusinessAcquisitionContingentConsiderationAtFairValueNoncurrent
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, at Fair Value, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Noncurrent portion of the fair value as of the acquisition date of potential payments under the contingent consideration arrangement, including cash and shares as applicable.

standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: BusinessAcquisitionContingentConsiderationPotentialCashPayment
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, Potential Cash Payment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of potential cash payments that could result from the contingent consideration arrangement.

name: BusinessAcquisitionContingentConsiderationSharesIssuable
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, Shares Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Maximum number of shares issuable under the contingent consideration arrangement in a business combination.

standard_label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, Shares Issuable, Description (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of the potential shares that are issuable under a contingent consideration arrangement.

documentation: Amount of cash paid to acquire the entity.

standard_label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Description of Purchase Price Components (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of the components of the costs of a business acquisition and the basis for determining value assigned to the components (including carryover basis ascribed to securities issued in a leveraged buy-out transaction). For example, cash paid to shareholders of acquired entity, fair value of debt and equity securities issued to shareholders of acquired entity, and transaction costs paid to third parties.

name: BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The acquisition-date fair value of the equity interests of the acquirer, including the number of instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

name: BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityLiabilitiesIncurred
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Liabilities Incurred (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityOtherNoncashConsideration

name: BusinessAcquisitionCostOfAcquiredEntityPlannedRestructuringActivities
standard_label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Planned Restructuring Activities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the acquisition costs expected to be expended for restructuring activities for the acquired entity. standard_label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Purchase Price (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: BusinessAcquisitionEquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableValueAssigned

documentation: The entire disclosure for cost incurred and expensed by acquirer in connection with business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, business and system integration-related, employee-related, restructuring, and other related costs.

documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: BusinessAcquisitionNameOfAcquiredEntity

documentation: Name of acquiree in business combination.

standard_label: Business Combination, Voting Equity Interest Acquired, Percentage
documentation: Percentage of voting equity interest acquired in business combination.

name: BusinessAcquisitionPeriodResultsIncludedInCombinedEntity

documentation: Description of the period for which the results of operations of the acquired entity are included in the income statement of the combined entity.

documentation: Period when results of operations of the acquired entity are included in the income statement of the combined entity, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

documentation: Income (expense) and gain (loss) recognized from the settlement of a preexisting relationship between the acquirer and the acquiree.

name: BusinessAcquisitionProFormaEarningsPerShareBasic
standard_label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
