documentation: Indicates measurement input for fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date in business combination when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

name: BusinessCombinationAcquisitionOfLessThan100PercentNoncontrollingInterestFairValueValuationTechniqueExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquisition of Less than 100 Percent, Noncontrolling Interest, Fair Value, Valuation Technique [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates valuation technique used to measure fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date in business combination when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

name: BusinessCombinationAcquisitionOfLessThan100PercentNoncontrollingInterestSignificantInputs
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquisition of Less than 100 Percent, Noncontrolling Interest, Significant Inputs (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: This item represents the significant inputs, including any assumptions, used by management to estimate the fair value of the noncontrolling interest in the acquiree at the acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationAcquisitionOfLessThan100PercentNoncontrollingInterestValuationTechnique
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquisition of Less than 100 Percent, Noncontrolling Interest, Valuation Technique (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value of the noncontrolling interest in the acquiree at the acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquisition-Related Cost, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and general administrative cost, including cost of maintaining internal acquisition department.

name: BusinessCombinationAndAssetAcquisitionAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Asset Acquisition, Transaction between Entities under Common Control, and Joint Venture Formation [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognized
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Liability to Asset, Excess (Less), Fair Value
documentation: Amount of liability in excess of (less than) asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognizedAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Liability to Asset, Excess (Less), Fair Value [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognizedOtherThanAtFairValue
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Liability to Asset, Excess (Less), Other than at Fair Value
documentation: Amount of liability in excess of (less than) asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognizedOtherThanAtFairValueAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Liability to Asset, Excess (Less), Other than at Fair Value [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesDescription
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Description
documentation: Description of nature and measurement basis of asset and liability arising from contingency in business combination, recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsAndLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesNoAmountRecognized
standard_label: Business Combination, Assets and Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, No Amount Recognized (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: This element represents an explanation why, if no amount of assets acquired and liabilities assumed arising from contingencies was recognized.

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognized
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Asset Acquired, Fair Value
documentation: Amount of asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationAssetsArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognizedOtherThanAtFairValue
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Asset Acquired, Other than at Fair Value
documentation: Amount of asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseGainRecognizedAmount
standard_label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
documentation: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

name: BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseGainRecognizedAmountFinancialStatementCaption
standard_label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount, Financial Statement Caption (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the income statement line item in which the gain has been recognized.

name: BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseGainRecognizedDescription
standard_label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Description
documentation: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents a description of the reasons why the transaction resulted in a gain.

name: BusinessCombinationBargainPurchaseGainRecognizedStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain from bargain purchase in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the acquisition-date fair value of the total consideration transferred which consists of the sum of the acquisition-date fair values of the assets transferred by the acquirer, the liabilities incurred by the acquirer to former owners of the acquiree, and the equity interests issued by the acquirer.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred
documentation: Amount of consideration transferred, consisting of acquisition-date fair value of assets transferred by the acquirer, liabilities incurred by the acquirer, and equity interest issued by the acquirer.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interest
documentation: Amount of equity interests of the acquirer, including instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredIncludingEquityInterestInAcquireeHeldPriorToCombination
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Including Equity Interest in Acquiree Held Prior to Combination (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the sum of the: (1) acquisition-date fair value of the total consideration transferred which consists of the sum of the acquisition-date fair values of the assets transferred by the acquirer, the liabilities incurred by the acquirer to former owners of the acquiree, and the equity interests issued by the acquirer and (2) the acquisition-date fair value of any equity interest in the acquiree held by the acquirer prior to the business combination (for example, a step acquis

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredIncludingEquityInterestInAcquireeHeldPriorToCombination1
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred and Preacquisition Equity Interest in Acquiree
documentation: Fair value at acquisition date of asset transferred, liability incurred, equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer, and equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages. Includes, but is not limited to, instrument or interest issued or issuable by acquirer.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredIncludingEquityInterestInAcquireeHeldPriorToCombinationAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred and Preacquisition Equity Interest in Acquiree [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredLiabilitiesIncurred
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Liabilities Incurred
documentation: Amount of liabilities incurred by the acquirer as part of consideration transferred in a business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredOther
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Other (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the acquisition-date fair value of any tangible or intangible assets, including a business or subsidiary of the acquirer, but excluding cash, transferred by the entity to the former owners of the acquire.

name: BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredOther1
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Tangible and Intangible Assets, Excluding Cash
documentation: Amount of tangible and intangible assets other than cash transferred by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, business or subsidiary, or both, of acquirer transferred to former owner of acquiree.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsAndIndemnificationAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements and Indemnification Assets [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsBasisForAmount
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Basis for Amount
documentation: For contingent consideration arrangements recognized in connection with a business combination, this element represents a description of the basis for determining the amount of the payment recorded.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Contingent Consideration [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationAsset
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the amount of any change, including any differences arising upon settlement, recognized during the reporting period in the value of an asset or assets, arising from an item of contingent consideration, recognized in a business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationAsset1
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Contingent Consideration, Asset, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of asset in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationLiability
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Liability (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the amount of any change, including any differences arising upon settlement, recognized during the reporting period in the value of a liability, arising from an item of contingent consideration, assumed in a business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInAmountOfContingentConsiderationLiability1
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Contingent Consideration, Liability, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination, including, but not limited to, difference arising upon settlement.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInTheRangeOfOutcomesContingentConsiderationLiabilityReasons
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Range of Outcomes, Reason
documentation: This element represents a description of the reasons causing an amount of any change recognized during the period in the estimated range of outcomes (undiscounted) of a liability assumed in a business combination arising from an item of contingent consideration.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInTheRangeOfOutcomesContingentConsiderationLiabilitySignificantInputs
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Range of Outcomes, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Significant Inputs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant inputs, including any assumptions, used by management to estimate the range of outcomes for a contingent liability assumed in a business combination for which a change in the range of outcomes has been recognized during the reporting period.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInTheRangeOfOutcomesContingentConsiderationLiabilityValuationTechnique
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Range of Outcomes, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Valuation Technique (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the range of outcomes for a liability assumed in a business combination arising from an item of contingent consideration for which a change in the range of outcomes has been recognized during the reporting period.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInTheRangeOfOutcomesContingentConsiderationLiabilityValueHigh
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Range of Outcomes, Liability, Maximum, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsChangeInTheRangeOfOutcomesContingentConsiderationLiabilityValueLow
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Change in Range of Outcomes, Liability, Minimum, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsDescription
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Description
documentation: Description of contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsRangeOfOutcomesInestimable
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Inestimable, Reason
documentation: Description of reason why undiscounted range of outcomes cannot be estimated in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsRangeOfOutcomesMaximumUnlimited
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Maximum Amount, Unlimited
documentation: For contingent consideration arrangements recognized in connection with a business combination, if the maximum (undiscounted) potential outcome is limitless, this element represents a statement of that fact.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsRangeOfOutcomesValueHigh
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Maximum, Amount
documentation: Maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationArrangementsRangeOfOutcomesValueLow
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Minimum, Amount
documentation: Minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationAsset
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset
documentation: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationAssetAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationAssetCurrent
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset, Current
documentation: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be realized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationAssetNoncurrent
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be realized beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiability
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability
documentation: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityChangeInValuationTechnique
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Change in Valuation Technique [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether valuation technique or approach changed for measuring liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityChangeInValuationTechniqueReasonExtensibleList
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Change in Valuation Technique, Reason [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates reason valuation technique or approach changed for measuring liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Current
documentation: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy of contingent consideration liability from business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityMeasurementInput
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Measurement Input
documentation: Value of input used to measure liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityMeasurementInputExtensibleList
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Measurement Input [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates measurement input for liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityNoncurrent
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of liability recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be settled beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityTypeExtensibleList
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityValuationTechniqueExtensibleList
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Valuation Technique [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates valuation technique for measuring liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationRangeOfOutcomesInestimable
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Inestimable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination is inestimable.

name: BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationRangeOfOutcomesMaximumAmountUnlimited
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Maximum Amount, Unlimited [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether maximum amount of payment in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination is unlimited.

name: BusinessCombinationControlObtainedDescription
standard_label: Business Combination, Control Obtained, Description
documentation: Description of how acquirer obtained control of acquiree in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationCostOfAcquiredEntityEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuableFairValueMethod
standard_label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interest, Fair Value Method
documentation: Description of method used to determine acquisition-date fair value of equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationDescriptionAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Description [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Business Combination [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationGoodwillAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Goodwill [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationGoodwillRecognizedDescription
standard_label: Business Combination, Goodwill, Description
documentation: This element represents a qualitative description of the factors that make up the goodwill recognized in a business combination, such as expected synergies by the entity to be derived from combining operations of the acquiree, intangible assets that do not qualify for separate recognition, and such other factors as may apply.

name: BusinessCombinationGoodwillRecognizedSegmentAllocation
standard_label: Business Combination, Goodwill Recognized, Segment Allocation (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents a narrative description of the segment to which recognized goodwill resulting from a business combination was assigned.

name: BusinessCombinationGoodwillReportingUnitAssignmentNotComplete
standard_label: Business Combination, Goodwill, Reporting Unit Assignment, Incomplete [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether assignment of goodwill to reporting unit in business combination is incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetRangeOfOutcomesInestimable
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Range of Outcomes, Inestimable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether undiscounted range of outcomes for indemnification asset in business combination is inestimable.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetRangeOfOutcomesMaximumAmountUnlimited
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Range of Outcomes, Maximum Amount, Unlimited [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether maximum amount of payment for indemnification asset in business combination is unlimited.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsAmountAsOfAcquisitionDate
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Acquisition Date, Amount
documentation: Amount of indemnification asset recognized at acquisition date in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsBasisForAmount
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Basis for Amount (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: For indemnification assets recognized in connection with a business combination, this element represents a description of the basis for determining the amount of the asset recorded.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsDescription
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Description
documentation: Description of indemnification arrangement, basis for determining amount of payment related to indemnification asset recognized at acquisition date in business combination, and reason why range of outcomes in indemnification arrangement cannot be estimated.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsRangeOfOutcomesInestimable
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Range of Outcomes, Inestimable (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: For indemnification assets recognized in connection with a business combination, if a range (undiscounted) of potential outcomes cannot be estimated, this element represents a statement of that fact and the reasons why a range cannot be estimated.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsRangeOfOutcomesMaximumUnlimited
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Range of Outcomes, Maximum Unlimited (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: For indemnification assets recognized in connection with a business combination, if the maximum (undiscounted) potential outcome is limitless, this element represents a statement of that fact.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsRangeOfOutcomesValueHigh
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Range of Outcomes, Maximum, Amount
documentation: Maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes for indemnification asset in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssetsRangeOfOutcomesValueLow
standard_label: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Range of Outcomes, Minimum, Amount
documentation: Minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes for indemnification asset in business combination.

name: BusinessCombinationIntegrationRelatedCosts
standard_label: Business Combination, Integration-Related Cost, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for integration-related cost incurred in connection with business combination. Includes system integration and conversion costs; severance and other employee-related costs; restructuring and other post-combination costs. Excludes acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination; cost to issue debt or equity securities; and cost related to acquisition of asset.

name: BusinessCombinationLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognized
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Liability Assumed, Fair Value
documentation: Amount of liability arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationLiabilitiesArisingFromContingenciesAmountRecognizedOtherThanAtFairValue
standard_label: Business Combination, Contingency Recognized at Acquisition Date, Liability Assumed, Other than at Fair Value
documentation: Amount of liability arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationMember
standard_label: Business Combination [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Qualitative information concerning a business combination which has occurred and thereby requires an eligible item to be measured at fair value at the time of the event but does not require fair value measurement at each reporting date after that, excluding the recognition of impairment under lower-of-cost-or market accounting or other-than-temporary impairment.

name: BusinessCombinationOrJointVentureFormationValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetEffectOnContributedCapitalIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Effect on Contributed Capital, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation allowance for deferred tax asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation, or both, and reported as adjustment to contributed capital. Excludes change in valuation allowance within measurement period.

name: BusinessCombinationOrJointVentureFormationValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetEffectOnGoodwillIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Effect on Goodwill, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation allowance for deferred tax asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation, or both, and reported as adjustment to goodwill. Excludes change in valuation allowance outside of measurement period.

name: BusinessCombinationPriceOfAcquisitionExpected
standard_label: Business Combination, Price of Acquisition, Expected
documentation: Purchase price of expected business acquisition prior to consideration being transferred. Excludes asset acquisition.

name: BusinessCombinationProFormaInformationAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: BusinessCombinationProFormaInformationDisclosureImpracticable
standard_label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Disclosure Impracticable, Explanation
documentation: Explanation of why disclosure of acquiree's revenue and earnings since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income for reporting period or other required pro forma disclosure information is impracticable.

name: BusinessCombinationProFormaInformationDisclosureImpracticable1
standard_label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Disclosure Impracticable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether disclosure of acquiree's revenue and earnings since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income for reporting period or other required pro forma disclosure information is impracticable.

name: BusinessCombinationProFormaInformationEarningsOrLossOfAcquireeSinceAcquisitionDateActual
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquiree's Earnings (Loss) since Acquisition Date, Actual
documentation: Amount of acquiree's earnings (loss) since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

name: BusinessCombinationProFormaInformationIncompleteInitialAccounting
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquisition Date after Reporting Period, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Description
documentation: Description of initial accounting for business combination that is incomplete when business combination occurs after reporting date and before financial statements are issued or issuable. Includes, but is not limited to, description of disclosure that cannot be made and reason why initial accounting for business combination is incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProFormaInformationRevenueOfAcquireeSinceAcquisitionDateActual
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquiree's Revenue since Acquisition Date, Actual
documentation: Amount of acquiree's revenue since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentConsiderationTransferred
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Consideration Transferred
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to items of consideration transferred in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentEquityInterests
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Equity Interests
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to equity interests acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentFinancialAssets
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Assets
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial assets acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentFinancialLiabilities
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Liabilities
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial liabilities assumed in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentIntangibles
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Intangibles
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to intangibles acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentInventory
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Inventory
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to inventory acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentPropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Property, Plant, and Equipment
documentation: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to property, plant, and equipment acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentsAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustments [Abstract]

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteAdjustmentsRelatedToPreviousPeriod
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustments Related to Previous Period
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in income that would have been recognized in previous periods if the adjustments to provisional amounts were recognized as of the acquisition date.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteItems
standard_label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Items
documentation: This element represents a statement of which of the assets, liabilities, equity interests, recognized in the financial statements or items of consideration transferred for which the initial accounting is incomplete in connection with a business combination occurring during the period.

name: BusinessCombinationProvisionalInformationInitialAccountingIncompleteNatureOfAdjustments

standard_label: Class of Warrant or Right, Title of Security Warrants or Rights Outstanding (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This item provides the title of issue of securities called for by warrants or rights outstanding.

name: ClassOfWarrantOrRightUnissued

documentation: The number of warrants or rights which entitle the entity to receive future services in exchange for the unvested, forfeitable warrants or rights.

name: ClassificationOfInstitutionCreditUnions
standard_label: Classification of Institution, Credit Unions (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of whether the institution meets the definition of a complex credit union as defined by the National Credit Union Administration.

name: ClassificationOfVariableInterestEntityDomain
standard_label: Variable Interest Entity, Classification [Domain] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Categorization of Variable Interest Entities (VIE) for consolidation and (or) disclosure purposes, whether individually or in aggregate, by: (1) VIEs consolidated because the entity is the primary beneficiary, (2) VIEs not consolidated because the entity is not the primary beneficiary, and (3) VIEs or potential VIEs that are not consolidated because necessary information is not available. name: ClearanceFees
standard_label: Clearance Fees
documentation: The amount of expense in the period for clearance fees.

name: ClearanceFeesMember
standard_label: Clearance Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fees paid to clearing brokers for equity transactions, transaction fees paid to NASDAQ and other exchanges and regulatory bodies, and execution fees paid to third parties, primarily for executing trades on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") and other exchanges, and for executing orders through third party.

name: ClearingFeesRevenue
standard_label: Clearing Fees Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from clearing fees. Clearing fees are charged by an exchange for each contract and trade cleared. There are also clearing fees associated with deliveries, creation of a futures position resulting from an option exercise or assignment, Exchange for Physicals (EFP), block trades, transfer trades and adjustments.

name: ClearingServiceMember
standard_label: Clearing Service [Member]
documentation: Matching of all buy and sell orders to reconcile transactions, ensure delivery of order and record transfer of funds. Includes, but is not limited to, delivery and creation of futures position from option exercise or assignment, Exchange for Physicals (EFP), block trades and transfer trades.

name: ClosedBlockAccountingPolicy
standard_label: Closed Block Accounting Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for defined, limited group of policies and defined set of assets governed by set of operating rules to preserve reasonable dividend expectation of individual policyholder with individual life, health, and annuity policies for which dividends are currently being paid or are expected to be paid under current dividend scale.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: A presentation of assets and liabilities for an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block) established as a way to protect the interests of preexisting policyholders from the competing interests of the stockholders. Typically presented as a table.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesAbstract

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesChangeInPolicyholderDividendObligation
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Change in Policyholder Dividend Obligation
documentation: For the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block, the change in the period in the obligation representing amounts to be distributed to policyholders owning contracts in the closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesDisclosures
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Disclosures (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: A schedule reflecting the liabilities of the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block and the assets allocated to the closed block, along with the assets backing them (known as a closed block) established as a way to protect the interests of preexisting policyholders from the competing interests of the stockholders assets, including all assets and liabilities, the net liability balance, any adjustments for net liability amounts re

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesEffectOnOtherComprehensiveIncome
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Effect on Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
documentation: The increase or decrease in the period in other comprehensive income within the closed block comprised of the change in (a) dividend obligation to policyholders of the closed block, and (b) unrealized gain (loss) on available for sale securities allocated to the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesEffectOnOtherComprehensiveIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Effect on Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesMaximumFutureEarningsToBeRecognized
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized
documentation: The carrying amount of closed block liabilities in excess of the carrying amount of closed block assets at the date of demutualization (adjusted to eliminate the impact of related amounts in accumulated other comprehensive income).

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesMaximumFutureEarningsToBeRecognizedAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesMaximumFutureEarningsToBeRecognizedOtherAdjustments
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized, Other Adjustments
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) for other adjustments to closed block's maximum future earnings.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesMaximumFutureEarningsToBeRecognizedPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of closed block liabilities in excess of closed block assets at the date of demutualization.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesMaximumFutureEarningsToBeRecognizedRollForward
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities, Maximum Future Earnings to be Recognized [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: ClosedBlockAssetsAndLiabilitiesTableTextBlock
standard_label: Closed Block Assets and Liabilities [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Tabular disclosure of assets and liabilities for an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block).

name: ClosedBlockDescription
standard_label: Closed Block, Description
documentation: A general description of the insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block) established as a way to protect the interests of preexisting policyholders from the competing interests of the stockholders. The description might include the purpose of the closed block, the types of insurance policies included in the closed block, the nature of cash flows that increase and decrease the asse

name: ClosedBlockDescriptionOfMethodOfEmergenceOfEarnings
standard_label: Closed Block Description of Method of Emergence of Earnings
documentation: Description of the method of emergence of earnings from the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Disclosure [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Closed Block Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure pertaining to the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligation
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the excess of the cumulative actual closed block earnings over the cumulative expected (actuarially determined) closed block earnings for the period from the actuarial calculation date to the date of measurement. The excess will result in future dividends to closed block policyholders, unless offset by less favorable than expected future performance of the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligationAssumptions
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Assumptions (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Methodology and assumptions underlying the calculations of the excess of the cumulative actual closed block earnings over the expected (actuarially determined) closed block earnings for the period. The excess will result in future dividends to closed block policyholders, unless offset by less favorable than expected future performance of the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligationChangeInUnrealizedInvestmentGainsLosses
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Change in Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the closed block dividend obligation from the unrealized gain (loss) on investments allocated to the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligationEffectOfOperatingResults
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Effect of Operating Results (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The effect on the dividends to policyholders of the net results of operations (premiums less allocated expenses) for the period of the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligationIncreaseDecreaseForEffectOfOperatingResults
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Effect of Operating Results
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the closed block dividend obligation from the effect on dividends to policyholders on the net results of operations for the period of the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligationPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the policyholder dividend obligation attributable to closed block liabilities.

name: ClosedBlockDividendObligationTableTextBlock
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the changes in the closed block policyholder dividend obligation.

name: ClosedBlockInvestmentsAvailableForSaleChangeInUnrealizedAppreciation
standard_label: Closed Block Investments, Available-for-Sale, Change in Unrealized Appreciation
documentation: The net increase or decrease in the period in the fair value of the fixed maturity and equity investments designated as available for sale as of the balance sheet date that were allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as a closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

name: ClosedBlockInvestmentsFixedMaturityAvailableForSaleAmortizedCost
standard_label: Closed Block Investments, Fixed Maturity, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost
documentation: The amortized cost as of the balance sheet date of those fixed maturity investments designated as available for sale and reported at fair value which are allocated to the closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

name: ClosedBlockLiabilities
standard_label: Closed Block Liabilities
documentation: For the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets backing them (known as a closed block), the total of future policy benefits, policyholder account balance, policyholder dividend obligation and any other closed block liabilities.

name: ClosedBlockLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Liabilities [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockLiabilitiesFuturePolicyBenefitsAndPolicyholderAccountBalances
standard_label: Closed Block Liabilities, Future Policy Benefits and Policyholder Account Balances
documentation: The liability as of the balance sheet date for future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and expenses, less the present value of future net premiums payable under the insurance contracts and the policy cash accumulations, for the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as a closed block.

name: ClosedBlockLiabilitiesOtherClosedBlockLiabilities
standard_label: Closed Block Liabilities, Other Closed Block Liabilities
documentation: Amount of liabilities allocated to the closed block, classified as other.

name: ClosedBlockLiabilitiesOtherPolicyholderFunds
standard_label: Closed Block Liabilities, Other Policyholder Funds
documentation: Amount of closed block policyholder funds held, which are refundable.

name: ClosedBlockLiabilitiesPolicyholderDividendObligation
standard_label: Closed Block Dividend Obligation
documentation: The liability as of the balance sheet date for the excess of the cumulative actual closed block earnings over the cumulative expected (actuarially determined) closed block earnings (each) for the period from the actuarial calculation date to the date of measurement. The excess will result in future dividends to closed block policyholders, unless offset by less favorable than expected future performance of the closed block. name: ClosedBlockLiabilitiesPolicyholderDividendsPayable
standard_label: Closed Block Liabilities, Policyholder Dividends Payable
documentation: Amount of dividends payable as of the balance sheet date to policyholders of contracts in the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsAfterTaxResultsFromContinuingOperations
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, after Tax Results from Continuing Operations
documentation: Amount after tax of closed block income from continuing operations.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsAfterTaxResultsFromContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, after Tax Results from Continuing Operations [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockOperationsBenefitsAndExpense
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Benefits and Expense
documentation: Amount of benefits, claims and expenses that are related to an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block). Includes, but is not limited to, death benefits, matured endowments, participating dividends, general expenses and deferred acquisition costs related to the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsBenefitsAndExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Benefits and Expense [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockOperationsChangeInPolicyholderBenefitsAndInterestCreditedToPolicyholderAccountBalances
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Change in Policyholder Benefits and Interest Credited to Policyholder Account Balances
documentation: Difference between prior period and current period estimated policy claims and interest due to and designated to policies in an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block).

name: ClosedBlockOperationsChangeInPolicyholderDividendObligation
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Change in Policyholder Dividend Obligation (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Difference between prior period and current period policyholder dividend obligation designated to policies in an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block).

name: ClosedBlockOperationsIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTax
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a disposal group, which is allocated to the operations of the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Income Taxes
documentation: The amount of income tax expense or benefit allocated to the operations of the closed block for the period.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsNetInvestmentIncome
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Net Investment Income
documentation: Income for the period from the investments allocated to an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts (known as a closed block), net of investment expenses, which are typically reported in a table of closed block operations.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsNetResults
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Net Results
documentation: Amount of net income (loss) from operations of the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsNetResultsAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Net Results [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockOperationsNetResultsTableTextBlock
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Net Results [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the closed block operations.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsOtherExpense
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Other Expense
documentation: Amount of expense classified as other allocated to the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsOtherRevenue
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Other Revenue
documentation: Amount of revenue classified as other allocated to the closed block.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsPolicyholderBenefits
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Policyholder Benefits
documentation: An expense for the period for estimated policy claims in an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block), as typically reported in a table of closed block operations as part of summarized financial data.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsPolicyholderDividends
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Policyholder Dividends
documentation: An expense for the period representing distributions paid or accrued for the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block), which may be presented in a table of closed block operations as part of summarized financial data.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsPremiums
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Premiums
documentation: For the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block), revenue for the period from insurance policy premiums; typically included in a table of closed block operations.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsRealizedInvestmentGainsLosses
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
documentation: Gains and losses realized for the period from the investments allocated to an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts (known as a closed block).

name: ClosedBlockOperationsResultsBeforeIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Results before Income Taxes
documentation: The revenues less expenses from operations of the closed block during the period, before income taxes allocated thereto.

name: ClosedBlockOperationsResultsBeforeIncomeTaxesAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Results before Income Taxes [Abstract]

name: ClosedBlockOperationsRevenue
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Revenue
documentation: Total revenues from an insurance company's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block).

name: ClosedBlockOperationsRevenueAbstract
standard_label: Closed Block Operations, Revenue [Abstract]

standard_label: Closed Block Policyholder Dividend Obligation
documentation: An insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets allocated to them (known as a closed block) established as a way to protect the interests of preexisting policyholders from the competing interests of the stockholders. name: ClosedBlockTermsOfOperation
standard_label: Closed Block Terms of Operation
documentation: A general outline of the operations of an insurance entity's segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts along with the assets backing them (known as a closed block) established as a way to protect the interests of preexisting policyholders from the competing interests of the entity's stockholders. Includes liabilities attributable to and assets allocated to the closed block, the use of cash flows from the closed block, and the operating rules established for the

name: ClosedPortfolioAndBeneficialInterestLastOfLayerAmortizedCost
standard_label: Financial Asset, Closed Portfolio and Beneficial Interest, Portfolio Layer Method, Amortized Cost
documentation: Amortized cost of closed portfolio of financial asset and beneficial interest secured by financial instrument, used to designate hedging relationship in which hedged item is expected to be outstanding for designated hedge period.

name: ClosedPortfolioAndBeneficialInterestLastOfLayerAmortizedCostAbstract
standard_label: Financial Asset, Closed Portfolio and Beneficial Interest, Portfolio Layer Method, Amortized Cost [Abstract]

name: CoVenturerMember

documentation: Amount of obligation for medical and death benefits to be provided under Coal Industry Retiree Health Benefit Act of 1992.

name: CoalIndustryRetireeHealthBenefitActOf1992ImpactOfAct

name: CoalIndustryRetireeHealthBenefitActOf1992MethodOfAccountingAdopted

documentation: Description of method of accounting adopted for obligation to provide medical and death benefits under Coal Industry Retiree Health Benefit Act of 1992.

name: CoalProductsAndServicesRevenue
standard_label: Coal Products and Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: CoalSupplyAgreementObligationNoncurrent

documentation: Noncurrent liability of coal supply agreement.

name: CoalSupplyAgreementsMember
standard_label: Coal Supply Agreements [Member]
documentation: Coal supply agreement under which an entity buys coal to meet the requirements of one of its facilities.

name: CollaborativeArrangementAccountingPolicy

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for collaborative arrangements.

name: CollaborativeArrangementCopromotionMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Co-promotion [Member] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Contractual arrangement involving the promotion of products jointly developed, manufactured, marketed, or otherwise in which both the entity and its partner: (i) actively participate in the joint operating activity and (ii) are exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.

name: CollaborativeArrangementDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for collaborative arrangements in which the entity is a participant, including a) information about the nature and purpose of such arrangements; b) its rights and obligations thereunder; c) the accounting policy for collaborative arrangements; and d) the income statement classification and amounts attributable to transactions arising from the collaborative arrangement between participants.

name: CollaborativeArrangementIncomeStatementClassification
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Income Statement Classification (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The income statement assertion in which amounts related to collaborative arrangements, including co-promotion agreements and similar collaborative arrangement amounts are included.

name: CollaborativeArrangementMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Contractual arrangement that involves two or more parties that both: (i) actively participate in a joint operating activity and (ii) are exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.

name: CollaborativeArrangementNatureAndPurpose
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Nature and Purpose
documentation: Description of nature and purpose of collaborative arrangements.

standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Product, Aggregated Disclosure [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: CollaborativeArrangementProductAgreementMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Product [Member] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: A specific collaborative arrangement in which the entity provides product it manufactures to collaborative arrangement partners. A collaborative arrangement is a contractual arrangement with a specific party or parties that both: (i) actively participate in a joint operating activity and (ii) is (are) exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.

name: CollaborativeArrangementProductMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Product [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Collaborative arrangement to which the entity provides product it manufactures to collaborative arrangement partners. A collaborative arrangement is a contractual arrangement that involves two or more parties that both: (i) actively participate in a joint operating activity and (ii) are exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.

name: CollaborativeArrangementRightsAndObligations
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Rights and Obligations
documentation: Description of rights and obligations under the collaborative arrangements.

name: CollaborativeArrangementTransactionStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes revenue from collaborative arrangement. Excludes revenue from contract with customer under Topic 606.

name: CollaborativeArrangementTransactionWithPartyToCollaborativeArrangementAndThirdPartyMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Transaction with Party to Collaborative Arrangement and Third Party [Member]
documentation: Collaborative arrangement transaction between party to collaborative arrangement and third party.

name: CollaborativeArrangementTransactionWithPartyToCollaborativeArrangementMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement, Transaction with Party to Collaborative Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Collaborative arrangement transaction between parties to collaborative arrangement.

name: CollaborativeArrangementsAndNoncollaborativeArrangementTransactionsAxis

name: CollaborativeArrangementsAndNoncollaborativeArrangementTransactionsLineItems
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangement and Arrangement Other than Collaborative [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: CollaborativeArrangementsAndNoncollaborativeArrangementTransactionsMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangements and Non-collaborative Arrangement Transactions [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The collective collaborative arrangements, which are contractual arrangements with a party or parties that both: (i) actively participate in a joint operating activity and (ii) is (are) exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity and all other non-collaborative arrangement transactions.

name: CollaborativeArrangementsCopromotionAgreementAggregatedDisclosureMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangements, Co-promotion Agreement, Aggregated Disclosure [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Specific contractual arrangements for the promotion of products jointly developed, manufactured, marketed, or otherwise that are disclosed in aggregate, if reporting such arrangements with each party would not provide more useful information. The parties to the aggregated contractual arrangements both: (i) actively participate in a joint operating activity and (ii) are exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.

name: CollaborativeArrangementsCopromotionAgreementAgreementMember
standard_label: Collaborative Arrangements, Co-promotion Agreement, Agreement [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A specific contractual arrangement for the promotion of product jointly developed, manufactured, marketed, or otherwise in which both the entity and its partner or partners: (i) actively participate in the joint operating activity and (ii) is (are) exposed to significant risks and rewards that depend on the commercial success of the joint operating activity.

name: CollateralAlreadyPostedAggregateFairValue
standard_label: Collateral Already Posted, Aggregate Fair Value
documentation: The aggregate fair value of assets that are already posted, at the end of the reporting period, as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features.

name: CollateralAxis

documentation: Information by category of collateral or no collateral, from lender's perspective.

name: CollateralDomain
standard_label: Collateral Held [Domain]
documentation: Category of collateral or no collateral, from lender's perspective.

name: CollateralHeldOnReverseRepurchaseAgreementsSegregatedUnderCommodityExchangeActRegulation

documentation: Description and classification of assets pledged as collateral that are not reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position.

name: CollateralPledgedInSecuredBorrowingAxis

name: CollateralPledgedInSecuredBorrowingDomain

name: CollateralPledgedMember
