documentation: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current [Abstract]

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableAllowanceForCreditLoss
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
documentation: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

name: ContractWithCustomerReceivableCreditLossExpenseReversal
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
documentation: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

name: ContractWithCustomerRefundLiability
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability
documentation: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer.

name: ContractWithCustomerRefundLiabilityAbstract
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability [Abstract]

name: ContractWithCustomerRefundLiabilityCurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Current
documentation: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as current.

name: ContractWithCustomerRefundLiabilityNoncurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as noncurrent.

name: ContractWithCustomerRightOfReturnAbstract
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Right of Return [Abstract]

name: ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProduct
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product
documentation: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability.

name: ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProductAbstract
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product [Abstract]

name: ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProductCurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product, Current
documentation: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability, classified as current.

name: ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProductNoncurrent
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability, classified as noncurrent.

name: ContractWithCustomerSalesChannelAxis
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Sales Channel [Axis]
documentation: Information by sales channel for delivery of good or service in contract with customer.

name: ContractWithCustomerSalesChannelDomain
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Sales Channel [Domain]
documentation: Sales channel for delivery of good or service in contract with customer. Includes, but is not limited to, directly to consumer and through intermediary.

name: ContractWithCustomerTimingOfSatisfactionOfPerformanceObligationAndPayment
standard_label: Contract with Customer, Timing of Satisfaction of Performance Obligation and Payment
documentation: Description of effect, from relationship that timing of satisfaction of performance obligation has on timing of payment, on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time and on obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

name: ContractorsAbstract
standard_label: Contractors [Abstract]

name: ContractsAccountedForUnderPercentageOfCompletionMember
standard_label: Contracts Accounted for under Percentage of Completion [Member]
documentation: Modifications to or changes in assumptions surrounding contracts accounted for under the percentage of completion method of accounting. Percentage of completion is a method of accounting whereby profit on a long-term (construction) contracts is recognized based on reliable estimates as to the degree of completion generally based on contractual relationships (costs incurred to total costs anticipated).

name: ContractsInForceSubjectToParticipationThroughReinsurancePercentage
standard_label: Contracts in Force Subject to Participation through Reinsurance, Ratio
documentation: Ratio of insurance contracts that are subject to reinsurance participation to all contracts in force.

name: ContractsInForceSubjectToParticipationThroughReinsuranceValue
standard_label: Contracts in Force Subject to Participation Through Reinsurance, Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The value of insurance contracts that are subject to reinsurance participation agreements (risk assumed from other insurers).

name: ContractsReceivable
standard_label: Contracts Receivable (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amounts due for services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the entity and, at a minimum, one other party. Such amounts may be billed or unbilled depending on the specifics of the contract.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmounts
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts
documentation: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsAbstract
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsExpectedToBeCollectedAfterNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Expected to be Collected after Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts that are expected to be collected after the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsExpectedToBeCollectedAfterOneYear
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Expected to be Collected after Next 12 Months
documentation: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts that are expected to be collected after the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsExpectedToBeCollectedInNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Expected to be Collected in Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts that are expected to be collected in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsExpectedToBeCollectedInRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Expected to be Collected in Remainder of Fiscal Year
documentation: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts that are expected to be collected in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsExpectedToBeCollectedWithinOneYear
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Expected to be Collected in Next 12 Months
documentation: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts that are expected to be collected in the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsNatureAndStatus
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Nature and Status
documentation: Explanation of the amounts included within receivables, billed or unbilled, under long-term contracts, which represent claims or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization.

name: ContractsReceivableClaimsAndUncertainAmountsRollingMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Rolling Maturity [Abstract] (Deprecated 2020)

name: ContractsRevenue
standard_label: Contracts Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of revenue earned from products sold or services provided under the terms of a contract, including, but not limited to, government contracts and construction contracts, classified as other.

name: ContractualAdjustmentsAndThirdPartySettlementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Contractual Adjustments and Third-Party Settlements, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for contractual adjustments and third-party settlements.

name: ContractualInterestExpenseOnPrepetitionLiabilitiesNotRecognizedInStatementOfOperations
standard_label: Contractual Interest Expense on Prepetition Liabilities Not Recognized in Statement of Operations
documentation: The amount of contractual interest expense on prepetition liabilities not included in the statement of operations.

name: ContractualInterestRateReductionMember
standard_label: Contractual Interest Rate Reduction [Member]
documentation: Loan modification for a reduction of contractual interest rate.

name: ContractualMaturitiesOfTimeDeposits100000OrMoreDescription
standard_label: Contractual Maturities of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Description (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Description of contractual maturities of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

name: ContractualMaturitiesOfTimeDeposits100000OrMoreDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Contractual Maturities of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Disclosures [Abstract] (Deprecated 2025)

name: ContractualMaturitiesTimeDeposits100000OrMoreAbstract
standard_label: Time Deposits, $100,000 or More [Abstract]

name: ContractualMaturitiesTimeDeposits100000OrMoreAfter12Months
standard_label: Contractual Maturities, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, after 12 Months
documentation: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more, maturing after twelve months from the balance sheet date.

name: ContractualMaturitiesTimeDeposits100000OrMoreSixMonthsThrough12Months
standard_label: Contractual Maturities, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, 6 Months through 12 Months
documentation: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more, maturing within six to twelve months after the balance sheet date.

name: ContractualMaturitiesTimeDeposits100000OrMoreThreeMonthsOrLess
standard_label: Contractual Maturities, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Three Months or Less
documentation: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more, maturing within three months or fewer from the balance sheet date.

name: ContractualMaturitiesTimeDeposits100000OrMoreThreeMonthsThroughSixMonths
standard_label: Contractual Maturities, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Three Months Through Six Months
documentation: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more, maturing within three to six months after the balance sheet date.

name: ContractualObligation
standard_label: Contractual Obligation
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

name: ContractualObligationDueAfterFifthYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInFifthYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInFourthAndFifthYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInFourthAndFifthYearAbstract
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five [Abstract]

name: ContractualObligationDueInFourthYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInNextTwelveMonths
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInSecondAndThirdYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInSecondAndThirdYearAbstract
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three [Abstract]

name: ContractualObligationDueInSecondYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationDueInThirdYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: ContractualObligationFiscalYearMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: ContractualObligationFiscalYearMaturityScheduleAbstract
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, Fiscal Year Maturity Schedule [Abstract]

name: ContractualObligationFiscalYearMaturityScheduleTableTextBlock
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, Fiscal Year Maturity Schedule [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the aggregate amount of payments due on known contractual obligations for the five years following the date of the latest balance sheet and the combined aggregate amount of maturities of known contractual obligations.

name: ContractualObligationFutureMinimumPaymentsDueRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
documentation: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

name: ContractualRightsMember
standard_label: Contractual Rights [Member]
documentation: Rights that arise from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

name: ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeeIncomeStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fee Income, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes contractually specified servicing fee income.

name: ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeeLateFeeAndAncillaryFeeEarnedInExchangeForServicingFinancialAssetAbstract
standard_label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fee, Late Fee, and Ancillary Fee Earned in Exchange for Servicing Financial Asset [Abstract]

name: ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeesAmount
standard_label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fees, Amount
documentation: All amounts that, per contract, are due to the servicer in exchange for servicing the financial asset and would no longer be received by a servicer if the beneficial owners of the serviced assets (or their trustees or agents) were to exercise their actual or potential authority under the contract to shift the servicing to another servicer. Depending on the servicing contract, those fees may include some or all of the difference between the interest rate collected on the asset being serviced and

name: ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeesDescriptionOfWhereReportedOnStatementOfIncome
standard_label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fees, Description of Where Reported on Statement of Income (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The line item within the income statement where these fees appear.

name: ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeesLateFeesAndAncillaryFeesEarnedInExchangeForServicingFinancialAssets
standard_label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fee, Late Fee, and Ancillary Fee Earned in Exchange for Servicing Financial Asset
documentation: Amount of contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and ancillary fee recognized as income for servicing asset and servicing liability.

name: ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeesLateFeesAndAncillaryFeesEarnedInExchangeForServicingFinancialAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fees, Late Fees, and Ancillary Fees Earned in Exchange for Servicing Financial Assets [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ContributionOfLandByGovernmentUnitMember
standard_label: Contribution of Land by Government Unit [Member]
documentation: The contribution of land by a government unit for construction of productive facilities by an enterprise.

name: ContributionOfNonmonetaryAssetsToCharitableOrganizationMember
standard_label: Contribution of Nonmonetary Assets to Charitable Organization [Member]
documentation: Contribution of nonmonetary assets by an enterprise to a charitable organization.

name: ContributionOfProperty
standard_label: Contribution of Property
documentation: Value of property contributed in noncash investing and financing activities.

name: ContributionsFromNoncontrollingInterests
standard_label: Contributions from Noncontrolling Interests (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from contributions from noncontrolling interests in an investment.

name: ContributionsInAidOfConstruction
standard_label: Contributions in Aid of Construction
documentation: Developers, builders, governmental agencies and municipalities will provide the entity with cash, or in some cases property, to extend its services to their properties. Nonrefundable contributions are recorded as contributions in aid of construction ("CIAC").

name: ControllerMember
standard_label: Controller [Member]
documentation: Executive responsible for the entity's accounting activities and is in effect the chief accountant.

name: ConventionalLoanMember
standard_label: Conventional Mortgage Loan [Member]
documentation: Mortgage loan issued by a bank, which is typically in an amount between 70 to 80 percent of the purchase price of the property securing the loan, has a repayment period of 15 to 30 years, and requires that certain credit criteria be met.

name: ConversionGainsAndLossesOnForeignInvestments
standard_label: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
documentation: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

name: ConversionOfStockAmountConverted1
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Amount Converted
documentation: The value of the stock converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: ConversionOfStockAmountIssued1
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Amount Issued
documentation: The value of the financial instrument issued [noncash or part noncash] in the conversion of stock. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: ConversionOfStockByUniqueDescriptionAxis
standard_label: Stock Conversion Description [Axis]
documentation: Information by description of stock conversions.

name: ConversionOfStockDescription
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Description
documentation: A unique description of a noncash or part noncash stock conversion. The description would be expected to include sufficient information to provide an understanding of the nature and purpose of the conversion. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: ConversionOfStockLineItems
standard_label: Conversion of Stock [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ConversionOfStockNameDomain
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Name [Domain]
documentation: The unique name of a noncash or part noncash stock conversion.

name: ConversionOfStockNewIssuance
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, New Issuance
documentation: A description of the new financial instrument issued in a noncash (or part noncash) conversion of stock. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: ConversionOfStockSharesConverted1
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Converted
documentation: The number of shares converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: ConversionOfStockSharesIssued1
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Issued
documentation: The number of new shares issued in the conversion of stock in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: ConversionOfStockTable
standard_label: Conversion of Stock [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about stock converted into another financial instrument in noncash or part noncash transaction.

name: ConversionOfStockTypeOfStockConverted
standard_label: Conversion of Stock, Type of Stock Converted
documentation: The type of stock (i.e. preferred, common, treasury, etc.) being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

name: ConvertibleCommonStockMember
standard_label: Convertible Common Stock [Member]
documentation: Common stock securities that may be converted to another form of security.

name: ConvertibleDebt
standard_label: Convertible Debt
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying amount of debt identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument (typically the entity's common stock) as of the balance sheet date, which originally required full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company.

name: ConvertibleDebtCurrent
standard_label: Convertible Debt, Current
documentation: The portion of the carrying value of long-term convertible debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle if longer. Convertible debt is a financial instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ConvertibleDebtFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy of convertible debt.

name: ConvertibleDebtFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: ConvertibleDebtFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: ConvertibleDebtFairValueDisclosures
standard_label: Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosures
documentation: Fair value portion of borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.

name: ConvertibleDebtMember
standard_label: Convertible Debt [Member]
documentation: Borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.

name: ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent
standard_label: Convertible Debt, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount of long-term convertible debt as of the balance sheet date, net of the amount due in the next twelve months or greater than the normal operating cycle, if longer. The debt is convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

name: ConvertibleDebtSecuritiesMember
standard_label: Convertible Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Debt securities that can be exchanged for equity of the debt issuer at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ConvertibleDebtTableTextBlock
standard_label: Convertible Debt [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of convertible debt instrument. Includes, but is not limited to, principal amount and amortized premium or discount.

name: ConvertibleLongTermNotesPayable
standard_label: Convertible Notes Payable, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Convertible Notes Payable, excluding current portion. Convertible Notes Payable is a written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another, related security, at the option of the issuer and the holder.

name: ConvertibleLongtermNotesPayableCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Convertible Notes Payable [Abstract]

name: ConvertibleNotesPayable
standard_label: Convertible Notes Payable
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of a written promise to pay a note, initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer, which can be exchanged for a specified amount of one or more securities (typically common stock), at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ConvertibleNotesPayableCurrent
standard_label: Convertible Notes Payable, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term debt due within one year or the operating cycle if longer identified as Convertible Notes Payable. Convertible Notes Payable is a written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another, related security, at the option of the issuer and the holder.

name: ConvertibleNotesPayableMember
standard_label: Convertible Notes Payable [Member]
documentation: Written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified quantity of securities (typically common stock), at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ConvertiblePreferredDividendsNetOfTax
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Dividends, Net of Tax
documentation: The after-tax amount of any dividends on convertible preferred stock.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockAssociatedDerivativeTransactions
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Associated Derivative Transactions
documentation: Describe and provide information on derivative transactions entered into in connection with the issuance of the contingently convertible securities that may be useful in explaining the potential impact of the contingently convertible securities. May include the terms of those derivative transactions (including the terms of the settlement), how those transactions relate to the contingently convertible securities, and the number of shares underlying the derivatives.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockConvertedToOtherSecurities
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock Converted to Other Securities
documentation: Value of convertible preferred stock that was converted to other securities.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockMember
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock [Member]
documentation: Preferred stock that may be exchanged into common shares or other types of securities at the owner's option.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockNonredeemableOrRedeemableIssuerOptionValue
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Nonredeemable or Redeemable, Issuer Option, Value
documentation: Value of outstanding nonredeemable convertible preferred stock or outstanding convertible preferred stock that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockSettlementTerms
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Settlement Terms
documentation: Describe the manner of settlement upon conversion and any alternative settlement methods (e.g., cash, shares, a combination of both).

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockSharesIssuedUponConversion
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued upon Conversion
documentation: Number of shares issued for each share of convertible preferred stock that is converted.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockSharesReservedForFutureIssuance
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
documentation: Aggregate number of nonredeemable convertible preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Convertible Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
documentation: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets upon an event that is certain to occur.

name: ConvertiblePreferredStockTermsOfConversion
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Terms
documentation: Description of conversion terms for preferred stock.

name: ConvertibleSubordinatedDebt
standard_label: Convertible Subordinated Debt
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt, as of the balance sheet date, initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer. name: ConvertibleSubordinatedDebtCurrent
standard_label: Convertible Subordinated Debt, Current
documentation: The portion of the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment upon liquidation of the entity's assets.

name: ConvertibleSubordinatedDebtCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Convertible Subordinated Debt [Abstract]

name: ConvertibleSubordinatedDebtMember
standard_label: Convertible Subordinated Debt [Member]
documentation: Debt that places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ConvertibleSubordinatedDebtNoncurrent
standard_label: Convertible Subordinated Debt, Noncurrent
documentation: The portion of the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

name: ConvertiblesAndBondsWithWarrantsAttachedMember
standard_label: Convertibles and Bonds with Warrants Attached [Member]
documentation: Bonds which are convertible into another security, usually common shares of the issuer and bonds with warrants attached.

name: CooperativeAdvertisingAmount
standard_label: Cooperative Advertising Amount

name: CooperativeAdvertisingExpense

documentation: Amount of expense under a cooperative advertising arrangement.

name: CooperativeAdvertisingExpenseMember

documentation: Total amount received by an entity from a vendor under a cooperative advertising arrangement that has been offset against advertising expense.

name: CooperativeAdvertisingPolicy
standard_label: Cooperative Advertising Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for offsetting cash consideration received from a vendor arising from cooperative advertising arrangements against advertising expense when such consideration represents a reimbursement of a specific, incremental, identifiable cost incurred by the entity in selling the vendor's products or services.

name: CooperativeInventoryAmount
standard_label: Agricultural Cooperative Inventory, Amount
documentation: The carrying amount of members' products at the balance sheet date.

name: CooperativeInventoryPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Agricultural Cooperative Inventory, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for assigning values to the members' products in an agricultural cooperative arrangement.

name: CopyrightsMember
standard_label: Copyrights [Member]
documentation: Legal rights held for a finite period specified by law, covering only the form or manner in which ideas or information have been manifested, and which prohibit reproduction of same without the right holder's consent, such as reproducing a copyrighted text, work of art, or software.

name: CoreAndNonCoreStatusAxis
standard_label: Core and Noncore Status [Axis]
documentation: Information by core and noncore status of asset, liability, and business operation.

name: CoreAndNonCoreStatusDomain

name: CoreDepositsMember
standard_label: Core Deposits [Member]
documentation: Entity's long-term relationships with depositors, commonly known as core deposit intangibles, which are separate from the financial instruments themselves.

name: CoreMember

name: CorporateAlternativeMinimumTaxCamtAccountingPolicyElection

name: CorporateAndOtherMember

name: CorporateDebtSecuritiesMember

name: CorporateJointVentureMember
standard_label: Corporate Joint Venture [Member]
documentation: Corporation owned and operated by a small group of ventures to accomplish a mutually beneficial venture or project.

name: CorporateLifeInsuranceGuaranteedRate

name: CorporateLifeInsuranceInterestRateAssumptions
standard_label: Corporate Life Insurance Interest Rate Assumptions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Assumptions regarding interest rates applied to the policyholder deposits for life insurance contracts which are purchased by corporate entities for purposes such as funding the cost of providing employee benefits and protecting against the loss of "key persons." where investment income is accumulated tax free through the internal build-up of the cash surrender value.

name: CorporateLifeInsuranceWeightedAverageCreditRate
standard_label: Corporate Life Insurance Weighted Average Credit Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Weighted average interest rate applied for the subject period to cash values in determining the dividend to be credited for life insurance contracts which are purchased by corporate entities for purposes such as funding the cost of providing employee benefits and protecting against the loss of "key persons." where investment income is accumulated tax free through the internal build-up of the cash surrender value.

name: CorporateMember
standard_label: Corporate Segment [Member]
documentation: Component of an entity that usually provides financial, operational and administrative support and is considered an operating segment. Excludes intersegment elimination and reconciling items.

name: CorporateNonSegmentMember
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Item, Corporate Nonsegment [Member]
documentation: Corporate headquarters or functional department that may not earn revenues or may earn revenues that are only incidental to the activities of the entity and is not considered an operating segment.

name: CorporateNoteSecuritiesMember
standard_label: Corporate Note Securities [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about short-term debt securities that are issued by either a domestic or foreign corporate business entity with a date certain promise of repayment and a return to the holder for the time value of money (for example, variable or fixed interest).

name: CorporationMember
standard_label: Corporation [Member]

name: CorrespondentClearingMember

documentation: Security clearing, custody, deposit, fund transfer and settlement provided by financial institution for another financial institution.

standard_label: Cost, Depreciation, Amortization and Depletion [Abstract]

name: CostDirectMaterial
standard_label: Cost, Direct Material

name: CostMaintenance

documentation: Description of cost method investments classified as other.

standard_label: Cost Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Fair value portion of investments accounted under the cost method.

standard_label: Cost Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: CostMethodInvestmentsRealizedGainLoss
standard_label: Cost-method Investments, Realized Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: This item represents the gain (loss) realized during the period from the sale of investments accounted for under the cost method of accounting and any losses recognized thereon for impairments of other than a temporary nature.

documentation: For investments in debt and equity securities accounted for at cost, the excess of net sale proceeds over the carrying amount of investments disposed of during the period.

name: CostMethodInvestmentsRealizedLosses
standard_label: Cost-method Investments, Realized Losses (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: For investments in debt and equity securities accounted for at cost, the excess of the carrying amount over net sale proceeds of investments disposed of during the period and any losses recognized thereon for impairments of other than a temporary nature.

name: CostMethodInvestmentsStatementThatFairValueWasNotEstimated
standard_label: Cost Method Investments, Statement that Fair Value was Not Estimated (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: This item represents the required disclosure of the fact that the fair value of a cost-method investment is not estimated because there have been no identified events or changes in circumstances that may have a significant adverse effect on the fair value of the investment, and (1) that it is not practicable to estimate the fair value of the investment, or (2) that the investor is exempt from estimating fair value because it is a nonpublic entity (as defined).

name: CostMethodLifoMember

documentation: Last-in, first-out (LIFO) method used to determine cost basis.

name: CostMethodMovingAverageMember

documentation: Moving average cost method used to determine cost basis.

name: CostMethodRimMember

documentation: Retail inventory method (RIM) used to determine cost basis.

name: CostMethodSpecificIdentificationMember
standard_label: Cost Method, Specific Identification [Member]

name: CostOfCoalProductsAndServices

documentation: Cost of electricity sold during the reporting period, operations of which is regulated by a federal or state agency.

name: CostOfDomesticRegulatedGasRevenue
standard_label: Cost of Domestic Regulated Gas Revenue (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The cost of generation, transmission, and distribution of [natural] gas, which are regulated by a federal, state, or local government or agency.

name: CostOfGoldProductsAndServices

name: CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldAbstract

name: CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDepreciation
standard_label: Cost, Depreciation
documentation: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

name: CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDepreciationAndAmortization
standard_label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization
documentation: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

name: CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDepreciationAndAmortizationAbstract
standard_label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization [Abstract]

name: CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldOverhead

name: CostOfGoodsProductLineMember

name: CostOfGoodsSegmentMember

name: CostOfGoodsSold

name: CostOfGoodsSoldDepletion
standard_label: Cost of Goods Sold, Depletion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The expense recognized in the current period that recognizes the reduction in the quantity of resources (for example, coal, oil, minerals, gas) that are held as assets on the statement of financial position. This element applies only to assets used in the production of goods sold.

name: CostOfGoodsSoldDepreciation
standard_label: Cost of Goods Sold, Depreciation (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of a tangible asset over the asset's useful life. This element applies only to an asset used in the production of goods sold.

name: CostOfGoodsSoldDepreciationAndAmortization
standard_label: Cost of Goods Sold, Depreciation and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Depreciation of property, plant and equipment directly related to goods produced and sold during the reporting period.

name: CostOfGoodsSoldDepreciationAndAmortizationAbstract

documentation: Cost of product sold and service rendered, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation.

name: CostOfMerchandiseSalesBuyingAndOccupancyCosts

documentation: The aggregate of buying and occupancy costs reported during the period related to merchandise sold. Costs could include, but not be limited to, inbound and outbound freight; costs of operating distribution centers; payroll, benefits, and travel costs directly associated with buying inventory; systems costs related to the buying and tracking of inventory; rent; depreciation; property taxes; and facility operations.

name: CostOfNaturalGasPurchases

name: CostOfOtherManufacturedProducts

name: CostOfRealEstateRevenue

name: CostOfRealEstateSalesAbstract

name: CostOfRealEstateSalesExcludingInterest

name: CostOfReimbursableExpense

name: CostOfRevenue

name: CostOfRevenueAbstract

documentation: The noncurrent portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

name: CustomerFunds
standard_label: Customer Funds
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts received from and refundable to customers unless used by them to obtain goods and services from the entity.

name: CustomerListsMember
standard_label: Customer Lists [Member]
documentation: Information about customers such as their name and contact information; it may also be an extensive database that includes other information about the customers such as their order history and demographic information.

name: CustomerLoyaltyProgramLiabilityCurrent
standard_label: Customer Loyalty Program Liability, Current (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Value of deferred revenue or cost to provide products or services, which is expected to be recognized in income or incurred within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, resulting from customer loyalty program. Excludes liability associated with frequent flier programs. Includes liability associated with customer loyalty programs for other businesses, for example, but is not limited to, hotels, supermarkets, credit card companies, automobile rental companies, and book sellers.

name: CustomerLoyaltyProgramLiabilityNoncurrent
standard_label: Customer Loyalty Program Liability, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Value of deferred revenue or cost to provide products or services, which is expected to be recognized in income or incurred after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, resulting from customer loyalty program. Excludes liability associated with frequent flier programs. Includes liability associated with customer loyalty programs for other businesses, for example, but is not limited to, hotels, supermarkets, credit card companies, automobile rental companies, and book sellers.

name: CustomerReceiptsMember
standard_label: Customer Receipts [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

name: CustomerRefundLiabilityCurrent
standard_label: Customer Refund Liability, Current
documentation: Current regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

name: CustomerRefundLiabilityNoncurrent
standard_label: Customer Refund Liability, Noncurrent
documentation: Noncurrent regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

name: CustomerRefundableFees
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of proceeds that had been received in revenue related transactions that are refundable to the customers and do not meet the criteria for revenue recognition (for example, refundable membership fees).

name: CustomerRefundableFeesCashReceived
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Cash Received (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The amount of cash received from customers during the period for revenue related transactions that are refundable to them and do not meet the criteria for revenue recognition.

name: CustomerRefundableFeesPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in customer refundable fees.

name: CustomerRefundableFeesProceeds
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Proceeds
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from customers for revenue related transactions that are refundable to the customers and do not meet the criteria for revenue recognition.

name: CustomerRefundableFeesRefundPayments
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Refund Payments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of refund payments made to customers during the period.

name: CustomerRefundableFeesRefundPayments1
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Refund Payments
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to customers for refund payments.

name: CustomerRefundableFeesRevenueRecognized
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Revenue Recognized (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the amount of revenue recognized which is attributable to customer refundable fees that are no longer refundable.

name: CustomerRefundableFeesRevenueRecognized1
standard_label: Customer Refundable Fees, Revenue Recognized
documentation: Amount of revenue recognized attributable to customer refundable fees.

name: CustomerRelatedIntangibleAssetsMember
standard_label: Customer-Related Intangible Assets [Member]
documentation: Customer-related asset, including, but not limited to, customer lists, and noncontractual customer relationships.

name: CustomerRelationshipsMember
standard_label: Customer Relationships [Member]
documentation: Customer relationship that exists between an entity and its customer, for example, but not limited to, tenant relationships.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeDescription
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of customer securities accepted as collateral and re-pledged to counterparties as collateral or sold.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeFairValue
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it is permitted by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge to counterparties as collateral.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeFairValueOfSecuritiesSoldOrRepledged
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Fair Value of Securities Sold or Repledged
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it has sold or re-pledged to counterparties as collateral.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeLineItems
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge (Including Securities Sold or Repledged) [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeSecuritiesSoldOrRepledgedClassification
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Securities Sold or Repledged, Classification (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Classification within financial statement of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it has sold or re-pledged to counterparties as collateral.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeSecuritiesTypeDomain
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Securities Type [Domain] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of financial instrument type of customer securities accepted by the entity and re-pledged to counterparties as collateral or sold.

name: CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRightToSellOrRepledgeTable
standard_label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about customer security accepted and repledged to counterparty as collateral or sold.

name: CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesGross
standard_label: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, before Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

name: CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesNet
standard_label: Customer's Liability for Acceptances, Net (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The aggregate of all customer's outstanding debt to the institution that resulted from short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as banker's acceptance transactions), net of allowance for uncollectible customer's liability for acceptances.

name: CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesNetAbstract
standard_label: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

name: DJIAIndexFutureMember
standard_label: DJIA Index Future [Member]
documentation: A standardized contract, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) Index at a certain date in the future, at a certain price.

name: DamageFromFireExplosionOrOtherHazardMember
standard_label: Damage from Fire, Explosion or Other Hazard [Member]
documentation: Risk of loss from uninsured portions of losses resulting from fire, explosion or other hazard.

name: DamagesFromProductDefectsMember
standard_label: Damages from Product Defects [Member]
documentation: The risk of loss arises with respect to product defects and recalls, or improperly performed services which actually or allegedly resulted in damages suffered by the injured party, excluding major product liability matters.

name: DatabasesMember
standard_label: Database Rights [Member]
documentation: Exclusive legal rights granted to the owner or licensee of collections of information stored in electronic form (such as on computer disks or files).

name: DateFounded
standard_label: Date Founded (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The year in which the entity was founded.

name: DebenturesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Debentures Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
documentation: A type of debt instrument that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, that is not secured by physical assets or other collateral. name: DebitCardMember
standard_label: Debit Card [Member]
documentation: Card issued to user to facilitate payment for purchase of product and service, directly from user's checking account.

name: DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations
standard_label: Debt and Lease Obligation
documentation: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

name: DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsAbstract
standard_label: Debt and Lease Obligation [Abstract]

documentation: The entire disclosure for debt and capital lease obligations can be reported. documentation: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities and foreign currency transaction on investment in debt and equity securities from change in market price, classified as operating.

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeUnrealizedGainLossOperatingBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Debt and Equity Securities and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities and foreign currency transaction on investment in debt and equity securities from change in market price, classified as operating.

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList
standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy of investment in debt and equity securities.

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLoss
standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLossAbstract
standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss) [Abstract]

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLossAlternativeAbstract

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLossExcludingImpairmentLossAbstract
standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss [Abstract]

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesGainLossExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairmentLoss
standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities, excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

name: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesRealizedGainLoss
standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss) [Abstract]

standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
documentation: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities. Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment [Abstract]

standard_label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

name: DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis
standard_label: Debt Conversion Description [Axis]
documentation: Information by description of debt issuances converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentAmount1
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Amount
documentation: The value of the financial instrument(s) that the original debt is being converted into in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirationOrDueDateDayMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Expiration or Due Date
documentation: Expiration, mandatory redemption, or due date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, of the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirationOrDueDateMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Expiration or Due Date, Month and Year
documentation: The expiration, mandatory redemption, or due date, month and year (YYYY-MM), of the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirationOrDueDateYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Expiration or Due Date, Year
documentation: Year of expiration or mandatory redemption of the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction, in YYYY format.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanceDateDayMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Issuance Date
documentation: Date the financial instrument was issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanceDateMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Issuance Date, Month and Year
documentation: The month and year (YYYY-MM) the financial instrument was issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanceDateYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Issuance Date, Year
documentation: Year the financial instrument was issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction, in YYYY format.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentRate
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Rate
documentation: Dividend or interest rate associated with the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction. Noncash are transactions that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments. Part noncash refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Shares Issued
documentation: The number of shares issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentType
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Type
documentation: The type of the financial instrument that the original debt is being converted into (for example, new debt, common stock, preferred stock, etc.) in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentWarrantsOrOptionsIssued1
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Warrants or Options Issued
documentation: The number of warrants issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionDescription
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Description
documentation: Description of conversion of original debt instrument in noncash or part noncash transaction.

name: DebtConversionLineItems
standard_label: Debt Conversion [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DebtConversionNameDomain
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Name [Domain]
documentation: The name of the original debt issue that has been converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction during the accounting period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Amount
documentation: The amount of the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtDayMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Due Date of Debt
documentation: Date the original debt was scheduled to mature, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Due Date of Debt, Month and Year
documentation: The month and year (YYYY-MM) in which the original debt was scheduled to mature.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Due Date, Year
documentation: Year the original debt was scheduled to mature, in YYYY format.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtInterestRateOfDebt
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Interest Rate of Debt
documentation: The rate of interest that was being paid on the original debt issue that is being converted in the noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtIssuanceDateOfDebtDayMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Issuance Date of Debt
documentation: Date the original debt was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtConversionOriginalDebtIssuanceDateOfDebtMonthAndYear
standard_label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Issuance Date of Debt, Month and Year (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The month and year (YYYY-MM) in which the original debt was issued.

name: DebtDefaultShorttermDebtAbstract

documentation: Amount of outstanding short-term debt or borrowing associated with any securities or credit agreement for which there has been a default in principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption provisions, or any breach of covenant that existed at the end of the period and subsequently has not been cured.

name: DebtDefaultShorttermDebtDescriptionOfNoticeOfDefault
standard_label: Debt Default, Short-Term Debt, Description of Notice of Default

documentation: Indicates reason valuation technique or approach changed for measuring debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

name: DebtInstrumentCollateralAmount

name: DebtInstrumentCollateralFee

documentation: The carrying amount of the equity component of convertible debt which may be settled in cash upon conversion.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleControlOfRightsFixedList
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Control of Rights [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates party controlling conversion right in convertible debt instrument. Acceptable values are "Issuer" and "Holder".

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Date
documentation: Date debt instrument can be converted into equity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPriceDecrease
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price, Decrease

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPriceIncrease
