name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionRatio1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Ratio
documentation: Ratio applied to the conversion of debt instrument into equity with equity shares divided by debt principal amount.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleEarliestDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Earliest Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The earliest date on which the debt instrument can be converted into equity, which may be presented in a variety of ways (for example, (year only, month and year, day, month and year, quarter).

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleEarliestDate1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Earliest Date
documentation: Earliest date when the debt instrument can be converted into equity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleEffectiveInterestRate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Effective Interest Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The effective interest rate on the liability component of convertible debt instrument which may be settled in cash upon conversion, including partial cash settlement.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleIfConvertedValueInExcessOfPrincipal
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, If-converted Value in Excess of Principal
documentation: The amount by which the convertible debt's if-converted value exceeds its principle amount at the balance sheet date, regardless of whether the instrument is currently convertible. This element applies to public companies only.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleInterestExpense
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Interest Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Interest expense related to convertible debt instruments which has been recognized for the period, including the contractual interest coupon and amortization of the debt discount, if any.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleLatestDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Latest Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The latest date on which the debt instrument can be converted into equity, which may be presented in a variety of ways (for example, (year only, month and year, day, month and year, quarter).

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleLatestDate1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Latest Date
documentation: Latest date when the debt instrument can be converted into equity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleLiquidationPreferencePerShare
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Liquidation Preference, Per Share
documentation: Per share excess of preference in liquidation over convertible debt instrument's if-converted par or stated value of share.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleLiquidationPreferenceValue
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Liquidation Preference, Value
documentation: Amount of excess of preference in liquidation over convertible debt instrument's if-converted par or stated value of share.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Number of Equity Instruments
documentation: The number of equity instruments that the holder of the debt instrument would receive if the debt was converted to equity.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleRemainingDiscountAmortizationPeriod
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Remaining Discount Amortization Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Remaining amortization period for any discount on the liability component of convertible debt which may be settled in cash upon conversion.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleRemainingDiscountAmortizationPeriod1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Remaining Discount Amortization Period
documentation: Remaining amortization period for discount on the liability component of convertible debt which may be settled in cash upon conversion, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleSettlementMethodAbstract
standard_label: Financial Instrument, Settlement Method [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleSettlementMethodExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Settlement Method [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates method of settlement upon conversion of debt instrument. Includes, but is not limited to, cash, shares, or combination of cash and shares.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleStockPriceTrigger
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Stock Price Trigger
documentation: Price of the entity's common stock which would be required to be attained for the conversion feature embedded in the debt instrument to become effective.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleTermsOfConversionFeature
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Terms of Conversion Feature
documentation: Description of conversion terms for debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Consecutive Trading Days (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Threshold period of specified consecutive trading days within which common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instruments must exceed threshold percentage for a specified number of trading days to trigger conversion feature, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Consecutive Trading Days
documentation: Threshold period of specified consecutive trading days within which common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instrument must exceed threshold percentage for specified number of trading days to trigger conversion feature.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Percentage of Stock Price Trigger
documentation: Minimum percentage of common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instruments to determine eligibility of conversion.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Trading Days
documentation: Threshold number of specified trading days that common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instruments must exceed threshold percentage within a specified consecutive trading period to trigger conversion feature.

name: DebtInstrumentConvertibleTypeOfEquitySecurity
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Type of Equity Security
documentation: Description of the type of equity security or securities into which conversion will be made (for example, common stock or preferred shares).

name: DebtInstrumentCovenantCompliance
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Covenant Compliance
documentation: States whether the entity was in compliance with the debt covenants throughout the reporting period, and describes facts and circumstances of any compliance failure.

name: DebtInstrumentCovenantDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Covenant Description
documentation: Description of minimum financial levels (for example, tangible net worth and working capital) and achievement of certain financial ratios (for example, working capital ratio and debt service coverage ratio), and adherence to certain clauses which generally require or restrict certain actions (for example, entering into a debt arrangement with equal or greater seniority, and selling or discontinuing a certain business segment or material subsidiary) to be in compliance with the covenant clauses o

name: DebtInstrumentCreditRating
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Credit Rating
documentation: Description of the credit rating indicative of likelihood of repayment of the debt instrument given by a credit rating agency (for example, Standard and Poor's, Moody's, Fitch).

name: DebtInstrumentCumulativeSinkingFundPayments
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Cumulative Sinking Fund Payments
documentation: Cumulative amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentCurrency
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Currency
documentation: Description of the type of currency in which the debt instrument is required to be repaid.

name: DebtInstrumentDateOfFirstRequiredPayment
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Date of First Required Payment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Date that the debt agreement requires the first payment to be made, which may be presented in a variety of ways (year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter, etc.).

name: DebtInstrumentDateOfFirstRequiredPayment1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Date of First Required Payment
documentation: Date the debt agreement requires the first payment to be made, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentDecreaseForgiveness
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Decrease, Forgiveness
documentation: Decrease for amounts of indebtedness forgiven by the holder of the debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentDecreaseRepayments
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Decrease, Repayments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Decrease for amounts repaid on the debt instrument for the period.

name: DebtInstrumentDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Description
documentation: Identification of the lender and information about a contractual promise to repay a short-term or long-term obligation, which includes borrowings under lines of credit, notes payable, commercial paper, bonds payable, debentures, and other contractual obligations for payment. This may include rationale for entering into the arrangement, significant terms of the arrangement, which may include amount, repayment terms, priority, collateral required, debt covenants, borrowing capacity, call features,

name: DebtInstrumentDescriptionOfVariableRateBasis
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Description of Variable Rate Basis
documentation: Description of reference rate used for variable rate of debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentFaceAmount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
documentation: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

name: DebtInstrumentFairValue
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

name: DebtInstrumentFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy of debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

name: DebtInstrumentFairValueDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: DebtInstrumentFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: DebtInstrumentFee
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fee
documentation: Description of a fee associated with the debt instrument, including a commitment fee on unborrowed portions of a lender's total contractual commitment.

name: DebtInstrumentFeeAmount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Fee Amount
documentation: Amount of the fee that accompanies borrowing money under the debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentFrequencyOfFee
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Frequency of Fee
documentation: Description of when a fee associated with a debt instrument is required to be paid (for example, quarterly, annually, or monthly).

name: DebtInstrumentFrequencyOfPeriodicPayment
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Frequency of Periodic Payment
documentation: Description of the frequency of periodic payments (monthly, quarterly, annual).

name: DebtInstrumentIncreaseAccruedInterest
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Increase, Accrued Interest
documentation: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the debt instrument for the period.

name: DebtInstrumentIncreaseAdditionalBorrowings
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Increase, Additional Borrowings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Increase of additional borrowings on existing and new debt instruments.

name: DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease) for Period, Description
documentation: Description of the increases or decreases in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period, and may include a discussion of any significant changes in the authorized and issued amounts of bonds, mortgages and other types of debt during the reporting period.

name: DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodNet
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Net
documentation: Net increase or decrease in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period.

name: DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseNetAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Net [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseOtherNet
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateAtPeriodEnd
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate at Period End (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The effective interest rate at the end of the reporting period.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateBasisForEffectiveRate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Basis for Effective Rate
documentation: Description of any adjustments made to the stated rate to determine the effective rate.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate During Period
documentation: The average effective interest rate during the reporting period.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
documentation: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentageAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentageRateRangeMaximum
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: When presenting a range of interest rates, the highest effective rate for funds borrowed under the debt agreement as of the balance sheet date.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentageRateRangeMinimum
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: When presenting a range of interest rates, the lowest effective rate for funds borrowed under the debt agreement as of the balance sheet date.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncrease
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate Increase (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Increase in basis points of the stated interest rate on the debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Incremental percentage increase (decrease) in the stated rate on a debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
documentation: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentageAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentageRateRangeMaximum
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Maximum contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentageRateRangeMinimum
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Minimum contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentInterestRateTerms
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate Terms
documentation: Description of the interest rate as being fixed or variable, and, if variable, identification of the index or rate on which the interest rate is based and the number of points or percentage added to that index or rate to set the rate, and other pertinent information, such as frequency of rate resets.

name: DebtInstrumentIssuanceDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Issuance Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Date when the debt instrument was issued, which may be presented in a variety of ways (year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter, etc.).

name: DebtInstrumentIssuanceDate1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Issuance Date
documentation: Date the debt instrument was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Issued, Principal
documentation: Amount of principal of debt issued.

name: DebtInstrumentIssuer
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Issuer
documentation: Identification of the contractual issuer of the debt instrument (for example, a subsidiary of the reporting entity).

name: DebtInstrumentLineItems
standard_label: Debt Instrument [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DebtInstrumentMaturityDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Maturity Date
documentation: Date when the debt instrument is scheduled to be fully repaid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentMaturityDateDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Maturity Date, Description
documentation: Description of the maturity date of the debt instrument including whether the debt matures serially and, if so, a brief description of the serial maturities.

name: DebtInstrumentMaturityDateRangeEnd
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Maturity Date Range, End (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: When presenting a range of maturity dates, the latest date when the outstanding debt instruments are required to be repaid. May be presented in a variety of ways (for example: year only, month and year, day, month and year, and number of years).

name: DebtInstrumentMaturityDateRangeEnd1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Maturity Date Range, End
documentation: Latest date the outstanding debt instruments are required to be repaid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentMaturityDateRangeStart
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Maturity Date Range, Start (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: When presenting a range of maturity dates, the earliest date when the outstanding debt instruments are required to be repaid. May be presented in a variety of ways (for example: year only, month and year, day, month and year, and number of years).

name: DebtInstrumentMaturityDateRangeStart1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Maturity Date Range, Start
documentation: Earliest date the outstanding debt instruments are required to be repaid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentMeasurementInput
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Measurement Input
documentation: Value of input used to measure debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

name: DebtInstrumentMeasurementInputExtensibleList
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Measurement Input [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates measurement input for debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

name: DebtInstrumentNameDomain
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Name [Domain]
documentation: The name for the particular debt instrument or borrowing that distinguishes it from other debt instruments or borrowings, including draws against credit facilities.

name: DebtInstrumentOfferingDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Offering Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Date when the debt instrument was offered for sale, which may be presented in a variety of ways (year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter, etc.).

name: DebtInstrumentOfferingDate1
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Offering Date
documentation: Date the debt instrument was offered for sale, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Payment Terms
documentation: Description of the payment terms of the debt instrument (for example, whether periodic payments include principal and frequency of payments) and discussion about any contingencies associated with the payment.

name: DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment
documentation: Amount of the required periodic payments including both interest and principal payments.

name: DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentInterest
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Interest
documentation: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to interest.

name: DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentPrincipal
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Principal
documentation: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to principal.

name: DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentTermsBalloonPaymentToBePaid
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment Terms, Balloon Payment to be Paid
documentation: Amount of payment greater than the preceding installment payments to be paid at final maturity date of debt.

name: DebtInstrumentPriority
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Priority
documentation: Description of the debt instrument's priority, or seniority, for repayment in relation to other obligations of the entity in the event of liquidation.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Description
documentation: Description of debt redemption features under terms of the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionLineItems
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodAxis
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period [Axis]
documentation: Information by period of debt redemption feature under terms of debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodDomain
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period [Domain]
documentation: Period as defined under terms of the debt agreement for debt redemption features.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodEndDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Period, End Date
documentation: End date of debt instrument redemption period, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodFiveMember
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period Five [Member]
documentation: Period five representing fifth most current period of debt redemption features under terms of the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodFourMember
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period Four [Member]
documentation: Period four representing fourth most current period of debt redemption features under terms of the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodOneMember
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period One [Member]
documentation: Period one representing most current period of debt redemption features under terms of the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodStartDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Period, Start Date
documentation: Start date of debt instrument redemption period, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodThreeMember
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period Three [Member]
documentation: Period three representing third most current period of debt redemption features under terms of the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPeriodTwoMember
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption, Period Two [Member]
documentation: Period two representing second most current period of debt redemption features under terms of the debt agreement.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage
documentation: Percentage price of original principal amount of debt at which debt can be redeemed by the issuer.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentageOfPrincipalAmountRedeemed
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage of Principal Amount Redeemed
documentation: Percentage of principal amount of debt redeemed.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionTable
standard_label: Debt Instrument Redemption [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about debt instruments or arrangements with redemption features. Includes, but is not limited to, description of debt redemption features, percentage price at which debt can be redeemed by the issuer, and period start and end for debt maturity or redemption.

name: DebtInstrumentRedemptionTableTextBlock
standard_label: Debt Instrument Redemption [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of debt instruments or arrangements with redemption features. Includes, but is not limited to, description of debt redemption features, percentage price at which debt can be redeemed by the issuer, and period start and end for debt maturity or redemption.

name: DebtInstrumentRepaidPrincipal
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Repaid, Principal
documentation: Amount of principal of debt repaid.

name: DebtInstrumentRepurchaseAmount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Repurchase Amount
documentation: Fair value amount of debt instrument that was repurchased.

name: DebtInstrumentRepurchaseDate
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Repurchase Date
documentation: Date the debt instrument was repurchased, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DebtInstrumentRepurchasedFaceAmount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Repurchased Face Amount
documentation: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

name: DebtInstrumentRestrictiveCovenants
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Restrictive Covenants
documentation: Description of covenants that limit or prohibit certain actions or activities without the lender's prior consent within a specified period of time or until certain specified targets are achieved for example, reduction of the debt or an increase in net worth to a specified amount).

name: DebtInstrumentSinkingFundAmount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Sinking Fund Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount paid during the reporting period into the sinking fund.

name: DebtInstrumentSinkingFundDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Sinking Fund Description
documentation: Describes the provision of a debt agreement that requires the borrower to periodically place monies into a fund which is used to retire, typically annually, a portion of the outstanding debt.

name: DebtInstrumentSinkingFundPayment
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Sinking Fund Payment
documentation: Amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentSubjectiveAccelerationClause
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Subjective Acceleration Clause
documentation: Description of a subjective acceleration clause that is a part of the debt instrument. A subjective acceleration clause is a provision in a debt agreement that states that the creditor may accelerate the scheduled maturities of the obligation under conditions that are not objectively determinable (for example, if the debtor fails to maintain satisfactory operations or if a material adverse change occurs).

name: DebtInstrumentTable
standard_label: Schedule of Long-Term Debt Instruments [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about long-term debt instrument or arrangement.

name: DebtInstrumentTaxStatus
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Tax Status (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Discussion of whether interest on the debt instrument is taxable or nontaxable at federal, state or other levels, and a description of its other tax attributes.

name: DebtInstrumentTerm
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Term
documentation: Period between issuance and maturity of debt instrument, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: DebtInstrumentThirdPartyCreditEnhancement
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Third-Party Credit Enhancement (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Disclosure of the existence of a third-party credit enhancement on the entity's issued liability.

name: DebtInstrumentTypeExtensibleList
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountCurrent
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Current
documentation: Amount of debt discount to be amortized within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountNoncurrent
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of debt discount to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumAndDebtIssuanceCostsNet
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
documentation: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumAndDebtIssuanceCostsNetAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumNet
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumNetAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedPremium
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedPremiumAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium [Abstract]

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedPremiumCurrent
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Current
documentation: Amount of debt premium to be amortized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: DebtInstrumentUnamortizedPremiumNoncurrent
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of debt premium to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmount
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Amount
documentation: Amount of unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity as of the balance sheet date.

name: DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityDescription
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Description
documentation: Description of unused borrowing capacity under the debt instrument and conditions under which the commitment can be withdrawn by the lender.

name: DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityFee
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Fee
documentation: Amount of commitment fees for the unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity.

name: DebtInstrumentValuationTechniqueExtensibleList
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Valuation Technique [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates valuation technique for measuring debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

name: DebtInstrumentVariableInterestRateTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Debt Instrument, Variable Interest Rate, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of variable interest rate on debt instrument.

name: DebtInstrumentsAbstract
standard_label: Debt Instruments [Abstract]

name: DebtIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Debt Issuance Cost (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of debt issuance costs (for example, but not limited to, legal, accounting, broker, and regulatory fees).

name: DebtIssuanceCostsIncurredDuringNoncashOrPartialNoncashTransaction
standard_label: Debt Issuance Costs Incurred During Noncash or Partial Noncash Transaction
documentation: The amount of debt issuance costs that were incurred during a noncash or partial noncash transaction.

name: DebtIssuanceCostsLineOfCreditArrangementsGross
standard_label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Gross
documentation: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

name: DebtIssuanceCostsLineOfCreditArrangementsNet
standard_label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

name: DebtIssuanceCostsLineOfCreditArrangementsNetAbstract
standard_label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net [Abstract]

name: DebtIssuanceCostsNetAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net, Alternative [Abstract]

name: DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount
standard_label: Debt, Long-Term and Short-Term, Combined Amount
documentation: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

name: DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmountAbstract
standard_label: Debt, Long-Term and Short-Term, Combined Amount [Abstract]

name: DebtMember
standard_label: Debt [Member]
documentation: Contractual obligation to pay money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates.

name: DebtOfSubsidiaryNotAssumed
standard_label: Debt of Subsidiary, Not Assumed
documentation: Debt of a subsidiary that has not been assumed or guaranteed by the entity and any liens on premises of a subsidiary, or its consolidated subsidiaries, which have not been assumed by the entity, or its consolidated subsidiaries.

name: DebtPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Debt, Policy [Policy Text Block]

In the case of a nuclear station this comprises three different states of clearance. Immediately after the final closure, radi

name: DecommissioningLiabilityNoncurrent
standard_label: Decommissioning Liability, Noncurrent

name: DecommissioningTrustAssetsAmount

name: DecommissioningTrustAssetsDescription

name: DeconsolidationNatureOfContinuingInvolvementDescription

name: DeconsolidationRevaluationOfRetainedInvestmentGainOrLossAmount
standard_label: Deconsolidation, Revaluation of Retained Investment, Gain (Loss), Amount
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement to fair value of retained investment in former subsidiary and group of assets constituting business or nonprofit activity deconsolidated and derecognized, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of product or service in contract with customer.

name: DecreaseInRestrictedCash

name: DecreaseInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossible

name: DeductionsCharges

name: DeductionsChargesAbstract

documentation: Date the financial statement was made available and submitted, in CCYY-MM-DD format.

name: DeferrableNotesMember
standard_label: Deferrable Notes [Member]
documentation: Deferrable Notes or Deferred Interest Notes defer interest payments until some future date. They are similar to a zero coupon bond except that interest is paid at some future date.

name: DeferredAdvertisingCosts
standard_label: Deferred Advertising Costs
documentation: The costs of direct-response advertising whose primary purpose is to elicit sales to customers who could be shown to have responded specifically to the advertising and that results in probable future benefits and are reported as assets net of accumulated amortization.

documentation: Value of revenue deferred or cost to provide future services associated with points or miles outstanding and awards that expect to be redeemed through customer loyalty programs and the value of transportation services sold but as yet used by the passenger. name: DeferredAirTrafficRevenueCurrentAbstract

Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans and defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans.

name: DeferredBonusMember
standard_label: Deferred Bonus [Member]
documentation: Contractual arrangement whereby employee is entitled to receive future bonus, subject to vesting and other restrictions as defined in agreement, in addition to employee's regular salary and profit sharing. Includes, but is not limited to, discretionary or fixed formula employer contribution based on individual, group, and entity-wide performance goals or other factors.

name: DeferredChargesInsurersAbstract

name: DeferredChargesPolicyTextBlock

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for deferral and amortization of significant deferred charges.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualAllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-Based Compensation Expense
documentation: Amount of expense recognized from equity-based compensation arrangements (for example, shares of stock, unit, stock options or other equity instruments), awarded to key employees or individuals. name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualByTypeOfCompensationPensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsMember
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, by Type of Compensation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits [Member]
documentation: Deferred compensation arrangement providing pension or other postretirement benefits, to employee or their beneficiary, that are not equivalent to defined benefit plan.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCashAwardGrantedAmount

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCashAwardsGrantedAmount

documentation: Amount of commitment made to pay deferred cash remuneration.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCashAwardsGrantedPercentage
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Cash Awards Granted, Percentage
documentation: Commitment made to pay deferred cash remuneration expressed as a percentage of the individual's base salary.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCommonStockReservedForFutureIssuance
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Common Stock Reserved for Future Issuance
documentation: Number of common shares reserved for future issuance related to deferred compensation arrangements with individuals.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualCompensationExpense
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
documentation: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualContributionsByEmployer
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Contributions by Employer
documentation: Amount of contributions made by employer into fund established for purposes of making future disbursement to individual in accordance with deferred compensation arrangement.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualDescription
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Description
documentation: Description of the deferred compensation arrangement, including fixed amounts and determinable awards, or the method for determining payments and awards, the timing of such payments and awards, and any requisite service or performance criteria, as of the balance sheet date.

This type of arrangement is distinguished from broader based employee benefit plans as it

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualDistributionPaid
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Distribution Paid

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualDistributionsPaid
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Distributions Paid (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: The amount of distributions made to the individual during the period.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualEmployerContribution
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Employer Contribution (Deprecated 2017-01-31)

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualExcludingShareBasedPaymentsAndPostretirementBenefitsByTitleOfIndividualAxis

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualExcludingShareBasedPaymentsAndPostretirementBenefitsByTypeOfDeferredCompensationAxis

documentation: Maximum term of contract for deferred compensation arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualPostretirementBenefitsByTitleOfIndividualAxis
standard_label: Postretirement Benefits, by Title of Individual [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information by title of individual party related to other postretirement benefit arrangements. Excludes equity-based payments, pension or deferred bonus or profit sharing plan.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualPostretirementBenefitsByTypeOfDeferredCompensationAxis
standard_label: Other Postretirement Benefits, Individual Contracts, Type of Deferred Compensation [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of deferred compensation related to other postretirement benefit arrangements that are not equivalent to a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans and defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualPostretirementBenefitsLineItems
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Postretirement Benefits [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualRecordedLiability
standard_label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Recorded Liability
documentation: The carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date to an individual under a deferred compensation arrangement. This amount may be the result of periodic accruals made over the period of active employment, or reflect termination benefits resulting contractual terms or a death benefit.

name: DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualShareBasedPaymentsLineItems

name: DeferredCompensationCashbasedArrangementsLiabilityClassifiedNoncurrent

name: DeferredCompensationCashbasedArrangementsLiabilityCurrentAndNoncurrent

name: DeferredCompensationExcludingShareBasedPaymentsAndRetirementBenefitsMember

name: DeferredCompensationSharebasedArrangementsLiabilityCurrentAndNoncurrent

documentation: Amount of deferred cost assets and assets classified as other.

name: DeferredCostsCreditCardOriginationCostsAmortization

name: DeferredCreditsAndOtherLiabilitiesAbstract

documentation: Assertion that the determination of the amount of the unrecognized deferred tax liability relating to a temporary difference due to undistributed earnings of domestic subsidiaries is not practicable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedDeterminationOfDeferredTaxLiabilityIsNotPracticableUndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiaries
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Determination of Deferred Tax Liability is Not Practicable, Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Assertion that the determination of the amount of the unrecognized deferred tax liability relating to a temporary difference due to undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries is not practicable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedEventsThatWouldCauseTemporaryDifferenceToBeTaxable
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Events that Would Cause Temporary Difference to be Taxable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A summary of the events that would cause the temporary difference for which a deferred tax liability has not been recognized, because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes, to become taxable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedEventsThatWouldCauseTemporaryDifferenceToBeTaxableBadDebtReserveForTaxPurposesOfQualifiedLender
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Events that Would Cause Temporary Difference to be Taxable, Bad Debt Reserve for Tax Purposes of Qualified Lender
documentation: Description of events that would cause the temporary difference for which a deferred tax liability has not been recognized, because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to a bad debt reserve for tax purposes of a qualified lender, to be taxable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedEventsThatWouldCauseTemporaryDifferenceToBeTaxablePolicyholdersSurplus
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Events that Would Cause Temporary Difference to be Taxable, Policyholders' Surplus
documentation: Description of events that would cause the temporary difference for which a deferred tax liability has not been recognized, because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to a policyholders' surplus, to become taxable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedEventsThatWouldCauseTemporaryDifferenceToBeTaxableUndistributedEarningsOfDomesticSubsidiaries
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Events that Would Cause Temporary Difference to be Taxable, Undistributed Earnings of Domestic Subsidiaries
documentation: Description of events that would cause the temporary difference for which a deferred tax liability has not been recognized, because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of domestic subsidiaries, to become taxable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedEventsThatWouldCauseTemporaryDifferenceToBeTaxableUndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiaries
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Events that Would Cause Temporary Difference to be Taxable, Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
documentation: Description of events that would cause the temporary difference for which a deferred tax liability has not been recognized, because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries, to become taxable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedLineItems
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized [Line Items] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedNameOfTemporaryDifferenceDomain
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Temporary differences for which a deferred tax liability has not been recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedPolicyholdersSurplusAbstract
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Policyholders' Surplus [Abstract]

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedTable
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized [Table] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Schedule of deferred tax liabilities not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes. Includes, but is not limited to, descriptions of the temporary differences, events that would cause temporary differences to become taxable, the cumulative amount of temporary differences, and the amounts not recognized as deferred tax liabilities or a statement that the determination of the deferred tax liabilities is not practicable.

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedUndistributedEarningsOfDomesticSubsidiariesAbstract
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Undistributed Earnings of Domestic Subsidiaries [Abstract]

name: DeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedUndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiariesAbstract
standard_label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries [Abstract]

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAbstract
standard_label: Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset [Abstract]

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAllocatedToContributedCapital
standard_label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Allocated to Contributed Capital (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of valuation allowance for tax benefit to be credited to shareholders' equity if tax benefit subsequently becomes realizable. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment to opening balance of retained earnings for change in accounting principle or correction of error, gain (loss) in comprehensive income (loss) but excluded from net income (loss), deductible expenditure for income tax purposes reported as reduction of shareholders' equity, and deductible temporary difference existing at da

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAllocatedToReduceCapitalDescription
standard_label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Allocated to Reduce Capital, Description (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of circumstance resulting in valuation allowance being recorded for tax benefit to be credited directly to shareholders' equity. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment to opening balance of retained earnings for change in accounting principle or correction of error, gain (loss) in comprehensive income (loss) but excluded from net income (loss), deductible expenditure for income tax purposes reported as reduction of shareholders' equity, and deductible temporary difference existi

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAvailableToReduceGoodwill
standard_label: Deferred Tax, Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Goodwill (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of valuation allowance for deferred tax asset related to goodwill acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAvailableToReduceGoodwillAndIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Deferred Tax, Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Goodwill and Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of valuation allowance for deferred tax asset related to goodwill and intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAvailableToReduceGoodwillOrIntangibleAssetsDescription
standard_label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Goodwill or Intangible Assets, Description (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Describes the circumstances giving rise to a valuation allowance recorded against a deferred tax asset recognized for differences between the assigned values and the tax bases of the assets and liabilities recognized in a purchase business combination. Includes any portion of the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets for which subsequently recognized tax benefits will be allocated to reduce goodwill or other noncurrent intangible assets of an acquired entity.

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAvailableToReduceIncomeTaxExpense
standard_label: Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Effect on Income Tax Expense, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation allowance for deferred tax asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation, or both, and reported as adjustment to income tax expense. Excludes change in valuation allowance within measurement period.

name: DeferredTaxesBusinessCombinationValuationAllowanceAvailableToReduceIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Deferred Tax, Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of valuation allowance for deferred tax asset related to intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

name: DeferredVariableAnnuityMember
standard_label: Deferred Variable Annuity [Member]
documentation: Contract that provides periodic payments, which vary according to the investment experience of the separate accounts in which the amounts paid to provide for the annuity are allocated, which begin at a future date.

name: DefinedBenefitPensionMember
standard_label: Defined Benefit Pension [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: A defined benefit pension plan defines an amount of pension benefit to be provided to a retiree (or beneficiary), usually as a function of one or more factors such as age, years of service, or compensation. Any pension plan that is not a defined contribution pension plan is a defined benefit pension plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPensionPlanCurrentAndNoncurrentLiabilities
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPensionPlanLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Current
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as current. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPensionPlanLiabilitiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPensionPlansAndDefinedBenefitPostretirementPlansDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan [Abstract] (Deprecated 2020)

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccountingPolicyElectionMeasurementDate
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Accounting Policy Election, Measurement Date
documentation: Month-end measurement date applicable when an accounting policy election is made to measure plan assets and benefit obligations as of the month-end that is closest to the fiscal year-end, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccountingPolicyElectionMeasurementDateAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Accounting Policy Election, Measurement Date [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccountingPolicyElectionMeasurementDatePolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Accounting Policy Election, Measurement Date [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy election to measure plan assets and benefit obligations as of the month-end that is closest to the fiscal year-end.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObligation
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
documentation: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObligationIncreaseDecreaseForPlanAmendment
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated benefit obligation from change in existing term of defined benefit plan or initiation of new defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObligationIncreaseDecreaseForSettlementAndCurtailment
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement and Curtailment
documentation: Amount of (increase) decrease in accumulated benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from effects of settlement and curtailment.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeBeforeTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAfterTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), after Tax (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: After tax total of net gain (loss), prior service cost (credit), and transition assets (obligations), as well as minimum pension liability if still remaining, included in accumulated other comprehensive income associated with a defined benefit pension or other postretirement plan(s).

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAfterTaxAbstract
standard_label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeMinimumPensionLiabilityAfterTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income Minimum Pension Liability, after Tax (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: After tax amount of additional minimum pension liability not yet recognized as a net periodic pension cost.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeMinimumPensionLiabilityBeforeTax
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability, before Tax (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Before tax amount of additional minimum pension liability not yet recognized as a net periodic pension cost.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetGainsLossesAfterTax
standard_label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetGainsLossesBeforeTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Gain (Loss), before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetPriorServiceCostCreditAfterTax
standard_label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetPriorServiceCostCreditBeforeTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetTransitionAssetsObligationsAfterTax
standard_label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetTransitionAssetsObligationsBeforeTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Transition Asset (Obligation), before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAssets
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAssetsSoldDuringPeriod
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Sold
documentation: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets sold.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAssetsStillHeld
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Still Held
documentation: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets still held.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActuarialGainLoss
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActuarialGainLossImmediateRecognitionAsComponentInNetPeriodicBenefitCostCredit
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Gain (Loss), Immediate Recognition as Component in Net Periodic Benefit (Cost) Credit
documentation: Amount of gain (loss), recognized immediately as component of net periodic benefit (cost) credit, for change in value of benefit obligation or plan assets from experience different from that assumed, change in actuarial assumption, or consequence of temporarily deviating from substantive plan. Includes, but is not limited to, amount in excess of 10 percent of greater of fair value of plan assets or benefit obligation.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanActuarialNetGainsLosses
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Net (Gains) Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The net increase or decrease of changes in the value of either the benefit obligation or the plan assets resulting from experience different from that assumed or from a change in an actuarial assumption, or the consequence of a decision to temporarily deviate from the substantive plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAdditionalDisclosuresAboutPlanAssets
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Additional Disclosures about Plan Assets (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of additional asset categories and additional information about specific assets within a category that is useful in understanding the risks associated with each asset category and the overall expected long-term rate of return on assets.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAdditionalInformationAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Additional Information [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAdministrationExpenses
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Administration Expense
documentation: Amount of administration expense of defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. Excludes plan administration expense paid by employer.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAlternativeMethodUsedToAmortizeNetGainsAndLosses
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Alternative Method Used to Amortize Gain (Loss), Description
documentation: Description of alternative method used to amortize gain (loss) for defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAlternativeMethodUsedToAmortizePriorServiceAmounts
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Alternative Method Used to Amortize Prior Service Cost, Description
documentation: Description of alternative method used to amortize prior service cost (credit) for defined benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, straight-line amortization over average remaining service period of employees expected to receive benefits.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfGainsLosses
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfNetGainsLosses
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Gains (Losses) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amounts in accumulated other comprehensive income related to gains and losses that are not recognized immediately and are expected to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost over the next fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position presented.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfNetPriorServiceCostCredit
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amounts in accumulated other comprehensive income related to prior service cost or credit expected to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost over the next fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position presented.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfNetTransitionAssetObligation
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Transition Obligation (Asset) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) related to transition obligation (asset) expected to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for the fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfPriorServiceCostCredit
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
documentation: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfTransitionAssetObligation
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation)
documentation: Amount of transition asset (obligation) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfTransitionObligationsAssets
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Obligations (Assets) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: The amount of the transition obligation or asset recognized in net periodic benefit cost.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountAndTimingOfAssetsExpectedToBeReturnedToEmployerDuringFollowing12MonthPeriod
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assets Expected to be Returned to Employer, Description (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Description of plan assets expected to be returned to employer during 12-month period, or operating cycle, if longer, following latest fiscal year.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountOfEmployerAndRelatedPartySecuritiesIncludedInPlanAssets
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Amount
documentation: Amount of employer security in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, security issued or managed by related party of employer.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountToBeAmortizedFromAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNextFiscalYear
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount to be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) expected to be recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost for the fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position, including gain (loss), prior service cost (credit), and transition asset (obligation).

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInBalanceSheet
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position
documentation: Amount of asset (liability), recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInBalanceSheetAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetGainLossBeforeTax
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income from gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetGainLossBeforeTax
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Gain (Loss), before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate net gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income, including amounts arising during the period and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income as a result of being recognized as components of net periodic benefit cost for the period.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetGainLossBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetPriorServiceCostCreditBeforeTax
standard_label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income from prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeNetPriorServiceCostCreditBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsThatWillBeAmortizedFromAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossInNextFiscalYear
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Amounts that Will be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate amount in accumulated other comprehensive income expected to be recognized as a component of net periodic benefit cost over the fiscal year that follows the most recent annual statement of financial position presented, including the net gain (loss), net prior service cost or credit, and net transition asset or obligation.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsThatWillBeAmortizedFromAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossInNextFiscalYearAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization, Next Fiscal Year [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsExpectedToBeReturnedToEmployerAmount
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Expected to be Returned to Employer, Amount (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Amount of defined benefit plan asset expected to be returned to employer within one year or operating cycle, if longer, following current fiscal year.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsForPlanBenefitsAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assets for Plan Benefits [Abstract] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsForPlanBenefitsCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assets for Plan Benefits (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: This represents the entire assets recognized in the balance sheet that are associated with the defined benefit plans.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsForPlanBenefitsNoncurrent
standard_label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
documentation: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTargetAllocationsAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Allocations [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTransferredToFromPlan
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumedHealthCareCostTrendRatesAbstract
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumed Health Care Cost Trend Rates [Abstract]

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingBenefitObligationDiscountRate
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
documentation: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingBenefitObligationDiscountRateSupportBondIndices
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate Support, Bond Indices (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: If the assumed rate is benchmarked off published long-term bond indices, disclosure of how the timing and amount of cash outflows related to the bonds included in the indices match the plan's defined benefit payments. If there are differences between the terms of the bonds and the terms of the benefit obligations, disclosure of how the entity adjusts for the difference.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingBenefitObligationDiscountRateSupportMethodologyAndSourceData
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate Support, Methodology and Source Data (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of how the assumed discount rate was determined and the specific source data used to support the discount rate.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingBenefitObligationRateOfCompensationIncrease
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
documentation: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingBenefitObligationWeightedAverageInterestCreditingRate
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
documentation: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingNetPeriodicBenefitCostChangeDueToSubsequentInterimMeasurement
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Change Due to Subsequent Interim Measurement (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: The measurement date for determining rate assumptions used in calculating the net periodic benefit cost (such as the weighted-average expected long-term rate of return on plan assets and the discount rate) is normally the beginning of the year measurement date. If an assumed rate(s) changes due to a subsequent interim measurement of both plan assets and obligations, disclosure of the beginning and more recently assumed rate(s), or a properly weighted combination of the two. Disclosure may includ

name: DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalculatingNetPeriodicBenefitCostChangeDueToSubsequentInterimMeasurementWeightedAverageExpectedLongTermRateOfReturnOnPlanAssets
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Change Due to Subsequent Interim Measurement, Weighted-Average Expected Long-Term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
