Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset
documentation: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiabilityAmountNotOffsetAgainstCollateral
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset of Collateral
documentation: Fair value, after offset of derivative asset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, elected not to be and before offset against a right to receive collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiabilityAmountOffsetAgainstCollateral
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeNet
standard_label: Derivative, Fair Value, Net
documentation: Fair value of the assets less the liabilities of a derivative or group of derivatives.

name: DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeNetAbstract
standard_label: Derivative, Fair Value, Net [Abstract]

name: DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsAssetsFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

documentation: This item represents derivative instrument obligations meeting the definition of a liability which are reported as of the balance sheet date. name: DerivativeFixedInterestRate

documentation: Fixed interest rate related to the interest rate derivative.

name: DerivativeFloorInterestRate

documentation: Floor rate on an interest rate derivative such as an interest rate floor or collar. If market rates falls below the floor rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

name: DerivativeFloorPrice

documentation: Floor rate on a price risk derivative such as a floor or a collar. A payment or receipt is triggered if the market rate falls below the floor rate on the contract.

name: DerivativeForeignCurrencyOptionStrikePrice

standard_label: Derivative, Forward Interest Rate

name: DerivativeForwardPrice

documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes loss from effective portion of derivative instrument reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) into income.

name: DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis

name: DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAssetsAtFairValue
standard_label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Assets, at Fair Value
documentation: Aggregate fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAtFairValueNet
standard_label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, at Fair Value, Net
documentation: Aggregate net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAtFairValueNetAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, at Fair Value, Net [Abstract]

name: DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesLiabilitiesAtFairValue
standard_label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Liabilities, at Fair Value
documentation: Aggregate fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsIncomeStatementLocationOfGainOrLossReclassifiedFromAccumulatedOCI
standard_label: Derivative Instruments, Income Statement Location of Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The income statement location of the effective portion of net gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsLossReclassifiedFromAccumulatedOCIIntoIncomeEffectivePortion
standard_label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The effective portion of loss reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsLossRecognizedInIncome
standard_label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of loss recognized in income during the period on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments in fair value hedges and related hedged items designated and qualifying in fair value hedges, on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments in cash flow hedges, and on derivative instruments not designated as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsLossRecognizedInIncomeIneffectivePortionAndAmountExcludedFromEffectivenessTesting
standard_label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Income, Ineffective Portion and Amount Excluded from Effectiveness Testing (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The portion of losses on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments representing (a) the amount of the hedge ineffectiveness and (b) the amount, if any, excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsLossRecognizedInOtherComprehensiveIncomeEffectivePortion
standard_label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The effective portion of losses on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments that was recognized in other comprehensive income during the current period.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments [Abstract]

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsAssetAtFairValue
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsDescriptionOfTerms
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Description of Terms (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of the terms of the identified derivative instrument, Includes items such as the term and strike price for an option or the term, fixed leg and variable leg for a swap.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGain
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain
documentation: Amount of realized and unrealized gain of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
documentation: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNetAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net [Abstract]

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsLiabilityAtFairValue
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsLineItemOnIncomeStatementForGainLoss
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Line Item on Income Statement for Gain (loss) (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The caption on the income statement reflecting the gain (loss) on derivative instruments not designated as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsLoss
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Loss
documentation: Amount of realized and unrealized loss of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsPurpose
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Purpose
documentation: Description of the purpose of the derivative not designated as a hedging instrument.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsRisk
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Risk
documentation: Description of the risk underlying the derivative not designated as a hedging instrument. For example, interest rate risk, currency exchange risk, credit risk, or price risk.

name: DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsType
standard_label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Type (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of the type of derivative instrument identified. For example, swaps, swaptions, forwards.

name: DerivativeLiabilities
standard_label: Derivative Liability
documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

name: DerivativeLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Current
documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

name: DerivativeLiabilitiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent
documentation: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

name: DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
documentation: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Alternative [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityChangeInValuationTechnique
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Change in Valuation Technique [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether valuation technique or approach changed for measuring derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityChangeInValuationTechniqueReasonExtensibleList
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Change in Valuation Technique, Reason [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates reason valuation technique or approach changed for measuring derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityCollateralRightToReclaimCashOffset
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash Offset
documentation: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements offset against derivative liabilities.

name: DerivativeLiabilityCounterpartyNameExtensibleList
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Counterparty Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of counterparty to derivative liability. Counterparty is other party participating in financial transaction. Example includes, but is not limited to, name of financial institution.

name: DerivativeLiabilityCurrentStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes derivative liability classified as current.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAmountOffsetAgainstCollateralAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy of derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAsset
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Asset Offset
documentation: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAssetAndRightToReclaimCashOffset
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Gross Asset and Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset
documentation: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAssetAndRightToReclaimCashOffsetAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Gross Asset and Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossLiabilityIncludingNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
documentation: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossLiabilityIncludingNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueNet
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the gross assets less the gross liabilities of a derivative liability or group of derivative liabilities.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueNet1
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fair value of the gross liabilities less the gross assets of a derivative liability or group of derivative liabilities.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueNetAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset of Collateral [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueOfCollateral
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value of Collateral
documentation: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against derivative liabilities.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueOffsetAgainstCollateralNetOfNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementPolicyElection
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against the right to receive collateral.

name: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueOffsetAgainstCollateralNetOfNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementPolicyElectionAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: DerivativeLiabilityMeasurementDifferenceDescription
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Measurement Difference Description
documentation: Description of measurement difference between recognized amounts and resulting measurement differences for derivative liabilities.

name: DerivativeLiabilityMeasurementInput
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Measurement Input
documentation: Value of input used to measure derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityMeasurementInputExtensibleList
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Measurement Input [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates measurement input for derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityNoncurrentStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes derivative liability classified as noncurrent.

name: DerivativeLiabilityNotOffsetPolicyElectionDeduction
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
documentation: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
documentation: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: DerivativeLiabilityNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementDeduction
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative liabilities.

name: DerivativeLiabilityNotionalAmount
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Notional Amount
documentation: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityNumberOfInstrumentsHeld
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Number of Instruments Held
documentation: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative liability or group of derivative liabilities held by the entity.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseSecuritiesLoanedAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Alternative [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoaned
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned
documentation: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedAmountOffsetAgainstCollateral
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Includes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedAmountOffsetAgainstCollateralAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedAsset
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Asset Offset
documentation: Amount of asset associated with derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedCollateralRightToReclaimCash
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash Not Offset
documentation: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedCollateralRightToReclaimSecurities
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Security Not Offset
documentation: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedGross
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset
documentation: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedGrossIncludingNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
documentation: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedGrossIncludingNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedNotOffsetPolicyElectionDeduction
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
documentation: Amount of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
documentation: Amount of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementDeduction
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedOffsetAgainstCollateralNetOfNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementPolicyElection
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned, offset against a right to receive collateral.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellSecuritiesLoanedOffsetAgainstCollateralNetOfNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementPolicyElectionAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]

name: DerivativeLiabilitySetoffRightsDescription
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Setoff Rights, Description
documentation: Description of rights of setoff associated with the entity's recognized derivative liabilities subject to an enforceable master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: DerivativeLiabilityStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityTypeExtensibleList
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLiabilityValuationTechniqueExtensibleList
standard_label: Derivative Liability, Valuation Technique [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates valuation technique for measuring derivative liability.

name: DerivativeLineItems
standard_label: Derivative [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DerivativeLossOnDerivative
standard_label: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
documentation: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

name: DerivativeLossStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative, Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes loss from derivative.

name: DerivativeLowerFixedInterestRateRange
standard_label: Derivative, Lower Fixed Interest Rate Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low end of the range of fixed interest rates when a range is presented for a group of interest rate derivatives.

name: DerivativeLowerRangeOfBasisSpreadOnVariableRate
standard_label: Derivative, Lower Range of Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low end of the range of percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the group of interest rate derivatives.

name: DerivativeLowerRemainingMaturityRange
standard_label: Derivative, Lower Remaining Maturity Range (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The low end of the range of time remaining until maturity when a range is presented for a group of derivatives.

name: DerivativeLowerRemainingMaturityRange1
standard_label: Derivative, Lower Remaining Maturity Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low end period remaining until maturity of derivative contract, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: DerivativeLowerVariableInterestRateRange
standard_label: Derivative, Lower Variable Interest Rate Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low end of the range of variable interest rates when a range is presented for a group of interest rate derivatives.

name: DerivativeMaturityDates
standard_label: Derivative, Contract End Date
documentation: Date derivative contract ends, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: DerivativeMember
standard_label: Derivative [Member]
documentation: This element represents types of derivative financial instruments which are financial instruments or other contractual arrangements with all three of the following characteristics: (a) it has (1) one or more underlyings and (2) one or more notional amounts or payment provisions or both. Those terms determine the amount of the settlement or settlements, and, in some cases, whether or not a settlement is required; (b) it requires no initial net investment or an initial net investment that is small

name: DerivativeNameDomain
standard_label: Derivative, Name [Domain] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The name that identifies a derivative or group of derivatives on a disaggregated basis, such as for individual instruments, or small groups of similar instruments.

name: DerivativeNetAssetsPercentage
standard_label: Derivative, Net Assets, Percentage
documentation: Percentage of value of derivative contract to net assets.

name: DerivativeNetHedgeIneffectivenessGainLoss
standard_label: Derivative, Net Hedge Ineffectiveness Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from the ineffectiveness of the hedge.

name: DerivativeNetLiabilityPositionAggregateFairValue
standard_label: Derivative, Net Liability Position, Aggregate Fair Value
documentation: The aggregate fair value amounts of derivative instruments that contain credit-risk-related contingent features that are in a net liability position at the end of the reporting period. For nonderivative instruments that are designated and qualify as hedging instruments, the fair value amounts are the carrying value of the nonderivative hedging instrument, including the adjustment for the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on that instrument.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmount
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount
documentation: Nominal number of units used to calculate payment on derivative.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountEnergyMeasure
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Energy Measure
documentation: Nominal energy measure used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountFlowRate
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Flow Rate
documentation: Nominal flow rate used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountMass
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Mass
documentation: Nominal mass used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountPercentOfRequiredNeedCoverage
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Percent of Required Need, Coverage
documentation: The percentage of expected requirements covered by the aggregate notional amount of derivative contracts expressed in nonmonetary units. For example, the number of barrels specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract as a percentage of expected need.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountPricePerBarrel
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Price Per Barrel (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The price per barrel of the notional amount of the derivative contract expressed in nonmonetary units. For example, the price per barrel specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountPricePerGallon
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Price Per Gallon (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The price per gallon of the notional amount of the derivative contract expressed in nonmonetary units. For example, the price per gallon specified in a fuel forward purchase contract.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountPricePerUnit
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Price Per Unit (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The price per unit of the notional amount of the derivative contract expressed in nonmonetary units. For example, the price per barrel specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract.

name: DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountVolume
standard_label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Volume
documentation: Nominal volume used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

name: DerivativeNotionalAmount
standard_label: Derivative, Notional Amount
documentation: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

name: DerivativeNumberOfInstrumentsHeld
standard_label: Derivative, Number of Instruments Held

name: DerivativeNumberOfInstrumentsHeldAbstract

name: DerivativePositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative, Position [Extensible Enumeration]

name: DerivativePremiumPaid
standard_label: Derivative, Premium Paid

name: DerivativePriceRiskOptionStrikePrice
standard_label: Derivative, Price Risk Option Strike Price

name: DerivativeRemainingMaturity

name: DerivativeSignificantUnobservableInput

documentation: Indicates (true false) whether derivative value was determined using significant unobservable input.

name: DerivativeSwapType
standard_label: Derivative, Swap Type

name: DerivativeSwapTypeAverageFixedPrice
standard_label: Derivative, Swap Type, Average Fixed Price

name: DerivativeSwapTypeAverageVariablePrice
standard_label: Derivative, Swap Type, Average Variable Price
documentation: Average variable price rate related to the group of price risk swap derivatives.

name: DerivativeSwapTypeFixedPrice
standard_label: Derivative, Swap Type, Fixed Price
documentation: Fixed price related to the price risk swap derivative.

name: DerivativeSwapTypeVariablePrice
standard_label: Derivative, Swap Type, Variable Price (Deprecated 2026)

name: DerivativeSwaptionInterestRate
standard_label: Derivative, Swaption Interest Rate

name: DerivativeTable

name: DerivativeTermOfContract
standard_label: Derivative, Contract Term
documentation: Term of derivative contract, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: DerivativeTypeOfInstrument
standard_label: Derivative, Type of Instrument (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of the type of derivative instrument, such as a swap, forward, and option. Excludes the underlying risk of the instrument.

name: DerivativeUnderlying
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying
documentation: The underlying refers to the price on the security, commodity, index, or other variable specified by the contract.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingBasis
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Basis
documentation: Reference to the index or unit of measurement for the underlying which establishes the pricing terms of the derivative instrument. For example, the basis on the underlying for a natural gas futures contract might be the NYMEX price per million British thermal units (MMBtu).

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentBasketOrIndexAbstract
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Basket or Index [Abstract]

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentBasketOrIndexExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Basket or Index [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates basket or index for underlying investment in derivative.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentFairValue
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of underlying investment in derivative.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of underlying investment in derivative.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentPercentageToNetAssetsOfBasketOrIndex
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Percentage to Net Assets of Basket or Index
documentation: Percentage of underlying investment in derivative to net assets of basket or index.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentPrincipal
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Principal
documentation: Amount of principal of underlying investment in derivative.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentShares
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Investment, Shares
documentation: Number of shares of underlying investment in derivative.

name: DerivativeUnderlyingRisk
standard_label: Derivative, Underlying Risk, Description
documentation: Description of primary underlying risk exposure associated with the derivative, for example, but not limited to, interest rate risk, credit risk, foreign exchange rate risk, or price risk.

name: DerivativeVariableInterestRate
standard_label: Derivative, Variable Interest Rate
documentation: Variable interest rate in effect as of the balance sheet date related to the interest rate derivative.

name: DerivativesAndFairValueTextBlock
standard_label: Derivatives and Fair Value [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for derivatives and fair value of assets and liabilities.

name: DerivativesBasisAndUseOfDerivatives
standard_label: Derivatives, Basis and Use of Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the basis at which an entity records derivatives in its statements of financial position and the entity's use of derivatives in its operations.

name: DerivativesBasisAndUseOfDerivativesBasis
standard_label: Derivatives, Measurement Basis (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the basis at which an entity records derivatives in its statements of financial position.

name: DerivativesBasisAndUseOfDerivativesBasisDeterminationOfFairValue
standard_label: Derivatives, Determination of Fair Value
documentation: Describes how an entity determines the fair values of its derivatives, including its valuation methodology and significant assumptions used.

name: DerivativesBasisAndUseOfDerivativesUseOfDerivatives
standard_label: Derivatives, Use of Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes an entity's use of derivatives in its operations, including how the entity initially designates how its derivatives will be used in its operations.

name: DerivativesEmbeddedDerivatives
standard_label: Derivatives, Embedded Derivatives [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for embedded derivatives, including how such derivatives are identified and analyzed for possible separation from their host contracts.

name: DerivativesFairValueByBalanceSheetLocationAxis
standard_label: Derivatives, Fair Value, by Balance Sheet Location [Axis] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Fair value of derivative instrument, presented on a gross basis even when the derivative instrument is subject to master netting arrangements and qualifies for net presentation in the statement of financial position; presented by line item in the statement of financial position in which the fair value amounts of the derivative instruments are included.

name: DerivativesFairValueLineItems
standard_label: Derivatives, Fair Value [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DerivativesHedgeDiscontinuances
standard_label: Derivatives, Hedge Discontinuances [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for hedge discontinuances caused by termination of the hedging instrument, sale, extinguishment or maturity of the hedged item, or an assessment that it is no longer probable that an anticipated transaction will occur.

name: DerivativesHedgeDiscontinuancesAnticipatedTransactions
standard_label: Derivatives, Hedge Discontinuances, Anticipated Transactions [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for derivatives designated to an anticipated transaction, when it is no longer probable that the anticipated transaction will occur.

name: DerivativesHedgeDiscontinuancesTerminationOfHedgingInstrumentOrHedgedItem
standard_label: Derivatives, Hedge Discontinuances, Termination of Hedging Instrument or Hedged Item [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for terminations of derivatives designated as hedges or derivatives used to affect directly or indirectly the terms, fair value, or cash flows of a designated item, and the method used to account for derivatives when the designated item matures, is sold, extinguished, or terminated.

name: DerivativesMethodsOfAccounting
standard_label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Describes each method an entity uses to account for its derivative financial instruments and derivative commodity instruments ("derivatives"). name: DerivativesMethodsOfAccountingDerivativeTypes
standard_label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting, Derivative Types (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Describes the types of derivatives and the accounting method used by the entity for each type.

name: DerivativesMethodsOfAccountingHedgeDocumentation
standard_label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting, Hedge Documentation [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for documenting designated hedging relationships.

name: DerivativesMethodsOfAccountingHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting, Hedge Effectiveness [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining hedging effectiveness and if hedge effectiveness was assessed on quantitative or qualitative basis.

name: DerivativesMethodsOfAccountingHedgingDerivatives
standard_label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting, Hedging Derivatives [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for derivatives used in hedging relationships, which may include how gains or losses are recognized and presented in the financial statements, and amortization policies for deferred amounts.

name: DerivativesMethodsOfAccountingNonhedgingDerivatives
standard_label: Derivatives, Methods of Accounting, Derivatives Not Designated or Qualifying as Hedges [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for derivatives that either were not designated as hedging instruments or do not qualify for hedge accounting.

name: DerivativesOffsettingFairValueAmountsPolicy
standard_label: Derivatives, Offsetting Fair Value Amounts, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for offsetting or not offsetting fair value amounts recognized for derivative instruments against such amounts recognized for the right to reclaim cash collateral (a receivable) or the obligation to return cash collateral (a payable) arising from derivative instruments recognized at fair value.

name: DerivativesPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Derivatives, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for its derivative instruments and hedging activities.

name: DerivativesReportingOfDerivativeActivity
standard_label: Derivatives, Reporting of Derivative Activity [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for derivatives entered into for trading purposes and those entered into for purposes other than trading including where and when derivative financial instruments and derivative commodity instruments and their related gains or losses are reported in the entity's statements of financial position, cash flows, and results of operations.

name: DerivativesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Derivatives Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
documentation: Options and forward contracts that require physical settlement by repurchase of a fixed number of the issuer's equity shares in exchange for cash or that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the instrument by transferring its assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event certain to occur.

name: DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHedgeGainLossReclassifiedToEarningsNetOfTax
standard_label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings from the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

name: DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHedgeTaxExpenseBenefit
standard_label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Tax Expense (Benefit)
documentation: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from transactions on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

name: DescriptionAndEffectsOfChangesInPrepaymentEstimateAssumptionsForCMOsAndREMICsLineItems
standard_label: Description and Effects of Changes in Prepayment Estimate Assumptions for CMOs and REMICs [Line Items] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingForDiscontinuationOfForeignCurrencyFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Accounting for Discontinuation of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the accounting for discontinuation of an foreign currency fair value hedging relationship. Includes the accounting for the hedged item and the hedging instrument after discontinuation of the hedge designation. Also includes discussion of income statement and balance sheet effects of the discontinuation and the method of amortization of any adjustments to the carrying value of hedged items (if applicable).

name: DescriptionOfAccountingForDiscontinuationOfInterestRateFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Accounting for Discontinuation of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the accounting for discontinuation of an interest rate fair value hedging relationship. Includes the accounting for the hedged item and the hedging instrument after discontinuation of the hedge designation. Also includes discussion of income statement and balance sheet effects of the discontinuation and the method of amortization of any adjustments to the carrying value of hedged items (if applicable).

name: DescriptionOfAccountingForDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Accounting for Discontinuation of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the accounting for discontinuation of a price risk fair value hedging relationship. Includes the accounting for the hedged item and the hedging instrument after discontinuation of the hedge designation. Also includes discussion of income statement and balance sheet effects of the discontinuation and the method of amortization of any adjustments to the carrying value of hedged items (if applicable).

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodForForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method for Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for foreign currency derivatives designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodForHybridInstruments
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method for Hybrid Instruments (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for hybrid instruments containing embedded derivative instruments. May include discussion of where the hybrid instrument and the related gain (loss) are reported in the financial statements, and discussion of the analysis resulting in the bifurcation of the hybrid instrument and whether the entity has elected to account for the contract at fair value in its entirety.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodForInterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method for Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodForPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method for Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodUsedForCreditRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method Used for Credit Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for credit risk derivatives. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements. Also includes discussion of any hedge designations used, the assessment of hedge effectiveness and measurement of hedge ineffectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodUsedForForeignCurrencyDerivatives
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method Used for Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for foreign currency exchange rate derivatives. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements. Also includes discussion of any hedge designations used, the assessment of hedge effectiveness and measurement of hedge ineffectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodUsedForInterestRateDerivatives
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method Used for Interest Rate Derivatives (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for interest rate derivatives. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements. Also includes discussion of any hedge designations used, the assessment of hedge effectiveness and measurement of hedge ineffectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfAccountingMethodUsedForPriceRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Description of Accounting Method Used for Price Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for price risk derivatives. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements. Also includes discussion of any hedge designations used, the assessment of hedge effectiveness and measurement of hedge ineffectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfActivitiesOfParentCompany
standard_label: Description of Activities of Parent Company (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of activities of the registrant.

name: DescriptionOfAdoptionOfPolicyOnAccruedSabbatical
standard_label: Description of Adoption of Policy on Accrued Sabbatical (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of adoption, impact and effective dates of the policy to accrue sabbatical pay.

name: DescriptionOfAmountsOffsettingGainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Description of Amounts Offsetting Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of items and amounts that offset the gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. Includes discussion of foreign currency instruments that are used as natural or economic hedges.

name: DescriptionOfAmountsOffsettingGainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivatives
standard_label: Description of Amounts Offsetting Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of items and amounts that offset the gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives.

name: DescriptionOfAmountsOffsettingGainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Description of Amounts Offsetting Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of items and amounts that offset the gain (loss) on price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. Includes discussion of price risk instruments that are used as natural or economic hedges.

name: DescriptionOfBasisOfAccountingForTransactionsBetweenReportableSegments
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Measurement for Transactions Between Reportable Segments
documentation: A description of the basis of accounting for transactions between reportable segments.

name: DescriptionOfCapitalRequirementsOnTrustAssets
standard_label: Description of Capital Requirements on Trust Assets
documentation: Describes the capital requirements for trusts assets under management.

name: DescriptionOfCashFlowHedgeAccountingMethod
standard_label: Description of Cash Flow Hedge Accounting Method (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: General discussion of the accounting for cash flow hedges. Includes discussion of where derivatives and the gain (loss) on derivatives are reported in the financial statements. Also includes discussion of the assessment of hedge effectiveness and measurement of hedge ineffectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfCashFlowHedgeActivity
standard_label: Description of Cash Flow Hedge Activity
documentation: Contains all pertinent information about an entity's cash flow hedging activities.

name: DescriptionOfCashFlowHedgeRiskManagementPolicy
standard_label: Description of Cash Flow Hedge Risk Management Policy
documentation: Description of the entity's risk management policy for cash flow hedges, including a description of the items or transactions for which risks are hedged.

name: DescriptionOfChangeInAccountingPrincipleSFAS158
standard_label: Description of Change in Accounting Principle, FAS 158 (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of a change in accounting for a company's defined benefit postretirement plan including any changes required by the initial adoption of FAS No. 158, Employers' Accounting for Defined Benefit Pension and Other Postretirement Plans.

name: DescriptionOfChangeInAverageTrancheLifeEstimate
standard_label: Description of Change in Average Tranche Life Estimate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A description of a change in the average tranche life used as an underlying assumption for the prepayment estimates incorporated into cash flow projections for Collateralized Mortgage Obligations (CMOs) and Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduits (REMICs).

name: DescriptionOfChangeInCashFlowProjectionsEstimate
standard_label: Description of Change in Cash Flow Projections Estimate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A description of a change in the underlying assumption for the prepayment estimates incorporated into cash flow projections for Collateralized Mortgage Obligations (CMOs) and Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduits (REMICs).

name: DescriptionOfChangeInMeasurementDateSFAS158
standard_label: Description of Change in Measurement Date, FAS 158 (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of a change (and its effects) in the measurement date for a company's defined benefit postretirement plan including any changes required by the adoption of FASB Statement No. 158, Employers' Accounting for Defined Benefit Pension and Other Postretirement Plans.

name: DescriptionOfChangeInReinvestmentRateOfReturnEstimate
standard_label: Description of Change in Reinvestment Rate of Return Estimate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A description of a change in the reinvestment rate of return used as an underlying assumption for the prepayment estimates incorporated into cash flow projections for Collateralized Mortgage Obligations (CMOs) and Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduits (REMICs).

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfCashFlowHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfCreditRiskHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Credit Risk Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfFairValueHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of foreign currency cash flow hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of foreign currency fair value hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfInterestRateCashFlowHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of interest rate cash flow hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfInterestRateFairValueHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of interest rate fair value hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfNetInvestmentHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Net Investment Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of the ineffectiveness of a hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of price risk cash flow hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfComponentsOfGainLossExcludedFromAssessmentOfPriceRiskFairValueHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Description of Components of Gain (Loss) Excluded from Assessment of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of components of derivative instruments' gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of price risk fair value hedge effectiveness.

name: DescriptionOfCreditRiskDerivativeActivities
standard_label: Description of Credit Risk Derivative Activities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: General discussion of the entity's credit risk derivative activities.

name: DescriptionOfCreditRiskExposure
standard_label: Description of Credit Risk Exposure
documentation: Description of the sources of credit risk exposure faced by the entity.

name: DescriptionOfCreditRiskRelatedContingentFeaturesAbstract
standard_label: Description of Credit Risk Related Contingent Features [Abstract]

name: DescriptionOfCurrentStatusOfProject
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Property and Project, Description
documentation: A description of the current status of the significant properties or projects involved that have been excluded from amortization because the existence of oil and gas reserves has not been proved.

name: DescriptionOfDeferredCostsRelatedToLongTermContracts
standard_label: Description of Deferred Costs Related to Long-Term Contracts (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The description of deferred costs for long-term contracts and programs as of the balance sheet date. Examples include initial tooling and deferred production costs.

name: DescriptionOfDefinedContributionPensionAndOtherPostretirementPlans
standard_label: Defined Contribution Plan, Description
documentation: Description of defined contribution pension and other postretirement plans.

name: DescriptionOfDerivativeActivityVolume
standard_label: Description of Derivative Activity Volume
documentation: Information that would enable users to understand the volume of the entity's derivative activity.

name: DescriptionOfDerivativeInstrumentsByRiskExposure
standard_label: Description of Derivative Instruments by Risk Exposure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of derivative activity based on the instruments' primary underlying risk exposure such as interest rate risk, credit risk, foreign currency exchange risk, or overall price risk.

name: DescriptionOfDerivativeRiskManagementPolicy
standard_label: Description of Derivative Risk Management Policy (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of the entity's objectives and strategies pertaining to the use of derivative instruments and nonderivative hedging instruments in the context of the entity's overall risk management profile, and the risks associated with the use of derivatives. Indicates the purpose of derivative instruments not used for hedging purposes. Qualitative disclosures that describe the entity's objectives and strategies for holding derivatives in the context of an entity's overall risk management profile.

name: DescriptionOfDifferenceBetweenReportedAmountAndReportingCurrencyDenominatedAmount
standard_label: Description of Difference between Reported Amount and Reporting Currency Denominated Amount
documentation: Description of why the actual reporting currency-denominated balances differ from the amounts reported for financial reporting purposes, including the reasons for using two different rates with respect to remeasurement and translation. For example, in certain jurisdictions, companies may utilize an official exchange rate and also a parallel rate.

name: DescriptionOfDiscontinuationOfFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Discontinuation of Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the method used to account for discontinued fair value hedge relationships, including identification of hedged items and hedging instruments. Includes reasons for the discontinuation of the fair value hedge and the effects of the discontinuation on the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfDiscontinuationOfForeignCurrencyFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Discontinuation of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of discontinued fair value hedge relationships, including identification of hedged items and hedging instruments. Includes reasons for the discontinuation of the foreign currency fair value hedge and the effects of the discontinuation on the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfDiscontinuationOfInterestRateFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Discontinuation of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of discontinued fair value hedge relationships, including identification of hedged items and hedging instruments. Includes reasons for the discontinuation of the interest rate fair value hedge and the effects of the discontinuation on the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskFairValueHedge
standard_label: Description of Discontinuation of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of discontinued fair value hedge relationships, including identification of hedged items and hedging instruments. Includes reasons for the discontinuation of the price risk fair value hedge and the effects of the discontinuation on the financial statements.

name: DescriptionOfEffectOfSubsequentForeignCurrencyExchangeRateChange
standard_label: Description of Effect of Subsequent Foreign Currency Exchange Rate Change (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of a rate change that occurs after the date of the reporting entity's financial statements and its effects on unsettled balances pertaining to foreign currency transactions. Includes consideration of changes in unsettled transactions from the date of the financial statements to the date the rate changed and, if appropriate, a statement that it may not be practicable to determine these changes.

name: DescriptionOfEffectOnPreviouslyReportedSegmentInformationForChangeInCompositionOfReportableSegments
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Recasting, Previously Reported Information, Description
documentation: Description of recasting of previously reported segment information. Includes, but is not limited to, reason, timing, or why information has not been recast.

name: DescriptionOfEmbeddedDerivative
standard_label: Description of Embedded Derivative
documentation: Description of the embedded derivative instrument that was separated from its host contract and accounted for as a derivative. Includes identification of the embedded features and description of the terms of the instrument.

name: DescriptionOfEmbeddedRegulatoryAsset
standard_label: Description of Embedded Regulatory Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describes any embedded regulatory assets within the plant accounts. This may result when the regulatory depreciable life is longer than the depreciable life generally used for nonregulatory accounting.

name: DescriptionOfEmbeddedRegulatoryLiability
standard_label: Description of Embedded Regulatory Liability (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Describes any embedded regulatory liabilities within the plant accounts.

name: DescriptionOfFactorsThatMayAffectCapitalAdequacy

name: EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbeddedDerivativeNetAbstract

name: EmbeddedDerivativeLiabilityMeasurementInputExtensibleList

name: EmbeddedDerivativeLiabilityTypeExtensibleList

name: EmbeddedDerivativeLineItems

name: EmbeddedDerivativeLossOnEmbeddedDerivative

name: EmbeddedDerivativeNoLongerBifurcatedAmountReclassifiedToStockholdersEquity
standard_label: Embedded Derivative, No Longer Bifurcated, Amount Reclassified to Stockholders' Equity

name: EmbeddedDerivativeNoLongerBifurcatedReason

documentation: A description of the principal changes causing the embedded option to no longer require separation from the host instrument.

name: EmbeddedDerivativeTable

documentation: Disclosure of information about embedded derivatives.

name: EmbeddedServiceCosts

name: EmissionCreditsOrAllowancesPolicy
standard_label: Emission Credits or Allowances, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for emission credits or allowances. Such accounting policy has generally been based on an inventory or intangible asset model.

name: EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Employee Benefits and Share-Based Compensation
documentation: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

name: EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensationAbstract

name: EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensationNoncash
standard_label: Employee Benefit and Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash

name: EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
documentation: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrentAbstract

name: EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Employee-related Liabilities
documentation: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

name: EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationEstimatedQuantityOfSharesToBeRepurchasedInFollowingPeriod

documentation: Number of shares to be repurchased in accordance with a policy to use treasury stock to satisfy share-award conversions.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationEstimatedQuantityOfSharesToBeRepurchasedInFollowingPeriodMaximum
standard_label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Estimated Quantity of Shares to be Repurchased in Following Period, Maximum (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Maximum number of shares to be repurchased in accordance with a policy to use treasury stock to satisfy share-award conversions.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationEstimatedQuantityOfSharesToBeRepurchasedInFollowingPeriodMinimum
standard_label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Estimated Quantity of Shares to be Repurchased in Following Period, Minimum (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Minimum number of shares to be repurchased in accordance with a policy to use treasury stock to satisfy share-award conversions.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognized
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
documentation: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

standard_label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Total Compensation Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
