name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedPeriodForRecognition1
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition
documentation: Weighted-average period over which cost not yet recognized is expected to be recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Excluding Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
documentation: Amount of cost to be recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedStockOptions
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
documentation: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationPolicyForIssuingSharesUponExercise
standard_label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Policy for Issuing Shares upon Exercise (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The policy, if any, for issuing shares or units upon exercise or conversion of equity-based awards into shares of stock or units, including the source of those shares or units (that is, new share, treasury shares, new units or treasury units).

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTaxBenefitFromCompensationExpense
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
documentation: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTaxBenefitFromExerciseOfStockOptions

documentation: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

standard_label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Tax Benefit Realized from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of the aggregate tax benefit realized from the exercise of stock options and the conversion of similar instruments during the annual period.

name: EmployeeSeveranceMember

name: EmployeeStockMember
standard_label: Employee Stock [Member]
documentation: An Employee Stock Purchase Plan is a tax-efficient means by which employees of a corporation can purchase the corporation's stock.

name: EmployeeStockOptionMember
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option [Member]
documentation: Share-based payment arrangement granting right, subject to vesting and other restrictions, to purchase or sell certain number of shares at predetermined price for specified period of time.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPCashContributionsToESOP
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Cash Contributions to ESOP
documentation: This item represents the amount of cash contributions during the period made by the entity to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPClassificationOfDividends
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Classification of Dividends (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the entity's reporting of dividends on ESOP shares. For unallocated shares, describe the reduction of debt, reduction of accrued interest payable, or the increase of compensation cost. For allocated shares, describe the charge to retained earnings.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPCompensationExpense
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStructureDirectLoanDescription
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Description
documentation: Description of the terms of a loan made to the ESOP by a lender other than the employer, including interest rate and repayment requirements, and description of any guarantee of debt repayment made by the employer to the lender.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStructureDirectLoanEmployerCashPaymentsUsedForDebtService
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Employer Cash Payments Used for Debt Service
documentation: The amount of cash provided by the employer through contributions or dividends that the ESOP used in the period to repay debt and interest on a third-party loan made directly to the ESOP.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStructureEmployerLoanDescription
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Employer Loan, Description
documentation: Sets forth the terms of the arrangement, including interest rate and repayment requirements, in which the employer lends funds to the ESOP. The loan amount is not required to be externally reported.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStructureEmployerLoanGuarantee
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Employer Loan Guarantee
documentation: Reflects the amount as of the balance sheet date of the employer's guarantee of debt repayment by the ESOP.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStructureIndirectLoanAmount
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Indirect Loan, Amount
documentation: The amount reported as a liability as of the balance sheet date by the entity (the employer) of the loan made by a third-party lender to the employer relating to loans made by the employer to the ESOP.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStructureIndirectLoanDescription
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Indirect Loan, Description
documentation: Description of the terms of a loan, including interest rate and repayment requirements, made by a third-party lender to the employer relating to loans made by the employer to the ESOP, and description of any guarantee of debt repayment made by the employer to the lender.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDeferredShares
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares
documentation: Represents the carrying amount of shares held by the ESOP as of the balance sheet date in which no ESOP participant has a vested interest and no lender has a claim.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDeferredSharesAccountingTreatment
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares, Accounting Treatment (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the way transactions affect unearned shares (or any other form of unearned equity). Unearned ESOP shares are credited as shares and are committed to be released based on the cost of the shares to the ESOP. Employers charge or credit the difference between the fair value of shares committed to be released and the cost of those shares to the ESOP to shareholders' equity in the same manner as gains and losses on sales of treasury stock (generally to additional paid-in capital). If the emp

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDeferredSharesFairValue
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of unearned shares held by the employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDisclosuresByPlanAxis
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) Name [Axis]
documentation: Information by name of employee stock ownership plan.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDisclosuresLineItems
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) Disclosures [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDividendsPaidToESOP
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Dividends Paid to ESOP
documentation: Dividends paid on stock held by an employee stock ownership plan.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPEffectOfChangeinFairValueMeasurement
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Effect of Change in Fair Value Measurement (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Description of how the valuation methodology that was previously used differs from Topic 820 of the Accounting Standards Codification and the possible effect on prior valuations.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPEffectOnEarningsPerShare
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Effect on Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the treatment of ESOP shares in earnings per share computations.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPFairValueOfSharesSubjectToRepurchaseObligation
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Fair Value of Shares Subject to Repurchase Obligation
documentation: Fair value of the shares allocated that are subject to a repurchase obligation.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPGainLossOnTransactionsInDeferredShares
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Gain (Loss) on Transactions in Deferred Shares
documentation: The difference between cost and fair value added or subtracted from paid-in capital, arising from contribution of shares to an ESOP or commitments-to-release ESOP shares.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPInterestPaymentsFromESOP
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Interest Payments from ESOP
documentation: An entity often discloses the amount of interest paid by the ESOP to a lender.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPMethodOfMeasuringCompensation
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Method of Measuring Compensation (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the methods used in determining compensation expense to be recognized by the entity pertaining to its ESOP.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPNumberOfAllocatedShares
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Allocated Shares
documentation: The shares or units in an ESOP trust that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula. IRS rules require allocations to be nondiscriminatory generally based on compensation, length of service, or a combination of both. For any particular participant such shares or units may be vested, unvested, or partially vested.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPNumberOfCommittedToBeReleasedShares
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Committed-to-be-Released Shares
documentation: The shares that, although not legally released, will be released by a future scheduled and committed debt service payment and will be allocated to employees for service rendered in the current accounting period. The ESOP documents typically define the period of service to which the shares relate. ESOP shares are released to compensate employees directly, to settle employer liabilities for other employee benefits, and to replace dividends on allocated shares that are used for debt service.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPNumberOfSuspenseShares
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
documentation: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPlanDescription
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Plan Description
documentation: Description of the plan, including the basis for determining contributions, the employee groups covered, and the nature and effect of significant matters affecting comparability of information for all periods presented. For leveraged ESOPs and pension reversion ESOPs, the description generally includes the basis for releasing shares and how dividends on allocated and unallocated shares are used.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPlanDomain
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Plan [Domain]
documentation: Entities identify multiple employee stock ownership plans by unique name.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPolicy
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for ESOP transactions, including the method of measuring compensation, the classification of dividends on ESOP shares, and the treatment of ESOP shares for EPS computations. If the employer has both old ESOP shares for which it does not adopt new guidance and new ESOP shares for which new guidance is required, these disclosures are required for both blocks of shares.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPRepurchaseObligationAmount
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Repurchase Obligation Amount
documentation: An entity will typically disclose the amount of any repurchase obligation.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPSharesContributedToESOP
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares Contributed to ESOP
documentation: This item represents the number of shares provided to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) during the period.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPSharesInESOP
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares in ESOP
documentation: Sum of the allocated, committed-to-be-released and suspense shares of the entity held by the plan.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPSharesInESOPAbstract
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares in ESOP [Abstract]

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPTaxBenefitOfDividendsPaidToPlan

documentation: The tax benefit resulting from dividends paid on preferred stock held by an employee stock option plan, when that stock is not a common stock equivalent.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPTermsOfRepurchaseObligation
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Terms of Repurchase Obligation
documentation: Existence and nature of any repurchase obligation.

name: EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPWeightedAveragePurchasePriceOfSharesPurchased
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Weighted Average Purchase Price of Shares Purchased
documentation: Weighted average purchase price of capital shares purchased through an employee stock ownership plan.

name: EmployeeTrustAbstract
standard_label: Employee Trust [Abstract]

name: EmploymentContractsMember
standard_label: Employment Contracts [Member]
documentation: Contracts securing the services of employees, which may define the period of employment and the nature of the business relationship, and which may include nondisclosure and noncompete restrictions.

name: EnergyAxis
standard_label: Energy [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of energy source.

name: EnergyCommoditiesAndServiceMember
standard_label: Energy Commodities and Service [Member]
documentation: Energy provided from operation of on-site facility or cogeneration plant and by procurement service to energy purchaser, and marketing and trading of energy commodity and derivative.

name: EnergyDomain
standard_label: Energy [Domain]
documentation: Combustible material used to power engines, power plants or reactors. Examples include, but are not limited to, fuel and oil.

name: EnergyEquipmentMember
standard_label: Energy Equipment [Member]
documentation: Assets used in the production and distribution of energy from the producer to the consumer.

name: EnergyMarketingAccountsPayable
standard_label: Energy Marketing Accounts Payable
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for energy purchases, typically by a utility or an entity engaged in selling energy contracts.

name: EnergyMarketingContractLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Current
documentation: Current liabilities attributable to energy marketing activities (trading activities). Current energy marketing (trading activities) are when entities engage in both financial and physical trading to increase profits, manage their commodity price risk and enhance system reliability. They may trade electricity, coal, natural gas and oil. These entities typically use a variety of financial instruments, including forward contracts, options and swaps.

name: EnergyMarketingContractLiabilitiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Noncurrent
documentation: Fair value of liability arising from energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

name: EnergyMarketingContractsAssetsCurrent
standard_label: Energy Marketing Contracts Assets, Current
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from energy trading activities that involves the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts that include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: EnergyMarketingContractsAssetsNoncurrent
standard_label: Energy Marketing Contracts Assets, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from energy trading activities that involves the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts that include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: EnergyRelatedDerivativeMember
standard_label: Energy Related Derivative [Member]
documentation: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to energy, for example, but not limited to, crude oil, electricity and natural gas.

name: EnergyRelatedInventory
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies relating to a source of usable power held for future sale or future use in manufacturing or production process.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryAbstract
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory [Abstract]

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryChemicals
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Chemicals
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of solvents or substances produced by or used in a process to change the shape, form or composition of some related matter.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryCoal
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Coal
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of coal, which is a combustible rock or minerals which are extracted from the ground and used as fuel.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryGasStoredUnderground
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Gas Stored Underground
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas stored underground in depleted gas reservoirs, aquifers, or salt caverns to meet seasonal and peak load demands, and also as insurance against unforeseen supply disruptions, and deemed to be a current asset because it is expected to be used within twelve months or in the normal operating cycle.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryNaturalGasInStorage
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Natural Gas in Storage
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas in storage, which is a mixture of gases (liquefied or otherwise), used for fuel and manufacturing purposes, which is ready for sale.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryNaturalGasLiquids
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Natural Gas Liquids
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of liquid hydrocarbon components recovered from natural gas.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryOtherFossilFuel
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Other Fossil Fuel
documentation: Amount of fossil fuel included in inventory classified as other.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryPetroleum
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Petroleum
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of petroleum or crude oil.

name: EnergyRelatedInventoryPropaneGas
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Propane Gas
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of product derived from petroleum during the processing of oil or natural gas which is then used as a heat source or fuel.

name: EnergySectorMember
standard_label: Energy Sector [Member]
documentation: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to energy.

name: EnergyServiceMember
standard_label: Energy Service [Member]
documentation: Energy provided from operation of on-site facility or cogeneration plant and by procurement service to energy purchaser.

name: EnhancedEquipmentTrustCertificateMember

The revenue stream of the leased asset services the debt. When the trusts retire or otherwise satisfy the certificates, title to the asset will generally pass to the lessee. name: EntertainmentCashFlowElementsAbstract
standard_label: Entertainment Cash Flow Elements [Abstract]

name: EntertainmentEntitiesPolicyPolicyTextBlock

The disclosure may include a contingency conclusion that addresses the estimated total unrecognized exposure to environmental remediation and other loss contingencies.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostLineItems

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsAnticipatedCost
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Anticipated Cost
documentation: Total anticipated costs associated with remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs that may occur on the sale, disposal, or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsAssetsPreviouslyDisposedLiabilityForRemediation

documentation: Carrying amount of the liability for remediation of environmental damage pertaining to assets or businesses previously disposed.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsCostsAccruedToDate
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Costs Accrued to Date
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsImpairmentAssessment
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Impairment Assessment
documentation: Describes how the necessary expenditures are considered in the assessment of the asset's value and the possible need to reflect an impairment loss if an asset held for sale or development will require remediation to be performed before development, sale, or as a condition of sale.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsNameOfPropertyDomain
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Name of Property [Domain]
documentation: Name of the property being sold, disposed, or abandoned that requires remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs as a result of unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsNatureOfCosts
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Nature of Costs
documentation: Description of the types of remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossibleAdditionalLoss
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Loss
documentation: Estimate of reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossibleAdditionalLosses
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossibleAdditionalLossesBestEstimate
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Losses, Best Estimate (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Best estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossibleAdditionalLossesHighEstimate
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Losses, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High-end estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

name: EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossibleAdditionalLossesLowEstimate
standard_label: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Losses, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low-end estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

standard_label: Environmental Expense and Liabilities

name: EnvironmentalExpenseAndLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Environmental Expense and Liabilities [Abstract]

name: EnvironmentalIssueMember

documentation: Ecological or external issues that require remediation including, but not limited to, restoration or clean up of property, regulatory compliance, or to sell, abandon or dispose of such property.

name: EnvironmentalLossContingencyCurrentStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration

name: EnvironmentalLossContingencyDisclosureTextBlock

name: EnvironmentalLossContingencyNoncurrentStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Environmental Loss Contingency, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes accrual for environmental loss contingency classified as noncurrent.

name: EnvironmentalLossContingencyStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration

standard_label: Environmental Remediation Expense, after Recovery, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes environmental remediation expense after credit for recovery.

name: EnvironmentalRemediationExpenseMember

name: EnvironmentalRemediationExpenseRecoveryStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Environmental Remediation Expense, Recovery, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes recovery of environmental remediation expense.

name: EnvironmentalRemediationExpenseStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Environmental Remediation Expense, before Recovery, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes environmental remediation expense before recovery.

name: EnvironmentalRemediationMember

name: EquipmentExpense

standard_label: Equipment Leased to Other Party [Member] (Deprecated 2021)
documentation: Tangible personal property used to generate rental income.

This form of financing, for example, is commonly used by, but not limited to, airlines and railroads for the purchase of aircraft or rolling stock, respectively.

standard_label: Equity, Change in Capital Structure, Effective Date

standard_label: Equity, Class of Treasury Stock [Axis] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

name: EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptionModificationDebtOriginationIncreaseInEquityAmount
standard_label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Debt Origination, Increase in Equity, Amount

standard_label: Equity-Classified Written Call Option, Modification, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount

name: EquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestrictionIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Equity Security, FV-NI, Contractual Sale Restriction, Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in earnings on restricted investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) from removal of discount for contractual sale restriction in measurement of fair value.

name: EquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestrictionNatureOfRestrictionAndCircumstanceForLapse
standard_label: Equity Security, FV-NI, Contractual Sale Restriction, Nature of Restriction and Circumstance for Lapse
documentation: Description of nature of restriction and circumstance that could cause lapse in restriction for equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes investment in equity security by investment company for which discount for contractual sale restriction is applied.

name: EquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestrictionRemainingPeriod
standard_label: Equity Security, FV-NI, Contractual Sale Restriction, Remaining Period
documentation: Period remaining for contractual sale restriction on equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), subject to contractual sale restriction, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes investment in equity security by investment company for which discount for contractual sale restriction is applied.

name: EquitySwapMember
standard_label: Equity Swap [Member]
documentation: Contracts in which the counterparties exchange a series of cash payments based on (a) an equity index and (b) a fixed or floating interest rate on a notional principal amount. Equity swap contracts typically are tied to a stock index, but sometimes they relate to a particular stock or a defined basket of stocks.

name: EquityUnitPurchaseAgreementsMember
standard_label: Equity Unit Purchase Agreements [Member]
documentation: Contracts and securities that allow the holder to buy equity units from the entity.

name: ErrorCorrectionOtherMember
standard_label: Error Correction, Other [Member]
documentation: Error correction to previously issued financial statement classified as other.

name: ErrorCorrectionPreviouslyImmaterial
standard_label: Error Correction, Previously Immaterial [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether error was previously considered immaterial.

name: ErrorCorrectionTextBlock
standard_label: Error Correction [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for reporting error correction.

name: ErrorCorrectionTypeExtensibleList
standard_label: Error Correction, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of error correction.

name: ErrorCorrectionsAndPriorPeriodAdjustmentsDescription
standard_label: Error Corrections and Prior Period Adjustments, Description
documentation: Description of a prior period adjustment to previously issued financial statements, including an adjustment that is a correction of an error. At a minimum, the description may include the nature and reasons for the adjustment and the periods affected by the adjustment, as well as (1) the effect of the correction on each financial statement line item and any per-share amounts affected for each prior period presented (2) the cumulative effect of the change on retained earnings or other appropriate

name: ErrorCorrectionsAndPriorPeriodAdjustmentsInterimPeriodsOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Error Corrections and Prior Period Adjustments, Interim Periods of Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure made in interim financial reports about error corrections and adjustments related to prior interim periods of the current fiscal year, which includes: (a) the effect on income from continuing operations, net income, and related per share amounts for each prior interim period of the current fiscal year, and (b) income from continuing operations, net income, and related per share amounts for each restated prior interim period. Disclosure also includes the effect of the adjustment on the

name: ErrorCorrectionsAndPriorPeriodAdjustmentsRestatementByRestatementPeriodAndAmountAxis
standard_label: Error Correction, Type [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of error correction.

name: ErrorCorrectionsAndPriorPeriodAdjustmentsRestatementLineItems
standard_label: Error Corrections and Prior Period Adjustments Restatement [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: EscrowDeposit
standard_label: Escrow Deposit
documentation: The designation of funds furnished by a borrower to a lender to assure future payments of the borrower's real estate taxes and insurance obligations with respect to a mortgaged property. Escrow deposits may be made for a variety of other purposes such as earnest money and contingent payments. This element excludes replacement reserves which are an escrow separately provided for within the US GAAP taxonomy.

name: EscrowDepositDisbursementsRelatedToPropertyAcquisition
standard_label: Escrow Deposit Disbursements Related to Property Acquisition (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Escrow deposit disbursements related to property acquisition in noncash investing or financing transactions.

name: EscrowDepositDisbursementsRelatedToPropertyAcquisition1
standard_label: Escrow Deposit Disbursements Related to Property Acquisition
documentation: Amount of escrow deposit disbursements related to property acquisition in noncash investing or financing transactions.

name: EscrowDepositsRelatedToPropertySales
standard_label: Escrow Deposits Related to Property Sales
documentation: Escrow deposits related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

name: EsopCommonSharesMember
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan, Common, Shares [Member]
documentation: Contra-equity account for common shares issued by employer to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: EsopDividendOnAllocatedShareIncreaseDecreaseInNetIncomeToCommonShareholderAmount
standard_label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan, Dividend on Allocated Share, Increase (Decrease) in Income to Common Shareholder, Amount, after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) in income available to common shareholder for difference between amount of compensation cost reported and amount that would have been reported if allocated share had been converted to common stock at beginning of period, when dividend on allocated share is used to pay debt service for employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: EstimateOfCancellations
standard_label: Estimate of Cancellations (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Estimates of cancellations for refundable service fees, if accounted for by analogy to FASB Statement No. 48.

name: EstimateOfFairValueFairValueDisclosureMember
standard_label: Estimate of Fair Value Measurement [Member]
documentation: Measured as an estimate of fair value.

name: EstimatedInsuranceRecoveries
standard_label: Estimated Insurance Recoveries
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts expected to be recovered under the terms of insurance contracts.

name: EuriborFutureMember
standard_label: Euribor Future [Member]
documentation: A standardized contact, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell a 3-month Euro Interbank Offered Rate (Euribor) time deposit at a certain date n the future, at a certain yield.

name: EuroDollarCertificatesOfDepositMember
standard_label: EuroDollar Certificates of Deposit [Member]
documentation: Bank issued certificate of deposit denominated in U.S. Dollars where the issuing financial institution is located outside the US.

name: EurodollarFutureMember
standard_label: Eurodollar Future [Member]
documentation: A standardized contract, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell a 90-day Eurodollar time deposit at a certain date in the future, at a certain yield. At expiration, the official rate quoted on a 90-day Eurodollar time deposit by the British Bankers Association (BBA) determines the final settlement. Eurodollar futures contracts do not permit actual delivery of a Eurodollar time deposit; rather they settle in cash.

name: EurodollarMember
standard_label: Eurodollar [Member]
documentation: Interest rate based on U.S. dollar denominated deposits at foreign banks or foreign branches of U.S. banks.

name: EuropeMember
standard_label: Europe [Member]
documentation: Continent of Europe.

name: EuropeanUnionMember
standard_label: European Union [Member]
documentation: Economic and political union of member states, located primarily in Europe.

name: ExcessCapital
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Excess, Actual
documentation: Amount of total risk-based capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessCapitalToRiskWeightedAssets
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Excess, Actual
documentation: Ratio of total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessNetCapitalAt1000Percent
standard_label: Excess Net Capital at 1000 Percent (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The amount of net capital in excess of the level at which the broker-dealer may be prohibited from expanding its business.

name: ExcessNetCapitalAt1500Percent
standard_label: Excess Net Capital at 1500 Percent
documentation: The amount of net capital in excess of the minimum required net capital.

name: ExcessNetCapitalAt1500PercentAbstract
standard_label: Excess Net Capital at 1500 Percent [Abstract]

name: ExcessOfReplacementOrCurrentCostsOverStatedLIFOValue
standard_label: Excess of Replacement or Current Costs over Stated LIFO Value
documentation: The excess of replacement or current cost over the stated LIFO (last in first out) inventory value when the LIFO inventory method is utilized.

name: ExcessOfReportedClosedBlockLiabilitiesOverAssetsDesignatedToClosedBlock
standard_label: Excess of Reported Closed Block Liabilities over Assets Designated to Closed Block
documentation: The difference between the liabilities of and the assets allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

name: ExcessOfReportedClosedBlockLiabilitiesOverAssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockAbstract
standard_label: Excess of Reported Closed Block Liabilities over Assets Designated to Closed Block [Abstract]

name: ExcessStockNumberOfSharesParValueAndOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Excess Stock, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: ExcessStockSharesAuthorized
standard_label: Excess Stock, Shares Authorized
documentation: Maximum number of excess stock shares permitted to be issued.

name: ExcessStockSharesIssued
standard_label: Excess Stock, Shares Issued
documentation: Number of excess stock shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders.

name: ExcessStockSharesOutstanding
standard_label: Excess Stock, Shares Outstanding
documentation: Number of shares of excess stock held by shareholders.

name: ExcessTangibleCapital
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital, Excess, Actual
documentation: Amount of tangible capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessTangibleCapitalRequiredForCapitalAdequacyToTangibleAssets
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital Ratio, Excess, Actual
documentation: Ratio of tangible capital to tangible assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessTaxBenefitFromShareBasedCompensationFinancingActivities
standard_label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-Based Compensation, Financing Activities (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

name: ExcessTaxBenefitFromShareBasedCompensationOperatingActivities
standard_label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-Based Compensation, Operating Activities (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

name: ExcessTierOneLeverageCapital
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Excess Tier 1 Leverage Capital, Actual
documentation: Amount of Tier 1 leverage capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessTierOneLeverageCapitalToAverageAssets
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Excess Tier 1 Leverage Capital Ratio, Actual
documentation: Ratio of Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessTierOneRiskBasedCapital
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital, Excess, Actual
documentation: Amount of Tier 1 risk-based capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExcessTierOneRiskBasedCapitalToRiskWeightedAssets
standard_label: Banking Regulation, Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Excess, Actual
documentation: Ratio of Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

name: ExchangeClearedMember
standard_label: Exchange Cleared [Member]
documentation: Transaction where an organization acts as an intermediary, reconciling orders between transacting parties.

name: ExchangeFees
standard_label: Exchange Fees
documentation: The amount of expense in the period for fees charged by securities exchanges for the privilege of trading securities listed on that exchange. Some fees vary with the related volume, while others are fixed.

name: ExchangeFeesMember
standard_label: Exchange Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Exchange fees are charged by securities exchanges for the privilege of trading securities listed on that exchange.

name: ExchangeFeesPolicy
standard_label: Exchange Fees, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for disclosing fees charged by stock exchanges for the privilege of trading securities listed on those specific stock exchanges.

name: ExchangeMembershipContributedPolicy
standard_label: Exchange Membership Contributed Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for contributed exchange memberships, including the valuation method, terms of the contribution and any fees.

name: ExchangeMembershipWithRightToConductBusinessPolicy
standard_label: Exchange Membership with Right to Conduct Business Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for exchange memberships only with the right to conduct business, including the valuation method, classification as an intangible asset and whether the life of the exchange membership is finite or indefinite. The accounting policy may also disclose the impairment policy and any impairments recognized. If the intangible is a finite life, the disclosure could include assigned life, accumulated amortization, amortization expense for the reporting year and amortizatio

name: ExchangeMembershipWithRightsOfOwnershipAndToConductBusinessPolicy
standard_label: Exchange Membership with Rights of Ownership and to Conduct Business Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for exchange memberships ownership rights and rights to conduct business including valuation method and impairment policy. This element is not applicable to exchange memberships that do not include both ownership rights and the right to conduct business on the exchange.

name: ExchangeMembershipsPolicy
standard_label: Exchange Memberships, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for exchange membership with right of ownership, right to conduct business and contributed exchange membership.

name: ExchangeOfProductHeldForSaleForDissimilarProductMember
standard_label: Exchange of Held-for-Sale Product for Dissimilar Product [Member]
documentation: The exchange of a product held for sale in the ordinary course of business for dissimilar property as a means of selling the product to a customer.

name: ExchangeOfProductHeldForSaleForSimilarProductMember
standard_label: Exchange of Held-for-Sale Product for Similar Product [Member]
documentation: The exchange of a product held for sale in the ordinary course of business for similar property as an accommodation, to satisfy an immediate inventory need or otherwise reduce costs or facilitate ultimate sales.

name: ExchangeOfProductiveAssetsMember
standard_label: Exchange of Productive Assets [Member]
documentation: The exchange of assets employed in production for similar productive assets or an equivalent interest in similar productive assets. The trade of player contracts by professional sports organizations is an example.

name: ExchangeOfStockForStockMember
standard_label: Reorganization, Chapter 11, Exchange of Stock Adjustment [Member]
documentation: This type of entry reflects the exchange of predecessor common and preferred stock with common stock of the successor entity.

name: ExchangeTradedFundsMember
standard_label: Exchange Traded Funds [Member]
documentation: Investment that follows an index, commodity or basket of assets that trades similar to a stock on an exchange.

name: ExchangeTradedMember
standard_label: Exchange Traded [Member]
documentation: Transaction that takes place on an organized exchange.

name: ExchangeTradedOptionsMember
standard_label: Exchange Traded Options [Member]
documentation: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific or standard commodity, or financial or equity instrument, at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option), which are traded on a stock exchange.

name: ExchangeableDebtMember
standard_label: Exchangeable Debt [Member]
documentation: Debt instrument that permits the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring assets upon an event that is certain to occur.

name: ExciseAndSalesTaxes
standard_label: Excise and Sales Taxes
documentation: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

name: ExciseTaxesCollected
standard_label: Excise Taxes Collected
documentation: The excise taxes collected by a public utility and reported in revenues if the amount of excise taxes is equal to 1 percent or more of such total.

name: ExecutiveCommitteeMember
standard_label: Executive Committee [Member]
documentation: Group of individual members with executive titles.

name: ExecutiveCompensationContractsMember
standard_label: Executive Compensation Contracts [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Contracts securing the services of executive employees, which may define the period of employment and the nature of the business relationship, and which may include nondisclosure and noncompete restrictions.

name: ExecutiveOfficerMember
standard_label: Executive Officer [Member]
documentation: One of the ranking officers of the entity, appointed to the position by the board of directors.

name: ExecutiveVicePresidentMember
standard_label: Executive Vice President [Member]
documentation: Senior officer of the entity that may be appointed by the board of directors, with a rank below president or chief executive officer.

name: ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsNetOfInterestAccruedAbstract
standard_label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Next Five Years [Abstract]

name: ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearFive
standard_label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Five (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Expected amortization expense in the fifth year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

name: ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearFour
standard_label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Four (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Expected amortization expense in the fourth year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

name: ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearOne
standard_label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year One (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Expected amortization expense in the first year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

name: ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearThree
standard_label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Three (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Expected amortization expense in the third year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

name: ExpectedAmortizationExpenseOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearTwo
standard_label: Expected Amortization Expense of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Two (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Expected amortization expense in the second year after the balance sheet date of the present value of the future profits of long-duration contracts acquired in a purchase of an insurance enterprise.

name: ExpenseOffsetArrangementExpenseIncrease
standard_label: Expense Offset Arrangement, Expense, Increase
documentation: Amount of increase in expense that would have been incurred if not under expense offset arrangement in which service is provided by another party in exchange for use of asset.

name: ExpenseOffsetArrangementExpenseIncreaseStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Expense Offset Arrangement, Expense, Increase, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase in expense that would have been incurred if not under expense offset arrangement in which service is provided by another party in exchange for use of asset.

name: ExpenseOffsetArrangementUseOfAsset
standard_label: Expense Offset Arrangement, Use of Asset [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether use of asset by another party in expense offset arrangement could have been used to produce income.

name: ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrServicingAndUnderwritingFees
standard_label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
documentation: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

name: ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrServicingAndUnderwritingFeesMember
standard_label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The expense incurred by the entity related to distribution or servicing and underwriting Fees.

name: ExpensesAndLossesReportingCurrencyDenominatedValue
standard_label: Expenses and Losses, Reporting Currency Denominated, Value
documentation: The reporting currency-denominated expense (including losses) amount.

name: ExperienceRatedRefundsPayable
standard_label: Experience Rated Refunds Payable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liability of the assuming entity to the ceding insurer for the refund of a portion of the excess of premiums earned over estimated claims and expenses and a profit factor, which is usually based upon an agreed upon formula.

name: ExperienceRatedRefundsReceivable
standard_label: Experience Rated Refunds Receivable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The estimated amount due by a ceding insurer from an assuming insurer of future policy benefits and losses plus a profit factor in excess of premiums, typically based on formulas in an agreement between the parties.

name: ExplanationDifferencesBetweenBookAndTaxBasis
standard_label: Explanation, Differences Between Book and Tax Basis (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Narrative regarding the nature of the differences, if any, between accounting for book purposes and federal income tax purposes. Examples may include deferral of losses on wash sales and straddles, tax treatment of like-kind securities transactions, timing of gains on certain futures and foreign currency contracts, and investments in passive foreign investment companies.

name: ExplanationOfChangeInCumulativeTranslationAdjustment
standard_label: Explanation of Change in Cumulative Translation Adjustment (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describes the cause of changes in the cumulative translation adjustment during the period.

name: ExplanationOfInterestRevenueReportedNetOfInterestExpense
standard_label: Segment Reporting Information, Interest Income or Expense, Net, Policy (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: A statement that interest revenue is reported net of interest expense for the reportable segment.

name: ExplanationOfNecessaryInformationNotAvailableAndDevelopmentCostExcessive
standard_label: Entity-Wide Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Impracticality of Disclosure (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of the impracticality, if applicable, of providing geographic segment information.

name: ExplanationOfReasonsForDifferencesInReserveEstimates
standard_label: Explanation of Reasons for Differences in Reserve Estimates (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Description of the nature of differences between reserve estimates filed with other federal agency or authority and estimates included in Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filing.

name: ExploitationCostsPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Exploitation Costs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for exploitation costs.

name: ExplorationAbandonmentAndImpairmentExpense
standard_label: Impairment, Oil and Gas, Property with Unproved Reserve
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with unproved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, previously capitalized cost of drilling exploratory well when proved reserve is not found or when there is substantial doubt about economic or operational viability of project.

name: ExplorationAndProductionCosts
standard_label: Exploration and Production Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Cost incurred related to the upstream oil and gas activities, such as the exploration, development, and production of crude petroleum and natural gas.

name: ExplorationAndProductionEquipmentMember
standard_label: Exploration and Production Equipment [Member]
documentation: Equipment used in the process of surveying, preparing land for the extraction of natural resources and extracting natural resources.

name: ExplorationAndProductionRevenue
standard_label: Exploration and Production Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue related to the upstream oil and gas activities, such as exploration, development, and production of crude petroleum.

name: ExplorationCosts
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Exploration Cost, Period Cost
documentation: Amount of capitalized exploration cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

name: ExplorationCostsCumulative
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Exploration Cost
documentation: Amount of capitalized exploration cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

name: ExplorationExpense
standard_label: Exploration Expense
documentation: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes r

name: ExplorationExpenseMining
standard_label: Exploration Expense, Mining (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to the mining industry would be included in operating expenses. Exploration costs include costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of mineral reserves.

name: ExploratoryDrillingCostsCapitalizationAndImpairmentPolicy
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for capitalization of exploratory drilling costs, including the criteria management applies in evaluating whether costs incurred meet the criteria for initial capitalization, continued capitalization, impairment, and how often such evaluations are made.

name: ExploratoryWellsDrilledLineItems
standard_label: Exploratory Wells Drilled [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ExploratoryWellsDrilledNetNonproductive
standard_label: Exploratory Wells Drilled, Net Nonproductive
documentation: The number of nonproductive exploratory wells (dry wells) drilled in the geographic area. A dry well (hole) is a well found to be incapable of producing either oil or gas in sufficient quantities to justify completion as an oil or gas well. The number of wells drilled refers to the number of wells (holes) completed at any time during the fiscal years, regardless when drilling was initiated.

name: ExploratoryWellsDrilledNetProductive
standard_label: Exploratory Wells Drilled, Net Productive
documentation: The number of productive exploratory wells drilled in the geographic area. A productive well is a well that is not a dry well. The number of wells drilled refers to the number of wells (holes) completed at any time during the fiscal years, regardless when drilling was initiated.

name: ExploratoryWellsDrilledTable
standard_label: Exploratory Wells Drilled [Table]
documentation: These elements contain detailed information for net exploratory wells drilled by geographic area.

name: ExplosionMember
standard_label: Explosion [Member]
documentation: Release of mechanical, chemical, or nuclear energy in a sudden and often violent manner.

name: ExpropriationOfAssetsAxis
standard_label: Expropriation of Assets [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information about a government's act or threat to take title to property owned by the entity without providing compensation at fair market value.

name: ExpropriationOfAssetsDomain
standard_label: Expropriation of Assets [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Acts or threats of governments to take title to property owned by the entity without providing compensation at fair market value.

name: ExpropriationOfAssetsMember
standard_label: Expropriation of Assets [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: A government's act or threat to take title to property owned by the entity without providing compensation at fair market value, if at all.

name: ExtendedMaturityAndInterestRateReductionMember
standard_label: Extended Maturity and Interest Rate Reduction [Member]
documentation: Loan modification for extension of term of loan in which it must be paid, reduction of contractual interest rate, and reduction of interest rate to lower than current market rate for new debt with similar risk.

name: ExtendedMaturityAndPrincipalForgivenessMember
standard_label: Extended Maturity and Principal Forgiveness [Member]
documentation: Loan modification for extension of term of loan in which it must be paid and reduction of unpaid principal amount on loan.

name: ExtendedMaturityMember
standard_label: Extended Maturity [Member]
documentation: Loan modification for an extension of the term of a loan in which it must be paid.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrual
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual
documentation: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate extended product warranty liability. Does not include the ending balance for the standard product warranty liability.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsFromBusinessAcquisition
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
documentation: Amount of increase in liability for extended product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for standard warranty acquired in business combination.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualBalanceSheetCaption
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Balance Sheet Caption (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describes the line item on the balance sheet where the aggregate extended product warranty liability is recorded.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualBalanceSheetClassificationAbstract
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Balance Sheet Classification [Abstract]

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualCurrencyTranslationIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Currency Translation Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Increase or Decrease in extended product warranty liability attributable to currency translation. Does not include any Increase or Decrease in standard product warranty liability due to currency translation.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualCurrent
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Current
documentation: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year of the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualForeignCurrencyTranslationGainLoss
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the extended product warranty accrual. Excludes standard product warranties.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualNoncurrent
standard_label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid after one year from the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

name: ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPayments
