name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedCorporateDebtAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Debt, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of firm holdings in corporate fixed income securities. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedCorporateEquitiesAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Equities, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in corporate stocks (common and preferred), stock options, warrants and any other financial instrument which represents, or provides the ability to obtain, ownership rights in a corporation. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedDerivativesAndOtherContractualAgreementsAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Derivatives and Other Contractual Agreements, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in all assets resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments. Their value is derived from the values of one or more underlying assets, reference rates, or indices of asset values. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedMortgagesMortgageBackedAndAssetBackedSecuritiesAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-Backed and Asset-Backed Securities, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card rece

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of firm holdings in securities classified as other. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherSovereignGovernmentObligationsAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other Sovereign Government Obligations, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in fixed income obligations issued by foreign governments. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPhysicalCommoditiesAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Physical Commodities, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in physical commodity contracts (for example, agricultural products, metals and energy). Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPledgedStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financial Instrument, Owned, Pledged Status [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates pledged status of security from proprietary transaction entered into by broker-dealer for trading and investment purposes.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPledgingPurposeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financial Instrument, Owned, Pledging Purpose [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates pledging purpose of security from proprietary transaction entered into by broker-dealer for trading and investment purposes.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPrincipalInvestmentsAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Principal Investments, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in private equity, mezzanine, venture capital, merchant banking, real estate and special situations investments. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedStateAndMunicipalGovernmentObligationsAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, State and Municipal Government Obligations, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in fixed income obligations issued by state and local governments and authorities. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsOwnedUSGovernmentAndAgencyObligationsAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value
documentation: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

name: FinancialInstrumentsPledgedAsCollateralAbstract
standard_label: Financial Instruments Pledged as Collateral [Abstract]

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedAtFairValue
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedAtFairValueAbstract
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value [Abstract]

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedCorporateDebt
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Corporate Debt
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from corporate debt obligations sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedCorporateEquities
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Corporate Equities
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from corporate equity sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedDerivativesAndOtherContracts
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Derivatives and Other Contracts
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from derivatives and other contracts sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedMortgagesMortgageBackedAndAssetBackedSecurities
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Mortgages, Mortgage-Backed and Asset-Backed Securities
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from mortgages, mortgage-backed securities and asset-backed securities sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedOtherSovereignGovernmentDebt
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Other Sovereign Government Debt
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from foreign government debt obligations short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedPhysicalCommoditiesSold
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Physical Commodities Sold
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from physical commodities sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedStateAndMunicipalGovernmentObligations
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, State and Municipal Government Obligations
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from state and municipal debt obligations sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedUSGovernmentAndAgencyObligations
standard_label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, US Government and Agency Obligations
documentation: Fair value of obligations arising from US treasury and other US government and agency debt obligations sold short.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionNumberOfStockholders
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Number of Stockholders (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Number of stockholders holding financial instruments subject to mandatory redemption.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionNumberOfStockholders1
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Number of Stockholders
documentation: Number of stockholders holding financial instruments subject to mandatory redemption.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionPastContractualRedemptionDateDueToOutstandingActivity
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Past Contractual Redemption Date, Due to Outstanding Activity
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock past the contractual redemption date due to outstanding activity.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionPastContractualRedemptionDateDueToRegulatoryAction
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Past Contractual Redemption Date, Due to Regulatory Action (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock past the contractual redemption date due to regulatory action.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionRedeemableInYearFive
standard_label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Five
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionRedeemableInYearFour
standard_label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Four
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionRedeemableInYearThree
standard_label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Three
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionRedeemableInYearTwo
standard_label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Two
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionRedeemableWithinOneYear
standard_label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year One
documentation: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsForwardPriceOrOptionStrikePriceSharesSettlementDate
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Forward Price or Option Strike Price, Shares, Settlement Date
documentation: Settlement date of the forward contract or option indexed to the issuer's equity shares, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsForwardPriceOrOptionStrikePriceSharesSettlementDates
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms Forward Price or Option Strike Price, Shares Settlement Dates (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: For a forward contract or an option indexed to the issuer's equity shares, the settlement dates or ranges of dates of the contract, as applicable.

name: FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsImpactOfChangesInFairValueOfSharesOnNumberOfShares
standard_label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Impact of Changes in Fair Value of Shares on Number of Shares
documentation: Increase (decrease) in number of shares from change in fair value of issuer's equity shares affect on settlement amount. For example, but not limited to, additional shares for each $1 decrease in the fair value of one share.

name: FinancialLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Financial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value of financial obligations, including, but not limited to, debt instruments, derivative liabilities, federal funds purchased and sold under agreements to repurchase, securities loaned or sold under agreements to repurchase, financial instruments sold not yet purchased, guarantees, line of credit, loans and notes payable, servicing liability, and trading liabilities.

name: FinancialLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Financial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

name: FinancialServiceMember
standard_label: Financial Service [Member]
documentation: Financial assistance, including, but not limited to, management and maintenance of depositor account, credit card, merchant discount, trust, investment and insurance.

name: FinancialServiceOtherMember
standard_label: Financial Service, Other [Member]
documentation: Financial assistance, including, but not limited to, management and maintenance of depositor account, credit card, merchant discount, trust, investment and insurance, classified as other.

name: FinancialServicesCosts
standard_label: Financial Services Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered by an entity.

name: FinancialServicesCostsAbstract
standard_label: Financial Services Costs [Abstract]

name: FinancialServicesLiabilities
standard_label: Financial Services Liabilities
documentation: For entities that provide full or partial financing and servicing for customers supplementary to its major operations (such as a manufacturer or a homebuilder providing and servicing loans to buyers), represents the liabilities associated with such activities, including accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

name: FinancialServicesRevenue
standard_label: Financial Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate financial services revenue and operating interest income earned during the reporting period.

name: FinancialServicesRevenueAbstract
standard_label: Financial Services Revenue [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: FinancialServicesSectorMember
standard_label: Financial Services Sector [Member]
documentation: Sector of the economy consisting of companies engaged in financial services.

name: FinancialStandbyLetterOfCreditMember
standard_label: Financial Standby Letter of Credit [Member]
documentation: An irrevocable undertaking (typically by a financial institution) to guarantee payment of a specified financial obligation if defined events occur or fail to occur.

name: FinancialStatementLineItemsWithDifferencesInReportedAmountAndReportingCurrencyDenominatedAmountsDomain
standard_label: Financial Statement Line Items with Differences in Reported Amount and Reporting Currency Denominated Amounts [Domain] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The line items on the financial statements for which the amounts reported for financial reporting purposes differ from the underlying reporting currency-denominated amounts.

standard_label: Financial Statement Line Items with Differences in Reported Amount and Reporting Currency Denominated Amounts [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: FinancialStatementPresentationWhileInChapter11Abstract
standard_label: Financial Statement Presentation While in Chapter 11 [Abstract]

name: FinancialSupportCapitalContributionsMember
standard_label: Financial Support, Capital Contributions [Member]
documentation: Assets contributed to an entity by a shareholder, partner or owner, increasing his or her equity interest in the entity. Excludes pari passu investments.

documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: FinancialSupportForNonconsolidatedLegalEntityTable
standard_label: Financial Support for Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about financial support provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

name: FinancialSupportPurchaseAgreementOfFinancialAssetsMember
standard_label: Financial Support, Purchase Agreement of Financial Assets [Member]
documentation: Agreement to purchase financial assets for amounts greater than fair value.

name: FinancialSupportToNonconsolidatedLegalEntityDomain
standard_label: Financial Support to Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Domain]
documentation: Financial support arrangement provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

name: FinancialSupportWaivedFeesMember
standard_label: Financial Support, Waived Fees [Member]
documentation: Fees which are no longer required to be paid.

name: FinancingAxis
standard_label: Financing [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information by type of financing an entity uses to raise funds or capital.

name: FinancingDomain
standard_label: Financing [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Activities the entity engages in to raise funds or capital for use in its operations.

name: FinancingInterestExpense
standard_label: Financing Interest Expense
documentation: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

name: FinancingLeaseLeaseNotYetCommencedMember
standard_label: Financing Lease, Lease Not yet Commenced [Member]
documentation: Lease that has not yet commenced, classified as financing.

name: FinancingMember
standard_label: Financing [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Raising of funds or capital for the entity for use in its operations.

name: FinancingReceivable
standard_label: Financing Receivable (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The amount of the recorded investment in a contractual right to receive money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates that is recognized as an asset in the creditor's statement of financial position. Examples include, but are not limited to, accounts receivable (with terms exceeding one year), notes receivable and receivables relating to lessor's rights to payments from leases other than operating leases that have been recorded as assets.

name: FinancingReceivableAccountingPolicyElectionAccruedInterestWriteoffMethodFixedList
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accounting Policy Election, Accrued Interest Writeoff Method [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates method of writeoff for accrued interest on financing receivable. Acceptable values are "Reversing interest income", "Recognizing credit loss expense", and "Reversing interest income and recognizing credit loss expense".

name: FinancingReceivableAccountingPolicyElectionAdjustmentOfEffectiveInterestRate
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accounting Policy Election, Adjustment of Effective Interest Rate [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether accounting policy was elected to adjust effective interest rate used to discount expected cash flows to consider effect of expected prepayment on financing receivable.

name: FinancingReceivableAccountingPolicyElectionNotToMeasureAllowanceForCreditLossForAccruedInterest
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accounting Policy Election, Not to Measure Allowance for Credit Loss for Accrued Interest [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether accounting policy was elected not to measure allowance for credit loss for accrued interest on financing receivable.

name: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.

standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, on financing receivable.

name: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.

name: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestModified
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Modified in Period, Accrued Interest, Amount
documentation: Amount of accrued interest on financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

name: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestThresholdPeriodWriteoff
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, Threshold Period, Writeoff
documentation: Period when accrued interest on financing receivable is considered uncollectible and written off, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestWriteoff
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, Writeoff
documentation: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on financing receivable recognized by reversing interest income.

name: FinancingReceivableAcquiredWithDeterioratedCreditQuality
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Acquired with Deteriorated Credit Quality (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The balance of financing receivables that were acquired with deteriorated credit quality.

name: FinancingReceivableAdditionalDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Additional Disclosures [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrentRelatedAndNonrelatedPartyStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current, Related and Nonrelated Party Status [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Indicates related and nonrelated party status for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss, classified as current.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrentRelatedPartyCounterpartyNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current, Related Party, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of related party for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss, classified as current.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrentRelatedPartyTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss, classified as current.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrentRelatedAndNonrelatedPartyStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent, Related and Nonrelated Party Status [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Indicates related and nonrelated party status for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss, classified as noncurrent.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrentRelatedPartyCounterpartyNameExtensibleEnumeration

documentation: Indicates name of related party for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss, classified as noncurrent.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrentRelatedPartyTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss, classified as noncurrent.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossRelatedAndNonrelatedPartyStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Related and Nonrelated Party Status [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Indicates related and nonrelated party status for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossRelatedPartyCounterpartyNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Related Party, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of related party for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossRelatedPartyTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for financing receivable, after allowance for credit loss.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterDeferredIncomeOffset
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Deferred Income Offset (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount, after fee received for commitment to originate or purchase, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

name: FinancingReceivableAfterDeferredIncomeOffsetAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Deferred Income Offset [Abstract] (Deprecated 2020)

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceDomain
standard_label: Financing Receivable Allowance [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Represents financing receivable portfolio segments.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossAdditionalInformationAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Additional Information [Abstract]

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest

documentation: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current
documentation: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossForeignCurrencyTranslation
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Foreign Currency Translation
documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanPurchased
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Other Purchased Loan
documentation: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased loan classified as other. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, purchased seasoned loan, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanSold
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Loan Sold
documentation: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossPurchasedSeasonedLoan
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased Seasoned Loan
documentation: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased seasoned loan.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossPurchasedSeasonedLoanMeasureUsingAmortizedCostBasisPolicyElection
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased Seasoned Loan, Measure Using Amortized Cost Basis, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether accounting policy is elected to measure allowance for credit loss for purchased seasoned loan using amortized cost basis.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossPurchasedWithCreditDeteriorationIncrease
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration
documentation: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoffAfterRecovery
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
documentation: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoffByOriginationYearAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, by Origination Year [Abstract]

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLosses
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesAcquiredWithDeterioratedCreditQuality
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Acquired with Deteriorated Credit Quality (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The valuation allowance for financing receivables acquired with deteriorated credit quality.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesCollectivelyEvaluatedForImpairment

documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on collective basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on individual basis.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesEffectOfChangeInMethod
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Effect of Change in Method

documentation: A description of the factors that influenced management's judgment concerning the allowance for credit losses including historical losses and existing economic conditions.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesIndividuallyEvaluatedForImpairment
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The valuation allowance for financing receivables that are expected to be uncollectible that were individually evaluated for impairment.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesIndividuallyEvaluatedForImpairment1
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Individually Evaluated
documentation: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesLineItems
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesPolicyForUncollectibleAmounts

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for charging off uncollectible financing receivables, including, but not limited to, factors and methodologies used in estimating the allowance for credit loss.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesPolicyOrMethodologyChangePolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Policy or Methodology Change [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing any changes to a creditor's accounting policies or methodology from the prior period and management's rationale for the change.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesProvisions
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Provisions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Charge to expense for financing receivables that are expected to be uncollectible.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesRecoveries
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Recoveries (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Reduction to the allowance for credit losses related to collections on financing receivables which have been partially or fully charged off as bad debts.

name: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesRecovery
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
documentation: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery.

name: FinancingReceivablesEqualToGreaterThan90DaysPastDueMember
standard_label: Financial Asset, Equal to or Greater than 90 Days Past Due [Member]
documentation: Financial asset equal to or greater than 90 days past due.

name: FinancingReceivablesImpairedTroubledDebtRestructuringWriteDown
standard_label: Financing Receivables, Impaired, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Write-down
documentation: Reflects the amount of the write-down related to a troubled debt restructuring.

name: FinancingReceivablesPeriodPastDueAxis
standard_label: Financial Asset, Aging [Axis]
documentation: Information by period in which financial asset is past due or not past due.

name: FinancingReceivablesPeriodPastDueDomain
standard_label: Financial Asset, Aging [Domain]
documentation: Period in which financial asset is past due or not past due. For past due, element name and standard label in Financial Asset, [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] [date measure] Past Due [Member] or Financial Asset, Greater than [low end numeric value] [date measure] Past Due [Member] or Financial Asset, Less than [high end numeric value] [date measure] Past Due [Member] formats.

name: FinancingReceivablesTextBlock
standard_label: Financing Receivables [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for financing receivable.

name: FiniteLivedAndIndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredAsPartOfBusinessCombinationTableTextBlock
standard_label: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Finite-Lived and Indefinite-Lived [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets acquired in business combination.

name: FiniteLivedCoalSupplyAgreementGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Coal Supply Agreement, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of an acquired coal supply agreement, which provides benefits for a finite period of time. Under a coal supply agreement, a power company buys coal to meet the requirements of one of its power plants. under specified terms for specified time periods. Coal prices are determined and adjusted pursuant to the price change provisions in the agreement.

name: FiniteLivedComputerSoftwareGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Computer Software, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs to ready software for sale or licensing, or for long-term internal use.

name: FiniteLivedContractualRightsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Contractual Rights, Gross
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of an intangible asset that arises from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

name: FiniteLivedCopyrightsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Copyrights, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the legal rights held for a finite period specified by legislation, covering only the form or manner in which ideas or information have been manifested, and which prohibit reproduction of same without the right holder's consent, such as reproducing copyrighted text, a work of art, or software.

name: FiniteLivedCoreDepositsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Core Deposits, Gross
documentation: Bank deposits belonging to an acquired bank that can be counted on as a stable source of lending funds. These deposits have the following attributes: predictable costs and low sensitivity to interest rates. This intangible asset is usually amortized over its estimated useful life.

name: FiniteLivedCustomerListsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Customer Lists, Gross
documentation: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer list acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

name: FiniteLivedCustomerRelationshipsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Customer Relationships, Gross
documentation: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer relationship acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

name: FiniteLivedDistributionRightsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Distribution Rights, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of legal rights to distribute a product or products, often within specific geographical areas or supply channels, for a specified period of time, including reasonably expected renewal periods.

name: FiniteLivedFranchiseRightsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Franchise Rights, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of acquired rights to market the name or products of another entity in a specified territory and for a specified period, including reasonably expected renewal periods.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetAcquiredInPlaceLeases
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Acquired-in-Place Leases
documentation: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to existing tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetOffMarketLeaseFavorableGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, off-Market Lease, Favorable, Gross
documentation: This element represents the identifiable intangible asset established upon acquisition based on a favorable difference between the terms of an acquired lease and the current market terms for that lease at the acquisition date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Useful Life
documentation: Useful life of finite-lived intangible asset, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetWeightedAveragePeriodBeforeNextRenewalOrExtension
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Renewed or Extended, before Next Renewal or Extension, Weighted-Average Period
documentation: Weighted-average period before next renewal or extension for finite-lived intangible asset that has been renewed or extended, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets [Abstract] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAmortization
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Accumulated Amortization
documentation: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired
standard_label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life acquired.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredAsPartOfBusinessCombinationTable
standard_label: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Finite-Lived [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpense
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate amount of intangible asset amortization recognized as expense during the period.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseAfterYearFive
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, after Year Five
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Next Rolling 12 Months
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseNextTwelveMonths
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year One
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Remainder of Fiscal Year
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseRollingAfterYearFive
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling after Year Five
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseRollingYearFive
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Five
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseRollingYearFour
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Four
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseRollingYearThree
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Three
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseRollingYearTwo
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Two
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseTableTextBlock
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Amortization Expense [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Includes, but is not limited to, capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearFive
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Five
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearFour
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Four
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearThree
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Three
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationExpenseYearTwo
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Estimated Amortization Expense, Year Two
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationMethod
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Amortization Method
documentation: Description of method used to amortize finite-lived intangible asset.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsArisingFromInsuranceContractsAcquiredInBusinessCombinationGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the intangible asset that arises from measuring the difference between (a) the fair value of the contractual insurance and reinsurance assets acquired and liabilities assumed and (b) the assets and liabilities measured in accordance with the acquirer's policies for insurance and reinsurance contracts that it issues or holds. This element is appropriate for business combinations entered into on or after December 15, 2008.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAverageUsefulLife
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The average useful life of a major finite-lived intangible asset class. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Class [Axis]
documentation: Information by class of finite-lived intangible asset.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsCostIncurredToRenewOrExtend
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Cost Incurred to Renew or Extend
documentation: Amount of cost incurred and capitalized to renew or extend term of recognized finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsForeignCurrencyTranslationGainLoss
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFutureAmortizationExpense
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Future Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate estimated amortization expense for succeeding fiscal years for intangible assets subject to amortization.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFutureAmortizationExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization, Estimated Amortization Expense, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFutureAmortizationExpenseCurrentAndFiveSucceedingFiscalYearsAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, and Capitalized Cost, Software to be Sold, Leased, or Marketed, Estimated Amortization Expense [Abstract]

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGross
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, before Accumulated Amortization
documentation: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGrossAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, before Accumulated Amortization [Abstract]

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsIntentOrAbilityToRenewOrExtendArrangement
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Intent or Ability to Renew or Extend Arrangement
documentation: Description of intent and ability to renew or extend arrangement related to finite-lived intangible asset's legal or contractual life and effect on expected future cash flow associated with finite-lived intangible asset.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsLineItems
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsMajorClassNameDomain
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Class [Domain]
documentation: Class of finite-lived intangible asset.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsMember
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets [Member]
documentation: Assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization
documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNetAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization [Abstract]

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNetAmortizationExpenseRollingMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization, Rolling Maturity [Abstract]

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPurchaseAccountingAdjustments
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Measurement Period Adjustment
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRemainingAmortizationPeriod
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Remaining Amortization Period (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A description of the remaining amortization period of a major finite-lived intangible asset class.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRemainingAmortizationPeriod1
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Remaining Amortization Period
documentation: Period remaining for amortization of finite-lived intangible asset, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRollForward
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAdjustments
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Translation Adjustments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) to assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life for foreign currency translation adjustments.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAndPurchaseAccountingAdjustments
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAndPurchaseAccountingAdjustmentsAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments [Abstract]

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLife
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The useful life of all finite-lived intangible assets.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLifeMaximum
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The maximum useful life of a major finite-lived intangible asset class. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsUsefulLifeMinimum
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The minimum useful life of a major finite-lived intangible asset class. A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsWeightedAveragePeriodPriorToNextRenewalOrExtension
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Period before Next Renewal or Extension (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: For intangible assets that have been renewed or extended in the period for which a statement of financial position is presented, this element represents the weighted-average period prior to the next renewal or extension (both explicit and implicit), by major intangible asset class.

name: FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsWeightedAverageUsefulLife
standard_label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The calculated weighted-average useful life of all finite-lived intangible assets.

name: FiniteLivedLicenseAgreementsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived License Agreements, Gross
documentation: Gross carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of certain rights acquired to exercise a certain privilege or pursue a particular business or occupation and which is deemed to have a finite economic life.

name: FiniteLivedMediaContentGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Media Content, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs for media content having a finite economic life.

name: FiniteLivedNoncompeteAgreementsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Noncompete Agreements, Gross
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of payments made to third parties in exchange for their agreement not to engage in specified competitive practices in specified geographic territories for a specified period of time.

name: FiniteLivedPatentsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Patents, Gross
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the costs pertaining to the exclusive legal rights granted to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law. Such costs may have been expended to directly apply and receive patent rights, or to acquire such rights.

name: FiniteLivedRoyaltyGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Royalty, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of an acquired contractual arrangement associated with the payment of royalties covering a specified period of time.

name: FiniteLivedTradeNamesGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Trade Names, Gross
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a reasonably expected period of economic benefit.

name: FiniteLivedTradeSecretsGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Trade Secrets, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of trade secrets which protect the entity's unique technology and knowledge in its field of business so as to obtain competitive advantage for a reasonably expected period of economic benefit.

name: FiniteLivedTrademarksGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Trademarks, Gross
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a specified period of time.

name: FiniteLivedTransmissionServiceAgreementGross
standard_label: Finite-Lived Transmission Service Agreement, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the costs pertaining to an agreement between a transmission customer and the transmission provider for service which has a finite beneficial life.

name: FinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired1
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Acquired
documentation: Amount of increase in finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: FireMember
standard_label: Fire [Member]
documentation: Oxidation process that releases energy in the form of light and heat (flames) and often creates smoke.

name: FirmCommitmentNotRecognizedAtInceptionFairValueOptionMember
standard_label: Firm Commitment Not Recognized at Inception, Fair Value Option [Member]
documentation: This element represents a firm commitment that would otherwise not be recognized at inception and that involves only financial instruments. For example, a forward purchase contract for a loan that is not readily convertible to cash is a commitment involving only financial instruments-a loan and cash-and would not otherwise be recognized because it is not a derivative instrument.

name: FirstMortgageMember
standard_label: First Mortgage [Member]
documentation: Loan secured by real property that has a first (highest) lien on such property in the event of default by the borrower.

name: FiscalPeriod
standard_label: Fiscal Period, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining an entity's fiscal year or other fiscal period. This disclosure may include identification of the fiscal period end-date, the length of the fiscal period, any reporting period lag between the entity and its subsidiaries, or equity investees. If a reporting lag exists, the closing date of the entity having a different period end is generally noted, along with an explanation of the necessity for using different closing dates. name: FiscalPeriodDuration
standard_label: Fiscal Period Duration
documentation: Duration of fiscal period, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, number of weeks in one year or interim period.

name: FuelCosts

name: FuelCostsGrossOfHedging

name: FuelMember

name: FuelTransportationMember
standard_label: Fuel, Transportation [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Material used to power transports. Examples include, but are not limited to, the conveyance of people, animals, goods and material.

name: FullCostMethodOfAccountingForInvestmentsInOilAndGasPropertiesDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Property and Equipment [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for oil and gas enterprises that follow the full cost method of accounting for investments in oil and gas properties.

name: FullCostMethodUsingGrossRevenueMethodPolicy
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense Calculation Method, Gross Revenue [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for use of the gross revenue method in place of the full cost method of accounting. The policy may describe when the entity believes it is more appropriate due to economic circumstances to compute amortization of capitalized costs based on the gross revenue method (rather than the units of production method that would result in improper matching of costs to the related revenue).

name: FullCostOrSuccessfulEffortsPolicy
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Accounting Method, Full Cost or Successful Efforts [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for cost incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities as full cost or successful efforts method.

name: FundedPlanMember
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded Plan [Member]
documentation: Defined benefit plan in which retirement benefits are payable directly from plan assets segregated and restricted to provide such benefits.

name: FundsHeldForClients
standard_label: Funds Held for Clients
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

name: FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsAsset
standard_label: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Asset

name: FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsLiability
standard_label: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Liability

name: FurnitureAndEquipmentRentalExpenseOperatingLeaseMember
standard_label: Furniture and Equipment, Rental Expense, Operating Lease [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: FurnitureAndFixturesGross

name: FurnitureAndFixturesMember

name: FutureAmortizationExpenseAfterYearFive

name: FutureAmortizationExpenseYearTwo

name: FutureMember

Futures are standardized contracts traded on an organized exchange.

name: FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebackTransactions
standard_label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions (Deprecated 2026)

standard_label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Remainder of Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2026)

name: FutureNetCashFlowsRelatingToProvedOilAndGasReservesCashInflows
standard_label: Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Cash Inflows

standard_label: Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Income Tax Expense
documentation: Amount of estimated future accumulated cash outflow for income tax, based on the future income less future expense derived from production and sale of proved oil and gas reserves.

name: FutureNetCashFlowsRelatingToProvedOilAndGasReservesNetCashFlows
standard_label: Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Net Cash Flows
documentation: Amount, after future accumulated cash outflow for development and production costs and future income tax, of estimated future accumulated cash inflow from the sale of proved oil and gas reserves.

name: FutureNetCashFlowsRelatingToProvedOilAndGasReservesProductionCosts

standard_label: Future Net Cash Flows Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Ten Percent Annual Discount for Estimated Timing of Cash Flows

standard_label: Gain Contingency, Description
documentation: Describes an existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as of the balance sheet date (or prior to issuance of the financial statements) as to a probable or reasonably possible gain to the entity that will ultimately be realized when one or more future events occur.

name: GainContingencyIncomeStatementCaption
standard_label: Gain Contingency, Income Statement Caption (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the line item of the income statement that reflects the gain recognized in the period upon resolution of a previously disclosed contingent gain.

name: GainContingencyNatureDomain
standard_label: Gain Contingency, Nature [Domain]
documentation: Describes any existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as of the balance sheet date (or before issuance of the financial statements) that might result in a gain, typically reflecting care to avoid misleading implications as to the likelihood of realization.

name: GainContingencyPatentsAllegedlyInfringedUponNumber
standard_label: Gain Contingency, Patents Allegedly Infringed upon, Number

name: GainContingencyPatentsFoundNotInfringedUponNumber
standard_label: Gain Contingency, Patents Found Not Infringed upon, Number
documentation: Number of entity's patents that another entity was found not to have infringed.

name: GainContingencyQuantitiesPatentsAbstract
standard_label: Gain Contingency, Quantities, Patents [Abstract]

name: GainContingencyUnrecordedAmount
standard_label: Gain Contingency, Unrecorded Amount
documentation: The amount or range of possible amounts of gain that could be realized upon the resolution of a contingency.

name: GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessmentOfCashFlowHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
documentation: The gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

name: GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessmentOfFairValueHedgeEffectiveness
standard_label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
documentation: Gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

name: GainFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsFairValueHedge
standard_label: Gain from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Amount of gain recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

name: GainHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsFairValueHedgeStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Gain, Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]

name: GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessmentOfPriceRiskHedgeEffectiveness

name: GainLossOnCondemnation

name: GainLossOnCondemnationNetOfTaxMember

name: GainLossOnCreditRiskDerivativesNet

name: GainLossOnCreditRiskHedgeIneffectiveness

documentation: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period due to the ineffectiveness of the hedge on credit risk.

name: GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsHeldForTradingPurposesNet
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
documentation: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

name: GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsMember

documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing gain (loss) on derivative instruments.

name: GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax

name: GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretaxAbstract

name: GainLossOnDerivativesMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Derivatives [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The gains and losses from Increase or Decrease in fair value of derivatives included in earnings.

name: GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueToForecastedTransactionProbableOfNotOccurringNetAbstract

name: GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeDueToForecastedTransactionProbableOfNotOccurringNet

documentation: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when foreign currency cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

name: GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfInterestRateCashFlowHedgeDueToForecastedTransactionProbableOfNotOccurringNet
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when interest rate cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

name: GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeDueToForecastedTransactionProbableOfNotOccurringNet
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when price risk cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfAssetsAbstract

documentation: Increases and decreases in equity (net assets) from peripheral or incidental sale or disposal of assets or property (anything owned by an individual or an entity, which has commercial or exchange value) of an entity except those that result from revenues or investments by owners.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfOtherAssetsMember

documentation: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale or disposal of other assets not otherwise defined.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfOtherFinancialAssets
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfProperty
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

This item does not include any gain (loss) recognized on the sale of oil and gas property or timber property.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfPropertyMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The gains and losses from the sale or disposal of assets or property which is anything owned by an individual or an entity, which has commercial or exchange value.

name: GainLossOnDispositionOfRealEstateDiscontinuedOperations
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Real Estate, Discontinued Operations
documentation: Amount of difference between the carrying amount and the sales price of real estate properties sold as part of discontinued operations.

name: GainLossOnExtinguishmentDebtRecourseStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Gain (Loss), Extinguishment of Debt, Recourse Status [Extensible Enumeration]

name: GainLossOnFairValueHedgesRecognizedInEarnings
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings

name: GainLossOnFairValueHedgesRecognizedInEarningsAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings [Abstract] (Deprecated 2025)

name: GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments

documentation: Aggregate impact of foreign currency derivatives on earnings for the period. name: GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings and from related hedged item to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

name: GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on foreign currency fair value hedges.

name: GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeIneffectivenessDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness, Disclosures [Abstract] (Deprecated 2025)

documentation: Amount of gain (loss) of interest rate cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

name: GainLossOnInterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

name: GainLossOnInterestRateFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on interest rate fair value hedges.

standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Investments [Abstract]

documentation: Information by category of marketable security.
