name: GainLossOnInvestmentsExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairmentsAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnInvestmentsExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairmentsRealizedAndUnrealizedAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments, Realized and Unrealized Alternative [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: GainLossOnInvestmentsIncludingMarketableSecuritiesAndInvestmentsHeldAtCostCategoriesOfInvestmentsDomain
standard_label: Marketable Securities and Investments Held at Cost [Domain] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Investments in debt and equity securities, including, but not limited to, held-to-maturity, trading and available-for-sale.

name: GainLossOnInvestmentsMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Investments [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Increases and decreases in equity (net assets) from peripheral or incidental investment transactions of an entity except those that result from revenues or investments by owners.

name: GainLossOnInvestmentsMember1
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Investments [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing gain (loss) on investments.

name: GainLossOnInvestmentsRealizedAndUnrealizedAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Realized and Unrealized Alternative [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: GainLossOnInvestmentsTextBlock

documentation: Tabular disclosure of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in security.

name: GainLossOnNonRecourseDebt
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Non-Recourse Debt (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount represents the difference between the cash acquisition price of the debt and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its extinguishment (or deconsolidation of in-substance real estate when an entity defaults on its debt obligations).

name: GainLossOnOilAndGasHedgingActivity
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
documentation: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

name: GainLossOnOilAndGasHedgingActivityMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Oil and Gas Hedging Activity [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The gains and losses included in earnings resulting from oil and gas hedging activities.

name: GainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to ineffectiveness in price risk cash flow hedges.

name: GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

name: GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativesNet
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
documentation: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

name: GainLossOnPriceRiskFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period due to the ineffectiveness of price risk fair value hedges.

name: GainLossOnPriceRiskHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period due to the ineffectiveness on price risk cash flow and fair value hedges.

name: GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstrument
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfAccountsReceivable
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfCapitalLeasesNet
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Capital Leases, Net (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's transactions involving the sale, transfer, or termination of financing agreements classified as capital leases.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfCommodityContracts
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Commodity Contracts
documentation: The difference between the book value and the sale price of agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfDebtInvestments
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Debt Investments (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of debt securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
documentation: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfEquityInvestments
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of equity securities, not separately or otherwise categorized as trading or available-for-sale. This element includes investments in which the entity holds a small ownership stake (generally, less than 20 percent of the shares outstanding) and cannot exert significant influence.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfInsuranceBlock
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Insurance Block
documentation: Excess (deficiency) of net proceeds received over the net carrying value of a certain, bundled grouping of insurance policies.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfInterestInProjects
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects
documentation: Gain (loss) included in earnings resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfInterestInProjectsMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
documentation: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetOperatingLeases
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
documentation: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetOperatingLeasesMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Represents the net gain (loss) arising from the sale of assets held or available for lease, by the owner (lessor), under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases for accounting and financial reporting purposes.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
documentation: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeasesAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnSaleOfLoansReceivableMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans Receivable [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) realized and recognized on a transfer of loans receivables qualifying as a sale.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
documentation: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from sale of financing receivable, including, but not limited to, lease receivable.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasPropertiesMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Oil and Gas Properties [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The gains and losses from the sale or disposal of oil and gas properties which includes refineries, pipelines and so forth.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasProperty
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfOtherLoansAndLeases
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Loans and Leases
documentation: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of other loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period; excludes gains (losses) on sales of consumer and mortgage loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnissuedStockBySubsidiaryOrEquityInvesteeNonoperatingIncome
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income
documentation: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries or equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfProject
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Project
documentation: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale of a project.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfProperties
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
documentation: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertiesApplicableIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the applicable amount of income taxes or benefit realized on the gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertiesBeforeApplicableIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, before Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the amount of gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period gross of the applicable income taxes realized.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertiesNetOfApplicableIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Net of Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the amount of gain (loss) on sale of properties during the reporting period net of the applicable income taxes realized.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertiesNetOfApplicableIncomeTaxesAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Net of Applicable Income Taxes [Abstract] (Deprecated 2020)

standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment

name: GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipmentAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnSaleOfProvedProperty

standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Securities, Net [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: GainLossOnSaleOfTimberProperty

name: GainLossOnSaleOfTradeReceivablesMember

name: GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses

name: GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpensesAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses [Abstract]

name: GainLossOnSaleOfUnprovedProperty

name: GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges

documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

name: GainLossOnSalesOfConsumerLoans
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
documentation: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

name: GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet

name: GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNetAbstract

name: GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBS
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
documentation: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).

name: GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAssets
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
documentation: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

name: GainLossOnSettlementOfDerivativeInstrumentMember
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Settlement of Derivative Instrument [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The excess or shortfall of realized amounts versus previously recorded fair value upon settlement of derivative instruments.

name: GainLossOnTerminationOfLease
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

name: GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSeparateAccount
standard_label: Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account
documentation: Amount of net gains or losses recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

name: GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSeparateAccountAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account [Abstract]

name: GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement
standard_label: Gain (Loss) from Litigation Settlement
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

name: GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlementAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) from Litigation Settlement [Abstract]

name: GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecovery
standard_label: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
documentation: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

name: GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecoveryStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain from business interruption insurance recovery.

name: GainOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The gain recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

name: GainOnDerivativeInstrumentsPretax
standard_label: Gain on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
documentation: Aggregate gain on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

name: GainOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueToForecastedTransactionProbableOfNotOccurring
standard_label: Gain on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
documentation: The amount of gain reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

name: GainOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Gain on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

name: GainOnPurchaseOfBusiness
standard_label: Gain on Purchase of Business (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the excess of the fair value of acquired net assets over the cost of an acquired business after pro rata reduction of the amounts that otherwise would have been assigned to acquired assets except financial assets other than investments accounted for by the equity method, assets to be disposed of by sale, deferred tax assets, prepaid assets relating to pension and postretirement benefit plans, and other current assets. This amount is considered an extraordinary item and often referred t

name: GainOnPurchaseOfBusinessMember
standard_label: Gain on Purchase of Business [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Gain on sale on the purchase of a business, which represents the excess of the fair value of acquired net assets over the cost of an acquired business after pro rata reduction of the amounts that otherwise would have been assigned to acquired assets except financial assets other than investments accounted for by the equity method, assets to be disposed of by sale, deferred tax assets, prepaid assets relating to pension and postretirement benefit plans, and other current assets. This amount is of

name: GainOnSaleOfInvestments
standard_label: Gain on Sale of Investments
documentation: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

name: GainOrLossFromSaleOfFinancialAssetsInSecuritizations
standard_label: Gain (Loss) from Sale of Financial Assets in Securitizations or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Difference between the sale price and the carrying value when a financial asset transferred in a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer is accounted for as a sale, including those transactions in which the seller or transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

name: GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnissuedStockByEquityInvestee
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Equity Investee
documentation: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

name: GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnissuedStockBySubsidiary
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary
documentation: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

name: GainOrLossOnSaleOfPreviouslyUnissuedStockBySubsidiaryOrEquityInvesteeNonoperatingIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income [Abstract]

name: GainOrLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidiary
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

name: GainOrLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee [Abstract]

name: GainRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSeparateAccountGross
standard_label: Gain Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
documentation: Amount of gain recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

name: GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
documentation: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

name: GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebtAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt [Abstract]

name: GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebtBeforeWriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Debt Issuance Cost Writeoff
documentation: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

name: GainsLossesOnRecourseDebt
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Recourse Debt (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount represents the difference between the cash acquisition price of the debt and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its extinguishment.

name: GainsLossesOnRestructuringOfDebt
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
documentation: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations [Abstract]

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssetsMember
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Assets [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The gains and losses from the sale or disposal of assets or property which is anything owned by an individual or an entity, which has commercial or exchange value.

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfCreditCardPortfolio
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
documentation: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
documentation: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherAssets
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The net gain (loss) resulting from the sale or disposal of assets not required to be reported separately in the statement of income.

name: GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate
standard_label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
documentation: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

name: GasAndOilAcreageDevelopedGross
standard_label: Gas and Oil Acreage, Developed, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Developed acres are acres spaced or assigned to productive wells. Gross acreage is an acre in which a working interest is owned.

name: GasAndOilAcreageDevelopedNet
standard_label: Gas and Oil Acreage, Developed, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Developed acres are acres spaced or assigned to productive wells. Net acres is the sum of the fractional interest owned based on working interests or other economic arrangements.

name: GasAndOilAcreageLineItems
standard_label: Gas and Oil Acreage [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: GasAndOilAcreageTable
standard_label: Gas and Oil Acreage [Table]
documentation: Detailed element information regarding actual developed and undeveloped gas and oil acreage (both gross and net). Gross acreage is an acre in which a working interest is owned.

name: GasAndOilAcreageUndevelopedGross
standard_label: Gas and Oil Acreage, Undeveloped, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Undeveloped acreage is considered to be those lease acres on which wells have not been drilled or completed to a point that would permit the production of commercial quantities of oil and gas regardless of whether or not such acreage contains proved reserves. Gross acreage is an acre in which a working interest is owned.

name: GasAndOilAcreageUndevelopedNet
standard_label: Gas and Oil Acreage, Undeveloped, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Undeveloped acreage is considered to be those lease acres on which wells have not been drilled or completed to a point that would permit the production of commercial quantities of oil and gas regardless of whether or not such acreage contains proved reserves. Net acres is the sum of the fractional interest owned based on working interests or other economic arrangements.

name: GasAndOilAreaDevelopedGross
standard_label: Gas and Oil Area, Developed, Gross
documentation: Area spaced or assigned to productive wells in which a working interest is owned.

name: GasAndOilAreaDevelopedNet
standard_label: Gas and Oil Area, Developed, Net
documentation: Fractional interest owned based on working interests or other economic arrangements of area spaced or assigned to productive wells.

name: GasAndOilAreaUndevelopedGross
standard_label: Gas and Oil Area, Undeveloped, Gross
documentation: Lease area in which a working interest is owned and on which wells have not been drilled or completed to a point that would permit the production of commercial quantities of oil and gas regardless of whether or not such area contains proved reserves.

name: GasAndOilAreaUndevelopedNet
standard_label: Gas and Oil Area, Undeveloped, Net
documentation: Fractional interest owned based on working interests or other economic arrangements of lease area on which wells have not been drilled or completed to a point that would permit the production of commercial quantities of oil and gas regardless of whether or not such area contains proved reserves.

name: GasBalancingArrangementsAbstract
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement [Abstract]

name: GasBalancingArrangementsPolicy
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for gas-balancing arrangement.

name: GasBalancingPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Gas Balancing, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for gas-balancing arrangements using either the entitlements method or the sales method consistently for all significant gas imbalances.

name: GasDistributionEquipmentMember
standard_label: Gas Distribution Equipment [Member]
documentation: Long lived, depreciable assets used for the primary purpose of distributing a gas product to the consumer.

name: GasDistributionMember
standard_label: Gas Distribution [Member]
documentation: System used for the primary purpose of distributing a gas to the consumer.

name: GasDomesticRegulatedRevenue
standard_label: Gas Domestic Regulated Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue derived from the regulated (by a federal, state, or local government or agency) generation, transmission and distribution of [natural] gas.

name: GasGatheringAndProcessingEquipmentMember
standard_label: Gas Gathering and Processing Equipment [Member]
documentation: Equipment for gathering and processing natural gas.

name: GasGatheringTransportationMarketingAndProcessingCosts
standard_label: Gas Gathering, Transportation, Marketing and Processing Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Cost incurred related to the gas activities, such as transportation, marketing and processing crude oil, natural gas and refined petroleum products.

name: GasGatheringTransportationMarketingAndProcessingRevenue
standard_label: Gas Gathering, Transportation, Marketing and Processing Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue related to midstream and downstream gas activities. May include the following: gathering from wells, processing to remove impurities, storage, transmission, and the sale of natural gas and related products.

name: GasImbalanceAssetLiability
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement, Asset (Liability)
documentation: The value of gas balancing asset or liability as of the end of the period.

name: GasImbalancePayableCurrent
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement, Payable, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to an underproduced working interest owner when an overproduced working interest owner has sold gas in excess of the party's ownership percentage. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: GasImbalancePayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement, Payable
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to an underproduced working interest owner when an overproduced working interest owner has sold gas in excess of the party's ownership percentage.

name: GasImbalanceVolumeAmount
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement, Imbalance Quantity, Volume
documentation: Quantity of gas imbalance in gas-balancing arrangement.

name: GasPurchaseContractFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Gas Purchase Contract, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value of contract to purchase gas.

name: GasPurchaseContractNet
standard_label: Gas Purchase Contract, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Carrying value of the discounted future value of a contract to purchase gas at favorable prices that is expected to be realized after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

name: GasPurchasePayableCurrent
standard_label: Gas Purchase Payable, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for purchases of natural gas. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: GasPurchasePayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Gas Purchase Payable (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for purchases of natural gas.

name: GasTransmissionAndDistributionEquipmentMember
standard_label: Gas, Transmission and Distribution Equipment [Member]
documentation: Equipment used for transmitting and distributing a gas product to the consumer.

name: GasTransmissionEquipmentMember
standard_label: Gas Transmission Equipment [Member]
documentation: Long lived, depreciable assets used for the primary purpose of transmitting and distributing gas product to the consumer.

name: GasTransmissionMember
standard_label: Gas Transmission [Member]
documentation: System used for the primary purpose of transmitting a gas product to the customer.

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventoryAbstract
standard_label: General and Administrative Costs in Inventory [Abstract]

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventoryAmountIncurred
standard_label: General and Administrative Costs in Inventory, Amount Incurred
documentation: Aggregate amount of general and administrative costs incurred in each period and charged to inventory.

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventoryAmountRemaining
standard_label: General and Administrative Costs in Inventory, Amount Remaining
documentation: Actual or estimated amount of general and administrative costs remaining in inventory.

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
standard_label: General and Administrative Expense
documentation: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeExpenseAbstract
standard_label: General and Administrative Expense [Abstract]

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeExpenseMember
standard_label: General and Administrative Expense [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing general and administrative expense.

name: GeneralAndAdministrativeExpenseRatio
standard_label: General and Administrative Expense Ratio
documentation: Ratio of non-life general and administrative expenses to non-life net premiums earned.

name: GeneralAndLimitedPartnersCapitalAccountAbstract
standard_label: General and Limited Partners' Capital Account [Abstract]

name: GeneralBusinessMember
standard_label: General Business Tax Credit Carryforward [Member]
documentation: Tax credit carryforwards which include, but are not limited to, investment, alcohol fuels, low income housing, alternative fuels, alternative motor vehicles, hurricane relief, disabled access, renewable resources electricity production, employer social security, orphan drug, new markets, employer provided child care facilities and services, biodiesel fuels, low sulfur diesel fuel production, distilled spirits and the advanced nuclear power facilities credit.

name: GeneralCashFlowHedgeInformationAbstract
standard_label: General Cash Flow Hedge Information [Abstract]

name: GeneralContractorCosts
standard_label: General Contractor Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate costs related to general contracting services.

name: GeneralContractorMember
standard_label: General Contractor [Member]
documentation: Person or company contracted to manage project with responsibility for coordinating activity, including, but not limited to, acquiring material and hiring subcontractor.

name: GeneralContractorRevenue
standard_label: General Contractor Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate revenue from general contracting services, which may include directly performed or subcontracted plumbing, electrical work, drywall and plaster installation, steel erection, painting, glass work, utility line construction, and other specialty trade services.

name: GeneralDiscussionOfDerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgingActivities
standard_label: General Discussion of Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities
documentation: Disclosure that addresses (a) how and why an entity uses derivative instruments, (b) how derivative instruments and related hedged items are accounted for, and (c) how derivative instruments affect an entity's financial position, results of operations, and cash flows.

name: GeneralDiscussionOfDerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: General Discussion of Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities [Abstract]

name: GeneralDiscussionOfPensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefits
standard_label: Retirement Benefits, Description
documentation: Description of nature and type of retirement benefits.

name: GeneralDiscussionOfPensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsAbstract
standard_label: Retirement Benefits, Description [Abstract]

name: GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationAbstract
standard_label: General Fair Value Hedge Information [Abstract]

name: GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationDollarOffsetThresholdMaximum
standard_label: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Dollar Offset Threshold, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The upper end of the range of quotients represented as a percentage derived by dividing the change in value of a hedging instrument by the change in the value of the hedged item over the assessment period.

name: GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationDollarOffsetThresholdMinimum
standard_label: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Dollar Offset Threshold, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The lower end of the range of quotients represented as a percentage derived by dividing the change in value of a hedging instrument by the change in the value of the hedged item over the assessment period.

name: GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationHedgeEffectivenessThreshold
standard_label: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Hedge Effectiveness Threshold
documentation: Percentage derived by dividing the change in value of a hedging instrument by the change in the value of the hedged item.

name: GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationMinimumRSquarePercentage
standard_label: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Minimum R Square, Percentage (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The correlation coefficient between the hypothetical instrument and the hedged item used in determination of the effectiveness of a hedging relationship.

name: GeneralInsuranceExpense
standard_label: General Insurance Expense
documentation: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

name: GeneralLiabilityMember
standard_label: General Liability [Member]
documentation: Type of business insurance which provides insurance coverage for a wide variety of liability exposures including, but not limited to, contractual liability, product liability and personal injury liability.

name: GeneralNetInvestmentHedgeInformationAbstract
standard_label: General Net Investment Hedge Information [Abstract]

name: GeneralPartnerDistributions
standard_label: General Partner Distributions
documentation: Distributions from earnings to the general partner of a partnership included in the consolidated financial statements.

name: GeneralPartnerMember
standard_label: General Partner [Member]
documentation: Party to a partnership business who has unlimited liability.

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccount
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account
documentation: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountAbstract
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account [Abstract]

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountDescriptionOfUnits
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account, Description of Units (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of the various rights, preferences, and privileges of the general partners' ownership units including: redemption, conversion, liquidation, tax status of distribution per unit and the sharing in distributions.

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountDistributionAmount
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account, Period Distribution Amount
documentation: The total amount of distributions to the general partner during the period.

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAuthorized
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Authorized
documentation: The number of general partner units authorized to be issued.

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsIssued
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
documentation: The number of general partner units issued.

name: GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutstanding
standard_label: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
documentation: The number of general partner units outstanding.

name: GeneralPartnersContributedCapital
standard_label: General Partners' Contributed Capital
documentation: The amount of capital contributed by the general partner.

name: GeneralPartnersCumulativeCashDistributions
standard_label: General Partners' Cumulative Cash Distributions
documentation: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the general partner.

name: GeneralPartnersCumulativeNetIncome
standard_label: General Partners' Cumulative Earnings
documentation: Aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to the general partner based on the sharing of income or losses between general and limited partners as specified in the partnership agreement, excluding any priority income allocations resulting from incentive distributions or any special earnings allocations.

name: GeneralPartnersOfferingCosts
standard_label: General Partners' Offering Costs
documentation: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the general partner.

name: GeneralPartnersShareOfUndistributedEarningsIncentiveDistributionRightEmbeddedInGeneralPartnerInterest
standard_label: General Partner's Share of Undistributed Earnings, Incentive Distribution Right Embedded in General Partner Interest (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings allocated to the general partner (as if the undistributed earnings were available cash) when the incentive distribution right is embedded in the general partner's interest. Depending on the structure of the master limited partnership, the incentive distribution right may be a separate class of non-voting limited partner interest that the general partner holds but generally may sell of transfer apart from its overall interest.

name: GeneralPartnersSpecialEarningsAllocation
standard_label: General Partners' Cumulative Special Earnings (Losses)
documentation: The aggregate cumulative amount of earnings allocated to general partners as a result of a non-recurring event (for example, a one-time settlement).

name: GeographicAreasLongLivedAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Entity-Wide Information Not Provided as Part of Reportable Segment, Geographical Area, Long-Lived Asset [Abstract]

name: GeographicAreasRevenuesFromExternalCustomersAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Entity-Wide Information Not Provided as Part of Reportable Segment, Geographical Area, Revenue [Abstract]

name: GeographicBasisAbstract
standard_label: Geographic Basis [Abstract]

name: GeographicBasisCorporateHeadquartersMember
standard_label: Geographic Basis, Corporate Headquarters [Member]
documentation: Location of corporate headquarters.

name: GeographicBasisCountryOfDomicileMember
standard_label: Geographic Basis, Country of Domicile [Member]
documentation: Country of domicile.

name: GeographicConcentrationRiskMember
standard_label: Geographic Concentration Risk [Member]
documentation: Reflects the percentage that a specified dollar value on the balance sheet or income statement in the period from one or more specified geographic areas is to a corresponding consolidated, segment, or product line amount. Risk is the materially adverse effects of economic decline or antagonistic political actions resulting in loss of assets, sales volume, labor supply, or source of materials and supplies in a US state or a specified country, continent, or region such as EMEA (Europe, Middle East

name: GeographicDistributionAxis
standard_label: Geographic Distribution [Axis]
documentation: Information by geographic distribution of business activity identified as either domestic or foreign. Excludes names of countries, states and provinces, and cities.

name: GeographicDistributionDomain
standard_label: Geographic Distribution [Domain]
documentation: Allocation of business activity identified as domestic or foreign. Excludes names of countries, states and provinces, and cities.

name: GeographicDistributionDomesticMember
standard_label: Geographic Distribution, Domestic [Member]
documentation: Allocation of business activity identified as domestic.

name: GeographicDistributionForeignMember
standard_label: Geographic Distribution, Foreign [Member]
documentation: Allocation of business activity identified as foreign.

name: GeographicalIntersegmentEliminationsMember
standard_label: Geographical Intersegment, Eliminations [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Eliminating entries used in geographical segment consolidation.

name: GeographyEliminationsMember
standard_label: Geography Eliminations [Member]
documentation: Eliminating entries used in geographic consolidation.

name: GiltiTaxAccountingPolicyFixedList
standard_label: NCTI Tax Accounting Policy [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates method of accounting for tax on net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)). Acceptable values are "Tax as incurred" and "Deferred tax recognized".

name: GoldMember
standard_label: Gold [Member]
documentation: Yellow metallic chemical element that is highly ductile and malleable and not subject to oxidation or corrosion.

name: GoldProductsAndServicesRevenue
standard_label: Gold Products and Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue derived from sale of gold and related products. Also includes rendering of services and selling of products for exploration, development, mining, and processing, as well as supporting activities.

name: GoodFaithAndMarginDepositsWithBrokerDealers
standard_label: Good Faith and Margin Deposit with Broker-Dealer
documentation: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

name: GoodsAndServicesExchangedForEquityInstrumentMember
standard_label: Goods and Services Exchanged for Equity Instrument [Member] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Represents transactions in which equity instruments are issued in exchange for the receipt of goods or services.

name: Goodwill
standard_label: Goodwill
documentation: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

name: GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod
standard_label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
documentation: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

name: GoodwillAllocationAdjustment
standard_label: Goodwill, Allocation Adjustment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Purchase price allocation adjustment for allocation not yet complete at the prior year end.

name: GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetImpairment
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Including Goodwill, Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, goodwill, and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetImpairmentAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Including Goodwill, Impairment Loss [Abstract]

name: GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Goodwill and Other [Abstract]

name: GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Intangible Asset and Goodwill [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for intangible asset and goodwill. Includes, but is not limited to, finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, capitalized cost for internal-use software and software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsGoodwillPolicy
standard_label: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Goodwill, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for goodwill. This accounting policy also may address how an entity assesses and measures impairment of goodwill, how reporting units are determined, how goodwill is allocated to such units, and how the fair values of the reporting units are determined.

name: GovernmentGuaranteedCollateralMember

documentation: Collateral guaranteed by government authority or agency to serve as protection against default.

name: GovernmentGuaranteedMortgageLoansUponForeclosureReceivableMember
standard_label: Government Guaranteed Mortgage Loans upon Foreclosure Receivable [Member]
documentation: Government-guaranteed mortgage loan receivables on foreclosed real estate. Government guarantee programs include, but are not limited to, guarantees offered by the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) and the US Department of Veterans Affairs.

name: GovernmentInvestigationIntoIllegalOrUnethicalActivityInGovernmentContracts
standard_label: Government Investigation Into Illegal or Unethical Activity in Government Contracts (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: General description regarding ongoing government investigations into illegal or unethical activity in the procurement of government defense contracts.

name: GovernmentMember
standard_label: Government [Member]
documentation: Organization that is the governing authority of a community.

name: GovernmentNationalMortgageAssociationCertificatesAndObligationsGNMAMember
standard_label: Government National Mortgage Association Certificates and Obligations (GNMA) [Member]
documentation: Investments in debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).

name: GovernmentNationalMortgageAssociationGnmaInsuredLoansMember
standard_label: Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA) [Member]
documentation: Government-owned corporation within Department of Housing and Urban Development known as Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).

name: GovernmentRestrictionsOnDisclosureOfEstimatedReservesOrDisclosureOfReservesOtherThanProved
standard_label: Government Restrictions on Disclosure of Estimated Reserves or Disclosure of Reserves Other than Proved (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Describes the reasons an enterprise did not disclose reserve estimates or amounts in figures for the named country or that reserve estimates include reserves other than proved due to a government 1) restricting the disclosure of estimated reserves for property under its authority; 2) restricting disclosure of amounts under long-term supply, purchase, or similar agreement or contracts; or 3) requiring the disclosure of reserves other than proved.

name: GovernmentSectorMember
standard_label: Government Sector [Member]
documentation: Sector of the economy consisting of government agencies and authorities.

name: GovernmentalContractsSubjectToRenegotiation
standard_label: Governmental Contracts Subject to Renegotiation (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Where government contracts constitute a substantial part of the business, a general description of the possible uncertainties resulting from the renegotiation of government contracts and subcontracts which are subject to renegotiation.

name: GovernmentalContractsSubjectToRenegotiationAbstract
standard_label: Governmental Contracts Subject to Renegotiation [Abstract] (Deprecated 2023)

standard_label: Grandfathered ESOP Expense Recognition, Actual Interest Incurred on ESOP Debt
documentation: For grandfathered ESOP shares acquired prior to January 1, 1993, the actual interest incurred on debt for obligations that the employer may secure on behalf of the ESOP.

name: GrandfatheredESOPExpenseRecognitionCashContributionsToESOP
standard_label: Grandfathered ESOP Expense Recognition, Cash Contributions to ESOP
documentation: For grandfathered ESOP shares acquired prior to January 1, 1993, the amount of cash contributions made to the ESOP.

name: GrandfatheredESOPExpenseRecognitionDividendsPaidToESOP
standard_label: Grandfathered ESOP Expense Recognition, Dividends Paid to ESOP
documentation: For grandfathered ESOP shares acquired prior to January 1, 1993, the dividends paid to the ESOP.

name: GrandfatheredESOPExpenseRecognitionDividendsUsedByESOPForDebtService
standard_label: Grandfathered ESOP Expense Recognition, Dividends Used by ESOP for Debt Service
documentation: For grandfathered ESOP shares acquired prior to January 1, 1993, the amount of ESOP dividends used to pay debt service by the sop.

name: GrandfatheredESOPExpenseRecognitionPolicy
standard_label: Grandfathered ESOP Expense Recognition, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for grandfathered ESOP shares acquired prior to January 1, 1993, including the method of measuring compensation, method of recognizing expense, the classification of dividends on ESOP shares, impact of the ESOP on the financial statements and the treatment of ESOP shares for earnings per share computations.

name: GrantMember
standard_label: Grant [Member]
documentation: Award of money not required to be repaid.

name: GranteeStatusAxis
standard_label: Grantee Status [Axis]
documentation: Information by status of recipient to whom award is granted.

name: GranteeStatusDomain
standard_label: Grantee Status [Domain]
documentation: Status of recipient to whom award is granted.

name: GrantsReceivable
standard_label: Grants Receivable
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

name: GrantsReceivableCurrent
standard_label: Grants Receivable, Current
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: GrantsReceivableNoncurrent
standard_label: Grants Receivable, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

name: GrossInvestmentIncomeOperating
standard_label: Gross Investment Income, Operating
documentation: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

name: GrossProfit
standard_label: Gross Profit
documentation: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

name: GrossProfitAbstract
standard_label: Gross Profit [Abstract]

name: GrossTransactionVolume
standard_label: Gross Billing, Agent Transaction
documentation: Amount of consideration expected to be received as agent for product and service transferred to customer by another party, before deduction of payment for product and service provided by that party.

name: GroundLeasesAccumulatedAmortization
standard_label: Ground Leases, Accumulated Amortization (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Accumulated amortization on long-term land leases capitalized as part of real property.

name: GroundLeasesDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Ground Leases Disclosures [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: GroundLeasesGross
standard_label: Ground Leases, Gross (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Gross long-term land leases capitalized as part of real property.

name: GroundLeasesNet
standard_label: Ground Leases, Net (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Net long-term land leases which are capitalized as part of real property.

name: GroundLeasesNetAbstract
standard_label: Ground Leases, Net [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: GroupPoliciesMember
standard_label: Group Insurance Policy [Member]
documentation: Contract consisting of insurance coverage issued to organization to provide benefit to more than one individual.

name: GuaranteeObligationsByNatureAxis
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Nature [Axis]
documentation: Information by nature of guarantee.

name: GuaranteeObligationsCaptionForRecordedLiabilities
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Caption for Recorded Liabilities (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Discloses the financial statement line item in which the aggregate carrying amount of the liability for recorded guarantees is included.

name: GuaranteeObligationsCollateralHeldDirectlyOrByThirdParties
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Collateral Held Directly or by Third Parties
documentation: Describes the nature of any assets held either as collateral or by third parties that, upon the occurrence of any triggering event or condition under the guarantee, the guarantor can obtain and liquidate to recover all or a portion of the amounts paid under the guarantee.

name: GuaranteeObligationsCurrentCarryingValue
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
documentation: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

name: GuaranteeObligationsLineItems
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: GuaranteeObligationsLiquidationProceeds
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Liquidation Proceeds, Monetary Amount
documentation: Indicates, if estimable, the approximate extent to which the proceeds from liquidation of any assets held either as collateral or by third parties would be expected to cover the maximum potential amount of future payments under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

name: GuaranteeObligationsLiquidationProceedsPercentage
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Liquidation Proceeds, Percentage
documentation: Indicates, if estimable, (as a percentage) the approximate extent to which the proceeds from liquidation of any assets held either as collateral or by third parties would be expected to cover the maximum potential amount of future payments under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

name: GuaranteeObligationsMaximumExposure
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
documentation: Maximum potential amount of future payments (undiscounted) the guarantor could be required to make under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

name: GuaranteeObligationsMaximumExposureInestimable
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Maximum Exposure Inestimable
documentation: States the reasons why the guarantor is unable to develop an estimate of the maximum potential amount of future payments under its guarantee (or each group of similar guarantees).

name: GuaranteeObligationsMember
standard_label: Guarantee Obligations [Member]
documentation: A written or oral contract that obligates the guarantor to either pay cash or perform services if another party fails to perform specified actions or achieve specified results.

name: GuaranteeObligationsNatureDomain
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Nature [Domain]
documentation: Represents a description of the nature of the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

name: GuaranteeObligationsOriginAndPurpose
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Origin and Purpose
documentation: Describes how and under what circumstances or in connection with which transaction the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees was given and the objective of the guarantee.

name: GuaranteeObligationsRecourseProvisions
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Recourse Provisions
documentation: Describes the nature of any recourse provisions that would enable the guarantor to recover from third parties any of the amounts paid under the guarantee (or each group of similar guarantees).

name: GuaranteeObligationsRelatedPartyDisclosure
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Related Party Disclosure
documentation: Describes certain required disclosures for those guarantees that are issued to benefit entities meeting the definition of a related party.

name: GuaranteeObligationsTerm
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Term (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Describe the approximate term of the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

name: GuaranteeObligationsTriggeringEvent
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Triggering Event
documentation: Describe the events or circumstances that would require the guarantor to perform under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

name: GuaranteeObligationsUnlimitedExposure
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations, Unlimited Exposure (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Discloses whether the terms of the guarantee (or each group of similar guarantees) provide for no limitation to the maximum potential future payments under the guarantee.

name: GuaranteeOfBusinessRevenueMember
standard_label: Guarantee of Business Revenue [Member]
documentation: Contracts that contingently require the indemnifying party (guarantor) to make payments to the indemnified party (guaranteed party) the amount by which the revenue of a specified business (or a specific portion of a business or for a specified product) for a specified period of time is less than a specified amount.

name: GuaranteeOfIndebtednessOfOthersMember
standard_label: Guarantee of Indebtedness of Others [Member]
documentation: Agreements (contracts) that contingently require the guarantor to make payments of principal and interest to a lender on another party's debt if that party fails to comply with the terms of the borrowing arrangement.

name: GuaranteeOfScheduledContractualCashFlowsFromAssetsOfSpecialPurposeEntitySPEMember
standard_label: Guarantee of Scheduled Contractual Cash Flows from Assets of Transferee [Member]
documentation: The guarantee of the collection of the scheduled contractual cash flows from individual financial assets held by a transferee.

name: GuaranteeTermNoLimitationToMaximumPotentialFuturePayment
standard_label: Guarantee, Terms, No Limitation to Maximum Potential Future Payment [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether terms provide no limitation to maximum potential payment.

name: GuaranteeTypeOtherMember
standard_label: Guarantee Type, Other [Member]
documentation: Agreement that requires the guarantor to make payments to a guaranteed party in compensation for that party's or parties' loss or injury, classified as other.

name: GuaranteedBenefitLiabilityGross
standard_label: Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Sum of the amount of expected guaranteed benefits in excess of the projected account balances for minimum guaranteed benefit contracts as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

name: GuaranteedBenefitLiabilityGrossPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the liability for guaranteed minimum benefits on long-duration contracts.

name: GuaranteedBenefitLiabilityNet
standard_label: Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Net
documentation: Sum of the amount of expected guaranteed benefits in excess of the projected account balances for minimum guaranteed benefit contracts, as of the balance sheet date, net of reinsurance recoverables, for all guaranteed benefit types.

name: GuaranteedBenefitsIncurred
standard_label: Guaranteed Benefits Incurred (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Total of amount of guaranteed minimum benefit expense incurred during the period presented, resulting in an increase to the liability for expected guaranteed minimum benefits in excess of projected account values, for all guaranteed benefit types.

name: GuaranteedBenefitsPaid
standard_label: Guaranteed Benefits Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Total amount of guaranteed minimum benefit payments to policyholders and contract holders, during the period presented, resulting in a decrease to the liability for expected guaranteed minimum benefits in excess of projected account values, for all guaranteed benefit types.

name: GuaranteedInsuranceBenefitTypeDomain
standard_label: Guaranteed Insurance Benefit Type [Domain] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Types of guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

name: GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfBenefitAxis
standard_label: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Benefit [Axis]
documentation: Information by benefit for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

name: GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfBenefitDomain
standard_label: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Benefit [Domain]
documentation: Benefit for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

name: GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfGuaranteeAxis

documentation: Information by guarantee for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

name: GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfGuaranteeDomain
standard_label: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Guarantee [Domain]
documentation: Guarantee for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

name: GuaranteedInterestContracts
standard_label: Guaranteed Interest Contracts
documentation: The amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date pertaining to the guarantee given by the insurance entity to contract holders of a specified rate of return (a guaranteed yield) on their investments for a specified period.

name: GuaranteedInvestmentContractAssumptions
standard_label: Guaranteed Investment Contract Assumptions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Assumptions used in determining the loss reserve for negotiated contracts between an insurance enterprise (issuer) and an investor, typically a pension plan or savings and investment plan. GICs held by defined benefit pension plans generally provide for a specified return on principal invested over a specified period.

name: GuaranteedInvestmentContractInterestRateAssumptions
standard_label: Guaranteed Investment Contract, Interest Rate Assumptions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Assumptions surrounding the entity's exposure to risk (net amount at risk) with respect to the guaranteed interest rate on a negotiated contract between an insurance enterprise (issuer) and an investor, typically a pension plan or savings and investment plan.

name: GuaranteedInvestmentContractInterestRateAssumptionsHighEnd
standard_label: Guaranteed Investment Contract, Interest Rate Assumptions, High End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The estimated maximum interest rate applied to guaranteed investment contract policyholder deposits during the stated period to calculate the net amount at risk.

name: GuaranteedInvestmentContractInterestRateAssumptionsLowEnd
standard_label: Guaranteed Investment Contract, Interest Rate Assumptions, Low End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The estimated minimum interest rate applied to guaranteed investment contract policyholder deposits during the stated period to calculate the net amount at risk.

name: GuaranteedInvestmentContractMember
standard_label: Guaranteed Investment Contract [Member]
documentation: Contract that guarantees interest for a predetermined period of time and repayment of principal.

name: GuaranteedLifetimeWithdrawalBenefitMember
standard_label: Guaranteed Lifetime Withdrawal Benefit [Member]
documentation: Feature in an insurance contract that allows the contract holder to, at a minimum, withdraw a fixed percentage of the annuity premiums on a periodic basis regardless of market performance for the life of the contract holder.

name: GuaranteedMinimumAccumulationBenefitMember
standard_label: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit [Member]
documentation: Feature in an insurance contract that guarantees a minimum contract value.

name: GuaranteedMinimumDeathBenefitMember
standard_label: Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit [Member]
documentation: Feature in an insurance contract that guarantees a minimum amount that will be payable upon the death of the insured.

name: GuaranteedMinimumIncomeBenefitMember
standard_label: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit [Member]
documentation: Feature in an insurance contract that provides a guaranteed minimum amount available for annuitization after a specified period, which is in addition to a guaranteed minimum annuity rate.

name: GuaranteedMinimumWithdrawalBenefitMember
standard_label: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit [Member]
documentation: Feature in an insurance contract that allows the contract holder to, at a minimum, withdraw a fixed percentage of the annuity premiums on a periodic basis regardless of market performance until the premium is recovered.

name: GuaranteesAbstract

name: GuaranteesAndProductWarrantiesAbstract

name: GuaranteesFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Guarantees, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: GuaranteesFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Guarantees, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: GuaranteesIndemnificationsAndWarrantiesPolicies

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for guarantees, indemnifications and product warranties, and methodologies used in determining the amount of such liabilities.

name: GuarantorObligationTerm1

name: GuarantorObligationsByUnderlyingAssetClassAxis
standard_label: Guarantor Obligations by Underlying Asset Class [Axis] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Terms and attributes of guarantee obligations by the type of asset being guaranteed.

name: GuarantorSubsidiariesMember
standard_label: Guarantor Subsidiaries [Member]
documentation: Entity owned or controlled by another entity which has guaranteed the issue of securities by another subsidiary of the parent or has guaranteed the issue of securities by the parent.

name: GuarantyAssets
standard_label: Guaranty Assets
documentation: The carrying amount of the contractual right to receive fees, as compensation in exchange for providing a guarantee to a third party, over life of the guarantee.

name: GuarantyFeeIncome
standard_label: Guaranty Fee Income (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the portion of monthly guaranty fees collected representing the interest imputed and recognized under the prospective interest method on the present value of the contractually stipulated guarantee payments at inception of the contract.

name: GuarantyLiabilities
standard_label: Guaranty Liabilities
documentation: This item represents a non-contingent liability for the fair value of an obligation to stand ready to perform over the term of a guaranty issued in the event that specified triggering events or conditions occur.

name: HaircutsOnBankersAcceptancesCertificatesOfDepositAndCommercialPaper

name: HaircutsOnStocksAndWarrants

name: HaircutsOnUSAndCanadianGovernmentObligations
standard_label: Haircuts on US and Canadian Government Obligations (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Percentage deduction to take into account portfolio and market risk on US and Canadian Government Obligations.

name: HaircutsOnUndueConcentrations
standard_label: Haircuts on Undue Concentrations (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Percentage deduction to take into account portfolio and market risk on undue concentrations.

name: HaircutsOther
standard_label: Haircuts, Other (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount of deduction to take into account portfolio and market risks on securities, classified as other.

name: HealthCareCostsPolicyPolicyTextBlock

name: HealthCareEntitiesPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Health Care Entities, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for all health care policies.

name: HealthCareMember

documentation: Service provided for prevention, maintenance, diagnosis or treatment of physical and mental health.

name: HealthCareOrganizationAccountsPayableToThirdPartyPayor
standard_label: Health Care Organization, Accounts Payable to Third-Party Payor
documentation: Amount payable to third-party payor by health care organization for contractual adjustment and final settlement.

name: HealthCareOrganizationAccountsReceivableDueFromThirdPartyPayorRetroactiveAdjustment
standard_label: Health Care Organization, Accounts Receivable Due from Third-Party Payor, Retroactive Adjustment
documentation: Amount of receivable from retroactive adjustment for final settlement or appeal due from third-party payor.

name: HealthCareOrganizationAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPercentageOfAccountsReceivable

documentation: Ratio of the allowance for doubtful accounts to accounts receivable, expressed as a percentage, for health care organizations.

name: HealthCareOrganizationAmountOfWriteOffsOfAllowanceForDoubtfulAccounts

documentation: Amount of write-off of the allowance for doubtful accounts of health care organizations.

name: HealthCareOrganizationBadDebtsPolicyPolicyTextBlock

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for assessing the timing and amount of uncollectible revenue recognized as bad debt expense.

name: HealthCareOrganizationCapitationRevenue
standard_label: Health Care Organization, Capitation Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of revenue recognized based on fees charged on a per capita basis.

name: HealthCareOrganizationChangeInWriteOffs

name: HealthCareOrganizationDisclosuresforCertainHealthCareEntitiesAbstract

name: HealthCareOrganizationHealthCareCostsGross

name: HealthCareOrganizationInsurancePolicyRetrospectivelyRated

name: HealthCareOrganizationInsurancePolicyRetrospectivelyRatedPremiumAccrualBasis

name: HealthCareOrganizationMedicalSuppliesAndDrugsExpense
standard_label: Health Care Organization, Medical Supplies and Drugs Expense (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of medical supplies consumed, for example, but not limited to, bandages, syringes and drugs, for patient care.

name: HealthCareOrganizationOtherRevenue

name: HealthCareOrganizationPatientServiceRevenue

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetFiniteLivedStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
