documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetIndefiniteLivedExcludingGoodwillStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived, Impairment Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwill
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwillAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Impairment Loss [Abstract]

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsFinitelived
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsIndefinitelivedExcludingGoodwill
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived, Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

name: ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsMember
standard_label: Impairment of Intangible Assets [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate charge against earnings resulting from the write down of the carrying amount of intangible assets to a lower fair value.

name: ImpairmentOfInvestments
standard_label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
documentation: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

name: ImpairmentOfLeasehold
standard_label: Impairment of Leasehold
documentation: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.

name: ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
standard_label: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

name: ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedOf
standard_label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
documentation: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

name: ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties
standard_label: Impairment, Oil and Gas, Property with Unproved and Proved Reserves
documentation: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with proved and unproved reserves in oil- and gas-producing activities.

name: ImpairmentOfOngoingProject
standard_label: Impairment of Ongoing Project
documentation: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.

name: ImpairmentOfRealEstate
standard_label: Impairment of Real Estate
documentation: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

name: ImpairmentOfRetainedInterest
standard_label: Impairment of Retained Interest
documentation: The charge against earnings to reduce the carrying value of an interest continued to be held by the transferor in a securitized financial instrument.

name: ImpairmentOfTangibleAssetsOtherDescriptors
standard_label: Impairment of Tangible Assets, Other Descriptors (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Voluntary or miscellaneous disclosures regarding impairment of long-lived assets.

name: ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedAssetsIncludingIntangibleAssetsPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Long-Lived Asset, Including Intangible Asset and Goodwill, Impairment and Disposal [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the impairment and disposal of long-lived assets including goodwill and other intangible assets.

name: ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedAssetsPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Long-Lived Asset, Excluding Intangible Asset and Goodwill, Impairment and Disposal [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing and measuring the impairment of long-lived assets. An entity also may disclose its accounting policy for long-lived assets to be sold. This policy excludes goodwill and intangible assets.

name: ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedIntangibleAssetsAssetsToBeSoldPolicy
standard_label: Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Intangible Assets, Assets to be Sold, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for long-lived assets to be sold.

name: ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedIntangibleAssetsImpairmentPolicy
standard_label: Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Intangible Assets, Impairment, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing and measuring the impairment of long-lived assets. This policy excludes goodwill and intangible assets.

name: ImpairmentOrDisposalOfTangibleAssetsDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Impairment or Disposal of Tangible Assets Disclosure [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: InProcessResearchAndDevelopmentMember
standard_label: In Process Research and Development [Member]
documentation: In process investigation of new knowledge useful in developing new product or service or new process or technique or improvement to existing product or process, and translation of knowledge into plan or design for new product or process or for improvement to existing product or process.

name: InProcessResearchAndDevelopmentPolicy
standard_label: In Process Research and Development, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for costs assigned to identifiable tangible and intangible assets of an acquired entity to be used in the research and development activities of the combined enterprise. An entity also may disclose the appraisal method or significant assumptions used to value acquired research and development assets.

name: IncentiveDistributionDate
standard_label: Incentive Distribution, Date (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Date the limited liability company (LLC) managing member or a limited partnership (LP) general partner receives payment of an incentive obligation in cash, stock or units, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: IncentiveDistributionDistributionPerUnit
standard_label: Incentive Distribution, Distribution Per Unit
documentation: Per-share or per-unit amount of incentive dividend declared and paid to managing member or general partner.

name: IncentiveDistributionDistributionPerYear
standard_label: Incentive Distribution, Distribution
documentation: Amount of incentive obligation paid in cash or stock during the period to a limited liability corporation managing member or limited partnership general partner.

name: IncentiveDistributionMadeToManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerAxis
standard_label: Managing Member or General Partner [Axis]
documentation: Information by managing member or partner type.

name: IncentiveDistributionMadeToManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerLineItems
standard_label: Incentive Distribution Made to Managing Member or General Partner [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: IncentiveDistributionManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerAbstract
standard_label: Incentive Distribution, Managing Member or General Partner [Abstract]

name: IncentiveDistributionPaymentsMadeAndMinimumDistributionLevel
standard_label: Incentive Distribution, Payments Made and Minimum Distribution Level (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Incentive distribution payments made to managing members or general partners on a percentage scale, based on amounts in excess of distributions to Limited Liability Corporation or Limited Partnership members or limited partners.

name: IncentiveDistributionPolicyManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerDescription
standard_label: Incentive Distribution Policy, Managing Member or General Partner, Description [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for an incentive policy and the associated accounting for a plan in a limited liability corporation or limited partnership that includes the payment of cash or stock or units to the managing member or general partner.

name: IncentiveDistributionRecipientDomain
standard_label: Incentive Distribution, Recipient [Domain]
documentation: The managing member or general partner receiving the distribution.

name: IncentiveFeeAmountPaid
standard_label: Incentive Fee, Amount Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount paid to managing member or general partner for incentive rights held.

name: IncentiveFeeDescription
standard_label: Incentive Fee, Description
documentation: Description of the nature of the payments to managing member or general partner for incentive rights held including the fee rate, basis of calculation, relevant accounting period, whether the fee is paid to an entity other than the managing member or general partner, or if the fee is waived.

name: IncentiveFeeExpense
standard_label: Incentive Fee Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

name: IncentiveFeeExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Incentive Fee Expense [Abstract]

name: IncentiveFeeExpenseCapitalGainBased
standard_label: Incentive Fee Expense, Capital-Gain-Based
documentation: Amount of expense for capital-gain-based incentive fee for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncentiveFeeExpenseIncomeBased
standard_label: Incentive Fee Expense, Income-Based
documentation: Amount of expense for income-based incentive fee for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncentiveFeePayable
standard_label: Incentive Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of fee payable for management of operations based on performance under arrangement, including, but not limited to, investment.

name: IncentiveFeePayableAbstract
standard_label: Incentive Fee Payable [Abstract]

name: IncentiveFeePayableCapitalGainBased
standard_label: Incentive Fee Payable, Capital-Gain-Based
documentation: Amount of capital-gain-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncentiveFeePayableIncomeBased
standard_label: Incentive Fee Payable, Income-Based
documentation: Amount of income-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncentiveFromLessor
standard_label: Incentive from Lessor
documentation: Amount of incentive received by lessee from lessor.

name: IncentiveToLessee
standard_label: Incentive to Lessee
documentation: Amount of incentive granted by lessor to lessee.

name: InclusionOfInvestmentIncomeInAssessmentOfPremiumDeficiencyOnShortDurationContracts
standard_label: Inclusion of Investment Income in Assessment of Premium Deficiency on Short-Duration Contracts (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Indicates whether the insurance enterprise considers anticipated investment income in determining if a premium deficiency relating to short-duration contracts exists.

name: IncomeAmountsAttributableToNoncontrollingInterestDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Income Amounts Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Disclosures [Abstract]

name: IncomeAmountsAttributableToReportingEntityDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Income Amounts Attributable to Parent, Disclosures [Abstract]

name: IncomeAndExpensesLesseeAbstract
standard_label: Income and Expenses, Lessee [Abstract]

name: IncomeAndExpensesLessorAbstract
standard_label: Income and Expenses, Lessor [Abstract]

name: IncomeApproachValuationTechniqueMember
standard_label: Valuation, Income Approach [Member]
documentation: Valuation approach converting future amounts to single current discounted amount.

name: IncomeBeforeExtraordinaryItemsMember
standard_label: Income before Extraordinary Items [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Income before extraordinary items.

name: IncomeDepositSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Income Deposit Securities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)

name: IncomeDepositSecuritiesDividendPolicy
standard_label: Income Deposit Securities, Dividend Policy (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describe the dividend policy for Income Security Deposits (ISD). Income security deposits pay a regular dividend equal to all cash in excess of current operating needs. This item may also be referred to as an income participating security (IPS).

name: IncomeDepositSecuritiesForwardLookingCashFlows
standard_label: Income Deposit Securities, Forward-Looking Cash Flows (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describe the forward-looking cash flows associated with Income Security Deposits (ISD). Income security deposits pay a regular dividend equal to all cash in excess of current operating needs. This item may also be referred to as an income participating security (IPS).

name: IncomeDepositSecuritiesRisksAndLimitations
standard_label: Income Deposit Securities, Risks and Limitations (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describe the associated risks and limitations of Income Security Deposits (ISD). For instance, the discretionary nature of dividends. Income security deposits pay a regular dividend equal to all cash in excess of current operating needs. This item may also be referred to as an income participating security (IPS).

name: IncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

name: IncomeLossAttributableToParent
standard_label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

name: IncomeLossAttributableToParentAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciple
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Income or Loss from continuing operations, net of taxes, including net Income or Loss from discontinued operations but before extraordinary items.

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrincipleAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerBasicShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The amount of net Income or Loss before extraordinary items per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerBasicShareAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic Share [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerDilutedShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The amount of net income or loss for the period before extraordinary items available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerDilutedShareAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Diluted Share [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of income (loss) before extraordinary items available to each outstanding general partnership unit during the reporting period.

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnitAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of income (loss) before extraordinary items available to each outstanding limited partnership unit during the reporting period.

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDiluted
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of Income or Loss before extraordinary items available to each limited partner unit outstanding during the reporting period and each unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for all dilutive potential units outstanding during the reporting period. Limited partners have limited liability and do not manage the partnership.

name: IncomeLossBeforeExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciplePerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: IncomeLossBeforeGainOrLossOnSaleOfPropertiesExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectsOfAccountingChanges
standard_label: Income (Loss) before Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount of income (loss) before gain (loss) on sale of properties of Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT).

name: IncomeLossBeforeGainOrLossOnSaleOfPropertiesExtraordinaryItemsAndCumulativeEffectsOfAccountingChangesAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) before Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties [Abstract] (Deprecated 2020)

name: IncomeLossFromAffordableHousingProjectsEquityMethodInvestments
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Equity Method Investment, Income (Loss) from Tax Credit Investment
documentation: Amount of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by equity method investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAttributableToNoncontrollingEntity
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAttributableToParentAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesDomestic
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterestAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesForeign
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesMinorityInterestAndIncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesMinorityInterestAndIncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeInterestExpenseInterestIncomeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterestsNet
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Interest Expense, Interest Income, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interests, Net
documentation: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDiluted
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBasicAndDilutedShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted share of common stock or unit when the per share amount is the same for both basic and diluted shares.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBasicShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
documentation: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDilutedShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
documentation: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of Income or Loss from continuing operations available to each general partnership unit in a publicly trade limited partnership or master limited partnership (MLP) during the reporting period. General partners have unlimited liability and manage the partnership.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnitNetOfTax
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasic
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
documentation: Per unit ownership amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, after tax, available to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasicAndDiluted
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of Income or Loss from continuing operations available to each limited partnership unit in a publicly trade limited partnership or master limited partnership (MLP) during the reporting period. Limited partners have limited liability and do not manage the partnership.

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitBasicNetOfTax
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).

name: IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDiluted
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of Income or Loss from continuing operations available to each limited partner unit outstanding during the reporting period and each unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for all dilutive potential units outstanding during the reporting period. Limited partners have limited liability and do not manage the partnership.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAndDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerBasicAndDilutedShareAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAndDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerBasicShareAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAndDisposalOfDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerDilutedShareAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTax
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntity
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntityAbstract
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerBasicAndDilutedShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Per basic and diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation, when the per share amount is the same.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerBasicShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
documentation: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerDilutedShare
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
documentation: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of income (loss) from disposition of discontinued operations available to each general partnership unit during the reporting period, net of tax.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnit1
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of gain (loss) on disposal of discontinued operations available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasic
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic
documentation: The amount of income (loss) from disposition of discontinued operations available to each limited partnership and general partnership unit during the reporting period, net of tax.

name: IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasicAndDiluted
standard_label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted (Deprecated 2026)

standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Notes Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the sum of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; and from note holders for outstanding loans.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndOtherOperatingLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Related Parties
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for goods and services provided by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries, subsidiaries of a common parent, an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other part

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableTrade
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Trade
documentation: Change in recurring obligations of a business that arise from the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services used in the production and sale of goods and services.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableAndOtherOperatingAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableFromSecuritization
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable from Securitization
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable, Related Parties
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to the reporting entity for good and services provided to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, member of their immediate families, affiliates,

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedCostOfOilAndGasReclamation
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Cost of Oil and Gas Reclamation
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in accrued costs that represent future cash outlays for restoration and reclamation of oil and gas producing properties.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInterestReceivableNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Interest Receivable, Net
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from borrowers for interest payments.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInvestmentIncomeReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Investment Income Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in investment income that has been earned but not yet received in cash.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherOperatingLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedSalaries
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedTaxesPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedTaxesPayableAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAdministrativeFeePayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Administrative Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fee payable for administrative service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, and overhead costs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAdvancePaymentsByBorrowersForTaxesAndInsurance
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepayments received from borrowers for taxes and insurance remitted to the appropriate tax authority or insurer on behalf of the borrower.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAirTrafficLiability1
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Air Traffic Liability (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of unearned revenue related to tickets sold but not yet recognized as revenue.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAllowanceForEquityFundsUsedDuringConstruction
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Allowance for Equity Funds Used During Construction
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the capitalized cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and / or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments. As a result of this capitalization, net income is increased. This element pertains to certain regulated industries, such as public utilities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAssetRetirementObligations
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInAssetsHeldForSale
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in book value of long-lived assets that the reporting entity plans to sell within one year (or one business cycle).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInBalancingAccountUtility
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Balancing Account, Utility
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the asset created by the regulatory convention in which costs and revenues associated with certain utility expenses (such as fuel) are accumulated but on which no return is earned.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInBillingInExcessOfCostOfEarnings
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Billing in Excess of Cost of Earnings
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability reflecting cash payments received before the related costs have been incurred.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInBookOverdrafts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Book Overdrafts
documentation: The increase (decrease) in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in book overdrafts.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInBorrowedSecurities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Borrowed Securities (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of securities that are temporarily held by the reporting entity.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerDealerRelatedReceivablesPayablesNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerageReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due to the entity related to activities and operations with other broker dealers, and clearing organizations, including deposits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCapitalizedExploratoryWellCostsThatArePendingDeterminationOfProvedReservesRollForward
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCarryingValueOfAssetsReceivedAsConsiderationInDisposalOfBusiness
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Carrying Value of Assets Received as Consideration in Disposal of Business (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The changes in the carrying value of assets received as consideration in the disposal or of residual interests in the business.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCashCollateralForBorrowedSecurities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is pledged as security when borrowing securities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCashCollateralForLoanedSecurities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Loaned Securities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInClientFundsHeld
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Client Funds Held
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of client funds held and maintained in custodial and separate accounts, and which are owned by clients or contract holders.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCoalInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Coal Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of coal held in inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCollateralHeldUnderSecuritiesLending
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Collateral Held under Securities Lending
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of assets, which may include but are not limited to cash and investments, received as collateral pertaining to securities loaned to a counterparty to the transaction. Includes the change during the period in any unrealized gain or loss on such investments.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCommodityContractAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Commodity Contract Assets and Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInConstructionPayables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Construction Payables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of obligations, not classified as trade payables, incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies, and services pertaining to construction projects.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInContractReceivablesNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerAsset
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCostInExcessOfBillingOnUncompletedContract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Cost in Excess of Billing on Uncompleted Contract
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCustomerAdvances
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCustomerAdvancesAndDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances and Deposits
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, or (c) a combination of (a) and (b).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCustomerAdvancesAndDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances and Deposits [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCustomerDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Deposits
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInCustomerLoyaltyProgramLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Loyalty Program Liability
documentation: Increase (decrease) in the liability arising from revenue deferred or cost to provide future products or services resulting from customer loyalty program. Excludes liability associated with frequent flier programs. Includes liability associated with customer loyalty programs for other businesses, for example, but not limited to, hotels, supermarkets, credit card companies, automobile rental companies, and book sellers.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDebtSecuritiesTrading
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredAirTrafficRevenue
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Air Traffic Revenue (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of unearned revenue related to tickets sold but not yet recognized as revenue and the estimated incremental cost for points or miles outstanding and awards that expect to be redeemed through customer loyalty programs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredAirTrafficRevenueAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Air Traffic Revenue [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredCharges
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredChargesInvesting
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges, Investing
documentation: The increase (decrease) in noncurrent deferred charges, classified as investing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredCompensation
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Compensation
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation created by employee agreements whereby earned compensation will be paid in the future.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredElectricCost
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Electric Cost
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized electric costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredFuelCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredFuelCostsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredGasCost
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Gas Cost
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized gas costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLeasingFees
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred initial direct cost for lease.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Liabilities
documentation: Change during the period in carrying value for all deferred liabilities due within one year or operating cycle.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPensionCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Pension Costs (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in obligations for pension benefits attributed to past service that have not yet been expensed.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRentReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Rent Receivables (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due that is the result of the cumulative difference between actual rent due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenueAndCustomerAdvancesAndDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue and Customer Advances and Deposits
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of an acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, (c) the increase (decrease) during the reporting period, excluding the portion taken into income, in the liabi

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenueAndCustomerAdvancesAndDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue and Customer Advances and Deposits [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDemandDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositOtherAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in moneys or securities given as security including, but not limited to, contract, escrow, or earnest money deposits, retainage (if applicable), deposits with clearing organizations and others, collateral, or margin deposits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositOtherAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits, Alternative [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsFromOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsOutstanding
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits Outstanding
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in monies given as security or collateral for items acquired or borrowed on a temporary basis. Deposits may also be paid as initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsWithOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDividendsReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Dividends Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash disbursements due from investments, representing the shareholders' portion of profits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromAffiliatesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromEmployeeCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Employee, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from employees for floats, allowances and loans (generally evidenced by promissory notes).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromOfficersAndStockholdersCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Officers and Stockholders, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromOtherRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Other Related Parties, Current
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party receivables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from other entities that could exert significant influence over the reporting entity.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedPartiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties, Current
documentation: The aggregate increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to ex

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedPartiesCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties, Current [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToAffiliates
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates
documentation: The increase (decrease) in obligations owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToAffiliatesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToEmployeesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Employees, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in obligations due within one year (or one business cycle) to employees other than officers.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToOfficersAndStockholders
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders
documentation: The increase (decrease), during an accounting period, in total obligations owed to the reporting entity's executives and owners.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToOfficersAndStockholdersCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to reporting entity's executives and owners.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToOtherRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToOtherRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties, Current
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties w

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedPartiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties w

name: IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedPartiesCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties, Current [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInEarnestMoneyDepositsOutstanding
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Earnest Money Deposits Outstanding
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of deposits given by the reporting entity to a seller which shows that the prospective buyer is serious about purchasing a property.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInEmployeeRelatedLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInEmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInEnergyTradingActivity
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Energy Trading Activity
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of long term assets generated by energy trading activities, which involve the purchase and sale of energy under forward contracts at fixed and variable prices and the buying and selling of financial energy contracts which include exchange futures and options and over the counter options and swaps.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInEquitySecuritiesFvNi
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInEstimatedFutureDevelopmentCosts
standard_label: Changes in Estimated Future Development Costs
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in standardized measure of discounted future net cash flow as a result of change in estimated future development costs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInExploitationLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Exploitation Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of exploitation liabilities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueAdjustmentsOnAssetsAndLiabilitiesCarriedAtFairValueUnderFairValueOption
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value Adjustments on Other Assets (Liabilities) Carried at Fair Value under Fair Value Option
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value adjustment on other assets (liabilities) carried at fair value under the fair value option on the statement of cash flows of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemInInterestRateFairValueHedge
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings for the period related to the fair value of the hedged item in an interest rate fair value hedge, which was offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemInInterestRateFairValueHedge1
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in an interest rate fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemInPriceRiskFairValueHedge
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Price Risk Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period related to the fair value of the hedged item in a price risk fair value hedge, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemInPriceRiskFairValueHedge1
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Price Risk Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in a price risk fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfInterestRateFairValueHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments. Recognized in earnings and offsets the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfInterestRateFairValueHedgingInstruments1
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfPriceRiskFairValueHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period related to the fair value of price risk derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfPriceRiskFairValueHedgingInstruments1
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of price risk derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfUnhedgedDerivativeInstruments
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Derivative Instruments, Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period, which was recognized in earnings, in the unrealized gains or losses on derivative instruments that are not or are no longer designated as hedging instruments.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchased
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund borrowed from other financial institution arising from the insufficient reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseNetAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSold
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Sold
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFilmCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Film Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of film costs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFilmCosts1
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Film Costs
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film. Examples include, but are not limited to, costs of story and scenario, compensation, set construction and postproduction costs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFinanceReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Finance Receivables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContractLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Guarantee Insurance Contract Liabilities (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period financial guarantee insurance contract liabilities balances which would generally be expected to be classified as cash flows from operating activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchased
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased. Proprietary securities transactions entered into by the broker-dealer for trading or investment purposes are included in "Securities Owned and Securities Sold, Not Yet Purchased." Although proprietary trading is frequently thought of as purchasing securities for sale to others, trading securities for the broker-dealer's own account sometimes leads to a liability for the fair value of securiti

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialInstrumentsUsedInOperatingActivities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialInstrumentsUsedInOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Finished Goods and Work in Process Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of finished goods inventory and work in process inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFossilFuelInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fossil Fuel Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fossil fuel held in inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFossilFuelInventoriesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fossil Fuel Inventories [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFrequentFlyerLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Frequent Flyer Liability (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of unearned revenue related to the estimated incremental cost for points or miles outstanding and awards that expect to be redeemed through customer loyalty programs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFuelInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fuel held in inventory.
