name: IncreaseDecreaseInFuelInventoriesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreements
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements
documentation: The change in funds held under reinsurance agreements or treaty (contract between the reinsurer and the ceding entity stipulating the manner in which insurance written on various risks is to be shared).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFutureIncomeTaxExpenseEstimatesOnFutureCashFlowsRelatedToProvedOilAndGasReserves
standard_label: Changes in Future Income Tax Expense Estimates on Future Cash Flows Related to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in standardized measure of discounted future net cash flow as a result of change in the estimated future income tax on future pretax net cash flows related to the entity's proved oil and gas reserves.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitReserves
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Future Policy Benefit Reserves
documentation: The change in the future policy benefit reserve balance on the balance sheet.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitReservesAndOtherInsuranceLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Future Policy Benefit Reserves and Other Insurance Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in estimated future policy benefit obligations under insurance contracts, and obligations under insurance contracts classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInGasImbalanceReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Gas-Balancing Receivable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivable in gas-balancing arrangement in oil- and gas-producing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInGiftCardLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Gift Card Liability (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation for outstanding gift cards. Retail customers purchase gift cards or gift certificates that can be redeemed at a later date for merchandise or services; those unredeemed represent a liability of the entity because the revenue is being deferred.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInHealthCareInsuranceLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Health Care Insurance Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncentiveFeePayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Incentive Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fee payable for management of operations based on performance under arrangement, including, but not limited to, investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncentiveFeePayableAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Incentive Fee Payable [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncentiveFeePayableCapitalGainBased
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Incentive Fee Payable, Capital-Gain-Based
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in capital-gain-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncentiveFeePayableIncomeBased
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Incentive Fee Payable, Income-Based
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in income-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxes
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesPayableNetOfIncomeTaxesReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIndustryFundObligation
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Industry Fund Obligation (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Change in Industry Fund also known as a multi-employer pension fund, which normally covers employees in a particular industry or group of industries, or in a particular geographic area.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Assets
documentation: The increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period in insurance industry assets which are classified as cash flows from operating activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Assets [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) in insurance liability balances during the period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceSettlementsReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Settlements Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in insurance settlements receivable, which are amounts due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. The expectation is that such reimbursement will be received within one year of the balance sheet date.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInIntangibleAssetsCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Intangible Assets, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in intangible assets (for example patents and licenses).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsReceivableAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInterestsContinuedToBeHeldByTransferorCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Interests Continued to be Held by Transferor, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the assets created and retained during the securitization of trade receivables, which are not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInventoriesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInventoriesAndOtherOperatingAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInInventoryForLongTermContractsOrPrograms
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of inventory pertaining to construction, development, or other contracts or programs that initially were expected to take more than one year or the normal operating cycle to complete.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLeaseAcquisitionCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Lease Acquisition Costs
documentation: The increase (decrease) in the balance of capitalized lease acquisition costs during the period. The cost usually covers a variety of administrative costs, such as the cost of obtaining a credit report, verifying insurance coverage, lease commission charges, checking the accuracy and completeness of the lease documentation, and entering the lease in data processing and accounting systems.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLeasingReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Leasing Receivables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from lessees arising from lease agreements.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLiabilityForClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReserve
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserve
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLifeInsuranceLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Life Insurance Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) in life insurance liability balances during the period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLoansDeferredIncome
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans, Deferred Income
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in net unamortized loan origination fees and other fees that are collected at origination but recorded as income over the life of the loan.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLoansFromOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans from Federal Home Loan Banks
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLoansHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loan, Held-for-Sale [Abstract] (Deprecated 2025)

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLoansToFederalHomeLoanBanks
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLongTermReceivablesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Long-Term Receivables, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) of receivables that were originally due beyond one year (or one business cycle).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInLossAndLossAdjustmentExpenseReserve
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loss and Loss Adjustment Expense Reserve (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the reserve account established to account for expected but unspecified losses.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Management and Incentive Fees Payable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) management and incentive fees payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayableAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Management and Incentive Fees Payable [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInManagementFeePayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Management Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) management fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInMarginDepositsOutstanding
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Margin Deposits Outstanding
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in money or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivative position.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInMarketableSecuritiesRestricted
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Marketable Securities, Restricted
documentation: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in total debt and equity financial instruments including: (1) securities held-to-maturity, (2) trading securities, and (3) securities available-for-sale that are pledged to one or more secured parties who have the right to buy, sell, or re-pledge the collateral.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInMaterialsAndSupplies
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Materials and Supplies
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, or both, which are not included in inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInMortgageLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of mortgage loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInMortgageLoansHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale [Abstract] (Deprecated 2025)

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesPayableCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current portion (due within one year or one business cycle) of obligations evidenced by formal promissory notes.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesPayableCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesPayableRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed by the reporting entry in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, manage

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesPayableRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion (due within one year or one business cycle, whichever is longer) of the amount owed by the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or und

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesReceivableCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from note holders for outstanding loans.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesReceivableRelatedParties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, manag

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesReceivableRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entry (during the current year or operating cycle) in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's managemen

name: IncreaseDecreaseInNotesReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Assets
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of assets used to generate operating income.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Assets [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingCapital
standard_label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Lease Liability
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for operating lease.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities that result from activities that generate operating income.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOptionPremiumContractsPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Option Premium Contracts Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of option premium contracts for energy-related commodities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccountsPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other obligations or expenses incurred but not yet paid.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherAccruedLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accrued Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other expenses incurred but not yet paid.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in current assets classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentAssetsAndLiabilitiesNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets and Liabilities, Net
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in current operating assets after deduction of current operating liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherCurrentLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in current liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherDeferredLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deferred Liability
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred obligations classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deposits
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherEmployeeRelatedLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherFinancialInstrumentsUsedInOperatingActivities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of other financial instruments used in operating activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherFossilFuelInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Fossil Fuel Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fossil fuel, other than coal, held in inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherInsuranceLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Insurance Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in insurance liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherLoans
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Loans
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentAssetsAndLiabilitiesNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherNoncurrentLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssetsAndLiabilitiesNetAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingCapitalNet
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherPolicyholderFunds
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Policyholder Funds
documentation: The change in other policyholder funds recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Receivables
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherRegulatoryAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Regulatory Assets
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of other assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs to the balance sheet.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOtherTimeDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Time Deposits
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in time deposits classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOutstandingChecksFinancingActivities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
documentation: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOutstandingChecksOperatingActivities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Operating Activities
documentation: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities. Another element, Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities, represents cash flows from outstanding checks classified as financing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOverEnergyRecovery
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in over Energy Recovery
documentation: The change during the reporting period in the value of the asset created by an over recovery. An over recovery means that the basic energy product price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less than the basic fuel price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOverUnderEnergyRecovery
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in over (under) Energy Recovery
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the asset or liability created by an over or under recovery. An over under-recovery means that the basic energy price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is less (over) or more (under) than the basic energy price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInOverUnderEnergyRecoveryAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in over (under) Energy Recovery [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInParticipationLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Participation Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of participation liabilities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPartnersCapitalRollForward
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Partners' Capital [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPayableForInvestmentPurchased
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Payable for Investment Purchased
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in payable for purchase of investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesToBrokerDealers
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Payable to Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesToCustomers
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Customers
documentation: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in amounts payable to customers. The term customers generally excludes other broker-dealers; persons who are principal officers, directors, and stockholders; and persons whose securities or funds are part of the regulatory net capital of the broker-dealer. Another broker-dealer's account can be classified as a customer if the account is carried as an omnibus account in compliance with certain regulations. The accounts of principal office

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesUnderRepurchaseAgreements
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables under Repurchase Agreements
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability under agreements to repurchase securities that were sold.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPensionAndPostretirementObligations
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPensionAndPostretirementObligationsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPensionPlanObligations
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension Benefits
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit or defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPneumoconiosisBenefitObligationsNoncurrent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Pneumoconiosis Benefit Obligations Noncurrent
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to fund payment obligations to former employees suffering from pneumoconiosis.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPostemploymentObligations
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Postemployment Obligations
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion of the liability that represents various benefits due to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPostretirementObligations
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPremiumsReceivable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Premiums Receivable
documentation: The change in the premium receivable balance on the balance sheet.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidAdvertising
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Advertising
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidDeferredExpenseAndOtherAssets
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidDeferredExpenseAndOtherAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidExpense
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of outstanding money paid in advance for goods or services that bring economic benefits for future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidExpensesOther
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expenses, Other
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidGasDelivery
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Gas Delivery (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of public utility natural gas purchases that have been paid but will not be delivered until beyond one year or one operating cycle.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidInsurance
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Insurance
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidInterest
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Interest
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidPensionCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Pension Costs (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in prepaid pension costs.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidReinsurancePremiums
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
documentation: The change in prepaid reinsurance premiums recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidRent
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Rent
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidRoyalties
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Royalties
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidSupplies
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Supplies
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for supplies that provide economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidTaxes
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Taxes
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits in future periods.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPrincipalPaymentsOnContractReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Principal Payments on Contract Receivables (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) in the principal payments on contract receivables.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInProductionParticipationPlanLiability
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Production Participation Plan Liability
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in obligations arising from employee benefits that are based on cash flows generated by interests in oil and gas properties acquired or developed during the year.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInProfessionalFeePayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Professional Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fee payable for professional service, including, but not limited to, legal and accounting services.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPropertyAndCasualtyInsuranceLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Casualty Insurance Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) in property and casualty insurance liabilities balances during the period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInPropertyAndOtherTaxesPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Other Taxes Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of cash payments due to taxing authorities for non-income-related taxes.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesRollForward
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRawMaterialsPackagingMaterialsAndSuppliesInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Raw Materials, Packaging Materials and Supplies Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of raw materials, packaging materials and supplies held in inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReceivableForInvestmentSold
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivable for Investment Sold
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivable from sale of investment.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReceivablesUnderRepurchaseAgreements
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables under Repurchase Agreements
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity under agreements to sell and repurchase securities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRecoverablePropertyDamageCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Recoverable Property Damage Costs
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the public utility damage costs that will be permitted by regulatory agencies to be recovered from rate payers.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRecoverableRefundableGasCosts
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Recoverable Refundable Gas Costs
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the asset or liability created by a public utility's ability to recover gas costs that are higher or lower than the basic cost included in rate payer calculations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs (revenues) to the balance sheet. This element is a the increase (decrease) of regulatory assets and liabilities combined.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRegulatoryClauseRevenue
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Clause Revenue
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in unrecovered fuel costs for a regulated utility company.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRegulatoryLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in regulated liabilities. Regulated liabilities are created when regulatory agency permits an entity to defer revenues to the balance sheet.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReinsurancePayables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Payables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to other insurance companies when the reporting entity has assumed a portion of the cedant's insurance risk which has resulted in insurance losses.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReinsuranceRecoverable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Recoverable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInReserveForCommissionsExpenseAndTaxes
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Reserve for Commissions, Expense and Taxes
documentation: The change in the reserve for commissions, expenses and taxes recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCash
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCashAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash [Abstract] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCashAndInvestments
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash and Investments (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow during the period for the aggregate increase (decrease) associated with funds and investments that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as assets held in escrow or contractually limited as to use or disposition) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCashAndInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash and Investments [Abstract] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCashAndInvestmentsForOperatingActivities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Investments for Operating Activities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in marketable securities and investments pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCashAndInvestmentsForOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Investments for Operating Activities [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestrictedCashForOperatingActivities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities. This may include cash restricted for regulatory purposes.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRestructuringReserve
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Restructuring Reserve
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) of the liability pertaining to the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination and to asset retirement obligations.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRetailRelatedInventories
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Retail Related Inventories
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of merchandise inventory held by a retailer, wholesaler, or distributor for future sale; includes packaging and other supplies used to store, transport, or present merchandise inventory.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRetainagePayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Retainage Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in retainage obligations due by the reporting entity that are payable within one year (or one business cycle).

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRetainedInterestInSecuritizedReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in retained interest in a securitized receivable, classified as a trading security.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRiskManagementAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Risk Management Assets and Liabilities
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of financial instruments other than those that are purchased and held principally for the purpose of hedging or mitigating market risk, credit risk, legal risk, operational risk and other types of risk.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInRoyaltiesPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Royalties Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for compensation payments related to the use of copyrights, patents, trade names, licenses, technology. Royalty payments are also paid by the lease holders for oil, gas, and mineral extraction.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSavingsDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Savings Deposits
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all savings account deposits, which may include passbook, statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs), classified as cash flows from financing activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSecuritiesBorrowed
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Borrowed
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity arising from securities borrowed transactions.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSecuritiesLendingPayable
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Lending Payable
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of the liability pertaining to obligations to return collateral that the entity received when it loaned securities to the counterparty to the transaction.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSecuritiesLoanedTransactions
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Loaned Transactions
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability arising from securities loaned transactions.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSecurityDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Security Deposits
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in security deposits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSelfInsuranceReserve
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Self Insurance Reserve
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInSpotCommodities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Spot Commodities (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in spot commodities balances.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInStandardizedMeasureOfDiscountedFutureNetCashFlowRelatingToProvedOilAndGasReservesRollForward
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flow Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInStockholdersEquityRollForward
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Stockholders' Equity [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTemporaryEquityRollForward
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Temporary Equity [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDeposits
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits
documentation: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsForeign
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits, Foreign (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The increase (decrease) in the total of foreign time deposits.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsOf100000OrMore
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits of $100,000 or more
documentation: The increase (decrease) in time deposits equal to or greater than $100,000 per account.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsOfLessThan100000
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits of Less than $100,000
documentation: The increase (decrease) in time deposits less than $100,000 per account.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTradingLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Trading Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of trading liabilities from the reporting entity's trading activities. This include liabilities resulting from sales of assets that the reporting entity does not own and revaluation losses.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTradingSecurities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInTradingSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI [Abstract]

name: IncreaseDecreaseInUnbilledReceivables
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Unbilled Receivables
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amount of revenue for work performed for which billing has not occurred, net of uncollectible accounts.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInUnderEnergyRecovery
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in under Energy Recovery
documentation: The change during the reporting period in the value of the liability created by an under-recovery. An under-recovery means that the basic energy product price based on the daily product price and exchange rate is more than the basic fuel price used in the calculation of the monthly retail energy product.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInUndisbursedLoanFunds
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Undisbursed Loan Funds
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in undistributed cash for loans that have been granted but not entirely funded.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiums
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Unearned Premiums
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiumsNet
standard_label: (Increase) Decrease in Unearned Premiums, Net
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of decrease (increase) in unearned premiums.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInUnprovedOilAndGasProperty
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Unproved Oil and Gas Property
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of property designated for oil and gas production that has not been found (through exploratory drilling) to have extractible reserves of oil and gas.

name: IncreaseDecreaseInWorkersCompensationLiabilities
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) in Workers' Compensation Liabilities
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due for insurance (or actual expenses) to cover the medical expenses and lost income for employees that are injured during the course of doing work-related activities.

name: IncreaseDecreaseOfRestrictedInvestments
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) of Restricted Investments
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

name: IncreaseDecreaseToSubordinatedLiabilitiesRollForward
standard_label: Increase (Decrease) to Subordinated Liabilities [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IncreaseDueToPurchasesOfMineralsInPlace
standard_label: Increase Due to Purchases of Minerals in Place
documentation: Amount of increase in standardized measure of discounted future net cash flow as a result of purchases of minerals in place.

name: IncreaseInCarryingAmountOfRedeemablePreferredStock
standard_label: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
documentation: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

name: IncreaseInRestrictedCash
standard_label: Increase in Restricted Cash (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of cash outflow associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as investing activities.

name: IncreaseInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossible
standard_label: Increase in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible
documentation: Amount of increase reasonably possible in the next twelve months for the unrecognized tax benefit.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToAcceleratedShareRepurchaseAgreements
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreements
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of accelerated share repurchase agreements. An accelerated share repurchase program is a combination of transactions that permits an entity to purchase a targeted number of shares immediately with the final purchase price of those shares determined by an average market price over a fixed period of time.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCallOptionsAndWarrants
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Call Options and Warrants
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of call options and warrants using the treasury stock method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToContingentlyIssuableShares
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Contingently Issuable Shares
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares are those shares that are issuable for little or no cash contingent on certain conditions being met.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToConversionOfDebtSecurities
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Debt Securities
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible debt securities using the if-converted method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToConversionOfPreferredStock
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToEquityForwardAgreements
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Forward Agreements
documentation: Additional shared included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity forward arrangements using the reverse treasury stock method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToEquityUnitPurchaseAgreements
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Unit Purchase Agreements
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity unit purchase agreements using the treasury stock method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToNonvestedSharesWithForfeitableDividends
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Nonvested Shares with Forfeitable Dividends
documentation: Number of additional shares included in diluted EPS for potentially dilutive effect of nonvested equity-based payment award containing forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents, whether paid or unpaid.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToParticipatingNonvestedSharesWithNonForfeitableDividendRights
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Participating Nonvested Shares with Non-forfeitable Dividend Rights
documentation: This element represents nonvested share-based payment awards that contain non-forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents (whether paid or unpaid). Basic and dilutive earnings per share are generally disclosed for such shares using the two-class method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToShareBasedPaymentArrangements
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

name: IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToWrittenPutOptions
standard_label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Written Put Options
documentation: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of outstanding written put options using the reverse treasury stock method.

name: IncrementalEffectOnBalanceSheetApplicationOfSFAS158RecognitionProvisionsLineItems
standard_label: Incremental Effect on Balance Sheet, Application of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions [Line Items] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: IncrementalEffectOnBalanceSheetAssetLineItemBalanceApplicationOfSFAS158RecognitionProvisions
standard_label: Incremental Effect on Balance Sheet, Asset Line Item Balance, Application of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Balances of individual asset line items in the year-end statement of financial position that are incrementally affected by the recognition provisions of FAS 158 in the year of initial application.

name: IncrementalEffectOnBalanceSheetAssetLineItemBalanceBeforeAdditionalMinimumPensionLiabilityAMLAdjustmentAndApplicationOfSFAS158RecognitionProvisions
standard_label: Incremental Effect on Balance Sheet, Asset Line Item Balance, before Additional Minimum Pension Liability (AML) Adjustment and Application of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
