standard_label: Incremental Effects on Balance Sheet, Application of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions, Balance Sheet Line Item [Axis] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: In the year of initial application of the recognition provisions of FAS 158, indicate the individual asset, liability or equity line items in the year-end statement of financial position that are incrementally affected.

name: IncurredClaimsFinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContracts
standard_label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Financial Guarantee (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount, after policies assumed or ceded, of provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for financial guarantee insurance contracts.

name: IncurredClaimsPropertyCasualtyAndLiability
standard_label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Property, Casualty and Liability (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for property and casualty insurance contracts.

name: IndefiniteLivedContractualRights
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Contractual Rights
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date of rights with an indefinite period of benefit that arose from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

name: IndefiniteLivedDomesticSlotsAndRoutes
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Domestic Slots and Routes (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Carrying amount, (original cost adjusted for any previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date, of domestic slots, route authorities, airport operating and gate lease rights and related intangibles.

name: IndefiniteLivedFranchiseRights
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Franchise Rights
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through a franchise arrangement having an indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Carrying amount of intangible assets, excluding goodwill, which have a projected indefinite period of benefit (hence are not amortized), allocated to the reportable segment. These assets, acquired either individually or as part of a group of assets, in either an asset acquisition or business combination, are assessed at least annually for impairment. Examples may include trade secrets, contractual rights, trade names, and licensing agreements.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredAsPartOfBusinessCombinationTable
standard_label: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Indefinite-Lived [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about indefinite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredDuringPeriod
standard_label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Acquired During Period (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate amount of indefinite-lived intangible assets acquired in the period and allocated to the reportable segment. The value is stated at fair value based on the purchase price allocation.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Class [Axis]
documentation: Information by class of indefinite-lived intangible asset.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassLineItems
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsBySegmentLineItems
standard_label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets by Segment [Line Items] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwill
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived
documentation: Amount of indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwillAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived [Abstract]

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwillFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill), Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, that lack physical substance, having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsForeignCurrencyTranslationGainLoss
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation, Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsImpairmentLosses
standard_label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Impairment Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Impairment recognized during the period and allocated to the reportable segment that results from the write-down of indefinite-lived intangible assets after comparing the implied fair value of reporting unit indefinite-lived intangible assets with the carrying amount of that indefinite-lived intangible assets, which are assessed at least annually for impairment.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsMajorClassNameDomain
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Class [Domain]
documentation: Class of indefinite-lived intangible asset.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPurchaseAccountingAdjustments
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Measurement Period Adjustment
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRollForward
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAdjustments
standard_label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Translation Adjustments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit, from foreign currency translation adjustments.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAndPurchaseAccountingAdjustments
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAndPurchaseAccountingAdjustmentsAbstract
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments [Abstract]

name: IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsWrittenOffRelatedToSaleOfBusinessUnit
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Divestiture
documentation: Amount of decrease in indefinite-lived intangible asset from divestiture. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefiniteLivedInternationalSlotsAndRoutes
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived International Slots and Routes (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Carrying amount, (original cost adjusted for any previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date, of international slots, route authorities, airport operating and gate lease rights and related intangibles.

name: IndefiniteLivedLicenseAgreements
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived License Agreements
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndefiniteLivedSlotsAndRoutes
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Slots and Routes (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Carrying amount, (original cost adjusted for any previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date, of slots, route authorities, airport operating and gate lease rights and related intangibles.

name: IndefiniteLivedSlotsAndRoutesAbstract
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Slots and Routes [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: IndefiniteLivedTradeDress
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Trade Dress (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date of costs pertaining to a distinctive, nonfunctional feature, which distinguishes a merchant's or manufacturer's goods or services from those of another.

name: IndefiniteLivedTradeNames
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Trade Names
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndefiniteLivedTradeSecrets
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Trade Secrets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for trade secrets which protect the entity's unique technology and knowledge in its field of business so as to obtain competitive advantage for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndefiniteLivedTrademarks
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Trademarks
documentation: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired
standard_label: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Acquired
documentation: Amount of increase in indefinite-lived asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill.

name: IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsMember
standard_label: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets [Member]
documentation: Assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, that lack physical substance, having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

name: IndemnificationGuaranteeMember
standard_label: Indemnification Agreement [Member]
documentation: An agreement (contract) that contingently requires the guarantor to make payments to the guaranteed party in compensation for that party's or parties' loss or injury attributable to specified events or actions, such as a patent infringement action against an entity that relied on certain representations as to ownership rights made by a software vendor.

name: IndependentTransmissionAndDistributionSystemMember
standard_label: Independent Transmission and Distribution System [Member]
documentation: System for the transmission and distribution of electricity, gas, water, or other fuels and materials.

name: IndexedAnnuityMember
standard_label: Indexed Annuity [Member]
documentation: Contract providing interest payment that varies according to index.

name: IndicationThatEntityWasInDevelopmentStageInPriorYears
standard_label: Indication that Entity was in Development Stage in Prior Years (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: A statement that in prior years the enterprise had been in the development stage. This statement is included in financial statements in the first fiscal year for which the enterprise is no longer considered to be a development stage enterprise. This statement may include details on the period during which the enterprise was in the development stage, when the enterprise exited the development stage, and activities undertaken that allowed the enterprise to exit the development stage.

name: IndicationThatFinancialStatementsAreThoseOfDevelopmentStageEnterprise
standard_label: Indication that Financial Statements are those of Development Stage Enterprise (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Indication that the current or prior year financial statements of the entity, its development stage subsidiary, or its investee as those of a development stage enterprise.

name: IndirectGuaranteeOfIndebtednessMember
standard_label: Indirect Guarantee of Indebtedness [Member]
documentation: An indirect guarantee of the indebtedness of another party arises under an agreement that obligates one entity to transfer funds to a second entity upon the occurrence of specified events, under conditions whereby (a) the funds become legally available to creditors of the second entity and (b) those creditors may enforce the second entity's claims against the first entity under the agreement. Examples of indirect guarantees include agreements to advance funds if a second entity's net income, cov

name: IndividualMember
standard_label: Individual Counterparty [Member]
documentation: Individual person that is legally permitted to enter into a contract and be sued if that person fails to meet the obligations imposed by a contract.

name: IndividualPoliciesMember
standard_label: Individual Insurance Policy [Member]
documentation: Contract consisting of insurance coverage issued to individual.

name: IndividuallyImmaterialCounterpartiesMember
standard_label: Individually Immaterial Counterparties [Member]
documentation: Individually insignificant counterparties not separately disclosed. Counterparty is other party participating in financial transaction.

name: InducedConversionOfConvertibleDebtExpense
standard_label: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for inducement to convert debt instrument representing fair value of security and other consideration transferred in excess of fair value of security and other consideration issuable pursuant to conversion privilege provided in terms of existing instrument.

name: IndustrialMiscellaneousAndAllOthersMember
standard_label: Industrial, Miscellaneous, and All Others [Member]
documentation: This item represents investments by the reporting entity in equity securities issued by any type of company other than public utilities, banks, trusts, and insurance companies the investments in which are summarized elsewhere.

name: IndustrialPropertyMember
standard_label: Industrial Property [Member]
documentation: Building designed to house industrial operations and provide the necessary conditions for the operation of industrial equipment.

name: IndustryOfCounterpartyDomain
standard_label: Industry of Counterparty [Domain]
documentation: The industry of the party or parties having primary responsibility to meet the obligations of the arrangement with the entity.

name: IndustrySpecificPoliciesAbstract
standard_label: Industry-Specific Policies [Abstract]

name: IndustrySpecificPoliciesBrokerDealerTextBlock
standard_label: Industry-Specific Policies, Broker-Dealer [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognition of revenues and expenses including commissions, underwriting, management and investment advisory fees, trading gains and losses, interest income and expense, dividend income and expense, floor brokerage, and exchange fees. Also, may include the broker-dealers' disclosure on the nature of operations and estimates used in preparation of financial statements and significant estimates.

name: IndustrySpecificPoliciesInsuranceCompaniesTextBlock
standard_label: Industry-Specific Policies, Insurance Companies [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for insurance companies that are industry specific.

name: IndustrySpecificPoliciesOilAndGasTextBlock
standard_label: Oil and Gas [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for oil and gas entities.

name: IneffectivenessOnCreditRiskHedgesIsImmaterial
standard_label: Ineffectiveness on Credit Risk Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Assertion that the amount of credit risk cash flow and fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

name: IneffectivenessOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgesIsImmaterial
standard_label: Ineffectiveness on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Assertion that the amount of foreign currency fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

name: IneffectivenessOnInterestRateFairValueHedgesIsImmaterial
standard_label: Ineffectiveness on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Assertion that the amount of fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

name: IneffectivenessOnPriceRiskFairValueHedgesIsImmaterial
standard_label: Ineffectiveness on Price Risk Fair Value Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Entity discloses that the amount of price risk fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

name: IneffectivenessOnPriceRiskHedgesIsImmaterial
standard_label: Ineffectiveness on Price Risk Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Assertion that the amount of price risk cash flow and fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

name: InformationAboutSourcesAndUsesOfCollateralThatIsReceivedThroughResaleAgreementsAndSecuritiesBorrowingAgreementsAndSubsequentlyRepledgedOrSold
standard_label: Information about Sources and Uses of Collateral that is Received Through Resale Agreements and Securities Borrowing Agreements
documentation: This describes information about the sources and uses of collateral that is acquired through resale agreements and securities borrowing agreements that the entity is permitted by contract or custom to sell or repledge.

name: InformationByCategoryOfDebtSecurityAxis
standard_label: Debt Security Category [Axis]
documentation: Information by category of debt security, either available-for-sale or held-to-maturity.

name: InformationByFinancialStatementLineItemAxis
standard_label: Information by Financial Statement Line Item [Axis] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Information by each relevant line item on the financial statements.

name: InformationTechnologyAndDataProcessing
standard_label: Information Technology and Data Processing
documentation: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

name: InitialApplicationPeriodCumulativeEffectTransitionAxis
standard_label: Initial Application Period Cumulative Effect Transition [Axis] (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Information about effect of transition method for cumulative effect in initial period of application.

name: InitialApplicationPeriodCumulativeEffectTransitionDomain
standard_label: Initial Application Period Cumulative Effect Transition [Domain] (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Effect of transition method for cumulative effect in initial period of application.

name: InitialFranchiseFees
standard_label: Initial Franchise Fees (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The amount of initial franchise fees.

name: InitialHookupDeferredRevenueMember
standard_label: Initial Hookup Deferred Revenue [Member]
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein cable television companies' initial hookup revenue is recognized as revenue to the extent of direct selling costs incurred. The remainder is deferred and amortized to income over the estimated average period that subscribers are expected to remain connected to the system.

name: InitialMeasurementOfInterestsContinuedToBeHeldByTransferorWhenSecuritizedFinancialAssetsAreAccountedForAsSalePolicy
standard_label: Initial Measurement of Assets or Liabilities that relate to Transferor's Continuing Involvement when Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Assets are Accounted for as Sale, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for initially measuring the assets or liabilities that relate to the transferor's continuing involvement (including interests that continue to be held by the transferor, and servicing assets or servicing liabilities), if any, including the methodology (whether quoted or market prices, prices based on sales of similar assets and liabilities, or prices based on valuation techniques) used in determining their fair value.

name: InitialOfferingPeriod
standard_label: Initial Offering Period
documentation: A description of the time period when the company made its initial offering of a class of securities.

name: InitialPeriodInWhichEffectsAreExpectedToBeRealized
standard_label: Initial Period in which Effects are Expected to be Realized (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The initial period in which these effects are expected to be realized.

name: InlandRevenueHongKongMember
standard_label: Inland Revenue, Hong Kong [Member]
documentation: Designated tax department of the government of Hong Kong.

name: InlandRevenueSingaporeIRASMember
standard_label: Inland Revenue, Singapore (IRAS) [Member]
documentation: Designated tax department of the government of Singapore.

name: InstrumentAxis
standard_label: Instrument [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information categorized by legal agreement.

name: InstrumentTypeMember
standard_label: Instrument Type [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This item is to be populated with the specific type of legal agreement entered into by the entity.

name: InsuranceAbstract
standard_label: Insurance [Abstract]

name: InsuranceAgencyManagementFee
standard_label: Insurance Agency Management Fee
documentation: Fees earned during the period for providing management services.

name: InsuranceClaimsMember
standard_label: Insurance Claims [Member]
documentation: A demand for payment of a policy benefit because of the occurrence of an insured event, such as the death or disability of the insured; the maturity of an endowment; the incurrence of hospital or medical bills; the destruction or damage of property and related deaths or injuries; defects in, liens on, or challenges to the title to real estate; or the occurrence of a surety loss; and the costs to process claims.

name: InsuranceCommissions
standard_label: Insurance Commissions
documentation: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

name: InsuranceCommissionsAndFees
standard_label: Insurance Commissions and Fees
documentation: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

name: InsuranceContractAcquisitionCostPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Insurance Contract, Acquisition Cost [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for cost related directly to successful acquisition of new and renewal of insurance contract. Information includes, but is not limited to, input, judgment, assumption, and method used to determine amortization amount, and change in input, judgment, and assumption. Cost, includes but is not limited to, deferred policy acquisition cost, deferred sale inducement cost, and present value of future profit of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

name: InsuranceContractAcquisitionCostTextBlock
standard_label: Insurance Contract, Acquisition Cost [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for cost related directly to successful acquisition of new and renewal of insurance contract. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred policy acquisition cost, deferred sale inducement cost, and present value of future profit of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

name: InsuranceContractRightsAndObligationsFairValueOptionMember
standard_label: Insurance Contract, Rights and Obligations [Member]
documentation: Rights and obligations under an insurance contract that is not a financial instrument (because it requires or permits the insurer to provide goods or services rather than a cash settlement), but whose terms permit the insurer to settle by paying a third party to provide those goods or services.

name: InsuranceContractsAcquiredInBusinessCombinationMember
standard_label: Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination [Member]
documentation: Written contracts detailing the terms and conditions of insurance acquired in a business combination.

name: InsuranceDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Insurance Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for the types of coverages and products sold, and the assets, obligations, recorded liabilities, revenues and expenses arising therefrom, and the amounts of and methodologies and assumptions used in determining the amounts of such items.

name: InsuranceIndustryIncomeExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Insurance Industry Income (Expense) [Abstract]

name: InsuranceInvestmentIncome
standard_label: Insurance Investment Income
documentation: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

name: InsuranceLossReservesAbstract
standard_label: Insurance Loss Reserves [Abstract]

name: InsurancePremiumsRevenueRecognitionPolicy
standard_label: Insurance Premiums Revenue Recognition, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for revenue recognition of insurance premium. Includes, but is not limited to, basis for measurement and timing of recognition of revenue from insurance premium received from contract holder and method used in performing premium deficiency testing.

name: InsuranceRatiosAbstract
standard_label: Insurance Ratios [Abstract]

name: InsuranceRatiosComment
standard_label: Insurance Ratios Comment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Methodology and assumptions regarding insurance ratios such as ratio of life insurance assumed to life insurance in force, premium income to total reinsurance.

name: InsuranceReceivableForMalpractice
standard_label: Insurance Receivable for Malpractice
documentation: The amount receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

name: InsuranceReceivableForMalpracticeAbstract
standard_label: Insurance Receivable for Malpractice [Abstract]

name: InsuranceReceivableForMalpracticeCurrent
standard_label: Insurance Receivable for Malpractice, Current
documentation: The current portion of the amount receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

name: InsuranceReceivableForMalpracticeNoncurrent
standard_label: Insurance Receivable for Malpractice, Noncurrent
documentation: The noncurrent portion of the receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

name: InsuranceRecoveries
standard_label: Insurance Recoveries
documentation: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

name: InsuranceRelatedAssessmentsMember
standard_label: Insurance-related Assessments [Member]
documentation: Any funding mandated by statute or regulatory authority that is related directly or indirectly to underwriting activities, including pools for self-insurance and excluding premium taxes and income taxes. The funds derived from the assessments generally enable a government guarantor to pay insurance claims in the event that the underwriting insurer is insolvent or otherwise unable to meet its payment obligations.

name: InsuranceSectorMember
standard_label: Insurance Sector [Member]
documentation: Sector of economy consisting of companies engaged in business activity related to insurance.

name: InsuranceServicesRevenue
standard_label: Insurance Services Revenue
documentation: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

name: InsuranceServicesRevenueAbstract
standard_label: Insurance Services Revenue [Abstract]

name: InsuranceSettlementMember
standard_label: Insurance Settlement [Member]
documentation: A potential recovery of a loss for which a claim was filed with an insurer.

name: InsuranceSettlementsReceivable
standard_label: Insurance Settlements Receivable
documentation: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

name: InsuranceSettlementsReceivableCurrent
standard_label: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Current
documentation: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

standard_label: Intra-Entity Profit to Regulated Affiliate [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for intra-entity profit on sale to regulated affiliate.

name: InterestAndDividendIncomeOperatingAbstract

name: InterestAndDividendIncomeOperatingPaidInKind
standard_label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating, Paid in Kind
documentation: Amount of interest and dividend income from investment paid in kind, classified as operating.

name: InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurities

documentation: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on available-for-sale securities.

name: InterestAndDividendIncomeSecuritiesByTaxableStatusAbstract

standard_label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity
documentation: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on held-to-maturity securities.

standard_label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating [Abstract]

name: InterestAndDividendIncomeSecuritiesOther
standard_label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Other
documentation: Amount of other operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

name: InterestAndDividendIncomeSecuritiesTradingOrMeasuredAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Trading or Measured at Fair Value (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on trading securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests.

documentation: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity). Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: InterestAndDividendsPayableCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Dividends Payable, Current [Abstract]

name: InterestAndDividendsPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Interest and Dividends Payable
documentation: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity).

name: InterestAndDividendsPayableCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Dividends Payable [Abstract]

standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeasesAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable [Abstract]

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeasesHeldForSale
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including mortgage loans, and interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeasesHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeasesHeldInPortfolio
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-in-Portfolio
documentation: Interest and fee income generated by loans the Entity intends and has the ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (1) industrial and agricultural; (2) real estate; and (3) real estate construction loans; (4) trade financing; (5) lease financing; (6) home equity lines-of-credit; (7) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (8) credit card and other revolving-type loans. Also

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeasesHeldInPortfolioAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-in-Portfolio [Abstract]

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercial
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial
documentation: Interest and fee income related to commercial loans including industrial and agricultural, real estate (commercial and residential, construction and development), trade financing, and lease financing.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercialAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial [Abstract]

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercialAndResidentialRealEstate
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial and Residential, Real Estate
documentation: Interest and fee income from commercial and residential real estate loans.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercialIndustrialAndAgriculturalLoans
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Industrial, and Agricultural Loans
documentation: Interest and fee income generated from all commercial, industrial, and agricultural loans.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercialRealEstate
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Real Estate
documentation: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by commercial properties. Examples of properties commonly securing commercial real estate loans may include office buildings, apartment buildings, shopping centers, industrial property, and hotels.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsumer
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer
documentation: Interest and fee income generated from consumer loans. Consumer loans are loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures. Such loans include residential mortgages, home equity lines-of-credit, automobiles and marine transport loans, credit card transactions, and others.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsumerAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer [Abstract]

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsumerHomeEquity
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Home Equity
documentation: Interest and fee income from home equity lines-of-credit extended to individuals (borrowers). Such loans are generally secured by the borrower's equity in her or his home.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsumerInstallmentAutomobilesMarineAndOtherVehicles
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Automobiles, Marine, and Other Vehicles
documentation: Interest and fee income generated by automobile, marine, and other vehicle loans made to individuals.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsumerInstallmentCreditCard
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Credit Card
documentation: Interest and fee income from credit card balances due from individuals. Such loans are considered revolving credit arrangements.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansConsumerRealEstate
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Real Estate
documentation: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by one- to four-family residential properties. This item excludes home equity lines-of-credit.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansForeign
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Foreign
documentation: Interest and fee income generated by commercial and consumer loans, made by foreign branches of the reporting entity, which may include loans to foreign governments, foreign banks and other financial institutions, commercial and industrial entities, and citizens of not domiciled in the same country as the reporting entity.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansHeldForSaleMortgages
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loan, Held-for-Sale, Mortgage
documentation: Interest and fee income from mortgage loans considered to be held-for-sale.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansLeaseFinancing
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Lease Financing
documentation: Interest and fee income generated by direct lease financing which consists of an institution owning and leasing personal property for the use of its customers at the customers' specific request.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansOtherConsumer
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Other Consumer
documentation: Interest and fee income from other loans extended to individual consumers.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansRealEstateConstruction
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Real Estate Construction
documentation: Interest and fee income from loans used for real estate development and construction costs. Such loans are referred to as "Construction" loans or mortgages.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansTradeFinancing
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Trade Financing
documentation: Interest and fee income generated by trade financing. Trade financing is a specialized area of commercial lending frequently used by businesses that engage in international activities. Such financing includes open account financing, sales on consignment, documentary collections, advances against collections, letters of credit, bankers' acceptances, factoring, and forfeiting.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeNonmortgageLoansAndLeasesHeldForSale
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Nonmortgage
documentation: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeOtherLoans
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans
documentation: Amount of interest and fee income from loans classified as other.

name: InterestAndFeeIncomeOtherLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Interest and Fee Income, Loan, Held-for-Sale, Other
documentation: Amount of interest and fee income from loans held-for-sale and classified as other.

name: InterestAndOtherIncome
standard_label: Interest and Other Income
documentation: The amount of interest income and other income recognized during the period. Included in this element is interest derived from investments in debt securities, cash and cash equivalents, and other investments which reflect the time value of money or transactions in which the payments are for the use or forbearance of money and other income from ancillary business-related activities (that is, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

name: InterestAndOtherIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Interest and Other Income [Abstract]

name: InterestAndOtherIncomeTableTextBlock
standard_label: Interest and Other Income [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of interest income and income classified as other.

name: InterestAndOtherIncomeTextBlock
standard_label: Interest and Other Income [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for interest and other income.

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilities
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesAbstract

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesByComponentAbstract
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, by Component [Abstract]

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDomestic
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
documentation: Total amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include brokered, retail, demand, checking, notice of withdrawal, money market and other interest-bearing deposits.

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDomesticByComponentAbstract
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic, by Component [Abstract]

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesForeign
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign

name: InterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesForeignByComponentAbstract
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign, by Component [Abstract]

name: InterestBearingDepositsInBanks
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
documentation: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

name: InterestBearingDepositsMember
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Deposits [Member]
documentation: Cash on deposit with financial institutions that earns interest, either at a fixed or market rate.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositBrokered
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Brokered
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositCertificatesOfDeposits
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposits
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic certificate of deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositChecking
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositDemand
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
documentation: Amount of money in interest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositLiabilitiesDescription
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include methodology, assumptions and the types and amounts of domestic deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositMoneyMarket
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Money Market
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositNegotiableOrderOfWithdrawalNOW
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) demand deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositOtherTimeDeposit
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Other Time Deposit
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities classified as other. Excludes certificates of deposit.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositRetail
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Retail
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic retail deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositSavings
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Savings
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities. Saving deposits bear interest and have no stated maturity.

name: InterestBearingDomesticDepositTimeDeposits
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Time Deposits
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing domestic time deposits. Time deposits bear interest for a fixed, stated period of time and include certificate of deposits and individual retirement accounts.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositBrokered
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Brokered
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing foreign third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositCertificatesOfDeposits

documentation: Amount of interest-bearing certificates of deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositChecking
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Checking
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing checking deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositDemand
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Demand
documentation: Amount of money in interest-bearing foreign accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits. Checking and negotiable order withdrawals (NOW) are the most common forms of demand deposits.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositLiabilitiesDescription
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit Liabilities, Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of interest-bearing deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices. This disclosure may include the types and amounts of foreign deposit liabilities.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositMoneyMarket
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Money Market
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing money market demand account deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositNegotiableOrderOfWithdrawalNOW

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositOtherTimeDeposits

documentation: Amount of interest-bearing time deposit liabilities other than certificates of deposit in foreign banking offices.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositRetail
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Retail
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing retail deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositSavings
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Savings
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing savings deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: InterestBearingForeignDepositTimeDeposits
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposit, Time Deposits
documentation: Amount of interest-bearing time deposits in foreign banking offices. Time deposits bear interest for a fixed, stated period of time and include certificate of deposits and individual retirement accounts.

name: InterestBearingLiabilitiesAverageAmountOutstanding

standard_label: Interest-Bearing Liabilities, Average Amount Outstanding [Abstract]

name: InterestExpenseBorrowingsAbstract

name: InterestExpenseCommercialPaper

name: InterestExpenseDebtAbstract

name: InterestExpenseDeposits
standard_label: Interest Expense, Deposits
documentation: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

name: InterestExpenseDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Interest Expense, Deposits [Abstract]

name: InterestExpenseDepositsByDomesticAndForeignComponentAbstract
standard_label: Interest Expense, Deposits, by Domestic and Foreign Component [Abstract]

name: InterestExpenseFederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchase
standard_label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
