standard_label: Interest Rate Below Market Reduction [Member]
documentation: Loan modification for a reduction of stated interest rate to a rate lower than the current market rate for new debt with similar risk.

name: InterestRateCapMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Cap [Member]
documentation: Contract in which the cap writer, in return for a premium, agrees to limit, or cap, the cap holder's risk associated with an increase in interest rates. If rates go above a specified interest-rate-level (the strike price or the cap rate), the cap holder is entitled to receive cash payments equal to the excess of the market rate over the strike price multiplied by the notional principal amount.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeAssetAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeDerivativeAtFairValueNet
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeDerivativeAtFairValueNetAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net [Abstract]

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeGainLossReclassifiedToEarningsNet
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
documentation: The amount of net gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeGainLossToBeReclassifiedDuringNext12MonthsNet
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months, Net
documentation: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges as of the balance sheet date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next twelve months.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessIsImmaterial
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure of an assertion that the amount of interest rate cash flow hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgeLiabilityAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Liability at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateCashFlowHedgesAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges [Abstract]

name: InterestRateContractMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Contract [Member]
documentation: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to the right to receive or pay a sum of money at a given interest rate.

name: InterestRateDerivativeAssetsAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as assets.

name: InterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments [Abstract]

name: InterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsAssetAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsAtFairValueNet
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsAtFairValueNetAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net [Abstract]

name: InterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsLiabilityAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities.

name: InterestRateDerivativesAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivatives [Abstract]

name: InterestRateDerivativesAtFairValueNet
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, net of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

name: InterestRateDerivativesAtFairValueNetAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net [Abstract]

name: InterestRateExclusiveOfImmediateTerminalFundingAnnuities
standard_label: Interest Rate Exclusive of Immediate, Terminal Funding Annuities (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Relevant interest rate assumptions that are an integral part of the methodology used in calculating the future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process exclusive

name: InterestRateExclusiveOfImmediateTerminalFundingAnnuitiesHighEnd
standard_label: Interest Rate Exclusive of Immediate, Terminal Funding Annuities, High End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Maximum interest rate in the range of interest rates used to calculate future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process exclusive of immediate terminal funding annu

name: InterestRateExclusiveOfImmediateTerminalFundingAnnuitiesLowEnd
standard_label: Interest Rate Exclusive of Immediate, Terminal Funding Annuities, Low End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Minimum interest rate in the range of interest rates used to calculate future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process exclusive of immediate terminal funding annu

name: InterestRateFairValueHedgeAssetAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateFairValueHedgeDerivativeAtFairValueNet
standard_label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
documentation: Fair value of all derivatives designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateFairValueHedgeDerivativeAtFairValueNetAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net [Abstract]

name: InterestRateFairValueHedgeLiabilityAtFairValue
standard_label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
documentation: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

name: InterestRateFairValueHedgesAbstract
standard_label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedges [Abstract]

name: InterestRateFloorMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Floor [Member]
documentation: Contracts in which the floor writer, in return for a premium, agrees to limit the risk associated with a decline in interest rates based on a notional amount. If rates fall below an agreed rate, the floor holder will receive cash payments from the floor writer equal to the difference between the market rate and an agreed rate multiplied by the notional principal amount.

name: InterestRateLockCommitmentsMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Lock Commitments [Member]
documentation: Commitments to extend credit where the interest rate is locked in advance of funds being disbursed for a specified period of time.

name: InterestRateRiskMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Risk [Member]
documentation: The risk associated with changes in interest rates that effect the value of an interest-bearing asset or liability, and a servicing asset or liability.

name: InterestRateSwapMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Swap [Member]
documentation: Forward based contracts in which two parties agree to swap periodic payments that are fixed at the outset of the swap contract with variable payments based on a market interest rate (index rate) over a specified period.

name: InterestRateSwaptionMember
standard_label: Interest Rate Swaption [Member]
documentation: An option granting the owner the right but not the obligation to enter into an interest rate swap.

name: InterestReceivable
standard_label: Interest Receivable
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

name: InterestReceivableAndOtherAssets
standard_label: Interest Receivable and Other Assets
documentation: Amount of interest receivable and assets classified as other.

name: InterestReceivableAndOtherAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Interest Receivable and Other Assets [Abstract]

name: InterestReceivableCurrent
standard_label: Interest Receivable, Current
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of current interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: InterestReceivableNoncurrent
standard_label: Interest Receivable, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of noncurrent interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

name: InterestRevenueExpense
standard_label: Segment Reporting Information, Interest Income or Expense, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of interest revenue net of interest expense for the reportable segment. Reporting interest revenue net of interest expense is permitted only when a majority of the segment's revenues are from interest and the chief operating decision maker relies primarily on net interest revenue to assess the performance of the segment and make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment.

name: InterestRevenueExpenseNet
standard_label: Interest Income (Expense), Operating and Nonoperating
documentation: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.

name: InterestRevenueOrExpenseNetAbstract
standard_label: Interest Income (Expense), Operating and Nonoperating [Abstract]

name: InterestSensitiveLifeInsuranceAssumptions
standard_label: Interest Sensitive Life Insurance Assumptions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Assumptions including methodology used to calculate loss reserve for contracts that contractually vary the amount and timing of premium payments without the approval of the insurer. Premium payments are credited to the policyholder balance, against which amounts are assessed for contract services and to which amounts are credited as income. The policyholder balance provides a base upon which interest accrues to the policyholder and, when compared with the death benefit amount, fixes the insurer'

name: InterestSensitiveLifeInterestRateAssumptions
standard_label: Interest Sensitive Life, Interest Rate Assumptions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Assumptions regarding interest rates applied to monetary deposits made by or on behalf of policyholders for contracts that may contractually vary the amount and timing of premium payments without the approval of the insurer and in which premium payments are credited to the policyholder balance, against which amounts are assessed for contract services and to which amounts are credited as income. The policyholder balance provides a base upon which interest accrues to the policyholder and, when com

name: InterestSensitiveLifeInterestRateAssumptionsHighEnd
standard_label: Interest Sensitive Life, Interest Rate Assumptions, High End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The maximum interest rate applied during the stated period to monetary deposits made by or on behalf of policyholders for contracts that may contractually vary the amount and timing of premium payments without the approval of the insurer and in which premium payments are credited to the policyholder balance, against which amounts are assessed for contract services and to which amounts are credited as income. The policyholder balance provides a base upon which interest accrues to the policyholder

name: InterestSensitiveLifeInterestRateAssumptionsLowEnd
standard_label: Interest Sensitive Life, Interest Rate Assumptions, Low End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The minimum interest rate applied to deposits made by or on behalf of policyholders to contracts that may contractually vary the amount and timing of premium payments without the approval of the insurer and in which premium payments are credited to the policyholder balance, against which amounts are assessed for contract services and to which amounts are credited as income. The policyholder balance provides a base upon which interest accrues to the policyholder and, when compared with the death

name: InterestSensitiveLifeMember
standard_label: Interest Sensitive Life [Member]
documentation: Contract providing death benefits in which the rate credited by the insurer is adjusted periodically.

name: InterestbearingDomesticDepositOther
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Other
documentation: Amount of other interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities.

name: InterestbearingDomesticDepositTimeDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Time Deposits [Abstract]

name: InterestsContinuedToBeHeldByTransferorFairValue
standard_label: Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Fair Value
documentation: The carrying amount (fair value) as of the balance sheet date of the transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (typically securitized receivables, generally not involved in the collection of principal) following transfer of significant portions of such financial instruments to other parties. Such interests could be ancillary cash flows and interest-only strips.

name: InterestsContinuedToBeHeldByTransferorInFinancialAssetsThatItHasSecuritizedOrServicingAssetsOrLiabilitiesPolicy
standard_label: Assets or Liabilities that Relate to Transferor's Continuing Involvement in Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for measuring the fair value of assets or liabilities that relate to the transferor's continuing involvement (including interests that continue to be held by the transferor and servicing assets or servicing liabilities), if any, and servicing assets or servicing liabilities, if any, including the methodology (whether quoted or market prices, prices based on sales of similar assets and liabilities, or prices based on valuation techniques) used in determining their

name: InterestsContinuedToBeHeldByTransferorInFinancialAssetsThatItHasSecuritizedOrServicingAssetsOrLiabilitiesRelatingToAssetsThatItHasSecuritizedAbstract
standard_label: Interests Continued to be Held by Transferor in Financial Assets that It has Securitized or Servicing Assets or Liabilities Relating to Assets that It has Securitized [Abstract]

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableAmountFirstItem
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable Amount, First Item
documentation: Amount of first item of cost and expense incurred during interim period not readily identified with activity or benefit of other interim period and charged to interim period in which incurred.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableAmountSecondItem
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable Amount, Second Item
documentation: Amount of second item of cost and expense incurred during interim period not readily identified with activity or benefit of other interim period and charged to interim period in which incurred.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableAmountThirdItem
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable Amount, Third Item
documentation: Amount of third item of cost and expense incurred during interim period not readily identified with activity or benefit of other interim period and charged to interim period in which incurred.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableDescription
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable, Description
documentation: A description of the nature of the cost or expense incurred during an interim period that cannot be readily identified with the activities or benefits of other interim periods and are charged to the interim period in which incurred.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableDomain
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable [Domain]
documentation: This element represents the type of costs and expenses incurred during an interim period that cannot be readily identified with the activities or benefits of other interim periods and are charged to the interim period in which incurred.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableLineItems
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableTable
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about cost and expense incurred during interim period that cannot be readily identified with activity or benefit of other interim period and charged to interim period in which it incurred. Includes, but is not limited to, nature and amount of cost.

name: InterimPeriodCostsNotAllocableTableTextBlock
standard_label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of costs and expenses incurred during an interim period that cannot be readily identified with the activities or benefits of other interim periods and are charged to the interim period in which incurred.

name: IntermediateLifePlantsAccumulatedCosts
standard_label: Agriculture, Intermediate-Life Plant, Accumulated Cost
documentation: Amount of accumulated cost for intermediate-life plant.

name: IntermediateLifePlantsEstimatedUsefulLife
standard_label: Intermediate-life Plants, Estimated Useful Life (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The estimated useful life of the intermediate-life plants.

name: IntermediateLifePlantsUsefulLife
standard_label: Agriculture, Intermediate-Life Plant, Useful Life
documentation: Useful life of intermediate-life plant, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: InternalCreditAssessmentAxis
standard_label: Internal Credit Assessment [Axis]
documentation: Information by entity-defined rating.

name: InternalCreditAssessmentDomain
standard_label: Internal Credit Assessment [Domain]
documentation: Entity defined credit risk rating.

name: InternalCreditRatingMember
standard_label: Internal Credit Rating [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Company defined internal payment/performance risk groupings used for managing risk.

name: InternalInvestmentGradeMember
standard_label: Internal Investment Grade [Member]
documentation: Credit rating classification developed by the entity in which the probability of default is low and full and timely repayments are expected.

name: InternalNoninvestmentGradeMember
standard_label: Internal Noninvestment Grade [Member]
documentation: Credit rating classification developed by the entity in which the probability of default is high and full and timely repayments are not expected.

name: InternalReplacementTransactionAlternativeApplicationPolicyElection
standard_label: Internal Replacement Transaction, Alternative Application, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether accounting policy was elected to apply alternative guidance for internal replacement transaction of long-duration contract issued by insurance entity.

name: InternalReplacementsOfInsuranceContractsPolicy
standard_label: Internal Replacements of Insurance Contracts, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for previously deferred policy acquisition costs and previously deferred sales inducements when internal replacements of insurance contracts occur, including whether or not the entity has availed itself of the alternative guidance permitted under GAAP, and, if so, for which types of internal replacement transactions.

name: InternalRevenueServiceIRSMember
standard_label: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) [Member]
documentation: Designated tax department of the United States of America government entitled to levy and collect income taxes from the entity.

name: InternalUseSoftwarePolicy
standard_label: Software, Internal-Use [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for internal-use software. Excludes software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

name: InternallyAssignedGradeMember
standard_label: Internally Assigned Grade [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Credit quality indicators that are developed and used internally by the company.

name: InternetDomainNamesMember
standard_label: Internet Domain Names [Member]
documentation: String of typographic characters used to describe the location of a specific individual, business, computer, or piece of information online. Formally known as the Uniform Resource Locator or URL, it is often considered to be the address of a certain World Wide Web site.

name: IntersegmentEliminationMember
standard_label: Intersegment Eliminations [Member]
documentation: Eliminating entries used in operating segment consolidation.

name: IntersubsegmentEliminationsMember
standard_label: Intersubsegment Eliminations [Member]
documentation: Eliminating entries used in subsegment consolidation.

name: InventoriesMember
standard_label: Inventories [Member]
documentation: Tangible personal property held for sale in the ordinary course of business, or in process of, or to be consumed in, production for sale.

name: InventoriesPropertyHeldForSaleCurrent
standard_label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Current (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryAdjustments
standard_label: Inventory Adjustments
documentation: Amount of inventory reserves for last-in first-out (LIFO) and other inventory valuation methods.

name: InventoryAdjustmentsAbstract
standard_label: Inventory Adjustments [Abstract]

name: InventoryAmountUnpricedChangeOrdersForLongTermContractsOrPrograms
standard_label: Inventory Amount, Unpriced Change Orders for Long-Term Contracts or Programs
documentation: Amount of unpriced change orders or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization included in inventory as of the balance sheet date.

name: InventoryBuildingsAndImprovements
standard_label: Inventory, Buildings and Improvements
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of building structures held as inventory including any additions, improvements, or renovations to those structures.

name: InventoryCaptionsCompositionsDescription
standard_label: Inventory Captions Compositions, Description (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Describes the components of disclosed captions in the financial statements and inventory note, and provides relevant, pertinent information additional to the accounting policy note.

name: InventoryCashFlowPolicy
standard_label: Inventory, Cash Flow Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining where the cash flows related to the sale of inventory are classified in the statements of cash flows and explain the nature of the receivables, notes, and loans.

name: InventoryClassificationByIndustryGrossAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Gross, Classification by Industry [Abstract]

name: InventoryCombiningWorkInProcessAndRawMaterialsAlternativeGrossAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Gross, Combining Work in Process and Raw Materials Alternative [Abstract]

name: InventoryCostMethodExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Inventory, Cost Method [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates method of determining cost basis for inventory. Includes, but is not limited to, first-in first-out (FIFO), last-in first-out (LIFO), and average cost.

name: InventoryCostsForContractsOrProgramsPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Costs for Contracts or Programs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the basis and manner that goods are added and removed from inventory for costs relating to long-term contracts or programs. If inventory is carried at cost, this disclosure includes the nature of the cost elements included in inventory and how cost is determined (such as FIFO, LIFO, average). Elements of costs in inventory may include retained costs representing the excess of manufacturing or production costs over the amounts charged to cost of sales or delive

name: InventoryCrudeOilProductsAndMerchandise
standard_label: Energy Related Inventory, Crude Oil, Products and Merchandise
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of finished goods inventories for petroleum products, crude oil, petrochemical products, and other oil and gas inventories.

name: InventoryCurrentTable
standard_label: Inventory, Current [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about inventory expected to be sold or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryDescriptionUnpricedChangeOrdersForLongTermContractsOrProgram
standard_label: Inventory Description, Unpriced Change Orders for Long-Term Contracts or Program
documentation: Description of unpriced change orders or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization included in inventory as of the balance sheet date and the status of principal items comprising such amount.

name: InventoryDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Inventory Disclosure [Abstract]

name: InventoryDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Inventory Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for inventory. Includes, but is not limited to, the basis of stating inventory, the method of determining inventory cost, the classes of inventory, and the nature of the cost elements included in inventory.

name: InventoryDrillingNoncurrent
standard_label: Inventory, Drilling, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of inventories of minerals, materials and supplies related to long-term drilling operations.

name: InventoryExchangesMember
standard_label: Inventory Exchanges [Member]
documentation: Inventory that is exchanged with the same counterpart as a sale of goods.

name: InventoryFinishedGoods
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Gross
documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of completed merchandise or goods expected to be sold within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcess
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross
documentation: Amount before valuation reserves of merchandise or goods held by the entity that are readily available for sale and items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for sale.

name: InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross [Abstract]

name: InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves
documentation: The aggregated amount of merchandise or goods held by the entity and readily available for future sale plus items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for future sale. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

name: InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessNetOfReservesAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves [Abstract]

name: InventoryFinishedGoodsNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

name: InventoryFinishedGoodsPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Finished Goods, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the basis and manner that goods are added and removed from inventory awaiting sale (finished goods). If inventory is carried at cost, this disclosure includes the nature of the cost elements included in inventory and how cost is determined (such as FIFO, LIFO, average).

name: InventoryFinishedHomes
standard_label: Inventory, Finished Homes
documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of homes that have been finished and are ready for sale, net of valuation allowance and impairment loss.

name: InventoryFirmPurchaseCommitmentLoss
standard_label: Inventory, Firm Purchase Commitment, Loss
documentation: Amount of loss recognized on firm purchase commitment for inventory.

name: InventoryForLongTermContractsOrPrograms
standard_label: Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs, Gross
documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves, and progress payments, of inventory associated with long-term contracts, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryForLongTermContractsOrProgramsAbstract
standard_label: Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs [Abstract]

name: InventoryForLongTermContractsOrProgramsDescription
standard_label: Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs, Description (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of inventories, or other deferred costs, associated with long-term contracts or programs at the balance sheet date including the disclosure of the amount of and types of deferred costs recorded; principal assumptions where average costs per unit is used; inventories held associated with customer claims; amount of progress payments netted against recorded inventory; or other deferred costs recorded; and unrecovered production costs.

name: InventoryForLongTermContractsOrProgramsGeneralAndAdministrativeCostsIncludedInInventory
standard_label: Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs, General and Administrative Costs Included in Inventory
documentation: The actual or estimated amount of general and administrative expense remaining in inventory as of the balance sheet date.

name: InventoryForLongTermContractsOrProgramsGeneralAndAdministrativeExpenseIncurred
standard_label: Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs, General and Administrative Expense Incurred
documentation: Amount of general and administrative costs charged to inventory.

name: InventoryGasInStorageUndergroundNoncurrent
standard_label: Inventory, Gas in Storage Underground, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of natural gas stored underground in depleted gas reservoirs, aquifers, or salt caverns to meet future seasonal and peak load demands and also as insurance against unforeseen supply disruptions, and deemed to be a noncurrent asset because it is not expected to be used within 12 months or in the normal operating cycle.

name: InventoryGross
standard_label: Inventory, Gross
documentation: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held for future sale or to be used in manufacturing, servicing or production process.

name: InventoryGrossAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Gross [Abstract]

name: InventoryHomesUnderConstruction
standard_label: Inventory, Homes under Construction
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized construction costs of homes for future sale.

name: InventoryImpairmentPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Impairment, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing inventory losses, including, but not limited to, substantial and unusual losses resulting from the subsequent measurement of inventory due to physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

name: InventoryInterestCapitalizationPolicy
standard_label: Inventory, Interest Capitalization Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for (i) capitalizing to inventory the interest costs incurred on land development, home construction, and building construction projects, (ii) charging such capitalized costs against earnings, including identification of the line item captions reflecting such expense (typically cost of sales), and (iii) allocating such costs to projects.

name: InventoryInventoryConsignedToOthersPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Consigned to Others, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the basis and manner that goods are added and removed from inventory of inventory consigned to others. If inventory is carried at cost, this disclosure includes the nature of the cost elements included in inventory and how cost is determined (such as FIFO, LIFO, average).

name: InventoryLIFOReserve
standard_label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve
documentation: Amount by which inventory stated at last-in first-out (LIFO) is less than (in excess of) inventory stated at other inventory cost methods.

name: InventoryLIFOReserveEffectOnIncomeNet
standard_label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Effect on Income, Net
documentation: The difference between the change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods and any LIFO decrement which have been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

name: InventoryLIFOReserveEffectOnIncomeNetAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Effect on Income, Net [Abstract]

name: InventoryLIFOReservePeriodCharge
standard_label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Period Charge
documentation: The change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods, which change has been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

name: InventoryLandHeldForDevelopmentAndSale
standard_label: Inventory, Land Held for Development and Sale
documentation: Carrying amount net of impairment reserves as of the balance sheet date primarily consisting of deposits for land purchases (including option payments), related acquisition costs, and land which is not expected to be developed in the next two years.

name: InventoryLandHeldForSale
standard_label: Inventory, Land, Held-for-Sale
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of parcels of land held for sale, and on which the entity has no intention or no further intention to perform construction activities.

name: InventoryLineItems
standard_label: Inventory [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: InventoryMajorClassesPolicy
standard_label: Inventory, Major Classes, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the major categories of inventory such as finished goods, inventoried costs relating to long-term contracts or programs, work in process, raw materials, and supplies.

name: InventoryMarkdownsPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Markdowns, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for permanent markdowns of inventory at retail.

name: InventoryNet
standard_label: Inventory, Net
documentation: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryNetAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Net [Abstract]

name: InventoryNetClassificationByIndustryAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Net, Classification by Industry Alternative [Abstract]

name: InventoryNetCombiningWorkInProgressAndRawMaterialsAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Net, Combining Work in Process and Raw Materials Alternative [Abstract]

name: InventoryNetItemsNetOfReserveAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Net, Items Net of Reserve Alternative [Abstract]

name: InventoryNetOfAllowancesCustomerAdvancesAndProgressBillings
standard_label: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings
documentation: Amount, after deduction of valuation reserves, other allowances, and customer advances received on long-term contracts or programs, of inventory expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

name: InventoryNetOfAllowancesCustomerAdvancesAndProgressBillingsAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings [Abstract]

name: InventoryNoncurrent
standard_label: Inventory, Noncurrent
documentation: Inventories not expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

name: InventoryNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: InventoryNoncurrentFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Inventory, Noncurrent, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of inventory expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryOperativeBuilders
standard_label: Inventory, Operative Builders
documentation: The net carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the various components of an operative builder's inventory, including finished homes. Operative builders primarily consist of entities that develop land, construct residential homes and commercial and industrial buildings thereon, and sell them to home buyers and operators of the commercial and industrial properties.

name: InventoryOperativeBuildersAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Operative Builders [Abstract]

name: InventoryOperativeBuildersDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Operative Builders, Disclosures [Abstract]

name: InventoryOperativeBuildersOther
standard_label: Inventory, Operative Builders, Other
documentation: Amount of inventory used in the development of real estate classified as other.

name: InventoryOreStockpilesOnLeachPads
standard_label: Inventory, Ore Stockpiles on Leach Pads, Gross
documentation: Amount before last-in first-out (LIFO) and valuation reserves of ore stockpile material contained on a leach pad, for example, but not limited to, copper or gold ore.

name: InventoryPartsAndComponentsNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Parts and Components, Net of Reserves
documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date for elements of machinery or equipment held for the purpose of replacing similar parts in the course of repair or maintenance.

name: InventoryPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Inventory, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of inventory accounting policy for inventory classes, including, but not limited to, basis for determining inventory amounts, methods by which amounts are added and removed from inventory classes, loss recognition on impairment of inventories, and situations in which inventories are stated above cost.

name: InventoryRawMaterials
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Gross
documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of raw materials expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryRawMaterialsAndPurchasedPartsNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Purchased Parts, Net of Reserves
documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items purchased for use as components of a finished product or pieces of machinery and equipment plus any items in their natural and unrefined state. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines raw materials and purchased parts into an aggregate amount.

name: InventoryRawMaterialsAndSupplies
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross
documentation: Gross amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed.

name: InventoryRawMaterialsAndSuppliesAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross [Abstract]

name: InventoryRawMaterialsAndSuppliesNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves
documentation: Aggregated amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

name: InventoryRawMaterialsAndSuppliesNetOfReservesAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves [Abstract]

name: InventoryRawMaterialsNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process.

name: InventoryRawMaterialsPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Raw Materials, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the basis and manner that goods are added and removed from inventory (for example, average cost, LIFO or FIFO) that are to be consumed, either directly or indirectly, in the production of goods or services to be available for sale (raw materials). If inventory is carried at cost, this disclosure includes the nature of the cost elements included in inventory and how cost is determined (such as, FIFO, LIFO, average).

name: InventoryRealEstate
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate
documentation: Amount of real estate project held for sale, held for development, and under development with intent to sell upon completion of project.

name: InventoryRealEstateAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate [Abstract]

name: InventoryRealEstateConstructionInProcess
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Construction in Process
documentation: Cost of real estate projects incurred for projects for eventual sale or transfer (condominium or time share projects, vacation clubs).

name: InventoryRealEstateHeldForSale
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Held-for-Sale
documentation: Represents properties which were acquired directly or through foreclosure for which a committed plan to sell exists and an active program to market such properties has been initiated.

name: InventoryRealEstateImprovements
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Improvements
documentation: Represents improvements to real estate during development for ultimate sale to third parties. Improvements may consist of project infrastructure and other expenditures necessary to completion of the development project which is generally of a long-term nature.

name: InventoryRealEstateLandAndLandDevelopmentCosts
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Land and Land Development Costs
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of valuation allowances and impairment losses, of costs of land expected to be developed in the near term plus capitalized costs of development, for purposes of selling completed units to home buyers or commercial or industrial entities.

name: InventoryRealEstateMortgageLoansHeldInInventory
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Mortgage Loans Held in Inventory
documentation: Represents mortgage loans held in inventory primarily for sale to others (third parties, businesses, legal entities) in the ordinary course of business.

name: InventoryRealEstateOther
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Other
documentation: Amount of investment in certain other real estate investments not specifically identified elsewhere in the existing taxonomy.

name: InventoryRealEstatePolicy
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for capitalizing costs incurred as inventory, determining carrying values, recognizing impairment; and the timing of and methods used for charging inventory to cost of sales.

name: InventoryRealEstateRentalFurnitureNet
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Rental Furniture, Net (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of furniture inventory held for rental to third parties, stated at cost, net of accumulated depreciation.

name: InventoryRealEstateTimeshareAvailableForSale
standard_label: Inventory, Real Estate, Timeshare Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of real estate which is available for sale in the form of shared property ownership in which rights vest in several owners (buyers, timeshare holders) to use the property for a specified period each year (timeshare). Included in this item would be real estate assets in which timeshares are for sale, such as in condominiums at timeshare resorts. Excluded from this item would be assets, other than real estate, in which the Entity has sold or intends to sell timeshares, such as for cruises,

name: InventoryRecallExpense
standard_label: Inventory Recall Expense
documentation: Reflects the amount charged against earnings comprised of the costs to announce and effect a recall of defective merchandise.

name: InventoryRelatedText
standard_label: Inventory Related Text (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Additional information disclosed related to inventory.

name: InventoryShrinkagePolicy
standard_label: Inventory Shrinkage, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for inventory shortages, shrinkage, damaged goods, and defective goods.

name: InventoryStatedAboveCost
standard_label: Inventory, Stated Above Cost [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether inventory is stated above cost.

name: InventoryStatedAboveCostPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Stated Above Cost, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for circumstance in which inventories are stated at an amount above cost (such as at market value for precious metals).

name: InventorySuppliesNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Supplies, Net of Reserves
documentation: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of products used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process, which may or may not become part of the final product. May also include items used in the storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods.

name: InventorySuppliesPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Supplies, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the basis and manner that goods are added and removed from inventory for supplies to be consumed directly or indirectly in production. If inventory is carried at cost, this disclosure includes the nature of the cost elements included in inventory and how cost is determined (such as FIFO, LIFO, average).

name: InventoryValuationAndObsolescenceMember
standard_label: Inventory Valuation and Obsolescence [Member]
documentation: A revision in the estimate of excess and obsolete inventory to reduce the carrying amount of inventory to net realizable value.

name: InventoryValuationReserveMember
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Reserve, Inventory [Member]
documentation: Reserve to reduce inventory to lower of cost or net realizable value.

name: InventoryValuationReserves
standard_label: Inventory Valuation Reserves
documentation: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

name: InventoryWorkInProcess
standard_label: Inventory, Work in Process, Gross
documentation: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of merchandise or goods in the production process expected to be completed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: InventoryWorkInProcessAndRawMaterials
standard_label: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials
documentation: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items held by the entity which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. Includes supplies used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

name: InventoryWorkInProcessAndRawMaterialsNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
documentation: The aggregate carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

name: InventoryWorkInProcessNetOfReserves
standard_label: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
documentation: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

name: InventoryWorkInProcessPolicy
standard_label: Inventory Work in Process, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the basis and manner that goods are added and removed from inventory in the course of production (work in process). If inventory is carried at cost, this disclosure includes the nature of the cost elements included in inventory and how cost is determined (such as FIFO, LIFO, average).

name: InventoryWorkInProgressAndRawMaterialsAbstract
standard_label: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials [Abstract]

name: InventoryWriteDown
standard_label: Inventory Write-down
documentation: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

name: InvesteeMember
standard_label: Investee [Member]
documentation: A corporation that issued voting stock held by an investor.

name: InvestmentAcquisitionDate
standard_label: Investment, Acquisition Date
documentation: Date when investment is acquired, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: InvestmentAdviceMember
standard_label: Investment Advice [Member]
documentation: Investment recommendation and research provided to customer.

name: InvestmentAdvisoryFees
standard_label: Investment Advisory Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of fees earned from providing investment advice and research to customers.

name: InvestmentAdvisoryManagementAndAdministrativeFees
standard_label: Investment Advisory, Management and Administrative Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of revenue from providing investment advisory, asset management and administrative services, including, but not limited to, distribution and shareholder services, accounting, tax, legal, regulatory filing, share registration, and shareholder correspondence activities.

name: InvestmentAdvisoryManagementAndAdministrativeServiceMember
standard_label: Investment Advisory, Management and Administrative Service [Member]
documentation: Investment advisory, asset management and administrative service. Includes, but is not limited to, distribution and shareholder service; and accounting, tax, legal, regulatory filing, share registration and shareholder correspondence activities.

name: InvestmentAffiliatedIssuerControlledMember
standard_label: Investment, Affiliated Issuer, Controlled [Member]
documentation: Controlled affiliated issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentAffiliatedIssuerMember
standard_label: Investment, Affiliated Issuer [Member]
documentation: Affiliated issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentAffiliatedIssuerNoncontrolledMember
standard_label: Investment, Affiliated Issuer, Noncontrolled [Member]
documentation: Noncontrolled affiliated issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokerageAndUnderwritingFeesAndCommissions
standard_label: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
documentation: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

name: InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokerageAndUnderwritingFeesAndCommissionsAlternativePresentationForBanksAbstract
standard_label: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions, Alternative Presentation for Banks [Abstract]

name: InvestmentBankingFeesPolicy
standard_label: Investment Banking Fees, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognition of revenue for securities underwriting, acting as agent, services in merger acquisition and financial advisory services. Revenues would include gains, losses and fees, net of syndicate expenses arising from securities offerings.

name: InvestmentBankingRevenue
standard_label: Investment Banking Revenue
documentation: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

name: InvestmentBasisSpreadVariableRate
standard_label: Investment, Basis Spread, Variable Rate
documentation: Percentage added to reference rate used to compute variable rate on investment.

name: InvestmentBuildingAndBuildingImprovements
standard_label: Investment Building and Building Improvements
documentation: Aggregate of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of investments in building and building improvements.

name: InvestmentCompanyAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyAccountingAndReportingUnderTopic946
standard_label: Investment Company, Accounting and Reporting under Topic 946 [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment company is following accounting and reporting guidance under Topic 946 of Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) Accounting Standards Codification.

name: InvestmentCompanyAmountReceivedToLiquidationValueExcessLess
standard_label: Investment Company, Share, Amount Received to Liquidation Value, Excess (Less)
documentation: Amount received for shares issued in excess of (less than) preference value in involuntary liquidation of same class of security before sale.

name: InvestmentCompanyAmountReceivedToNavExcessLess
standard_label: Investment Company, Share, Amount Received to NAV, Excess (Less)
documentation: Amount received for shares issued in excess of (less than) net asset value (NAV) of same class of security before sale.

name: InvestmentCompanyAssessmentOfStatusAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Assessment of Status [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyAverageNetAssets
standard_label: Investment Company, Average Net Assets
documentation: Amount of average net assets for investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyBalanceSheetItemsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Supplemental Balance Sheet Items [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyCapitalCommitmentsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Capital Commitments [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyCapitalShareTransactionsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Capital Share Transaction, Increase (Decrease) [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyCapitalShareTransactionsPartnershipAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Capital Share Transactions, Partnership [Abstract] (Deprecated 2023)

name: InvestmentCompanyCapitalShareTransactionsStockIssuedAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Capital Share Transactions, Stock Issued [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyCapitalShareTransactionsStockRepurchasedAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Capital Share Transactions, Stock Repurchased [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyChangeInNetAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Change in Net Assets [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: InvestmentCompanyChangeInStatus
standard_label: Investment Company, Change in Status
documentation: Description of change in status and reason for change to qualify or to no longer qualify as investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyChangeInStatusOccurrence
standard_label: Investment Company, Change in Status Occurrence [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether change in investment company status occurred.

name: InvestmentCompanyChangesInNetAssetsLineItems
standard_label: Investment Company, Change in Net Assets [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: InvestmentCompanyChangesInNetAssetsTable
standard_label: Investment Company, Change in Net Assets [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about change in net assets (equity) of investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyChangesInNetAssetsTableTextBlock
standard_label: Investment Company, Change in Net Assets [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of change in net assets (equity) of investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyCircumstancesOfLossOnInvestmentTransaction
standard_label: Investment Company, Circumstances of Loss on Investment Transaction
documentation: Description of circumstance in which payment is made by affiliate to reimburse fund for loss on investment transaction.

name: InvestmentCompanyCommittedCapital
standard_label: Investment Company, Committed Capital
documentation: Amount of funds committed to investment company from investors.

name: InvestmentCompanyContractualAndVoluntaryFeesWaived
standard_label: Investment Company, Contractual and Voluntary Fees Waived
documentation: Amount of fee waived contractually and voluntarily for investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyContractualAndVoluntaryFeesWaivedAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Contractual and Voluntary Fees Waived [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyContractualAndVoluntaryFeesWaivedAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Contractual and Voluntary Fees Waived, Alternative [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyContractualFeeWaived
standard_label: Investment Company, Contractual Fee Waived
documentation: Amount of fee contractually waived by investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyContractualFeeWaivedAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Contractual Fee Waived [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyContributedCapitalToCommittedCapitalRatio
standard_label: Investment Company, Contributed Capital to Committed Capital Ratio
documentation: Percentage of capital contributed to capital committed by investment company's investors.

name: InvestmentCompanyDebtInstrumentAmountRepaidToNavExcessLess
standard_label: Investment Company, Debt Instrument, Amount Repaid to NAV, Excess (Less)
documentation: Amount of cost for repayment of debt instrument in excess of (less than) net asset value (NAV) at date of repayment.

name: InvestmentCompanyDebtInstrumentAmountRepaidToPrincipalExcessLess
standard_label: Investment Company, Debt Instrument, Amount Repaid to Principal, Excess (Less)
documentation: Amount of cost for repayment of debt instrument in excess of (less than) principal at date of repayment.

name: InvestmentCompanyDeferredIncomeTaxUnrealizedAppreciation
standard_label: Investment Company, Deferred Income Tax, Unrealized Appreciation
documentation: Amount of deferred income tax expense for unrealized appreciation of investment.

name: InvestmentCompanyDescriptionOfFinancialCommitmentToInvestee
standard_label: Investment Company, Description of Financial Commitment to Investee
documentation: Description of reason for and circumstance of financial support by investment company to investee.

name: InvestmentCompanyDisclosureItemsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Disclosure Items [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarnings
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed tax basis earnings (deficit).

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarningsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings [Abstract] (Deprecated 2023)

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarningsLossAccumulatedAppreciationDepreciation
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Appreciation (Depreciation)
documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) from unrealized appreciation (depreciation) of investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarningsLossAccumulatedCapitalLossCarryforward
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Capital Loss Carryforward
documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed deficit from capital loss carryforward of investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarningsLossAccumulatedLongTermCapitalGainLoss
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Long-Term Capital Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) from long-term capital gain (loss) of investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarningsLossAccumulatedOrdinaryIncomeLoss
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Ordinary Income (Loss)
documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) from ordinary income (loss) of investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributableEarningsLossAccumulatedTemporaryDifferenceOther
standard_label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Temporary Difference, Other
documentation: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) from temporary difference between amount reported in financial statement and tax basis of investment company, classified as other.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributionLongTermCapitalGain
standard_label: Investment Company, Distribution, Long-Term Capital Gain
documentation: Amount of dividend distribution by investment company from long-term capital gain.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributionOrdinaryIncome
standard_label: Investment Company, Distribution, Ordinary Income
documentation: Amount of dividend distribution by investment company from ordinary income.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributionPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Investment Company, Distribution [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for distribution to ownership interest holder. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend distribution and tax return of capital.

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributionToShareholdersAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Distribution to Shareholders [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyDistributionToShareholdersPerShare
standard_label: Investment Company, Distribution to Shareholders, Per Share
documentation: Per share or unit amount of distribution to shareholders. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

name: InvestmentCompanyDividendDistribution
standard_label: Investment Company, Dividend Distribution
documentation: Amount of dividend distribution from ordinary income and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

name: InvestmentCompanyDividendDistributionAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Dividend Distribution [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyEquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestriction
standard_label: Investment Company, Equity Security, Contractual Sale Restriction
documentation: Amount of investment in equity security by investment company for which discount for contractual sale restriction is applied.

name: InvestmentCompanyEquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestrictionAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Equity Security, Contractual Sale Restriction [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyEquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestrictionNatureOfRestrictionAndCircumstanceForLapse
standard_label: Investment Company, Equity Security, Contractual Sale Restriction, Nature of Restriction and Circumstance for Lapse
documentation: Description of nature of restriction and circumstance that could cause lapse in restriction for investment in equity security by investment company subject to contractual sale restriction for which discount is applied.

name: InvestmentCompanyEquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestrictionRemainingPeriod
standard_label: Investment Company, Equity Security, Contractual Sale Restriction, Remaining Period
documentation: Period remaining for contractual sale restriction on investment in equity security by investment company for which discount for contractual sale restriction is applied, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: InvestmentCompanyExcessExpenseReimbursable
standard_label: Investment Company, Reimbursable Excess Expense
documentation: Amount of carryover of excess expense potentially reimbursable to adviser but not recorded as liability by investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyExciseTaxExpense
standard_label: Investment Company, Excise Tax Expense
documentation: Amount of excise tax expense on excess of required distribution over distributed amount for regulated investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseAfterReductionOfFeeWaiverAndReimbursement
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense, after Reduction of Fee Waiver and Reimbursement
documentation: Amount, after reimbursement and fee waiver, of expense for generation of investment income classified as operating.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseAfterReductionOfFeeWaiverAndReimbursementAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense, after Reduction of Fee Waiver and Reimbursement [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseLimitationAgreement
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Limitation Agreement [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether expense limitation agreement exists.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseLimitationAgreementDescription
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Limitation Agreement, Description
documentation: Description of expense limitation agreement. Includes, but is not limited to, term of carryover expense and expense in excess of expense limitation.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseLimitationAgreementsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Limitation Agreements [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseOffsetArrangement
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Offset Arrangement
documentation: Amount of expense reduction under arrangement in which third party explicitly reduces its fee by specified amount for service provided in exchange for use of investment company's assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseRatioAfterIncentiveAllocation
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Ratio after Incentive Allocation
documentation: Percentage of expense, after incentive allocation, to average net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseRatioBeforeIncentiveAllocation
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Ratio before Incentive Allocation
documentation: Percentage, before incentive allocation, of expense to average net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseRatioExcludingIncentiveFee
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Ratio, after Fee Waiver and before Incentive Fee Deduction
documentation: Percentage, after deduction of fee waiver and before deduction of incentive fee, of expense to average net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseRatioIncludingIncentiveFee
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Ratio, after Fee Waiver and Incentive Fee Deduction
documentation: Percentage, after deduction of fee waiver and incentive fee, of expense to average net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseRatioIncludingVoluntaryFeeWaiver
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Ratio, after Voluntary Fee Waiver Deduction
documentation: Percentage, after deduction of voluntary fee waiver, of expense to average net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyExpenseRatioVoluntaryFeeWaiver
standard_label: Investment Company, Expense Ratio, Voluntary Fee Waiver
documentation: Percentage of voluntary fee waiver to average net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyFairValueDerivativesGreaterThanFivePercentOfNetAssets
standard_label: Investment Company, Fair Value Derivative, Greater than 5 Percent of Net Assets [true false] (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether fair value for derivative instrument of underlying constitutes more than 5 percent of net assets.

name: InvestmentCompanyFeePaidIndirectly
standard_label: Investment Company, Fee Paid Indirectly
documentation: Amount that would have been incurred for brokerage service had service been paid for directly in arm's-length transaction.

name: InvestmentCompanyFeeWaiverTerms
standard_label: Investment Company, Fee Waiver Terms
documentation: Description of term of contractual and voluntary fee waiver agreement.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialCommitmentToInvesteeFutureAmount
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Support to Investee Contractually Required, Not Provided, Amount
documentation: Amount of financial support committed by investment company to investee that is contractually required but not provided.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighlightsAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Abstract]

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighlightsLineItems
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighlightsRollForward
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighlightsTable
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about financial highlights. Includes, but is not limited to, per share information, income and expense ratios, total return, capital commitment and fee waiver.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighlightsTableTextBlock
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of financial highlights. Includes, but is not limited to, per share information, income and expense ratios, total return, capital commitment and fee waiver.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialHighlightsTextBlock
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Highlights [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure of financial highlights reported by investment company.

name: InvestmentCompanyFinancialRatiosAbstract
standard_label: Investment Company, Financial Ratios [Abstract]

documentation: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing investment income (expense).

name: InvestmentIncomeInterest

name: InvestmentIncomeInterestAndDividend
standard_label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
documentation: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

name: InvestmentIncomeInterestAndDividendAbstract
standard_label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend [Abstract]

name: InvestmentIncomeInvestmentExpense
standard_label: Investment Income, Investment Expense
documentation: Amount of expenses related to the generation of investment income.

name: InvestmentIncomeMember
standard_label: Investment Income [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing investment income.

name: InvestmentIncomeNet
standard_label: Investment Income, Net
documentation: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

name: InvestmentIncomeNetAbstract
standard_label: Investment Income, Net [Abstract]

name: InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationOfDiscountAndPremium
standard_label: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
documentation: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

name: InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationOfDiscountAndPremiumAbstract
standard_label: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium [Abstract]

name: InvestmentIncomeNonoperating
standard_label: Investment Income, Nonoperating
documentation: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

name: InvestmentIncomeNonoperatingAbstract
standard_label: Investment Income, Nonoperating [Abstract]

name: InvestmentIncomeOperatingAfterExpenseAndTax
standard_label: Investment Income, Operating, after Expense and Tax
documentation: Amount, after expense and tax, of investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

name: InvestmentIncomeOperatingAfterExpenseAndTaxAbstract
standard_label: Investment Income, Operating, after Expense and Tax [Abstract]

name: InvestmentIncomeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
