documentation: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

name: InvestmentIncomeTextBlock
standard_label: Investment Income [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of investment income, including, but not limited to, interest and dividend income and amortization of discount (premium) derived from debt and equity securities. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investments.

name: InvestmentIndustrySectorExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Industry Sector [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates industry sector of investment.

name: InvestmentInterestAndDividendRateAbstract
standard_label: Investment Interest and Dividend, Rate [Abstract]

name: InvestmentInterestRate
standard_label: Investment Interest Rate
documentation: Rate of interest on investment.

name: InvestmentInterestRateFloor
standard_label: Investment, Interest Rate, Floor
documentation: Minimum rate of interest on investment.

name: InvestmentInterestRatePaidInCash
standard_label: Investment, Interest Rate, Paid in Cash
documentation: Rate of interest paid in cash on investment.

name: InvestmentInterestRatePaidInKind
standard_label: Investment, Interest Rate, Paid in Kind
documentation: Rate of interest paid in kind on investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerAffiliationAxis
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Affiliation [Axis]
documentation: Information by affiliation of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerAffiliationDomain
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Affiliation [Domain]
documentation: Affiliation of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerAffiliationExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Affiliation [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates affiliation of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerGeographicRegionBasisExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Geographic Region, Basis [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates basis for determining geographic region or country of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerGeographicRegionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Geographic Region [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates geographic region or country of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerNameAxis
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Name [Axis]
documentation: Information by name of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerNameDomain
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Name [Domain]
documentation: Name of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of issuer of investment.

name: InvestmentIssuerNameOtherMember
standard_label: Investment, Issuer Name, Other [Member]
documentation: Issuer of investment, classified as other.

name: InvestmentMaturityDate
standard_label: Investment Maturity Date
documentation: Maturity date of investment, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: InvestmentNonIncomeProducing
standard_label: Investment, Nonincome Producing [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment is nonincome producing.

name: InvestmentOwnedAtCost
standard_label: Investment Owned, Cost
documentation: Cost of the investment.

name: InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue
standard_label: Investment Owned, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of investment in security owned.

name: InvestmentOwnedBalanceAbstract
standard_label: Investment Owned, Balance [Abstract]

name: InvestmentOwnedBalanceContracts
standard_label: Investment Owned, Balance, Contracts
documentation: Balance held at close of period in number of contracts.

name: InvestmentOwnedBalanceOtherMeasure
standard_label: Investment Owned, Balance, Other Measure
documentation: Quantity of the investment. Indicate the measure in the unit of measure. This is commonly used for investments other than securities. For example, if the investment is gold, the balance would be the number of ounces and the unit of measure would indicate "ounces".

name: InvestmentOwnedBalancePrincipalAmount
standard_label: Investment Owned, Balance, Principal Amount
documentation: Amount of principal of investment owned.

name: InvestmentOwnedBalanceShares
standard_label: Investment Owned, Balance, Shares
documentation: Number of shares of investment owned.

name: InvestmentOwnedForeignCurrencyContractReportingCurrencyAmountCurrentValue
standard_label: Investment Owned, Foreign Currency Contract, Current Value
documentation: Amount the entity is obligated or for which it has the option to buy or sell the foreign currency contract.

name: InvestmentOwnedFromCashCollateralReceivedFromInvestmentsOnLoanFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, from Cash Collateral Received from Investment on Loan [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment was purchased with cash collateral received from investment on loan.

name: InvestmentOwnedInvestmentAdditionalInformation
standard_label: Investment Owned, Investment Additional Information (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Further narrative for the holding of the investment. Also any additional footnotes related to the position.

name: InvestmentOwnedLoanedForShortSalesAtFairValue
standard_label: Investment Owned, Loaned for Short Sales, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The aggregate value of investments loaned for short sales. This is not required to be disclosed under Regulation S-X but is commonly reported by Funds.

name: InvestmentOwnedOnLoanFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, on Loan [Fixed List] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Indicates that some or all of the investment is loaned out (often for short sales). This flag has three options: "Investment on Loan", "Entire Investment on Loan" and "Partial Investment on Loan". The first option "Investment on Load" does not distinguish if all or part of the investment is on loan. The other options indicate if all of the holding or only a part of the holding is on loan.

name: InvestmentOwnedOpenPutOrCallOptionFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Open Put or Call Option [true false] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Indicates that the investment is held in connection with open put or call option contracts.

name: InvestmentOwnedOptionExists
standard_label: Investment Owned, Option Exists [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether contract for right to buy or sell asset at fixed price by fixed date exists for investment owned.

name: InvestmentOwnedOtherThanSecuritiesInvestmentNotReadilyMarketableFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Other than Security, Investment Not Readily Marketable [true false] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Used for investments other than securities. Indicates that the investment is not readily marketable. The term "investment not readily marketable" includes investments for which there is no independent publicly quoted market and investments which cannot be sold because of restrictions or conditions applicable to the investment or the company.

name: InvestmentOwnedOtherThanSecuritiesLoanedForShortSalesAtFairValue
standard_label: Investment Owned, Other than Securities, Loaned for Short Sales, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate value of non-security investments loaned for short sales. This is not required to be disclosed under Regulation S-X but is commonly reported by Funds.

name: InvestmentOwnedPaymentInKindFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Payment in Kind [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment was acquired as payment in kind.

name: InvestmentOwnedPercentOfNetAssets
standard_label: Investment Owned, Net Assets, Percentage
documentation: Percentage of investment owned to net assets.

name: InvestmentOwnedPledgedFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Pledged [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates that some or all of investment is pledged as collateral. Acceptable values are "Investment Pledged", "Entire Investment Pledged", and "Partial Investment Pledged". "Investment Pledged" does not distinguish if all or part of investment is pledged. Other options indicate if all of investment or only part of investment is pledged.

name: InvestmentOwnedRestrictedAcquisitionDate
standard_label: Investment Owned, Restricted, Acquisition Date (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Date of acquisition for owned restricted investments, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: InvestmentOwnedRestrictedCarryingValuePerUnitAtDateOfBalanceSheet
standard_label: Investment Owned, Restricted, Carrying Value Per Unit at Date of Balance Sheet (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The carrying value per unit of investment at date of related balance sheet.

name: InvestmentOwnedRestrictedCost
standard_label: Investment Owned, Restricted, Cost
documentation: The cost of the restricted investment.

name: InvestmentOwnedRestrictedInvestmentFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Restricted Investment [Fixed List] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Indicates if the investment is a restricted security. This flag has three options: "Restricted Investment", "Restricted Investment Exempt from Registration" and "Restricted Investment Not Exempt from Registration".

name: InvestmentOwnedRestrictedInvestmentsNoteAbstract
standard_label: Investment Owned, Restricted Investments Note [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: InvestmentOwnedSubjectToOptionBalanceOtherMeasure
standard_label: Investment Owned, Subject to Option, Balance, Other Measure (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The quantity of the investment that is subject to option.

name: InvestmentOwnedSubjectToOptionExerciseDates
standard_label: Investment Owned, Subject to Option, Exercise Dates (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The list of dates or date range within which the options may be exercised of the investment subject to option.

name: InvestmentOwnedSubjectToOptionFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Subject to Option [true false] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Indicates the investment is subject to option. When the investment is subject to option the subject to option concepts also would be included in the instance document.

name: InvestmentOwnedSubjectToOptionNatureOfContract
standard_label: Investment Owned, Subject to Option, Nature of Contract (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The nature of the option contract of the investment that is subject to option. The value is either "put" or "call".

name: InvestmentOwnedSubjectToOptionPrice
standard_label: Investment Owned, Subject to Option, Price (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The option price of the investment that is subject to option.

name: InvestmentOwnedUnderlyingFaceAmountAtMarketValue
standard_label: Investment Owned, Face Amount
documentation: Nominal or face amount on the investment owned.

name: InvestmentOwnedUnrealizedAppreciationDepreciationNetAbstract
standard_label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

name: InvestmentOwnedUnrecognizedUnrealizedAppreciation
standard_label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

name: InvestmentOwnedUnrecognizedUnrealizedAppreciationDepreciationNet
standard_label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: This element represents the net excess or deficiency of the fair value of an investment (security, contract) over or under its cost (face amount, notional amount), respectively, which excess value or deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

name: InvestmentOwnedUnrecognizedUnrealizedDepreciation
standard_label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Depreciation (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

name: InvestmentOwnedUnrestrictedCarryingValuePerUnitAtDateOfPurchasePriceAgreement
standard_label: Investment Owned, Unrestricted, Carrying Value Per Unit at Date of Purchase Price Agreement (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The carrying value per unit of investment of unrestricted investment of the same issue as the restricted investment during the preceding year at the date the purchase price was agreed.

name: InvestmentOwnedUnrestrictedCarryingValuePerUnitAtDateWhenEnforceableRightToAcquireWasObtained
standard_label: Investment Owned, Unrestricted, Carrying Value Per Unit at Date When Enforceable Right to Acquire was Obtained (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The carrying value per unit of investment of unrestricted investment of the same issue as the restricted investment during the preceding year at the date on which an enforceable right to acquire the investments was obtained.

name: InvestmentOwnedValuedByTrusteesFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Valued by Trustees Flag (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The investment is valued at fair value by procedures approved by the Trustees.

name: InvestmentOwnedValuedByTrusteesFlag1
standard_label: Investment Owned, Valued by Trustee [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment is valued at fair value by procedure approved by trustee.

name: InvestmentOwnedZeroBalanceMayReflectAmountRoundedToZeroFlag
standard_label: Investment Owned, Zero Balance may Reflect Amount Rounded to Zero Flag (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Indicates that a zero balance does not necessarily represent that the value of the investment is zero. It may represent that the value was rounded down to zero.

name: InvestmentOwnedZeroBalanceMayReflectAmountRoundedToZeroFlag1
standard_label: Investment Owned, Zero Balance May Reflect Amount Rounded to Zero [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether zero balance represents value rounded down to zero.

name: InvestmentPartialDividendDeclared
standard_label: Investment, Partial Dividend Declared [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment had only partial dividend declared.

name: InvestmentPartialInterestPaid
standard_label: Investment, Partial Interest Paid [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment had only partial interest paid.

name: InvestmentPerformanceMember
standard_label: Investment Performance [Member]
documentation: Result achieved from investment. Excludes non-performance related result from asset under management.

name: InvestmentPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Investment, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for investment in financial asset.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodAppliedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherTaxBenefitAmortizationStatementOfCashFlowsExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Amortization Expense, Statement of Cash Flows [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of cash flows that includes amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodAppliedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherTaxBenefitAmortizationStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Amortization Expense, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodAppliedNonIncomeTaxRelatedActivityAndOtherReturn
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Non-Income-Tax-Related Activity and Other Return
documentation: Amount of income (loss) from non-income-tax-related activity and other return on investment under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method, not recognized in income tax expense (benefit).

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodAppliedNonIncomeTaxRelatedActivityAndOtherReturnStatementOfCashFlowsExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Non-Income-Tax-Related Activity and Other Return, Statement of Cash Flows [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of cash flows that includes income (loss) from non-income-tax-related activity and other return on investment under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method, not recognized in income tax expense (benefit).

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodAppliedNonIncomeTaxRelatedActivityAndOtherReturnStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Non-Income-Tax-Related Activity and Other Return, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes income (loss) from non-income-tax-related activity and other return on investment under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method, not recognized in income tax expense (benefit).

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCredit
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit
documentation: Amount of income tax credit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitAfterAmortizationExpense
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, after Amortization Expense
documentation: Amount, after amortization expense, of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitAfterAmortizationExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, after Amortization Expense [Abstract]

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitAfterAmortizationStatementOfCashFlowsExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, after Amortization, Statement of Cash Flows [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of cash flows that includes income tax credit and other income tax benefit, after amortization expense, generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitAfterAmortizationStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, after Amortization, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes income tax credit and other income tax benefit, after amortization expense, generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitBeforeAmortizationExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, before Amortization Expense [Abstract]

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitBeforeAmortizationStatementOfCashFlowsExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, before Amortization, Statement of Cash Flows [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of cash flows that includes income tax credit and other income tax benefit, before amortization expense, generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitBeforeAmortizationStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, before Amortization, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes income tax credit and other income tax benefit, before amortization expense, generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedOtherIncomeTaxBenefit
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Other Income Tax Benefit
documentation: Amount of other income tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedTable
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedTextBlock
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure of investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodPolicyElection
standard_label: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether proportional amortization method is elected to account for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program through limited liability entity.

name: InvestmentProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

name: InvestmentRelatedLiabilities

name: InvestmentRelatedLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Investment-related Liabilities [Abstract]

name: InvestmentRelatedPartyExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Investment, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for investment.

name: InvestmentRestrictedPerUnit
standard_label: Investment, Restricted, per Unit
documentation: Per unit amount of restricted investment, including, but not limited to, share or other unit of ownership.

name: InvestmentRestrictionStatus

documentation: Indicates (true false) whether restriction exists on investment.

name: InvestmentSecondaryCategorizationAxis

documentation: Information by second categorization of investments, which may include, but is not limited to industry.

name: InvestmentSignificantUnobservableInput
standard_label: Investment, Significant Unobservable Input [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether investment value was determined using significant unobservable input.

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedAdditionalInformation

documentation: Further narrative for the short position of the investment. Also any additional footnotes related to the short position.

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedAtFairValue
standard_label: Security Sold Short, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of security sold but not yet purchased.

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedBalanceAbstract
standard_label: Security Sold Short, Balance [Abstract]

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedBalanceShares

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedSaleProceeds

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedUnrestrictedCarryingValuePerUnitAtDateOfPurchasePriceAgreement

documentation: The carrying value per unit of investment of unrestricted investment of the same issue as the restricted investment during the preceding year at the date the purchase price was agreed.

name: InvestmentSoldNotYetPurchasedUnrestrictedCarryingValuePerUnitAtDateWhenEnforceableRightToAcquireWasObtained
standard_label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Unrestricted, Carrying Value Per Unit at Date When Enforceable Right to Acquire was Obtained (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: The carrying value per unit of investment of unrestricted investment of the same issue as the restricted investment during the preceding year at the date on which an enforceable right to acquire the investments was obtained.

name: LeveragedLeasesBalanceSheetInvestmentInLeveragedLeases
standard_label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases

name: LeveragedLeasesBalanceSheetInvestmentInLeveragedLeasesNetAbstract
standard_label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net [Abstract]

name: LeveragedLeasesEffectOfChangeInTaxRate

name: LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedLeasesDisclosureInvestmentInLeveragedLeasesNet

name: LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedLeasesDisclosureNonrecourseDebtService
standard_label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Nonrecourse Debt Service

standard_label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net

name: LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedLeasesDisclosureRentalReceivablesNetAbstract
standard_label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net [Abstract]

name: LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedLeasesDisclosureResidualValueOfLeasedAssets

standard_label: Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

standard_label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Gross

name: LiabilitiesForGuaranteesOnLongDurationContractsGuaranteedBenefitLiabilityNet
standard_label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Net

documentation: Weighted-average duration of liability for future policy benefit, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitWeightedAverageInterestAccretionRate
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Weighted-Average Interest Accretion Rate
documentation: Original weighted-average discount rate at contract issue date used to measure liability for future policy benefit.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefits
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance
documentation: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsActivityAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits Activity [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndPolicyholderContractDepositsAssumptionsAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Policyholder Contract Deposits, Assumptions [Abstract]

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpense
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
documentation: The aggregate amount of policy reserves (provided for future obligations including unpaid claims and claims adjustment expenses) and policy benefits (liability for future policy benefits) as of the balance sheet date; grouped amount of all the liabilities associated with the company's insurance policies.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense [Abstract]

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpaidClaimsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for liabilities related to future policy benefits and unpaid claims and claim adjustments.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAssumptionsAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Assumptions [Abstract]

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsBenefitsPaid
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Benefits Paid (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Monetary decrease in the future benefit reserve resulting from amounts paid to policy and contract holders during the period for policy benefit claims.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsByProductSegmentPresentValueAssumptions
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits by Product Segment, Present Value Assumptions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Describes the basis of assumptions (such as mortality rates and withdrawals) used in determining the present value of future policy benefits to be paid on policies existing as of the balance sheet date.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsContractTerminations
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Contract Terminations (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of decrease in the future benefit reserve resulting from policy expiration or cancellation.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsContractTerminations1
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Contract Terminations
documentation: Amount of expense reversal for policy expiration or cancellation of long-duration insurance contracts.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsDescription
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Description (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: A description of the accrued obligation to policyholders pertaining to insured events pertaining to long-duration contracts, which can be viewed as either (a) the present value of future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and expenses less the present value of future net premiums payable under the insurance contracts or (b) the accumulated amount of net premiums already collected less the accumulated amount of benefits and expenses already paid to or on behalf of policyholders.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsDisabilityAndAccidentBenefits
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Disability and Accident Benefits (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under disability and accident insurance contracts.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsIndividualAndGroupAnnuitiesAndSupplementaryContracts
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Individual and Group Annuities and Supplementary Contracts (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under individual and group annuities and supplementary insurance contracts.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsInterestRate
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Interest Rate
documentation: Rate of interest used to calculate the liability for future policy benefits.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsInterestRateAssumption
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Interest Rate Assumption
documentation: Relevant interest rate assumptions that are an integral part of the methodology used in calculating the future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsLiabilitiesAssumed
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Increase in the period in the accrued obligations to policy and contract holders that relates to insured events, and can be viewed as either (a) the estimated present value of future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and expenses less the present value of future net premiums payable under the insurance contracts or (b) the accumulated amount of net premiums already collected less the accumulated amount of benefits and expenses already paid to or on behalf of policyholders.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsLife
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Life (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under long-term life insurance contracts.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsMethodologyAndAssumptions
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Methodology and Assumptions
documentation: Methodology and assumptions for accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events, and can be viewed as either (a) the present value of future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and expenses less the present value of future net premiums payable under the insurance contracts or (b) the accumulated amount of net premiums already collected less the accumulated amount of benefits and expenses already paid to or on behalf of policyholders.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsOtherContracts
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Other Contracts (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under other insurance contracts.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsOtherIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Other Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of other increase (decrease) in accrued obligations to policyholders pertaining to insured events for the period.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsPaymentForBenefits
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Benefit Payment
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder from benefit payment for expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsPeriodExpense
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Period Expense (Income)
documentation: Amount of expense (income) recognized due to changes in the accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events.

name: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued obligations to policy and contract holders for long-duration insurance contracts.

name: LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDepositsAssumptionsAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Assumptions [Abstract]

name: LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDepositsGeneralAssumptions
standard_label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, General Assumptions
documentation: General assumptions associated with the liability for estimated reserve for cumulative deposits plus credited interest and fund performance, less withdrawals, expenses and cost of insurance charges, as applicable.

name: LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDepositsInterestRate
standard_label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Interest Rate
documentation: Rate of interest credited to policyholder deposits.

name: LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDepositsInterestRateAssumptionDeferredAnnuity
standard_label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Interest Rate Assumption, Deferred Annuity (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Methodology and period applied to interest rate used for annuity policyholder deposits.

name: LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDepositsInterestRateDeferredAnnuityHighEnd
standard_label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Interest Rate, Deferred Annuity, High End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The maximum interest rate applied to annuity policyholder deposits during the stated period.

name: LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDepositsInterestRateDeferredAnnuityLowEnd
standard_label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Interest Rate, Deferred Annuity, Low End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The minimum interest rate applied to annuity policyholder deposits during the stated period.

name: LiabilityForTitleClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpense
standard_label: Liability for Title Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling asserted and unasserted claims estimated to have been incurred by the insureds on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to the existence of a lien, encumbrance, defect or other matter purportedly affecting the title to the interest as insured.

name: LiabilityForTitleClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Title Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: LiabilityForTitleClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredButNotReportedIBNR
standard_label: Liability for Title Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling unasserted claims estimated to have been incurred by the insureds on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to the existence of a lien, encumbrance, defect or other matter purportedly affecting the title to the interest as insured.

name: LiabilityForTitleClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseKnownClaims
standard_label: Liability for Title Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Known Claims (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to an assertion by the insureds of the existence of a lien, encumbrance, defect or other matter purportedly affecting the title to the interest as insured.

name: LiabilityForUncertainTaxPositionsCurrent
standard_label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Current
documentation: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as current.

name: LiabilityForUncertainTaxPositionsNoncurrent
standard_label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAdjustmentExpenseByExpenseTypeTextBlock
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims Adjustment Expense by Expense Type [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Tabular disclosure of an adjustment or group of similar adjustments to the opening balance of the estimated reserve for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAdditionalOrReturnPremium
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Additional or Return Premium [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether additional or return premium has been accrued from change in prior-year incurred claims and claim adjustment expense.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAdjustmentOfOpeningBalanceAmount
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustment of Opening Balance, Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of an adjustment to the opening balance of the estimated reserve for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAdjustmentOfOpeningBalanceAxis
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustment of Opening Balance [Axis] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Information by type of revision to opening claims or future policy benefits reserve balance.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAdjustmentOfOpeningBalanceLineItems
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustment of Opening Balance [Line Items] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAdjustmentOfOpeningBalanceTable
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustment of Opening Balance [Table] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Description and amounts of an adjustment or group of similar adjustments to the opening balance of the estimated reserve for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAdjustmentOfOpeningBalanceTypeDomain
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustment of Opening Balance, Type [Domain] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Description of an adjustment to the opening balance of the estimated reserve for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseBusinessAcquisitions
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Business Combination
documentation: Amount, after deduction of reinsurance recovery, of increase (decrease) in cost of settling unpaid claim acquired in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, claim incurred but not reported.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseClaimsPaid
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Total amount of payments made during the reporting period to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseClaimsPaidAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid [Abstract]

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseClaimsPaidCurrentYear
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of payments made in the reporting period to settle claims incurred in the current period and related claims settlement costs.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseClaimsPaidCurrentYear1
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year
documentation: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in the current period and related claims settlement costs.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseClaimsPaidPriorYears
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of payments made in the reporting period to settle claims incurred in prior periods and related claims settlement costs.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseClaimsPaidPriorYears1
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years
documentation: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in prior periods and related claims settlement costs.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseForeignCurrencyTranslationGainLoss
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of foreign currency gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the cost of settling unpaid claims after deduction of reinsurance recoveries. Includes, but is not limited to, claims which have been incurred but not reported.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseForeignExchange
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Foreign Exchange (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the cost of settling unpaid claims after deduction of reinsurance recoveries related to foreign currency exchange rate changes. Includes, but is not limited to, claims which have been incurred but not reported.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseGross
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Gross (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The estimated cost of settling claims under the terms of the underlying insurance policies and assumed and ceded insurance contracts as of the balance sheet date, including an estimate for claims which have been incurred but not reported and the actual and estimated costs of settling claims.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredButNotReportedIBNRClaimsAmount
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims, Amount
documentation: Estimated costs as of the balance sheet date of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for claims that have not yet been submitted to the insurance company for reimbursement.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredButNotReportedIBNRClaimsCommentary
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims, Commentary (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Comments regarding estimated costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for claims that have not yet been submitted to the insurance company for reimbursement, including the methodologies and assumptions supporting the estimates.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredClaims
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Total provision in the period for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredClaims1
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims
documentation: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredClaimsAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims [Abstract]

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredClaimsCurrentYear
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of provision in the period for claims incurred in the reporting period and related claims settlement costs.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseIncurredClaimsPriorYears
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseNet
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Net
documentation: Liability as of the balance sheet date for amounts representing estimated cost of settling unpaid claims under the terms of the underlying insurance policies, less estimated reinsurance recoveries on such claims. This includes an estimate for claims which have been incurred but not reported. Claim adjustment expenses represent the costs estimated to be incurred in the settlement of unpaid claims.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseNetAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseOpeningBalanceAdjustments
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustments
documentation: Sum of adjustments to the estimated reserve for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of increase (decrease) in the liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReportedAndIncurredButNotReportedIBNRClaims
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported and Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The accrued obligation as of the balance sheet date which represents the cost of settling insured claims and insured claims relating to insured events that have occurred but have not yet been reported to the insurer or reinsurer as of the date of the financial statements.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReportedAndIncurredButNotReportedIBNRClaimsAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported and Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReportedAndIncurredButNotReportedIBNRClaimsCommentary
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported and Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims, Commentary (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Comments regarding costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for the specified year for claims that have been and have not yet been submitted to the insurance company, including the methodologies and assumptions supporting the estimates.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReportedAndIncurredButNotReportedIBNRClaimsDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported and Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims Disclosure [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReportedClaimsAmount
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported Claims, Amount

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseReportedClaimsCommentary
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported Claims, Commentary (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Comments regarding costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for the specified year specifically for claims that have already been submitted to the insurance company for reimbursement, including the methodologies and assumptions supporting the estimates.

name: LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseScheduleDiscussion
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Schedule, Discussion (Deprecated 2024)

standard_label: Liability, Premium Deficiency Testing on Long-Duration Contract, Anticipated Investment Income [true false]

name: LiabilityPremiumDeficiencyTestingOnLongDurationContractAnticipatedInvestmentIncomeAmount
standard_label: Liability, Premium Deficiency Testing on Long-Duration Contract, Anticipated Investment Income, Amount
documentation: Amount of anticipated investment income considered when performing premium deficiency testing on long-duration insurance contract issued by insurance entity.

name: LiabilityPremiumDeficiencyTestingOnShortDurationContractAnticipatedInvestmentIncome
standard_label: Liability, Premium Deficiency Testing on Short-Duration Contract, Anticipated Investment Income [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether anticipated investment income was considered when performing premium deficiency testing on short-duration contract issued by insurance entity.

name: LiabilityReportingCurrencyDenominatedValue

name: LifeAndAnnuityInsuranceProductLineMember

documentation: This item represents the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the Entity as of the date of the statement of financial position. name: LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedChangeInValue
standard_label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
documentation: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

name: LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedRestrictions
standard_label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Restrictions
documentation: Description of contractual restrictions on the ability to surrender and thereby receive the cash-value of a corporate or bank owned life insurance policy.

name: LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedTextBlock
standard_label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for corporate (COLI) or bank (BOLI) owned life insurance including the amount of cash surrender value that could be received as of the date of the statement of financial position, any restrictions on the company's ability to obtain the value of the life insurance policy on surrender, or any other additional information desired to be disclosed.

name: LifeInsuranceInForceAssumed

documentation: Amount of life insurance issued and outstanding assumed from other entities. Includes, but not limited to, dividends and adjustments to face value.

name: LifeInsuranceInForceCeded

name: LifeInsuranceInForceGross

name: LifeInsuranceInForceNet
