name: LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Expiration Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Reflects when the credit facility terminates, which may be presented in a variety of ways (year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter).

name: LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate1
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Expiration Date
documentation: Date the credit facility terminates, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationPeriod
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Expiration Period
documentation: Period remaining before termination of line of credit facility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityFairValueBasisForMeasurement
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value, Basis for Measurement
documentation: Description of the method(s) used to measure fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility and any significant assumptions used in the fair value measurement.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityFairValueOfAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
documentation: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfCommitmentFeePayment
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Frequency of Commitment Fee Payment
documentation: Description of when the fee for available but unused credit capacity is required to be paid (for example, annually, quarterly, or monthly).

name: LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfPaymentAndPaymentTerms
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Frequency of Payment and Payment Terms
documentation: Description of the frequency of the required periodic payments of interest, principal, or both, and the amount, if set, or a description of a formula upon which payment is based.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfPayments
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Frequency of Payments
documentation: Description of the frequency of periodic payments, which may be presented in a variety of ways (for example, monthly, quarterly, annually).

name: LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseAccruedInterest
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Accrued Interest
documentation: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the credit facility for the period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseAdditionalBorrowings
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Additional Borrowings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Increase for additional borrowings on the credit facility during the period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodDescription
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease) for Period, Description (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the increases or decreases in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodNet
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseNetAbstract
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net [Abstract]

name: LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseOtherNet
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of the credit facility.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityInitiationDate
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Initiation Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Reflects when the credit facility first became available, which may be presented in a variety of ways (year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter).

name: LineOfCreditFacilityInitiationDate1
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Initiation Date
documentation: Date the credit facility first became available, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateAtPeriodEnd
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate at Period End
documentation: The effective interest rate at the end of the reporting period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDescription
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate Description
documentation: Description of interest rate for borrowing under credit facility. Includes, but is not limited to, terms and method for determining interest rate.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDuringPeriod
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate During Period
documentation: The effective interest rate during the reporting period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityLenderDomain
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Lender [Domain]
documentation: Identification of the lender, which may be a single entity (for example, a bank, pension fund, venture capital firm) or a group of entities that participate in the line of credit, including a letter of credit facility.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityLineItems
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumAmountOutstandingDuringPeriod
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
documentation: Maximum amount borrowed under the credit facility at any time during the period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
documentation: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumMonthendOutstandingAmount
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
documentation: Maximum month-end amount borrowed under the credit facility during the period.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPayment
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment
documentation: Amount of the required periodic payments of both interest and principal.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPaymentInterest
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Interest
documentation: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to interest.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPaymentPrincipal
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Principal
documentation: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to principal.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityPriority
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Priority
documentation: Description of the credit facility's priority for repayment in relation to other obligations of the entity in the event of liquidation.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityRationaleForClassificationAsLongTermDebt
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Rationale for Classification as Long-Term Debt (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Justification for treatment of borrowings under the line of credit as noncurrent.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityRemainingBorrowingCapacity
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Remaining Borrowing Capacity
documentation: Amount of borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

name: LineOfCreditFacilityRevolvingCreditConversionToTermLoanDescription
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Revolving Credit Conversion to Term Loan, Description
documentation: Describes when borrowings outstanding under a line of credit will convert to a term loan, and describes the repayment terms, collateral, and priority (seniority) of the term loan.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityRevolvingCreditConversionToTermLoanStatus
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Revolving Credit Conversion to Term Loan, Status (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of whether outstanding balances under the short-term credit facility will be or were transformed into a long-term borrowing arrangement, and indicates when that is expected to occur or when it did occur.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityRevolvingCreditDescription
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Revolving Credit, Description (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Description of the terms of an arrangement in which loan proceeds can continuously be obtained following repayments, but the total amount borrowed cannot exceed a specified maximum amount. Terms typically include interest rate, collateral required, guarantees required, repayment requirements, and restrictions on use of assets and activities of the entity.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityTable
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about short-term and long-term contractual arrangements with lender under which borrowing can occur up to maximum amount. Includes, but is not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit, and revolving credit arrangement.

name: LineOfCreditFacilityUnusedCapacityCommitmentFeePercentage
standard_label: Line of Credit Facility, Unused Capacity, Commitment Fee Percentage
documentation: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

name: LineOfCreditMember
standard_label: Line of Credit [Member]
documentation: A contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars.

name: LinesOfCreditCurrent
standard_label: Line of Credit, Current
documentation: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before

name: LinesOfCreditFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Lines of Credit, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time.

name: LinesOfCreditFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Lines of Credit, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: LinesOfCreditFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Lines of Credit, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: LiquidationAccruedExpensePaymentPeriod
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Cost, Expected to be Paid, Period
documentation: Period over which cost accrued in statement of net asset in liquidation is expected to be paid, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: LiquidationAccruedIncomeEarnedPeriod
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Income, Expected to be Earned, Period
documentation: Period over which income accrued in statement of net asset in liquidation is expected to be earned, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccounting
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether financial statement is prepared using liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAccruedCost
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Cost
documentation: Amount of accrued cost expected to be incurred through end of liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting. Excludes estimated accrued cost to dispose of asset and other item expected to be sold in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAccruedCostsToDisposeOfAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Estimated Accrued Cost, Disposal of Asset and Other Item Expected to be Sold
documentation: Amount of estimated accrued cost to dispose of asset and other item expected to be sold in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAccruedIncome
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Income
documentation: Amount of accrued income expected to be earned through end of liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAdoption
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Adoption, Description
documentation: Description of fact and circumstance surrounding adoption of liquidation basis of accounting and determination that liquidation is imminent.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingCostsAndIncomes
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Costs and Incomes (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of costs and incomes accrued in the statement of net assets in liquidation and the period over which those costs are expected to be paid or income earned.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingLiquidationPlan
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Liquidation Plan, Description
documentation: Description of plan for liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting. Includes, but is not limited to, manner by which asset and other item, expected to be sold in liquidation that had not been previously recognized as asset, are expected to be disposed of and manner by which liability is expected to be settled.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingMember
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting [Member] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Accounting basis used when liquidation is deemed imminent.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingMethodsAndAssumptions
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Methods and Assumptions
documentation: Description of the methods and assumptions used to measure assets and liabilities, including subsequent changes to those methods and assumptions.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for liquidation basis of accounting used in preparation of financial statement.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasurementGainLossOnAccruedCostsToDisposeOfAssetsAndLiabilities
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Estimated Accrued Cost, Disposal of Asset and Other Item Expected to be Sold, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of estimated accrued cost to dispose of asset and other item expected to be sold in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasurementGainLossOnAsset
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Asset, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of asset for change in carrying value under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasurementGainLossOnItemsPreviouslyNotRecognized
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Other Item Previously Not Recognized, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of other item not previously recognized but expected to either be sold or used to settle liability in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisOfAccountingTextBlock
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for the liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationBasisofAccountingItemsPreviouslyNotRecognized
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Other Item Previously Not Recognized
documentation: Amount of other item not previously recognized but expected to be either sold or used to settle liability in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

name: LiquidationDate
standard_label: Liquidation Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The date the entity is scheduled to be liquidated.

name: LiquidationDate1
standard_label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Liquidation Plan, Expected Completion Date
documentation: Date when liquidation is expected to be completed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: LiquidityArrangementsGuaranteesAndOtherCommitmentsByThirdParties
standard_label: Variable Interest Entity, Commitments by Third Parties, Liquidity and Other Arrangements
documentation: Describes the terms of arrangements (for example, liquidity arrangements, guarantees, or other commitments) by third parties that may affect the fair value or risk of the reporting entity's variable interest in the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

name: LiquidityDisclosureFutureObligationsNotExpectedToBeRepaidAmount
standard_label: Liquidity Disclosure, Future Obligations Not Expected to be Repaid, Amount (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Disclose the approximate amount, if determinable, of future, fixed annual obligations not expected to be repaid from operations.

name: LiquidityDisclosureFutureObligationsNotExpectedToBeRepaidParentCompanyInformation
standard_label: Liquidity Disclosure, Future Obligations Not Expected to be Repaid, Parent Company Information (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Disclose appropriate parent company information when parent is dependent upon remittances from subsidiaries to satisfy its obligations.

name: LiquidityDisclosureGoingConcernNote
standard_label: Going Concern Note (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: If there is a substantial doubt about an entity's ability to continue as a going concern for a reasonable period of time (generally a year from the balance sheet date), disclose: (a) pertinent conditions and events giving rise to the assessment of substantial doubt about the entity's ability to continue as a going concern for a reasonable period of time, (b) the possible effects of such conditions and events, (c) management's evaluation of the significance of those conditions and events and any

name: LiquidityDisclosureSufficientCashAndWaiversNote
standard_label: Liquidity Disclosure, Sufficient Cash and Waivers Note (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Disclose whether operations for the current or prior years generated sufficient cash to cover current obligations, whether waivers were obtained from creditors relating to the company's default under the provisions of debt agreements and possible effects of such conditions and events, such as: whether there is a possible need to obtain additional financing (debt or equity) or to liquidate certain holdings to offset future cash flow deficiencies.

name: LiquidityDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Liquidity Disclosure [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for reporting when there is a substantial doubt about an entity's ability to continue as a going concern for a reasonable period of time (generally a year from the balance sheet date). Disclose: (a) pertinent conditions and events giving rise to the assessment of substantial doubt about the entity's ability to continue as a going concern for a reasonable period of time, (b) the possible effects of such conditions and events, (c) management's evaluation of the sign

name: ListedOptionsMember
standard_label: Listed Options [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific or standard commodity, or financial or equity instrument, at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option), which are listed on a stock exchange.

name: LitigationCaseAxis
standard_label: Litigation Case [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of judicial proceeding, alternative dispute resolution or claim.

name: LitigationCaseTypeDomain
standard_label: Litigation Case [Domain]
documentation: Judicial proceeding, alternative dispute resolution or claim. For example, but not limited to, name of case, category of litigation, or other differentiating information.

name: LitigationReserve
standard_label: Estimated Litigation Liability
documentation: Aggregate carrying amount of the estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs.

name: LitigationReserveCurrent
standard_label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Current
documentation: Carrying amount of reserve for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid within one year of the date of the statement of financial position.

name: LitigationReserveNoncurrent
standard_label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount of estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: LitigationSettlementAbstract
standard_label: Litigation Settlement [Abstract]

name: LitigationSettlementAmount
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Amount (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount of judgment or settlement awarded to (against) the entity in respect of litigation.

name: LitigationSettlementAmountAwardedFromOtherParty
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded from Other Party
documentation: Amount awarded from other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

name: LitigationSettlementAmountAwardedToOtherParty
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded to Other Party
documentation: Amount awarded to other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

name: LitigationSettlementExpense
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Fee Expense
documentation: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

name: LitigationSettlementGain
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Gain
documentation: Amount of gain from litigation settlement for amount awarded from other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

name: LitigationSettlementGross
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the gross amount awarded, to be received by, or to be remitted to the entity in settlement of litigation occurring during the period.

name: LitigationSettlementInterest
standard_label: Litigation Settlement Interest
documentation: Interest expense (income) directly attributable to an award in settlement of litigation.

name: LitigationSettlementLoss
standard_label: Litigation Settlement, Loss
documentation: Amount of loss from litigation settlement for amount awarded to other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

name: LitigationStatusAxis
standard_label: Litigation Status [Axis]
documentation: Information by status of pending, threatened, or settled litigation.

name: LitigationStatusDomain
standard_label: Litigation Status [Domain]
documentation: Status of pending, threatened, or settled litigation.

name: LoanAndLeaseReceivablesImpairedAbstract
standard_label: Loan and Lease Receivables, Impaired [Abstract]

name: LoanCommitmentsPolicy
standard_label: Loan Commitments, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for loan commitments accounted for as derivatives, including the methods and assumptions used to estimate fair value and any associated hedging strategies.

name: LoanLendingCommitmentArrangementFeesMember
standard_label: Loan Lending Commitment Arrangement Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein fees are received in advance for a commitment to originate a loan or lease or purchase a loan or group of loans or leases.

name: LoanOriginationCommitmentsMember
standard_label: Loan Origination Commitments [Member]
documentation: Commitments to borrowers or third party investors for the origination of a loan.

name: LoanParticipationsAndAssignmentsMember
standard_label: Loan Participations and Assignments [Member]
documentation: Investments consisting of the rights in and risks associated with loans shared among a number of (unrelated) parties which may or may not include an assignment of the underlying instrument.

name: LoanPortfolioExpense
standard_label: Loan Portfolio Expense
documentation: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

name: LoanPortfolioExpenseMember
standard_label: Loan Portfolio Expense [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the entity.

name: LoanProcessingFee
standard_label: Loan Processing Fee
documentation: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

name: LoanProcessingFeeMember
standard_label: Loan Processing Fee [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

name: LoanPurchaseCommitmentsMember
standard_label: Loan Purchase Commitments [Member]
documentation: Commitment to purchase loans from a third party.

name: LoanRestructuringModificationAxis
standard_label: Loan Restructuring Modification [Axis]
documentation: Information by concessions made to the terms of loan contracts.

name: LoanRestructuringModificationDomain
standard_label: Loan Restructuring Modification [Domain]
documentation: Concessions made to the terms of loan contracts, including but not limited to, interest rate reductions, maturity extensions, principal forgiveness, and payment deferral.

name: LoanRestructuringModificationNameAxis
standard_label: Loan Restructuring Modification Name [Axis]
documentation: Information by name of loan modification, for example, but not limited to, modifications under government programs.

name: LoanRestructuringModificationNameDomain
standard_label: Loan Restructuring Modification Name [Domain]
documentation: Name of loan modification, for example, but not limited to, modifications under government programs.

name: LoanRestructuringTrialModificationsAmount
standard_label: Loan Restructuring, Trial Modifications, Amount
documentation: Amount of financing receivable modified on trial basis.

name: LoanToValueAxis
standard_label: Debt-to-Value [Axis]
documentation: Information by debt-to-value ratio, for example, but not limited to, 80 percent to 100 percent. Element name and standard label in Debt-to-Value [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] Percent [Member] or Debt-to-Value Greater Than [low end numeric value] Percent [Member] or Debt-to-Value Less Than [high end numeric value] Percent [Member] formats.

name: LoanToValueDomain
standard_label: Debt-to-Value [Domain]
documentation: Debt-to-value (DTV) ratio, for example, but not limited to, 80 percent to 100 percent. Element name and standard label in DTV [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] Percent [Member] or DTV Greater Than [low end numeric value] Percent [Member] or DTV Less Than [high end numeric value] Percent [Member] formats.

name: LoansAcquiredAccountedForAsDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleCategoryAbstract
standard_label: Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale Category [Abstract]

name: LoansAcquiredAccountedForAsDebtSecuritiesDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, Disclosure [Abstract]

name: LoansAcquiredAccountedForAsDebtSecuritiesGeneralItemsAbstract
standard_label: Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, General Items [Abstract]

name: LoansAcquiredAccountedForAsDebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityCategoryAbstract
standard_label: Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity Category [Abstract]

name: LoansAndFinanceReceivablesMember
standard_label: Loans and Finance Receivables [Member]
documentation: Contractual rights to receive money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates that is recognized as an asset in the creditor's statement of financial position.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowance
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance
documentation: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceCovered
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance, Covered
documentation: Amount of allowance for loan and lease losses covered by loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceForLoanLossesPolicy
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance for Loan Losses Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for estimating the allowance for losses on loans and lease receivables. The disclosure may include (a) how the entity determines each element of the allowance, (b) which loans are evaluated individually and which loans are evaluated as a group, (c) how the entity determines both the allocated and unallocated portions of the allowance, (d) how the entity determines the loss factors applied to graded loans in order to develop a general allowance, and (e) what self-c

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableBeforeFeesGross
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, before Fees, Gross
documentation: Amount, before allowance and fees, of loans and leases receivable. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableBeforeFeesGrossAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, before Fees, Gross [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCollateralForSecuredBorrowings
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Collateral for Secured Borrowings (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Reflects the aggregate value of loans, trade receivables, securities and financial instruments that serve as collateral for obligations arising from a transfer of financial assets recorded as a secured borrowing.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercial
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of commercial loans and leases receivable includes, but not limited to, commercial and industrial loans, agricultural loans, mortgage loans, promissory notes, interbank and other loans to financial institutions, draws against credit facilities, trade financing, lease financings. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agree

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialAllowance
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Allowance (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The allowance for commercial loan and lease losses represents the reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified commercial loans and leases, as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of the commercial loan portfolio as of the balance sheet date. For banks, include currently required allocated transfer risk reserves. Include carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for commercial loan losses in connection with business combinations determined to

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialDescription
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of the various types of loans made to an entity for example, but not limited to, seasonal working capital needs, real estate, inventory financing, equipment purchases and acquisitions. Such loans may be used for general purposes or are limited by the terms of the debt instrument for a specific purpose or purposes, and may be fully or partially secured or are unsecured.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialGovernments
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Governments (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans and leases issued to a unit or agency of a federal, state or local jurisdiction within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialLoansInProcess
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Loans in Process (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The undisbursed portion of the commercial loan receivable balance (loans in process) which is deducted separately from total loans.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialNetOfDeferredIncome
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the net carrying amount of commercial loans and leases held in portfolio, after deducting deferred income, but before deducting the allowance for losses on commercial loans and leases.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommercialNetOfDeferredIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Net of Deferred Income [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentFeePolicy
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commitment Fee Policy (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Describes the basis for recognizing income on monies received or to be received with respect to agreements which obligate the lender to provide future funding to existing or prospective borrowers pursuant to agreed-upon terms and conditions.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsFixedRates

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsToPurchaseOrSell

documentation: Amount of financing receivable commitment to purchase or sell.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsVariableRates

documentation: Amount of financing receivable commitment with variable rate of interest.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerConstruction
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Construction (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans issued to build, improve or remodel a residential home. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerDescription
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Consumer, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describes the various types of loans made to individuals for personal needs, including mortgage, home equity, credit card, installment, and lease financing. Such loans may be used for general purposes or are limited by the terms of the debt instrument for a specific purpose or purposes, and may be fully or partially secured or are unsecured.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerHomeEquity
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Home Equity (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of revolving, open-end loan, extended under a line of credit and secured by the borrower's residential property. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerInstallmentAndRevolving
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment and Revolving (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of installment and revolving loans issued to individuals, including, but not limited to credit card, automobile, boat, student, durable home appliance loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerInstallmentAndRevolvingAbstract

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerInstallmentDurableGoods

Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerInstallmentOther
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment, Other (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of other consumer installment loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerInstallmentStudent
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment, Student (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of higher education or qualifying vocational and professional schools loans. Includes federally subsidized and personal loans and deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerLeaseFinancing
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Lease Financing (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of consumer lease agreements. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerLoansInProcess

documentation: The undisbursed portion of the consumer loan receivable balance (loans in process) which is deducted separately from total loans.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerMortgage
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Mortgage (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of consumer mortgage. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes subordinated loans such as home equity lines of credit and loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerNetOfDeferredIncome
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Consumer, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the net carrying amount of consumer loans and leases held in portfolio, after deducting deferred income, but before deducting the allowance for losses on consumer loans and leases.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerNetOfDeferredIncomeAbstract

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerRealEstate
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Real Estate (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of consumer real estate loans. Includes, but not limited to, construction financing, residential mortgage loans, and home equity lines of credit. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerRealEstateAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Real Estate [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerRevolvingCreditCard
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Revolving, Credit Card (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of credit card loans issued to individuals. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableConsumerRevolvingOther
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Revolving, Other (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of other revolving credit arrangements, for example, but not limited to, personal lines of credit. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes home equity lines of credit and credit cards and loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncome
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income
documentation: Amount of deferred interest and fee income, unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncomeAbstract

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncomeCommercial
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of interest and fees paid by commercial loan borrowers which have not yet been taken into income in conformity with GAAP. Also reflects the amount of unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans which have been classified as commercial loans by the entity and that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncomeConsumer
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of interest and fees paid by consumer loan borrowers which have not yet been taken into income in conformity with GAAP. Also reflects the amount of unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans which have been classified as consumer loans by the entity and that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncomeForeign
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of interest and fees, paid by borrowers for loans categorized as foreign, which have not yet been taken into income in conformity with GAAP. Also reflects the amount of unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans which have been classified as foreign loans by the entity and that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncomeOther

documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of interest and fees paid by borrowers, for loans not otherwise defined in the taxonomy, which have not yet been taken into income in conformity with GAAP. name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDescription
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Description (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Describes the major category and subcategories of loans held, any unusual risk concentration relating thereto, and the related loans receivable carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date. Such descriptions may include information pertaining to: (i) type of borrower, (ii) purpose of the loan, (iii) loan maturity, (iv) credit and other risk associated with the loan, and (v) other terms of importance (secured or unsecured, variable or fixed interest).

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable Disclosure [Abstract]

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDisclosureLineItems
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable Disclosure [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableDisclosureTable
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable Disclosure [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about loans and leases receivable.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableFeesEarnedButExcludedFromYield
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Fees Earned but Excluded from Yield (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Reflects the amount of fees recognized as income related to loan originations, commitments or servicing which are not included in interest income and that exceed 1 percent of the aggregate of total interest income and other income.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeign
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans and leases to borrowers not within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignCommercial
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans to entities involved in commercial enterprises, not originated within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignCommercialAndConsumerOther
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Commercial and Consumer, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, not originated within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignCommercialAndConsumerRealEstate
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Commercial and Consumer Real Estate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of real estate loans not originated within the country of domicile. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignConsumerInstallmentAndRevolving
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Consumer Installment and Revolving (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of consumer loans issued to individual borrowers not within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes, but not limited to, installment loans for vehicles, major appliances, vacations, education, credit card and other revolving loans. Also includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignDescription
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Foreign, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the other countries in which the lender makes loans to businesses and individuals, including loans made by overseas branches of the lending institution. May describe certain risks that are not associated with domestic lending, such as foreign exchange and country or transfer risks.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignFinancialInstitutions
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Financial Institutions (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans to financial institutions not within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignGovernments
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Governments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans issued to unit, agency or jurisdiction not within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignLeaseFinancing
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Lease Financing (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount before allowance of lease agreements, not originated within the country of domicile of the reporting entity. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignLoansInProcess
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Foreign, Loans in Process (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The undisbursed portion of the foreign loan receivable balance (loans in process) which is deducted separately from total loans.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignNetOfDeferredIncome
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Foreign, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the net carrying amount of foreign loans and leases held in portfolio, after deducting deferred income, but before deducting the allowance for losses on foreign loans and leases.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableForeignNetOfDeferredIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Foreign, Net of Deferred Income [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGainLossOnSalesNet
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sales, Net (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Reflects the net positive or negative amount derived from subtracting from net proceeds of sale and the carrying amounts, net of allocated reserves, of financial assets transferred to third parties in transactions that qualify for sales treatment.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGeographicTerritoriesOfBusiness
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Geographic Territories of Business (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the countries, states or other geographical territories in which a significant amount of loans and leases are issued.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmount
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross
documentation: Amount before allowance of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount [Abstract]

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountByCategoryAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, by Category Alternative [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountCommercial
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the aggregate gross carrying amount of all commercial loans and leases held in portfolio, prior to deducting deferred income and the allowance for losses on commercial loans and leases.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountCommercialAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Commercial [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountConsumer
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the aggregate gross carrying amount of all consumer loans and leases held in portfolio, prior to deducting deferred income and the allowance for losses on consumer loans and leases.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountConsumerAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Consumer [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountForeign
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the aggregate gross carrying amount of all foreign loans and leases held in portfolio, prior to deducting deferred income and the allowance for losses on foreign loans and leases.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountForeignAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Foreign [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the aggregate gross carrying amount of all loans and leases held in portfolio, not otherwise categorized (such as commercial, consumer, or foreign), prior to deducting deferred income and the allowance for losses on loans and leases, not otherwise categorized (such as commercial, consumer, or foreign).

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmountOtherAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Other [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedCommitmentToLend
standard_label: Financing Receivable, Modified, Commitment to Lend
documentation: Amount of commitment to lend additional funds to debtor experiencing financial difficulty for which creditor has modified terms of financing receivable.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedDescription
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Description (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the policies and procedures for identifying and measuring losses on loans when the present value of expected cash flows discounted at the loan's effective interest rate, or, alternatively, a loan's observable market price or fair value of the underlying collateral is less than the carrying amount of the loan, and sets forth the amount of the loss. Also sets forth material facts pertaining to significant loan modifications in a troubled debt restructuring, describes the method for valui

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedInterestIncomeRecognizedChangeInPresentValueAttributableToPassageOfTime
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Income Recognized, Change in Present Value Attributable to Passage of Time
documentation: The amount of interest income on impaired and nonperforming loans that is due to the change in present value attributable to the passage of time.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedInterestLostOnNonaccrualLoans
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Lost on Nonaccrual Loans
documentation: Reflects the amount of additional interest income that would have been recorded if impaired or nonperforming loans were instead current, in compliance with their original terms, and outstanding throughout the reporting period or since origination (if held for part of the period).

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedNonperformingAccrualOfInterest
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Accrual of Interest
documentation: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which interest is continuing to be earned or accrued.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedNonperformingNonaccrualOfInterest
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Nonaccrual of Interest
documentation: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which no interest is continuing to be recognized.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedTroubledDebtInterestIncome
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Troubled Debt, Interest Income
documentation: The gross interest income that would have been recorded in the period on troubled debt restructurings, if the loans had been current in accordance with their original terms and had been outstanding throughout the period or since origination, if held for part of the period.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableLeaseFinancingPolicy
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Lease Financing, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recording, valuing, and reporting amounts due from lessees pursuant to contractual arrangements, which are secured, at a minimum, by the asset being rented, and in measuring certain revenues, expenses and gains and losses arising from creating, acquiring, collecting, terminating, modifying and holding lease agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableLoansInProcess
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process
documentation: Amount of undisbursed portion of the loan receivable balance (loans in process). Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableLoansInProcessAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableMortgageAndMortgageBackedSecuritiesValuationPolicy
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Mortgage and Mortgage-Backed Securities, Valuation, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the method used in determining the lower of cost or market value of committed and uncommitted loans secured by real property and mortgage pools, and whether the method is applied to an individual loan or security collateralized by a pool of mortgages or to an aggregate portfolio of loans or such securities.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableMortgageBankingActivitiesPolicy
standard_label: Mortgage Banking Activity [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the lending, securitization, sales, transfers and servicing practices for mortgage banking activities.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetOfDeferredIncome
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income
documentation: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetOfDeferredIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income [Abstract]

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmount
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
documentation: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountAbstract

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountByCategoryAlternativeAbstract

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountCommercial
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of commercial loans and leases receivable including, but not limited to, commercial and industrial loans, agricultural loans, mortgage loans, promissory notes, interbank and other loans to financial institutions, draws against credit facilities, trade financing, lease financings. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountCommercialAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Commercial [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountConsumerAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Consumer [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountCovered
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered
documentation: Net carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountCoveredAbstract

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountCoveredAndNotCovered

documentation: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountCoveredAndNotCoveredAbstract
standard_label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered and Not Covered [Abstract]

name: LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmountForeign

documentation: Description of long-term debt arrangements, which are debt arrangements that originally require full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company, if longer, and disclosures pertaining to the underlying arrangements, including repayment terms, conversion features, interest rates, restrictions on assets and activities, debt covenants, and other matters important to users of the financial statements. Types of long-term debt arrangements

name: LongTermDebtFairValue
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value
documentation: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

name: LongTermDebtFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value by Fair Value Hierarchy Level [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates level within fair value hierarchy of long-term debt.

name: LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsFourAndFive
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four and Five
documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth and fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsFourAndFiveAbstract
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four and Five [Abstract]

name: LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsTwoAndThree
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two and Three
documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second and third fiscal year following current fiscal year. name: LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsTwoAndThreeAbstract
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two and Three [Abstract]

name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentTerms
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Maturities, Repayment Terms
documentation: Disclosure of timing of required repayments, sinking fund requirements, and other redeemable securities at fixed or determinable prices and dates in the five years immediately following the date of the latest balance sheet presented in the financial statements, and the amount thereafter to fully repay the principal of long-term debt. These disclosures may be made either on an individual debt or security basis, by type of debt or security basis, or on a combined basis.

name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrincipalAfterYearFive

name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrincipalInNextRollingTwelveMonths

For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrincipalInNextTwelveMonths
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One

Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrincipalInRollingYearFourAndFiveAbstract

name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrincipalInRollingYearThree

For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

documentation: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. name: LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrincipalInYearFour

name: LongTermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInterestRate
standard_label: Long-Term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Percentage Rate
documentation: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

name: LongTermDebtRecourseStatusExtensibleEnumeration

name: LongTermInvestmentsAndReceivablesNetAbstract

name: LongTermLineOfCredit

name: LongTermLoansFromBank

The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

name: LongTermPurchaseCommitmentAmount

documentation: The minimum amount the entity agreed to spend under the long-term purchase commitment.

documentation: Describes the terms of a significant arrangement with a supplier (excluding an unconditional purchase obligation) to acquire goods or services over a period of time beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, which may include identification of the goods or services to be purchased, pricing, effects on pricing of failing to reach minimum quantities required to be purchased, cancellation rights, and termination provisions.

name: LongTermPurchaseCommitmentLineItems

name: LongTermPurchaseCommitmentMilestones

name: LongTermPurchaseCommitmentMinimumEnergyVolumeRequired
standard_label: Long-Term Purchase Commitment, Minimum Energy Volume Required
documentation: Energy volume that must be purchased within the specified time period of the agreement to avoid penalties or unfavorable effects on pricing, among other adverse consequences.

name: LongTermPurchaseCommitmentMinimumMassRequired

name: LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuranceRelatedAssessmentLiabilityPaymentPeriod

name: LossContingencyDisputeResolutionTypeExtensibleEnumeration

name: LossContingencyDomicileOfLitigation

name: LossContingencyEstimateAbstract

name: LossContingencyEstimateOfPossibleLoss
standard_label: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss

name: LossContingencyEstimatedRecoveryFromThirdParty

documentation: If estimable, describe the recovery that could be expected to result from a right to proceed against a third party such as an insurer or co-defendant.

name: LossContingencyExpectedTrialCommencement

documentation: If determined, state the month and year in which the contingent legal matter will be considered in a court of law or other jurisdiction.

name: LossContingencyIncomeStatementCaption

standard_label: Loss Contingency, Litigation, Jurisdiction [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates jurisdiction of court of law, arbitration, or mediation proceeding. Includes, but is not limited to, U.S. District Court and Court of Appeals.

name: LossContingencyLossInPeriod
standard_label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Loss (Reversal of Loss)
documentation: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

name: LossContingencyManagementsAssessmentAndProcess
standard_label: Loss Contingency, Management's Assessment and Process
documentation: Describes management's process to evaluate the contingency matter and to estimate the impact on the financial statements and ongoing operations, such as added credit risk or loss of customers, including pertinent information to adequately disclose the matter and significant assumptions underlying the estimates.

name: LossContingencyNameOfDefendant
standard_label: Loss Contingency, Name of Defendant

name: LossContingencyNameOfPlaintiff
standard_label: Loss Contingency, Name of Plaintiff

name: LossContingencyNatureDomain

name: LossContingencyNewClaimsFiledNumber

name: LossContingencyPendingClaimsNumber

name: LossContingencyRangeOfPossibleLossMaximum

name: LossContingencyRangeOfPossibleLossMinimum

name: LossContingencyReceivableNoncurrent

name: LossContingencyReceivableProceeds

name: LossContingencyRelatedReceivableCarryingValueNoncurrent
