documentation: Loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

name: LossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsFairValueHedge
standard_label: Loss from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
documentation: Amount of loss recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

name: LossHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsFairValueHedgeStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Loss, Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes loss recognized in earnings when hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as fair value hedge.

name: LossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Loss on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The loss recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

name: LossOnContractTermination
standard_label: Loss on Contract Termination
documentation: The loss recognized on termination of a contract.

name: LossOnContractTerminationForDefault
standard_label: Loss on Contract Termination for Default
documentation: The amount of the loss on termination of a contract for default.

name: LossOnContracts
standard_label: Loss on Contracts
documentation: Losses recognized in the current period on contracts which are expected to generate losses, which are probable and can be reasonably estimated, in a future period.

name: LossOnDerivativeInstrumentsPretax
standard_label: Loss on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
documentation: Aggregate loss on all derivative instruments charged against earnings during the period, before tax effects.

name: LossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueToForecastedTransactionProbableOfNotOccurring
standard_label: Loss on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
documentation: The amount of loss reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

name: LossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness
standard_label: Loss on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of recognized loss from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

name: LossOnLongTermPurchaseCommitmentMember
standard_label: Loss on Long-Term Purchase Commitment [Member]
documentation: Estimated loss from pricing or market conditions arising from an obligation under a purchase commitment (evidenced by an executory contract which involves both an item that might be recorded as an asset and an item that might be recorded as a liability) with terms longer than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: LossOnReacquiredDebtMember
standard_label: Loss on Reacquired Debt [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of loss incurred on reacquisition or refinancing of debt.

name: LossOnReceivablesAxis
standard_label: Loss on Receivables [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information about the loss on receivables.

name: LossOnReceivablesDomain
standard_label: Loss on Receivables [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Losses on receivables.

name: LossOnReceivablesMember
standard_label: Loss on Receivables [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Loss on receivables resulting from conditions (such as a customer's major casualty) arising after the balance sheet date.

name: LossOnSaleOfInvestments
standard_label: Loss on Sale of Investments
documentation: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

name: LossRatio
standard_label: Loss Ratio
documentation: Ratio of non-life losses and loss expenses to non-life net premiums earned.

name: LossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSeparateAccountGross
standard_label: Loss Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
documentation: Amount of loss recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

name: LossesGainsOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges
standard_label: Losses (Gains) on Sales of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The aggregate impact on earnings in the period of (a) the loss (gain) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired during the reporting period, and (b) the charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of all assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

name: Ltv80To100PercentMember
standard_label: Debt-to-Value Ratio, 80 to 100 Percent [Member]
documentation: Debt-to-value (DTV) ratio from 80 percent to 100 percent. Element name and standard label in DTV [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] Percent [Member] format.

name: LtvLessThan80PercentMember
standard_label: Debt-to-Value Ratio, Less than 80 Percent [Member]
documentation: Debt-to-value (DTV) ratio less than 80 percent. Element name and standard label in DTV Greater Than [low end numeric value] Percent [Member] or DTV Less Than [high end numeric value] Percent [Member] formats.

name: LuxembourgInlandRevenueMember
standard_label: Luxembourg Inland Revenue [Member]
documentation: Designated tax department of the government of Luxembourg.

name: MachineryAndEquipmentGross
standard_label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross
documentation: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

name: MachineryAndEquipmentMember
standard_label: Machinery and Equipment [Member]
documentation: Tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

name: MainlineMember
standard_label: Mainline [Member]
documentation: Significant, primary, generally longer routes of a carrier that it operates under its own brand, depart from or arrive to major cities or destinations, which are not defined by the entity as regional.

name: MaintenanceCostPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Maintenance Cost, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of the accounting policy for maintenance costs. Does not include planned major maintenance activities.

name: MaintenanceCosts
standard_label: Maintenance Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Costs incurred and are directly related to generating maintenance revenues. Also includes cost of maintenance on client contracts.

name: MaintenanceMember
standard_label: Maintenance [Member]
documentation: Process of preserving asset, including, but not limited to, building, machinery and software.

name: MaintenanceRevenue
standard_label: Maintenance Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue derived from maintenance services provided under contracts or arrangements with clients. For example, it may include the maintenance of software, plant and equipment, and facilities.

name: MajorCustomersAxis
standard_label: Customer [Axis]
documentation: Information by name or description of a single external customer or a group of external customers.

name: MajorCustomersPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Major Customers, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for major customers. Major customers are those that the loss of such customers would have a material adverse effect on the entity.

name: MajorPropertyClassAxis
standard_label: Major Property Class [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Amount of property owned but leased or available for lease to third parties, by major property class.

name: MajorPropertyClassDomain
standard_label: Major Property Class [Domain] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The major classes of assets leased or available for lease to third parties under operating lease agreements as of the balance sheet date.

name: MajorTypesOfDebtAndEquitySecuritiesAxis
standard_label: Major Types of Debt and Equity Securities [Axis] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Information by major type of debt and equity security.

name: MajorTypesOfDebtAndEquitySecuritiesDomain
standard_label: Major Types of Debt and Equity Securities [Domain] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Debt instrument issued by corporations, governments and governmental agencies, municipalities, and other institutions. Equity securities are ownership interests or the right to acquire or dispose of ownership interests in corporations and other legal entities for which ownership interest is represented by shares of common or preferred stock.

name: MajorTypesOfDebtSecuritiesDomain
standard_label: Major Types of Debt Securities [Domain] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Provides general categories of investments for which information is required or determined to be disclosed.

name: MajorTypesOfTradingSecuritiesAndAssetsDomain
standard_label: Major Types of Trading Securities and Assets [Domain] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Provides general categories of investments for which information about Trading Securities and Other Trading Assets is required or determined to be disclosed. Gains and losses on trading activities (including both derivative and nonderivative instruments) recognized in the statement of financial performance, separately by major types of items (such as fixed income/interest rates, foreign exchange, equity, commodity, and credit).

name: MajorityOwnedSubsidiaryUnconsolidatedMember
standard_label: Majority-Owned Subsidiary, Nonconsolidated [Member]
documentation: Nonconsolidated entity in which financial interest is held through direct or indirect ownership of more than 50 percent of voting interest but entity is not controlled or broker-dealer has control of entity but control is likely to be temporary.

name: MajorityShareholderMember
standard_label: Majority Shareholder [Member]
documentation: Owner that controls more than 50 percent of the voting interest in the entity through direct or indirect ownership.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance [Abstract]

name: MalpracticeInsuranceAnnualCoverageLimit
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Annual Coverage Limit
documentation: Annual coverage limit provided by the insurance arrangement for malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceCountryOfCaptiveInsurer
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Country of Captive Insurer (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Country of legal organization of the captive insurance company.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceCoverageFloor
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Coverage Floor
documentation: Amount at the low end of the range in which the insurance begins to cover losses and costs associated with malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceDeductible
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Deductible (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of risk retained by the entity before the insurance arrangement begins to provide coverage.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceDeductible1
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Deductible
documentation: Amount of risk retained by the entity before the insurance arrangement begins to provide coverage.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceDescription
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Description
documentation: Description of insurance coverage used by the entity to manage the financial risk of malpractice claims (including general and professional liability). Disclosure may include a discussion of the entity's risk management policies, a description of the insurance arrangements (including type, coverage, coverage limits, deductible), description of the insurer, and whether the entity is self insured or retains significant self-insurance risk.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceEntityRating
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Entity Rating (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of the unrelated, third-party entity's rating at the end of the accounting period and the rating agency.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceLineItems
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceMaximumCoveragePerIncident
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Maximum Coverage Per Incident
documentation: Maximum coverage per malpractice claim provided by the insurance arrangement.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceMethodOfAccountingForInvestmentInCaptiveInsurer
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Method of Accounting for Investment in Captive Insurer
documentation: Description of a health care entity's method of accounting in its investment in, and the operation of, a captive insurer.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceMultiproviderCaptiveInsurerRetrospectivelyRatedPremiumAccrualBasis
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Multiprovider Captive Insurer, Retrospectively Rated, Premium, Accrual Basis [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether premium under retrospectively rated malpractice insurance policy is accrued based on experience of multiprovider captive insurance entity.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceNameOfCaptiveInsurer
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Name of Captive Insurer (Deprecated 2021)
documentation: Name of the captive insurer.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceOccurrenceOrClaimsMade
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Occurrence or Claims-made [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates type of malpractice insurance arrangement. Acceptable values are "Occurrence" and "Claims-made".

name: MalpracticeInsuranceOwnershipInCaptiveInsurer
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Ownership in Captive Insurer [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates whether captive insurer is used to address malpractice loss exposure. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

name: MalpracticeInsurancePercentageOfOwnershipInCaptiveInsurer
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Percentage of Ownership in Captive Insurer
documentation: State the entity's ownership interest in the captive insurer.

name: MalpracticeInsurancePercentageOfPremiumsPaidToCaptiveInsurer
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Percentage of Premiums Paid to Captive Insurer
documentation: Amount of the premiums paid by the entity to a partially-owned captive insurer. Express as a percentage of total premiums received by the captive insurer from all sources.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceRetrospectivelyRated
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Multiprovider Captive Insurer, Retrospectively Rated [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates whether health care organization is insured under retrospectively rated malpractice insurance policy of multiprovider captive insurance entity. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

name: MalpracticeInsuranceSelfInsuredStatus
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Self Insured Status [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates whether self-insured for malpractice claim. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

name: MalpracticeInsuranceTailCoverage
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Tail Coverage (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: State whether tail insurance covers malpractice claims incurred before, but reported after, the cancellation or expiration of a claims-made insurance policy.

name: MalpracticeInsuranceThirdPartyCoverage
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Third-Party Coverage [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates whether insurance coverage for malpractice claim was obtained from unrelated third-party. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

name: MalpracticeInsuranceThirdPartyInsuranceCompany
standard_label: Malpractice Insurance, Third Party Insurance Company (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Name of the unrelated, third-party entity that is providing insurance coverage for malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual [Abstract]

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualAdjustment
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual Adjustment (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of adjustments made to the accrued liability for malpractice claims other than changes for period costs, premium costs, and settlements of claims during an accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscounted
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Discounted
documentation: Amount of the accrued liability on a discounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscountedAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Discounted [Abstract]

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscountedCurrent
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Discounted, Current
documentation: Amount of the current portion of the accrued liability on a discounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscountedNoncurrent
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Discounted, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of the noncurrent portion of the accrued liability on a discounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualNotRecognized
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual Not Recognized (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Description of a loss contingency for malpractice claims that is not recognized for financial reporting purposes because the accounting recognition criteria is not met but there is a reasonable possibility of loss or additional loss (for example, a loss is not probable, but reasonably possible, of occurrence). The disclosure includes the nature of the loss contingency and a range of loss or statement that an estimate cannot be made.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualNotRecognized1
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual Not Recognized (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Description of a loss contingency for malpractice claims that is not recognized for financial reporting purposes but there is a reasonable possibility of loss or additional loss.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualNotRecognizedEstimateOfPossibleLoss
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual Not Recognized, Estimate of Possible Loss (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of estimated possible loss for a loss contingency for malpractice claims that is reasonably possible to occur but does not meet the loss recognition criteria.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualNotRecognizedHighEndOfLossRange
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual Not Recognized, High End of Loss Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High end of the loss range for a loss contingency for malpractice claims that is reasonably possible to occur but does not meet the loss recognition criteria.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualNotRecognizedLowEndOfLossRange
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual Not Recognized, Low End of Loss Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low end of the loss range for a loss contingency for malpractice claims that is reasonably possible to occur but does not meet the loss recognition criteria.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndiscounted
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted
documentation: Amount of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability) at the end of the accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndiscountedAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted [Abstract]

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndiscountedCurrent
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted, Current
documentation: Amount of the current portion of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndiscountedNoncurrent
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of the noncurrent portion of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyBasisForDiscountRate
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Basis for Discount Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The basis for determining the interest rate used to discount future estimated cash flows associated with the payment of malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurredInPeriod
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred in Period
documentation: Amount of loss recognized for asserted and unasserted malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurredInPriorPeriods
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred in Prior Periods
documentation: Amount of increase in asserted and unasserted malpractice claims that were originally recognized in a prior period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurredNet
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred, Net
documentation: Amount of costs associated with malpractice claims and insurance premiums incurred during an accounting period, less insurance recoveries and returns of previously paid premiums.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurredNetAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred, Net [Abstract]

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyDescription
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Description
documentation: Description of malpractice loss contingency may include, but is not limited to, the nature of the contingency and an estimate of the possible loss or range of loss or the statement that such an estimate cannot be made.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for the accrual for malpractice loss contingencies (general and professional liability) which may include the policy used for accruing the loss contingency, the nature and amount of any accrual, and any significant estimate used to determine the accrual.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyDiscountRate
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Discount Rate
documentation: The interest rate used to discount the estimated cash flows associated with the payment of malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyInsuranceRecoveries
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Insurance Recoveries
documentation: Amount of insurance recoveries recognized from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims recognized during an accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyLettersOfCreditAndSuretyBonds
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Letters of Credit and Surety Bonds
documentation: Amount of letters of credit and other surety bonds that are available for the future payment of malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyNumberOfClaims
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Number of Claims
documentation: Number of malpractice claims outstanding at the end of the accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriodCost
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Period Cost
documentation: Amount of costs associated with malpractice claims, including costs associated with litigating and settling claims, incurred during an accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriodCostNetRecognizedInIncomeStatementAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Period Cost, Net, Recognized in Income Statement [Abstract]

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: The increase (decrease) in the accrued liability for malpractice claims during an accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyPolicy
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of the accounting policy for malpractice loss contingencies accrual (general and professional liability) which may include the method for calculating incurred but not reported (IBNR) claims, the use of actuarial and individual case-based assumptions, whether the accrual has been discounted, the types of costs included in the accrual (for example, legal costs) and other significant estimates used to determine the accrued liability.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyPremiumCosts
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Premium Costs
documentation: Amount of costs incurred that are associated with obtaining malpractice insurance and other risk transferring arrangements during an accounting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyRestrictedCash
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Restricted Cash (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of cash restricted for the use of the future payment of malpractice claims.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencyReturnOfPremiums
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Return of Premiums
documentation: Amount received during the period representing a return of premiums previously paid, generally under a retrospectively rated policy.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencySettlementOfClaims
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Settlement of Claims (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amounts paid during an accounting period for malpractice claims, including costs associated with litigation or claims settlements.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencySubsequentEvent
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Subsequent Event (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of a loss contingency for malpractice claims that occur after the accounting reporting period. Includes the nature of the loss contingency and may provide a range of loss or may state that an estimate cannot be made.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencySubsequentEventAbstract
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Subsequent Event [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: MalpracticeLossContingencySubsequentEventBestEstimate
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Subsequent Event, Best Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Best estimate of the loss for a loss contingency for malpractice claims that occur after the accounting reporting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencySubsequentEventHighEndOfLossRange
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Subsequent Event, High End of Loss Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High end of the loss range for a loss contingency for malpractice claims that occur after the accounting reporting period.

name: MalpracticeLossContingencySubsequentEventLowEndOfLossRange
standard_label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Subsequent Event, Low End of Loss Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low end of the loss range for a loss contingency for malpractice claims that occur after the accounting reporting period.

name: ManagementAndIncentiveFeesExpense
standard_label: Management and Incentive Fees Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for management and incentive fees for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: ManagementAndIncentiveFeesExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Management and Incentive Fees Expense [Abstract]

name: ManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayable
standard_label: Management and Incentive Fees Payable
documentation: Amount of management and incentive fees payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

name: ManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayableAbstract
standard_label: Management and Incentive Fees Payable [Abstract]

name: ManagementAndInvestmentAdvisoryFeesPolicy
standard_label: Management and Investment Advisory Fees, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the recognition of fees for investment advise, research, administrative and investment account management services provided to customers by broker dealers. This fee is generally based on the net assets of the fund or the account.

name: ManagementAndServiceFeesBaseRate
standard_label: Management and Service Fees, Base Rate
documentation: Base rate for management and service fees under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

name: ManagementAndServiceFeesIncentiveRate
standard_label: Management and Service Fees, Incentive Rate
documentation: Rate based on performance for management and service fees under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

name: ManagementAndServiceFeesRate
standard_label: Management and Service Fees, Rate
documentation: Rate for management and service fees under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

name: ManagementAndServiceFeesRateAbstract
standard_label: Management and Service Fees, Rate [Abstract]

name: ManagementFeeAmountPaid
standard_label: Management Fee, Amount Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount paid to managing member or general partner for management of the day-to-day business functions of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

name: ManagementFeeDescription
standard_label: Management Fee, Description
documentation: Description of the nature of payments to managing member or general partner for management of the day-to-day business functions of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP), including the fee rate, basis of calculation, relevant accounting period, whether the fee is paid to an entity other than the managing member or general partner, or whether the fee is waived.

name: ManagementFeeExpense
standard_label: Management Fee Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

name: ManagementFeePayable
standard_label: Management Fee Payable
documentation: Amount of fee payable for management of fund or trust.

name: ManagementFeesBaseRevenue
standard_label: Management Fees, Base Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Base revenue, as contractually stipulated, for operating and managing another entity's business during the reporting period.

name: ManagementFeesIncentiveRevenue
standard_label: Management Fees, Incentive Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue for operating and managing another entity's business during the reporting period which is based on meeting certain operating or revenue metrics (for example: occupancy or vacancy rates, profitability or expense targets), or otherwise meant to incentivize the operator other than by guaranteed or minimum compensation.

name: ManagementFeesRevenue
standard_label: Management Fees Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue, comprised of base and incentive revenue derived from the management of joint ventures, managing third-party properties, or another entity's operations.

name: ManagementFeesRevenueAbstract
standard_label: Management Fees Revenue [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: ManagementMember
standard_label: Management [Member]
documentation: Person or persons controlling and directing the affairs of an entity.

name: ManagementOfRisksInherentInServicingAssetsAndServicingLiabilitiesTextBlock
standard_label: Management of Risks Inherent in Servicing Assets and Servicing Liabilities [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the risks inherent in servicing assets and servicing liabilities and, if applicable, the instruments used to mitigate the income statement effect of changes in fair value of the servicing assets and servicing liabilities.

name: ManagementServiceBaseMember
standard_label: Management Service, Base [Member]
documentation: Contractually stipulated right to receive base compensation for operating and managing business.

name: ManagementServiceIncentiveMember
standard_label: Management Service, Incentive [Member]
documentation: Contractually stipulated right to receive incentive compensation for operating and managing business.

name: ManagementServiceMember
standard_label: Management Service [Member]
documentation: Contractually stipulated right to receive compensation for operating and managing business.

name: ManagementsAssertionOfAdequacyOfInsuranceReserves
standard_label: Management's Assertion of Adequacy of Insurance Reserves (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Management's statement asserting its belief that the liability for claims losses and claims adjustment expense is presented fairly.

name: ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerRelatedPartyFeesAndOtherArrangements
standard_label: Managing Member or General Partner, Related Party Fees and Other Arrangements (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of related party fees and other related party arrangements and relationships between the LLC or LP and its managing member or general partner.

name: ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerSubsequentDistributionAmount
standard_label: Managing Member or General Partner, Subsequent Distribution Amount (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Amount of cash or stock or unit payment to a limited liability corporation managing member or limited partnership general partner after the end of the accounting period.

name: ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerSubsequentDistributionDate
standard_label: Managing Member or General Partner, Subsequent Distribution Date (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Date of payment to a limited liability company (LLC) managing member or limited partnership (LP) general partner, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: ManagingOfRisksInherentInServicingAssetsAndServicingLiabilitiesTable
standard_label: Servicing Asset and Servicing Liability, Risk Mitigation [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about risk inherent in servicing asset and servicing liability and instrument used to mitigate income statement effect of change in fair value of servicing asset and servicing liability.

name: ManagingRisksInherentInServicingAssetsAndServicingLiabilitiesByTypeOfRiskAxis
standard_label: Servicing Assets and Servicing Liabilities Risk [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of risks inherent in servicing assets and servicing liabilities.

name: MandatorilyRedeemableCapitalStockTableTextBlock
standard_label: Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

name: MandatorilyRedeemablePreferredStockFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred Stock, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of shares that an entity is required to redeem for cash or other assets at a fixed or determinable date or upon the occurrence of an event.

name: MandatorilyRedeemablePreferredStockFairValueDisclosureMethodology

documentation: Methane gas extracted from the ground and sold by oil industry companies.

name: NaturalGasProcessingPlantMember
standard_label: Natural Gas Processing Plant [Member]
documentation: Plant used in connection with natural gas operations.

name: NaturalGasProductionMember
standard_label: Natural Gas, Production [Member]
documentation: Process of obtaining and processing of flammable gas occurring naturally underground.

name: NaturalGasProductionRevenue
standard_label: Natural Gas Production Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from natural gas production during the reporting period. Natural gas consists largely of the hydrocarbon methane, and is found in underground formations either by itself or with crude oil.

name: NaturalGasReservesMember
standard_label: Natural Gas [Member]
documentation: Natural gas composed primarily of methane gas, excluding liquid or condensate natural gas.

name: NaturalGasStorageMember
standard_label: Natural Gas, Storage [Member]
documentation: Process of maintaining flammable gas occurring naturally underground in facility for future use.

name: NaturalGasStorageRevenue
standard_label: Natural Gas Storage Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from storage facilities, such as a LNG ( Liquefied Natural Gas) storage facility.

name: NaturalGasTransitionCostMember
standard_label: Natural Gas Transition Cost [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of natural gas transition costs.

name: NaturalGasUsRegulatedMember
standard_label: Natural Gas, US Regulated [Member]
documentation: Generation, transmission and distribution of flammable gas occurring naturally underground regulated by government or agency in United States.

name: NatureOfCommonOwnershipOrManagementControlRelationships
standard_label: Nature of Common Ownership or Management Control Relationships
documentation: This element represents a description of the nature of common ownership or management control relationships with other entities, regardless of there being transactions between the entities, when the existence of that control could result in operating results or financial position of the reporting entity significantly different from that which would have been obtained if the entities' were autonomous.

name: NatureOfDeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts
standard_label: Nature of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Describes the nature of costs related directly to the successful acquisition of new and renewal insurance contracts.

name: NatureOfErrorDomain
standard_label: Nature of Error [Domain] (Deprecated 2021)
documentation: Describes the nature of the error being corrected including when and how the error arose and the fact that the error had previously been considered immaterial.

name: NatureOfExpenseAxis
standard_label: Nature of Expense [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of cost or expense.

name: NatureOfOperations
standard_label: Nature of Operations [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for the nature of an entity's business, major products or services, principal markets including location, and the relative importance of its operations in each business and the basis for the determination, including but not limited to, assets, revenues, or earnings. For an entity that has not commenced principal operations, disclosures about the risks and uncertainties related to the activities in which the entity is currently engaged and an understanding of what those acti

name: NatureOfPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfits
standard_label: Nature of Present Value of Future Insurance Profits (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: In connection with the purchase of a life insurance company, describes the nature and amount of the present value of future profits (PVFP) of estimated net cash flows embedded in the existing long-duration contracts of the acquired entity. It is also known as Value of Business Acquired, or VOBA.

name: NaturePurposeAndEffectOfReinsuranceTransactions
standard_label: Nature, Purpose and Effect of Reinsurance Transactions (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the coverages that are ceded, explanation that the purpose of reinsurance is primarily to mitigate risk of loss under the policies ceded, and to explain in text the effects of reinsurance on the entity's financial statements and operations.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGeneralAccountValue
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, General Account Value
documentation: Value of the general accounts corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGuaranteeTypeAxis
standard_label: Guarantee Type [Axis] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Information by types of guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGuaranteedMinimumReturnRate
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Guaranteed Minimum Return Rate
documentation: Rate of guaranteed minimum return on deposits made to contracts reported in separate accounts maintained by an insurance entity.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeLineItems
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeNetAmountAtRisk
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Net Amount at Risk
documentation: Net amount at risk, representing the guaranteed benefit in excess of the current account balance corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeNetAmountAtRiskAtAnnuitization
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Net Amount at Risk at Annuitization (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Net amount at risk, representing the guaranteed benefit in excess of the current account balance corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeNetAmountAtRiskInEventOfDeath
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Net Amount at Risk in Event of Death (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The portion of the specified guaranteed benefit amount in excess of the sum of the current account balance amounts assuming death of the insureds, corresponding to the specified guarantee or subset of the guarantee.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeRangeOfGuaranteedMinimumReturnRates
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Range of Guaranteed Minimum Return Rates (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describes the range of guaranteed minimum return rates, in percentages.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeSeparateAccountValue
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Separate Account Value
documentation: Value of the separate accounts corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeSeparateAccountValueAtAnnuitization
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Separate Account Value at Annuitization (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Estimated value of the separate accounts as of the date benefit payments are to commence.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeSeparateAccountValueInEventOfDeath
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Separate Account Value in Event of Death (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Value of the separate accounts assuming death of the insured, corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeSubcategory
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Subcategory (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Identifies any subset of the specified guarantee (for example, return of net deposits, return of net deposits accrued at a stated rate, return of highest anniversary value) with additional benefit liabilities in excess of account balances, as appropriate.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeTable
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk, by Product and Guarantee [Table]
documentation: For contracts with guaranteed benefits in excess of the current account balance, sets forth the amounts of such excesses (the net amounts at risk) and other pertinent information by type of guarantee by type of insurance product), as of the most recent balance sheet date.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeWeightedAverageAttainedAge
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Weighted Average Attained Age (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Weighted average attained age of all policyholders or contract holders in the specified guarantee type and subset of guarantee class.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeWeightedAverageAttainedAge1
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Weighted Average Attained Age
documentation: Weighted average attained age of policyholders or contract holders in the specified guarantee type and subset of guarantee class, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeWeightedAveragePeriodRemaining
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Weighted Average Period Remaining (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Weighted average amount of time in years until annuitization or benefit payment is expected to occur.

name: NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeWeightedAveragePeriodRemaining1
standard_label: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Weighted Average Period Remaining
documentation: Weighted average period until annuitization or benefit payment is expected to occur, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: NetAssetValuePerShare
standard_label: Net Asset Value Per Share
documentation: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

name: NetAssetsAdjustedBalance
standard_label: Net Assets, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount of assets after deduction of liabilities and cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

name: NetAssetsAdjustedBalanceAbstract
standard_label: Net Assets, Adjusted Balance [Abstract] (Deprecated 2020)

name: NetAssetsGeographicAreaMember
standard_label: Net Assets, Geographic Area [Member]
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the total assets less the total liabilities of a designated geographic area ( such as a state, country, continent, or market) when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

name: NetAssetsSegmentMember
standard_label: Net Assets, Segment [Member]
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the total assets less the total liabilities of a business segment when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

name: NetCapital
standard_label: Net Capital
documentation: Net capital is equal to the net worth of the broker dealer, less certain items such as exchange memberships, carrying value of securities not readily marketable, haircuts on marketable securities in proprietary accounts, furniture and equipment and other illiquid assets as defined.

name: NetCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Net Capital [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: NetCapitalAsReportedInEntitysPartIIUnauditedFOCUSReport
standard_label: Net Capital as Reported in Entity's Part II Unaudited FOCUS Report (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Net capital as reported in Company's Part II of Form X-17A-5.

name: NetCapitalBeforeHaircutsOnSecuritiesPositions
standard_label: Net Capital before Haircuts on Securities Positions (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Capital and allowable subordinated borrowings less deductions and charges.

name: NetCapitalBeforeHaircutsOnSecuritiesPositionsAbstract
standard_label: Net Capital before Haircuts on Securities Positions [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: NetCapitalExcessShortageUnderCommodityExchangeAct
standard_label: Net Capital Excess (Shortage) under Commodity Exchange Act
documentation: The amount by which actual net capital exceeds (does not exceed) required net capital under the Commodity Exchange Act for futures commission merchants.

name: NetCapitalExcessShortageUnderCommodityExchangeActAbstract
standard_label: Net Capital Excess (Shortage) under Commodity Exchange Act [Abstract]

name: NetCapitalInExcessOfFivePercentOfDebitItems
standard_label: Net Capital in Excess of Five Percent of Debit Items
documentation: Net capital less five percent of aggregate debit items.

name: NetCapitalInExcessOfFourPercentOfDebitItems
standard_label: Net Capital in Excess of Four Percent of Debit Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Net capital less four percent of aggregate debit items.

name: NetCapitalReconciliationWithEntitysComputationAbstract
standard_label: Net Capital, Reconciliation with Entity's Computation [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: NetCapitalUnderCommodityExchangeActComputation
standard_label: Net Capital under Commodity Exchange Act Computation
documentation: The amount of net capital calculated under the Commodity Futures Trading Commission's minimum financial requirements, pursuant to the Commodity Exchange Act, less the market value of certain commodity options.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInContinuingOperations
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Continuing Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to continuing operation.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Continuing Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOperations
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOperationsAndContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Continuing and Discontinued Operations [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivities
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivitiesContinuingOperations
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Continuing Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to continuing operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivitiesContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Continuing Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivities
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivitiesContinuingOperations
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Continuing Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivitiesContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Continuing Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

name: NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation [Abstract]

name: NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertificates
standard_label: Net Change Annuities and Investment Certificates
documentation: The cash inflow or outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

name: NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertificatesAbstract
standard_label: Net Change Annuities and Investment Certificates [Abstract]

name: NetChangeContractHoldersFunds
standard_label: Net Change Contract Holders Funds
documentation: The cash inflow or outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

name: NetChangeContractHoldersFundsAbstract
standard_label: Net Change Contract Holders Funds [Abstract]

name: NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDepositsDomestic
standard_label: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic
documentation: The increase (decrease) in domestic interest and noninterest bearing deposits.

name: NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDepositsDomesticAbstract
standard_label: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic [Abstract]

name: NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDepositsForeign
standard_label: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Foreign
documentation: The increase (decrease) in foreign interest and noninterest bearing deposits.

name: NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDepositsForeignAbstract
standard_label: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Foreign [Abstract]

name: NetChangeInterestBearingDepositsDomestic
standard_label: Net Change Interest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic
documentation: The increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits domestic.

name: NetChangeInterestBearingDepositsForeign
standard_label: Net Change Interest-Bearing Deposits, Foreign
documentation: The increase (decrease) in interest bearing deposits foreign.

name: NetChangeNoninterestBearingDepositsDomestic
standard_label: Net Change Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic
documentation: The increase (decrease) in domestic noninterest bearing deposits.

name: NetChangeNoninterestBearingDepositsForeign
standard_label: Net Change Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Foreign
documentation: The increase (decrease) in foreign noninterest bearing deposits.

name: NetCreditLossOnLoansManagedOrSecuritizedOrAssetbackedFinancingArrangement
standard_label: Net Credit Loss on Loans Managed or Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement
documentation: Amount of credit loss after recoveries for transferred financial assets that continue to be recognized in the statement of financial position.

name: NetCreditLossesDuringPeriodOnLoansManagedOrSecuritized
standard_label: Net Credit Losses During Period on Loans Managed or Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This is the sum of charge-offs (credit losses) on loans managed or securitized during the period.

name: NetIncomeLoss
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
documentation: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

name: NetIncomeLossAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAllocatedToGeneralPartners
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to General Partners
documentation: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to general partners.

name: NetIncomeLossAllocatedToLimitedPartners
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to Limited Partners
documentation: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to limited partners.

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemableNoncontrollingInterestAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToParentDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Diluted
documentation: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent, and includes adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive convertible securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToParentDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Diluted [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToParentNetOfFederalHomeLoanBankAssessments
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Net of Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
documentation: Amount of profit (loss) after Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments attributable to the parent.

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedeemableNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedeemableNoncontrollingInterestAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAttributableToReportingEntityAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasic
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

name: NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersBasicAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

name: NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersOperationsBasicAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic, Operations [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholdersOperationsDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted, Operations [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersBasic
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

name: NetIncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

name: NetIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersBasic
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

name: NetIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
documentation: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

name: NetIncomeLossFromRealEstateInvestmentPartnership
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership
documentation: Amount of net income (loss) recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

name: NetIncomeLossFromRealEstateInvestmentPartnershipAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of income (loss) from consolidated real estate investments attributed to noncontrolling interest.

name: NetIncomeLossFromRealEstateInvestmentPartnershipAttributableToParent
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount of income (loss) from consolidated real estate investments attributed to parent.

name: NetIncomeLossFromRealEstateInvestmentPartnershipAttributableToParentAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributableToNonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

name: NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributableToNonredeemableNoncontrollingInterestAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding general partnership unit.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingGeneralPartnershipUnitNetOfTax
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasic
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
documentation: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasicAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasicAndDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each limited partnership and general partnership unit in instances when basic and diluted earnings per unit are the same amount and aggregated on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per unit is the amount of net income or loss for the period per unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per unit includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each limited and general partnership unit o

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasicAndDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipAndGeneralPartnershipUnitBasicOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding limited partnership unit.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitBasicNetOfTax
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
documentation: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to outstanding limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDiluted
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Net Income or Loss allocated to each limited partner unit outstanding during the reporting period and each unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for all dilutive potential units outstanding during the reporting period. Limited partners have limited liability and do not manage the partnership.

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitDilutedOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted, Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartnershipUnitOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: NetIncomeMember
standard_label: Net Income [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The profit or loss of the entity net of income taxes for the reporting period.

name: NetIncreaseDecreaseInAdvancePaymentsByBorrowersForTaxesAndInsurance
standard_label: Net Increase (Decrease) in Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The net increase/(decrease) in accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate tax authority or insurer (or insurance agency) on behalf of the borrower.

name: NetIncreaseDecreaseInSalesAndTransferPricesAndProductionCosts
standard_label: Net Increase (Decrease) in Sales and Transfer Prices and Production Costs
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in standardized measure of discounted future net cash flow as a result of change in sales and transfer prices and in production (lifting) costs related to future production.
