name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossLimitedPartnershipsRedeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Redeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOperatingPartnershipsNonredeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Nonredeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOperatingPartnershipsRedeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Redeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOtherNoncontrollingInterestsNonredeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Nonredeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other nonredeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOtherNoncontrollingInterestsRedeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Redeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other redeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossPreferredUnitHoldersNonredeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Nonredeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossPreferredUnitHoldersRedeemable
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

name: NoncontrollingInterestInVariableInterestEntity
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
documentation: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

name: NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromBusinessCombination
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
documentation: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

name: NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromSaleOfParentEquityInterest
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
documentation: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

name: NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromSubsidiaryEquityIssuance
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
documentation: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

name: NoncontrollingInterestItemsAbstract
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest Items [Abstract]

name: NoncontrollingInterestMember
standard_label: Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
documentation: This element represents that portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent. A noncontrolling interest is sometimes called a minority interest.

name: NoncumulativePreferredStockMember
standard_label: Noncumulative Preferred Stock [Member]
documentation: Preferred stock upon which unpaid dividends do not accrue.

name: NoncumulativePreferredStockSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Noncumulative Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
documentation: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, which provide a specific dividend that is paid before any dividends are paid to common stock holders, which take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation, which do not enjoy any of the voting rights of common stockholders and which do not accrue unpaid dividends.

name: NoncurrentAssets
standard_label: Long-Lived Asset, Excluding Financial Instrument, Customer Relationship, Mortgage Servicing Right, Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, and Deferred Tax Asset, Amount
documentation: Amount of long-lived asset, excluding financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

name: NondebtorReorganizationItemsLegalAndAdvisoryProfessionalFees
standard_label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Legal and Advisory Professional Fees
documentation: Amount of reorganization items related to legal and advisory professional fees related to entities not in bankruptcy.

name: NondebtorReorganizationItemsNetGainLossOnSettlementOfOtherClaims
standard_label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of reorganization items related to net gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy.

name: NondebtorReorganizationItemsNetGainLossOnSettlementOfOtherClaims1
standard_label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims
documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

name: NondesignatedMember
standard_label: Not Designated as Hedging Instrument [Member]
documentation: Derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

name: NonfinancialLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Nonfinancial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value of obligations not classified as financial liabilities. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, commitments, obligations, and other liabilities.

name: NonfinancialLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Nonfinancial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilities
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities
documentation: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities [Abstract]

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesByComponentAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, by Component [Abstract]

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDomestic
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
documentation: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDomesticByComponentAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic, by Component [Abstract]

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesForeign
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
documentation: Amount of foreign noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

name: NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesForeignByComponentAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign, by Component [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositBrokered
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Brokered
documentation: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

name: NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositChecking
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
documentation: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

name: NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositDemand
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
documentation: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

name: NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositDescription
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of noninterest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include methodology, assumptions and the types and amounts of domestic deposit liabilities.

name: NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositRetail
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Retail
documentation: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic retail deposit liabilities.

name: NoninterestBearingForeignDepositBrokered
standard_label: Noninterest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Brokered (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of noninterest-bearing foreign third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

name: NoninterestBearingForeignDepositChecking
standard_label: Noninterest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Checking (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of noninterest-bearing checking deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: NoninterestBearingForeignDepositDemand
standard_label: Noninterest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Demand (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing foreign accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

name: NoninterestBearingForeignDepositLiabilitiesDescription
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Foreign Deposit Liabilities Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices, which may include methodology, assumptions and the types and amounts of foreign deposit liabilities.

name: NoninterestBearingForeignDepositRetail
standard_label: Noninterest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Retail (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of noninterest-bearing retail deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

name: NoninterestEarningAssetsAverageAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Noninterest-Earning Assets, Average Amount Outstanding
documentation: Average amount outstanding of noninterest-earning assets.

name: NoninterestEarningLiabilitiesAverageAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Noninterest-Earning Liabilities, Average Amount Outstanding
documentation: Average amount outstanding of noninterest-bearing liabilities.

name: NoninterestExpense
standard_label: Noninterest Expense
documentation: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

name: NoninterestExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest Expense [Abstract]

name: NoninterestExpenseCommissionExpense
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Commission Expense
documentation: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

name: NoninterestExpenseCommissionExpenseMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Commission Expense [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fees paid by the entity to sales representatives based on commission payout contracts covering the sale of mutual funds and insurance products.

name: NoninterestExpenseDirectorsFees
standard_label: Director Fee
documentation: Amount of expense for service provided by entity's director.

name: NoninterestExpenseDirectorsFeesMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Directors Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fees paid by the entity to its directors. Directors' fees may be paid in addition to salary and other benefits.

name: NoninterestExpenseDistributionAndServicingFees
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Distribution and Servicing Fees (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Costs related to the marketing and selling of fund shares and servicing proprietary funds. Also includes cost of providing client or shareholder servicing, record keeping, or administrative services, and fund accounting fees, SEC filings, and other maintenance costs.

name: NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvisoryFees
standard_label: Investment Advisory Fee
documentation: Amount of expense for investment advisory service, including, but not limited to, managing money in fund.

name: NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvisoryFeesMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Investment Advisory Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Entity's cost for managing the money in a fund, which will be billed back to the entity and is a component of noninterest expenses.

name: NoninterestExpenseMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

name: NoninterestExpenseOfferingCost
standard_label: Offering Cost, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, legal fee pertaining to share offered for sale, registration fee, underwriting, printing prospectus, and initial fee for listing on exchange.

name: NoninterestExpenseOfferingCostMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Offering Cost [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Costs of open-end investment entities and closed-end funds with a continuous offering period, which are accounted for as a deferred charge until operations begin and thereafter amortized to expense.

name: NoninterestExpensePrintingAndFulfillment
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Printing and Fulfillment
documentation: Amounts expended for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

name: NoninterestExpensePrintingAndFulfillmentMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Printing and Fulfillment [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Cost incurred for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

name: NoninterestExpenseRelatedToPerformanceFees
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees
documentation: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves investment results above a specified contractual level.

name: NoninterestExpenseRelatedToPerformanceFeesMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a commodities trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves above average returns.

name: NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentAndCustodianFees
standard_label: Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees
documentation: Amount of expense for transfer agent and custodian services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid for maintaining investor record, account balance, and company's stock transaction and fee paid for holding and safeguarding assets of individual, mutual fund, and investment company.

name: NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentAndCustodianFeesMember
standard_label: Noninterest Expense Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fees paid to agents employed by the entity or mutual fund to maintain shareholder records, including purchases, sales, and account balances. Also includes custodian fees incurred by the agent, bank, trust, or other organization that holds and safeguards individuals, mutual funds, or investment assets. These fees will be billed back to the entity and are a component of noninterest expense.

name: NoninterestIncome
standard_label: Noninterest Income
documentation: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

name: NoninterestIncomeAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest Income [Abstract]

name: NoninterestIncomeOther
standard_label: Noninterest Income, Other
documentation: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

name: NoninterestIncomeOtherAbstract
standard_label: Noninterest Income, Other [Abstract]

name: NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingIncome
standard_label: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
documentation: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

name: NoninterestbearingDomesticDepositOther
standard_label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Other
documentation: Amount of other noninterest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities.

name: NonmonetaryNotionalAmountOfPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Nonmonetary Notional Amount of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of price risk derivatives designated as a cash flow hedge with notional amounts expressed in nonmonetary units. For example the number of barrels specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract.

name: NonmonetaryNotionalAmountOfPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Nonmonetary Notional Amount of Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of price risk derivatives not designated as a hedging instrument with notional amounts expressed in nonmonetary units. For example the number of barrels specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract.

name: NonmonetaryNotionalAmountOfPriceRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Nonmonetary Notional Amount of Price Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of price risk derivatives for instruments with notional amounts expressed in nonmonetary units.

name: NonmonetaryNotionalAmountOfPriceRiskFairValueHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Nonmonetary Notional Amount of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of price risk derivatives designated as a fair value hedge with notional amounts expressed in nonmonetary units. For example the number of barrels specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionAmountOfBarterTransaction
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Amount of Barter Transaction (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The amount of revenue and expenses for the services received and provided in a nonmonetary arrangement.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionBasisOfAccountingForAssetsTransferred
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Basis of Accounting for Assets Transferred
documentation: Disclosure of the accounting treatment and method of measurement for nonmonetary exchanges of assets or liabilities or related to a transfer of nonmonetary assets for which the Entity receives no assets in return.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionByTypeTable
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, by Type [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about nonmonetary transaction or group of transactions. Includes, but is not limited to, barter and exchange.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionFairValueNotDeterminable
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Fair Value Not Determinable (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Disclosure of information regarding the volume and type of advertising surrendered and received (such as the number of equivalent pages, the number of minutes, or the overall percentage of advertising volume) when the nonmonetary transaction has no determinable fair value.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionGainLossRecognizedOnTransfer
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gain (Loss) Recognized on Transfer
documentation: Disclosure of the difference in values (gain (loss)) between the nonmonetary assets or liabilities exchanged with another entity inclusive of boot (small monetary consideration).

name: NonmonetaryTransactionGrossOperatingRevenueRecognized
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gross Operating Revenue Recognized
documentation: The amount of gross operating revenue recognized in a nonmonetary transaction.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionLineItems
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionNameOfCounterparty
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Name of Counterparty (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure of the third party with whom the nonmonetary arrangement was entered into.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionTypeAxis
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction Type [Axis]
documentation: Information by nature of the nonmonetary transaction or group of similar transactions, such as a barter or exchange.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionTypeDomain
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transaction Type [Domain]
documentation: Identifies the nature of the nonmonetary transaction or group of similar transactions, such as a barter or exchange.

name: NonmonetaryTransactionsAbstract
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transactions [Abstract]

name: NonmonetaryTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Nonmonetary Transactions Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for exchanges with other entities that involve principally nonmonetary assets or liabilities or relate to a transfer of nonmonetary assets for which the entity receives no assets in return.

name: NonoperatingGainsLosses
standard_label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
documentation: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

name: NonoperatingGainsLossesAbstract
standard_label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses) [Abstract]

name: NonoperatingIncomeExpense
standard_label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
documentation: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

name: NonoperatingIncomeExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Nonoperating Income (Expense) [Abstract]

name: NonoperatingIncomeExpenseMember
standard_label: Nonoperating Income (Expense) [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing nonoperating income (expense).

name: NonparticipatingLifeInsurancePolicyMember
standard_label: Nonparticipating Life Insurance Contract [Member]
documentation: Contract providing death benefits that do not entitle the policyholder to a portion of earnings or surplus through policy dividends.

name: NonpatronageSourceEarnings
standard_label: Nonpatronage Source Earnings
documentation: The excess or revenues over costs resulting from transactions that do not relate to patrons.

name: NonperformingFinancingReceivableMember
standard_label: Nonperforming Financial Instruments [Member]
documentation: Category status of financial instruments in which payments are past due in accordance with the terms of the contract. Financial instruments include, but are not limited to, financing receivables, loans, debt, and investments.

name: NonqualifiedPlanMember
standard_label: Nonqualified Plan [Member]
documentation: Plan without tax-exempt status in accordance with applicable tax provision of designated taxing authority. Taxing authority includes, but is not limited to, U.S. Internal Revenue Service (IRS). Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

name: NonrecourseMember
standard_label: Nonrecourse [Member]
documentation: Liability for which creditor does not have recourse to debtor but rather has recourse only to property used for collateral in transaction or other specific property.

name: NonrecurringAdjustmentAxis
standard_label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Nonrecurring Adjustment [Axis]
documentation: Information by nonrecurring adjustment directly attributable to business combination included in reported pro forma revenue and earnings.

name: NonrecurringAdjustmentDomain
standard_label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Nonrecurring Adjustment [Domain]
documentation: Nonrecurring adjustment directly attributable to business combination included in reported pro forma revenue and earnings.

name: NonredeemableConvertiblePreferredStockMember
standard_label: Nonredeemable Convertible Preferred Stock [Member]
documentation: Capital stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity and may be exchanged into common shares or other types of securities at the owner's option as long as it is in accordance with the issuer's terms. This security does not have redemption requirements.

name: NonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

name: NonredeemablePreferredStockMember
standard_label: Nonredeemable Preferred Stock [Member]
documentation: Preferred shares that are not redeemable before liquidation of the entity. Preferred shares may provide a preferential dividend to the dividend on common stock and may take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation. Preferred shares typically represent an ownership interest in the company.

name: NonrelatedPartyMember
standard_label: Nonrelated Party [Member]
documentation: Party not related to reporting entity.

name: NonsoftwareLicenseArrangementMember
standard_label: Nonsoftware License Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein certain rights are granted under a license agreement to exploit one or more non-software products (such as proprietary drugs, goods, or business process), under which fees received are taken into income as revenue recognition criteria are met.

name: NonsoftwareServiceSupportAndMaintenanceArrangementMember
standard_label: Nonsoftware Service, Support and Maintenance Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein an entity agrees to debug, revise and maintain one or more specified products, under which fees are taken into income as performance occurs.

name: NontaxableInvestmentSecuritiesAverageAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Nontaxable Investment Securities, Average Amount Outstanding
documentation: Average amount outstanding of nontaxable investment securities.

name: NontaxableMunicipalBondsMember
standard_label: Nontaxable Municipal Bonds [Member]
documentation: Long-term debt securities issued by state, city or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city or local governments that are not taxable.

name: NontaxableMunicipalNotesMember
standard_label: Nontaxable Municipal Notes [Member]
documentation: Short-term debt securities issued by state, city or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city or local governments that are not taxable.

name: NontradeReceivableCurrentsAbstract
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables, Current [Abstract]

name: NontradeReceivables
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables
documentation: Carrying amounts due as of the balance sheet date of the sum of amounts receivable other than from customers.

name: NontradeReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables [Abstract]

name: NontradeReceivablesCurrent
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables, Current
documentation: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: NontradeReceivablesNoncurrent
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent
documentation: The noncurrent portion of the receivable other than from customers, that is amounts expected to be collected after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: NontradeReceivablesNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: NontradeReceivablesUnclassifiedAbstract
standard_label: Nontrade Receivables, Unclassified [Abstract]

name: NontraditionalLongDurationContractsMember
standard_label: Nontraditional Long-Duration Contracts [Member]
documentation: Primarily annuity and life products having nontraditional terms. Some of these products combine fixed and variable features and are sold as general account or separate account products.

name: NonvestedRestrictedStockSharesActivityTableTextBlock
standard_label: Nonvested Restricted Stock Shares Activity [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the changes in outstanding nonvested restricted stock shares.

name: NonvotingCommonStockMember
standard_label: Nonvoting Common Stock [Member]
documentation: Common stock securities that do not empower a holder to vote on corporate resolutions or the election of directors.

name: NorthAmericaMember
standard_label: North America [Member]
documentation: Continent of North America.

name: NorthRegionMember
standard_label: US North Region [Member]
documentation: Region of United States of America (US) designated as North.

name: NortheastRegionMember
standard_label: US Northeast Region [Member]
documentation: Region of United States of America (US) designated as Northeast.

name: NorthwestRegionMember
standard_label: US Northwest Region [Member]
documentation: Region of United States of America (US) designated as Northwest.

name: NotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentEconomicHedgeMember
standard_label: Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Economic Hedge [Member]
documentation: Derivative instrument, not designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), used as economic hedge for exposure to risk.

name: NotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentTradingMember
standard_label: Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Trading [Member]
documentation: Derivative instrument, not designated as hedging instrument under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), used for trading purposes for exposure to risk.

name: NotPreviouslyRequiredFinancialSupportProvidedAmount
standard_label: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Not Previously Required Financial Support Provided, Amount
documentation: The amount of the support provided by the transferor with a continuing involvement that was not previously contractually required to provide to the transferee or its beneficial interest holders.

name: NotPreviouslyRequiredFinancialSupportProvidedTypeAndPrimaryReasons
standard_label: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Not Previously Required Financial Support Provided, Type and Primary Reasons
documentation: The type of support provided that was not previously contractually required to be provided to the transferee or its beneficial interest holders and the reason that the support was provided.

name: NoteWarrantMember
standard_label: Note Warrant [Member]
documentation: A note that entitles the holder to buy stock of the company at a specified price, which is much higher than the stock price at the time of issue.

name: NotesAndLoansPayable
standard_label: Notes and Loans Payable
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

name: NotesAndLoansPayableAbstract
standard_label: Notes and Loans Payable [Abstract]

name: NotesAndLoansPayableCurrent
standard_label: Notes and Loans Payable, Current
documentation: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of all long-term notes and loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

name: NotesAndLoansPayableCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Notes and Loans Payable, Current [Abstract]

name: NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossCurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
documentation: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

name: NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossNoncurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
documentation: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

name: NotesAndLoansReceivableNetCurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
documentation: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

name: NotesAndLoansReceivableNetCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current [Abstract]

name: NotesAndLoansReceivableNetNoncurrent
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

name: NotesAndLoansReceivableNetNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: NotesAssumed1
standard_label: Notes Assumed
documentation: The fair value of notes assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

name: NotesIssued1
standard_label: Notes Issued
documentation: The fair value of notes issued in noncash investing and financing activities.

name: NotesPayable
standard_label: Notes Payable
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: NotesPayableAbstract
standard_label: Notes Payable [Abstract]

name: NotesPayableCurrent
standard_label: Notes Payable, Current
documentation: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

name: NotesPayableCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Notes Payable, Current [Abstract]

name: NotesPayableCurrentRelatedAndNonrelatedPartyStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Current, Related and Nonrelated Party Status [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Indicates related and nonrelated party status for notes payable classified as current.

name: NotesPayableCurrentRelatedPartyCounterpartyNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Current, Related Party, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of related party for notes payable classified as current.

name: NotesPayableCurrentRelatedPartyTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Current, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for notes payable classified as current.

name: NotesPayableFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of notes payable.

name: NotesPayableFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: NotesPayableFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: NotesPayableNoncurrentRelatedAndNonrelatedPartyStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent, Related and Nonrelated Party Status [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Indicates related and nonrelated party status for notes payable classified as noncurrent.

name: NotesPayableNoncurrentRelatedPartyCounterpartyNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent, Related Party, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of related party for notes payable classified as noncurrent.

name: NotesPayableNoncurrentRelatedPartyTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for notes payable classified as noncurrent.

name: NotesPayableOtherPayablesMember
standard_label: Notes Payable, Other Payables [Member]
documentation: A written promise to pay a note to a third party.

name: NotesPayableRelatedAndNonrelatedPartyStatusExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Related and Nonrelated Party Status [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Indicates related and nonrelated party status for notes payable.

name: NotesPayableRelatedPartiesClassifiedCurrent
standard_label: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: NotesPayableRelatedPartiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Notes Payable, Related Parties (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties.

name: NotesPayableRelatedPartiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Notes Payable, Related Parties, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), payable to related parties, which are due after one year (or one business cycle).

name: NotesPayableRelatedPartyCounterpartyNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Related Party, Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of related party for notes payable.

name: NotesPayableRelatedPartyTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Notes Payable, Related Party [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates status and type of related party for notes payable.

name: NotesPayableToBank
standard_label: Notes Payable to Bank
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable to banks, excluding mortgage notes, initially due beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer.

name: NotesPayableToBankCurrent
standard_label: Notes Payable to Bank, Current
documentation: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

name: NotesPayableToBankCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Notes Payable to Bank [Abstract]

name: NotesPayableToBankNoncurrent
standard_label: Notes Payable to Bank, Noncurrent
documentation: The total amount due within more than 12 month, or the operating cycle if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

name: NotesPayableToBanksMember
standard_label: Notes Payable to Banks [Member]
documentation: A written promise to pay a note to a bank.

name: NotesReceivableByOwnerToLimitedLiabilityCompanyLLC
standard_label: Notes Receivable by Owner to Limited Liability Company (LLC)
documentation: Amount of an agreement for an unconditional promise by an owner to pay limited liability company (LLC) a definite sum of money at a future date.

name: NotesReceivableFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Notes Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the holder a definite sum of money at a future date.

name: NotesReceivableFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Notes Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: NotesReceivableFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Notes Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: NotesReceivableGross
standard_label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

name: NotesReceivableMember
standard_label: Notes Receivable [Member]
documentation: An amount representing an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the Entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date(s) within one year of the balance sheet date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

name: NotesReceivableNet
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

name: NotesReceivableNetAbstract
standard_label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

name: NotesReceivableRelatedParties
standard_label: Notes Receivable, Related Parties (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: For an unclassified balance sheet, amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay.

name: NotesReceivableRelatedPartiesCurrent
standard_label: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due within 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

name: NotesReceivableRelatedPartiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).

name: NotesReduction
standard_label: Notes Reduction
documentation: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

name: NotionalAmountOfCashFlowHedgeInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Cash Flow Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. The notional amount relates to a number of currency units, shares, bushels, pounds, or other units specified in a derivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfCreditRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Credit Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of credit risk derivatives.

name: NotionalAmountOfDerivativeInstrumentsDesignatedAsNetInvestmentHedges
standard_label: Notional Amount of Derivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all derivatives designated as a hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation. The notional amount relates to a number of currency units, shares, bushels, pounds, or other units specified in a derivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Derivatives (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all derivatives. The notional amount relates to a number of currency units, shares, bushels, pounds, or other units specified in a derivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfDerivativesAbstract
standard_label: Notional Disclosures [Abstract]

name: NotionalAmountOfDerivativesAdditionalCategoriesOfDerivativesAbstract
standard_label: Notional Amount of Derivatives, Additional Categories of Derivatives [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: NotionalAmountOfDerivativesTotalAbstract
standard_label: Notional Amount of Derivatives, by Category of Derivative [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: NotionalAmountOfFairValueHedgeInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Fair Value Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all derivatives designated as a fair value hedging instrument. The notional amount relates to a number of currency units, shares, bushels, pounds, or other units specified in a derivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all foreign currency derivatives designated as hedging instruments in cash flow hedges. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfForeignCurrencyDerivativePurchaseContracts
standard_label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivative Purchase Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of foreign currency derivatives to purchase a foreign currency. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfForeignCurrencyDerivativeSaleContracts
standard_label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivative Sale Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of foreign currency derivatives to sell a foreign currency. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfForeignCurrencyDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all foreign currency derivatives designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfInterestRateCashFlowHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all interest rate derivatives designated as hedging instruments in cash flow hedges. Notional amount refers to the monetary amount specified in the interest rate derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfInterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. Notional amount refers to the monetary amount specified in the interest rate derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfInterestRateDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of interest rate derivatives, which relates to the currency amount specified in the interest rate derivative instruments.

name: NotionalAmountOfInterestRateFairValueHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all interest rate derivatives designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Notional amount refers to the monetary amount specified in the interest rate derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfNetInvestmentHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Net Investment Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Total notional amount of all derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as a hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation. The notional amount relates to a number of currency units, shares, bushels, pounds, or other units specified in a derivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfNetInvestmentHedgingInstrumentsTotalAbstract
standard_label: Notional Amount of Net Investment Hedging Instruments, Total [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: NotionalAmountOfNonderivativeInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments
documentation: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on a nonderivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfNonderivativeInstrumentsDesignatedAsNetInvestmentHedges
standard_label: Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all nonderivative instruments that are designated as hedging instruments in a hedge of the net investment of foreign operations. For example, foreign currency denominated intercompany loans.

name: NotionalAmountOfOtherDerivativesNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all derivatives not designated as a hedging instrument. The notional amount relates to a number of currency units, shares, bushels, pounds, or other units specified in a derivative instrument.

name: NotionalAmountOfPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all price risk derivatives designated as hedging instruments in cash flow hedges. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the price risk derivative contract. Excludes notional amount expressed in nonmonetary terms such as for a commodity forward contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Notional Amount of Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the foreign currency derivative contract.

name: NotionalAmountOfPriceRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Price Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of price risk derivatives, which relates to the monetary amount specified in the price risk derivative instruments. Excludes notional amounts on derivatives expressed in nonmonetary units.

name: NotionalAmountOfPriceRiskFairValueHedgeDerivatives
standard_label: Notional Amount of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate notional amount of all price risk derivatives designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Notional amount refers to the number of currency units specified in the price risk derivative contract.

name: NuclearFuelMember
standard_label: Nuclear Fuel [Member]
documentation: Any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

name: NuclearFuelNetOfAmortization
standard_label: Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization
documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

name: NuclearPlantMember
standard_label: Nuclear Plant [Member]
documentation: Plant used in connection with the generation of nuclear energy.

name: NumberOfAircraftOperated
standard_label: Airline, Aircraft Operated, Number
documentation: Number of aircraft operated by airline.

name: NumberOfBusinessesAcquired
standard_label: Business Combination, Number of Businesses Acquired
documentation: Number of businesses acquired in business combination.

name: NumberOfCountriesInWhichEntityOperates
standard_label: Number of Countries in which Entity Operates
documentation: The number of countries in which the entity operates as of balance sheet date.

name: NumberOfCreditRiskDerivativesHeld
standard_label: Number of Credit Risk Derivatives Held
documentation: Number of credit risk derivative instruments held.

name: NumberOfEmployeesGeographicAreaMember
standard_label: Number of Employees, Geographic Area [Member]
documentation: The full-time equivalent number of the entity's employees in a specified geographic area as of the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

name: NumberOfEmployeesTotalMember
standard_label: Number of Employees, Total [Member]
documentation: The consolidated full-time equivalent number of the entity's employees as of the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

name: NumberOfForeignCurrencyDerivativesHeld
standard_label: Number of Foreign Currency Derivatives Held
documentation: Number of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives held by the entity at the reporting date.

name: NumberOfInterestRateDerivativesHeld
standard_label: Number of Interest Rate Derivatives Held
documentation: Number of interest rate derivative instruments held by the entity at the reporting date.

name: NumberOfOperatingSegments
standard_label: Number of Operating Segments
documentation: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discret

name: NumberOfPriceRiskDerivativesHeld
standard_label: Number of Price Risk Derivatives Held
documentation: Number of price risk derivative instruments held by the entity at the reporting date.

name: NumberOfPropertiesSubjectToGroundLeases
standard_label: Number of Properties Subject to Ground Leases
documentation: Number of separate real estate development properties located on land subject to ground leases.

name: NumberOfRealEstateProperties
standard_label: Number of Real Estate Properties
documentation: The number of real estate properties owned as of the balance sheet date.

name: NumberOfRealEstatePropertiesFeeSimple
standard_label: Number of Real Estate Properties, Fee Simple
documentation: The number of real estate properties owned as of the statement of financial position to which the entity has fee simple title.

name: NumberOfReportableSegments
standard_label: Number of Reportable Segments
documentation: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

name: NumberOfReportingUnits
standard_label: Goodwill, Reporting Unit, Number
documentation: Number of reporting units tested for impairment of goodwill. A reporting unit is an operating segment or one level below an operating segment.

name: NumberOfRestaurants
standard_label: Number of Restaurants
documentation: Represents the number of restaurants.

name: NumberOfStatesInWhichEntityOperates
standard_label: Number of States in which Entity Operates
documentation: The number of states the entity operates in as of the balance sheet date.

name: NumberOfStores
standard_label: Number of Stores
documentation: Represents the number of stores.

name: NumberOfUnitsInRealEstateProperty
standard_label: Number of Units in Real Estate Property
documentation: The number of units in a real estate property owned as of the balance sheet date.

name: ObjectivesForUsingCashFlowHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Objectives for Using Cash Flow Hedging Instruments
documentation: Textual description of the reasons for holding or issuing derivative instruments designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Includes discussion of the objectives for holding the instruments, the context needed to understand those objectives, and the strategies for achieving those objectives. Disclosures may be more meaningful if such objectives and strategies are described in the context of an entity's overall risk management profile.

name: ObjectivesForUsingDerivativeInstruments
standard_label: Objectives for Using Derivative Instruments
documentation: Description of the reasons for holding or issuing derivative instruments and nonderivative hedging instruments. Includes discussion of the objectives for holding or issuing derivative instruments, the context needed to understand those objectives, and the strategies for achieving those objectives. The description generally distinguishes between derivative and nonderivative instruments by the types of hedging relationships and between those instruments used for risk management purposes and those

name: ObjectivesForUsingFairValueHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Objectives for Using Fair Value Hedging Instruments
documentation: Textual description of the reasons for holding or issuing derivative instruments and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments. Includes discussion of the objectives for holding the instruments, the context needed to understand those objectives, and the strategies for achieving those objectives. Disclosures may be more meaningful if such objectives and strategies are described in the context of an entity's overall risk management profile.

name: ObjectivesForUsingNetInvestmentHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Objectives for Using Net Investment Hedging Instruments
documentation: Description of the reasons for holding or issuing derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation. Includes discussion of the objectives for holding the instruments, the context needed to understand those objectives, and the strategies for achieving those objectives. Disclosures may be more meaningful if such objectives and strategies are described in the context of an entity's overa

name: ObligationToRepurchaseReceivablesSoldMember
standard_label: Obligation to Repurchase Receivables Sold [Member]
documentation: An agreement to repurchase receivables that have been sold to a third party, which exposes the entity to collection loss.

name: ObligationToReturnSecuritiesReceivedAsCollateral
standard_label: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral
documentation: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Abstract]

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Outstanding
documentation: Amount outstanding, before the effects of recovery, of obligation under the joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementAmountReceivable
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Receivable
documentation: Amount of receivable from other entities recognized in the balance sheet resulting from the joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementAmountRecognized
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Recognized
documentation: Amount of joint and several liability recognized in the balance sheet.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementCorrespondingEntryAmount
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Asset
documentation: Amount of asset in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementCorrespondingEntryAssetStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes amount of asset in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementCorrespondingEntryExpense
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementCorrespondingEntryExpenseStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Expense, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes amount of expense in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementCorrespondingEntryLiability
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Liability
documentation: Amount of liability in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementCorrespondingEntryLiabilityStatementOfFinancialPositionExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Liability, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes amount of liability in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementDescription
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Description
documentation: Description of the nature of the arrangement, including, but not limited to, how the liability arose, the relationships with other co-obligors, and the terms and conditions of the arrangement.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementLineItems
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementRecourseProvisionDescription
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Recourse Provision, Description
documentation: Description of the nature of a recourse provision that would enable recovery from other entities of the amounts paid, including, but not limited to, limitations on recoverable amounts.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementTable
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about contractual obligation with joint and several liability, including but not limited to, debt arrangements, settled litigation, and judicial rulings.

name: ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityArrangementTableTextBlock
standard_label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of contractual obligation or group of similar obligations with joint and several liability for which the total amount of the obligation is fixed, including but not limited to, debt arrangements, settled litigation, and judicial rulings.

name: ObligationsMember
standard_label: Obligations [Member]
documentation: Obligation, including, but not limited to, short-term and long-term debt and finance lease obligation.

name: OccupancyCosts
standard_label: Occupancy Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Costs incurred and are directly related to generating occupancy revenues.

name: OccupancyMember
standard_label: Occupancy [Member]
documentation: Residing in place for specified period of time. Including, but not limited to, hotel, cruise, or other type of lodging arrangement.

name: OccupancyNet
standard_label: Occupancy, Net
documentation: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

name: OccupancyNetMember
standard_label: Occupancy, Net [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of net occupancy expense that may include items such as rent expense, common area maintenance expense, taxes and insurance.

name: OccupancyRevenue
standard_label: Occupancy Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue derived from the provision of short term lodging; it does not apply to lease or rental income. Includes hotel rooms, cruise revenue, and other revenue related to lodgings.

name: OciBeforeReclassificationsBeforeTaxAttributableToParent
standard_label: OCI, before Reclassifications, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

name: OciBeforeReclassificationsNetOfTaxAttributableToParent
standard_label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

name: OciCashFlowHedgeReclassificationForDiscontinuanceStatementOfIncomeOrComprehensiveIncomeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: OCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Reclassification for Discontinuance, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from discontinuance of cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

name: OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransferToHeldToMaturityAdjustmentFromAociForAmortizationOfGainLossAfterTax
standard_label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

name: OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransferToHeldToMaturityAdjustmentFromAociForAmortizationOfGainLossBeforeTax
standard_label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

name: OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransferToHeldToMaturityAdjustmentFromAociForAmortizationOfGainLossTax
standard_label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), Tax
documentation: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

name: OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTax
standard_label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

name: OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTaxAbstract
standard_label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax [Abstract]
