documentation: The amount of the support provided by the Adviser to help the REIT achieve a certain return for the period.

name: OperatingSupportFromAdviserDescription
standard_label: Operating Support from Adviser, Description
documentation: Describes the relationship between the real estate investment trust (REIT) and its Adviser and the nature of the support provided by the Adviser (such as reduction of fees, forgiving indebtedness, providing a better than market return on a related party transaction) to help the REIT achieve a certain return for certain periods.

name: OperationsCommencedDate
standard_label: Operations Commenced Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The date the operations of the entity commenced.

name: OperationsCommencedDate1
standard_label: Operations Commenced Date
documentation: Date the operations of the entity commenced, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: OperativeBuildersAbstract
standard_label: Operative Builders [Abstract]

name: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementCashEffectOfChangeInFairValueOfShare
standard_label: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Cash, Effect of Change in Fair Value of Share
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash that would be paid upon settlement from change in fair value of share for option contract indexed to equity.

name: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementNumberOfSharesEffectOfChangeInFairValueOfShare
standard_label: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Number of Shares, Effect of Change in Fair Value of Share
documentation: Increase (decrease) in number of shares that would be issued upon settlement from change in fair value of share for option contract indexed to equity.

name: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValue
standard_label: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Share, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of shares that would be issued upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

name: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValuePerShare
standard_label: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Share, Fair Value Per Share
documentation: Fair value per share that would be issued upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityClassification
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Classification
documentation: Describes the entity's accounting for the freestanding option contract. For instance, the classification is either an asset, liability or equity.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityContractReclassification
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Contract Reclassification
documentation: Disclose option contract reclassifications (in whole or in part) into (or out of) permanent and/or temporary equity during the life of the freestanding contract, the reason for the reclassification, and the impact on the issuer's financial statements. If partially reclassified, disclose the accounting policy decision made to partially reclassify the freestanding option contract.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityDescriptionTextBlock
standard_label: Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for freestanding contract indexed to and potentially settled in entity's own stock. Includes, but is not limited to, strike price and number of shares to which contract is indexed, settlement date, and settlement alternatives.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityEquityAxis
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Information by type of options indexed to an issuer's equity.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityEquityTable
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Equity [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about option contract issued and indexed to equity, classified as equity. Includes, but is not limited to, strike price, number of shares, indexed share, and settlement date.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityIndexedShares
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
documentation: The number of issuer's shares to which the option contract is indexed.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityLineItems
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityRedeemableStockRedemptionRequirements
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Redeemable Stock, Redemption Requirements (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: For freestanding contracts indexed to, and potentially settled in, a Company's own stock that has redemption requirements, disclose the amount of redemption requirements for all issues of capital stock that are redeemable at fixed or determinable prices on fixed or determinable dates in each of the five years following the date of the latest statement of financial position presented.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityRedeemableStockRedemptionRequirementsAmount
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Redeemable Stock, Redemption Requirements, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: For freestanding option contracts indexed to, and potentially settled in, a company's own stock that has redemption requirements, the amount of redemption requirements for all issues of capital stock that are redeemable at fixed or determinable prices on fixed or determinable dates in each of the five years following the date of the latest statement of financial position presented.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityRedeemableStockRedemptionRequirementsAmount1
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Redeemable Stock, Redemption Requirements, Amount
documentation: Amount of redeemable stock for issue of capital stock that are redeemable at fixed or determinable prices on fixed or determinable dates in each of the five years following the date of the latest statement of financial position presented.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAlternatives
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives
documentation: Describes the settlement alternatives of the freestanding contract as either (i) physical settlement; (ii) net-share settlement; or, (iii) net-cash settlement. Physical settlement is when the party designated in the contract as the buyer delivers the full stated amount of cash to the seller, and the seller delivers the full stated number of shares to the buyer. Net-share settlement is when the party with a loss delivers to a party with a gain shares with a current fair value equal to the gain. N

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAlternativesAtFairValue
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: State the current fair value of each settlement alternative for each freestanding contract. This could be denominated in monetary terms or quantities of shares. State also how changes in the price of the issuer's equity instruments affect the settlement amounts.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAlternativesCashAtFairValue
standard_label: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Cash, Amount
documentation: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAlternativesSharesAtFairValue
standard_label: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Number of Shares
documentation: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding option contract.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementDateOrDates
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Date
documentation: Settlement date of the option indexed to issuer's equity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementDates
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuers Equity, Settlement Dates (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The settlement dates or range of dates of the freestanding contract, as applicable.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityShares
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Shares
documentation: Maximum number of shares that could be issued to settle option contract indexed to equity.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityStrikePrice
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The exercise (or strike) price stated in the contract. The fixed price at which the option holder can purchase, in the case of a call option, or sell, in the case of a put option, on the underlying security.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityStrikePrice1
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price
documentation: Exercise or strike price stated in the contract for options indexed to the issuer's equity shares.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityTable
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Liability [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about option contract issued and indexed to equity, classified as liability. Includes, but is not limited to, strike price, number of shares, indexed share, and settlement date.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityTypeAxis
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Type [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of freestanding contracts issued by an entity that are indexed to, and potentially settled in, an entity's own stock.

name: OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityTypeDomain
standard_label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Type [Domain]
documentation: Description of the type of freestanding contract issued by a Company that is indexed to, and potentially settled in, a Company's own stock. Specifically, the pertinent rights and privileges of the securities outstanding.

name: OptionMember
standard_label: Options Held [Member]
documentation: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific commodity, or financial or equity instrument, at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option) which were purchased or otherwise acquired, excluding options written (for which a premium was received).

name: OptionOnSecuritiesMember
standard_label: Option on Securities [Member]
documentation: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific quantity of a security at a specified price during a specified period or at a specified date.

name: OrderFlowFees
standard_label: Order Flow Fees
documentation: The amount of expense in the period for the cost of other broker-dealers' executions of orders.

name: OrderFlowFeesMember
standard_label: Order Flow Fees [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Fees charged when brokers send transactions to other broker dealers for execution in exchange for monthly payments.

name: OrderOrProductionBacklogMember
standard_label: Order or Production Backlog [Member]
documentation: Order or production backlog arising from contract acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

name: OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsAbstract
standard_label: Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements [Abstract]

name: OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock
standard_label: Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements Disclosure and Significant Accounting Policies [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for the organization, consolidation and basis of presentation of financial statements disclosure, and significant accounting policies of the reporting entity. May be provided in more than one note to the financial statements, as long as users are provided with an understanding of (1) the significant judgments and assumptions made by an enterprise in determining whether it must consolidate a VIE and/or disclose information about its involvement with a VIE, (2) the nature of

name: OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for organization, consolidation and basis of presentation of financial statements disclosure.

name: OrganizationConsolidationBasisOfPresentationBusinessDescriptionAndAccountingPoliciesTextBlock
standard_label: Organization, Consolidation, Basis of Presentation, Business Description and Accounting Policies [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for the general note to the financial statements for the reporting entity which may include, descriptions of the basis of presentation, business description, significant accounting policies, consolidations, reclassifications, new pronouncements not yet adopted and changes in accounting principles.

name: OrganizationalAndOfferingCostsExpense
standard_label: Offering and Organizational Costs, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company and for formation and organizational costs incurred to establish entity to do business.

name: OrganizationalAndOfferingCostsExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Offering and Organizational Costs, Expense [Abstract]

name: OrganizationalCostExpense
standard_label: Organizational Cost, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for formation and organizational costs incurred to establish entity to do business.

name: OriginationAndPurchasesOfMortgageBankingAssets
standard_label: Origination and Purchases of Mortgage Banking Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The value of mortgage-based securitized assets that were created through the writing and securitizing new loans and through purchasing previously securitized assets.

name: OriginationOfLoanToPurchaseCommonStock
standard_label: Origination of Loan to Purchase Common Stock
documentation: Cash outflow for origination of loan for purchasing common stock.

name: OriginationOfLoansToEmployeeStockOwnershipPlans
standard_label: Origination of Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
documentation: The cash outflow to finance the entity's defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

name: OriginationOfMortgageServicingRightsMSRs
standard_label: Origination of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The increase during the reporting period in the cumulative value of servicing rights. This increase is the result of new servicing rights that are created when mortgages are sold or transferred.

name: OriginationOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedParties
standard_label: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
documentation: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

name: OtherAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
standard_label: Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
documentation: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received classified as other, and expenses incurred but not yet paid, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

name: OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
documentation: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Other Accrued Liabilities
documentation: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other.

name: OtherAccruedLiabilitiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: OtherAdditionalCapital
standard_label: Other Additional Capital
documentation: Amount of additional paid-in capital (APIC) classified as other.

name: OtherAdditionalCapitalMember
standard_label: Other Additional Capital [Member]
documentation: This element represents a category to capture additional Paid-in Capital other than attributable to capital contributed by shareholders in excess of the par or stated value of the common or preferred stock issued by an entity. Certain entities report two components of additional Paid-in Capital consisting of (i) capital in excess of par or stated value and (ii) other additional capital. This member is only to be used if the entity distinguishes between additional Paid-in Capital and other additi

name: OtherAdjustmentsToIncomeDiscontinuedOperations
standard_label: Other Adjustments to Income, Discontinued Operations
documentation: Amount of noncash income (expense), classified as other, from discontinued operations.

name: OtherAffiliatesMember
standard_label: Other Affiliates [Member]
documentation: A category that identifies other affiliates.

name: OtherAggregatedInvestmentsMember
standard_label: Other Security Investments [Member]
documentation: Other investments in debt and equity securities and other forms of securities that provide ownership interests.

name: OtherAlternativeEnergySalesRevenue
standard_label: Other Alternative Energy Sales Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue earned during the period from alternative energy sources (for example, ethanol, biomass, solar, geothermal, and wind power).

name: OtherAmortizationMember
standard_label: Other Amortization [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Other amortization not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges
standard_label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges
documentation: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.

name: OtherAssetImpairmentCharges
standard_label: Other Asset Impairment Charges
documentation: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.

name: OtherAssets
standard_label: Other Assets
documentation: Amount of assets classified as other.

name: OtherAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Other Assets [Abstract]

name: OtherAssetsCurrent
standard_label: Other Assets, Current
documentation: Amount of current assets classified as other.

name: OtherAssetsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Other Assets Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for other assets. This disclosure includes other current assets and other noncurrent assets.

name: OtherAssetsFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of other assets.

name: OtherAssetsFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: OtherAssetsFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: OtherAssetsHeldForSale
standard_label: Other Assets Held-for-sale (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The lower of the carrying value or fair value less cost to sell of assets held-for-sale, other than loans receivable.

name: OtherAssetsHeldForSaleCurrent
standard_label: Other Assets Held-for-sale, Current (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: The lower of the carrying value or fair value less cost to sell of current assets held for sale that are not elsewhere specified in the taxonomy. The carrying value of major classes of assets and liabilities of the disposal group are separately disclosed in the balance sheet in the specific concepts provided.

name: OtherAssetsMember
standard_label: Other Assets [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing other assets.

name: OtherAssetsMiscellaneous
standard_label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous
documentation: Amount of other miscellaneous assets.

name: OtherAssetsMiscellaneousAbstract
standard_label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous [Abstract]

name: OtherAssetsMiscellaneousCurrent
standard_label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Current
documentation: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

name: OtherAssetsMiscellaneousNoncurrent
standard_label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: OtherAssetsNoncurrent
standard_label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

name: OtherAssetsNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Other Assets, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: OtherAssetsNoncurrentDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Other Assets, Noncurrent Disclosure [Abstract]

name: OtherAssetsNotAllowed
standard_label: Other Assets Not Allowed (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Other assets not readily convertible into cash, such as prepaid expenses, intangible assets, and unsecured receivables net of any reserves.

name: OtherAssetsPledgingPurposeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Other Asset, Pledging Purpose [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates pledging purpose of assets classified as other.

name: OtherAssetsSignificantAdditionsOrDeletionsAbstract
standard_label: Other Assets, Significant Additions or Deletions [Abstract]

name: OtherAssetsUnclassifiedAbstract
standard_label: Other Assets, Unclassified [Abstract]

name: OtherBorrowings
standard_label: Other Borrowings
documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date for the aggregate of other miscellaneous borrowings owed by the reporting entity.

name: OtherCapitalizedPropertyPlantAndEquipmentMember
standard_label: Other Capitalized Property Plant and Equipment [Member]
documentation: All other long term capitalized assets related to property plant and equipment not otherwise previously categorized.

name: OtherCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue
standard_label: Other Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
documentation: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates, classified as other. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

name: OtherCommitment
standard_label: Other Commitment
documentation: Minimum amount of other commitment not otherwise specified in the taxonomy. Excludes commitments explicitly modeled in the taxonomy, including but not limited to, long-term and short-term purchase commitments, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, supply commitments, registration payment arrangements, leases, debt, product warranties, guarantees, environmental remediation obligations, and pensions.

name: OtherCommitmentDueAfterFifthYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, after Year Five
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInFifthYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Five
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInFourthAndFifthYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInFourthAndFifthYearAbstract
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four and Five [Abstract]

name: OtherCommitmentDueInFourthYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInNextTwelveMonths
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year One
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInSecondAndThirdYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInSecondAndThirdYearAbstract
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two and Three [Abstract]

name: OtherCommitmentDueInSecondYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentDueInThirdYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Three
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

name: OtherCommitmentFiscalYearMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Other Commitment, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: OtherCommitmentsAbstract
standard_label: Other Commitments [Abstract]

name: OtherCommitmentsAxis
standard_label: Other Commitments [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of other commitment.

name: OtherCommitmentsDescription
standard_label: Other Commitments, Description
documentation: Description of the nature and terms of commitment.

name: OtherCommitmentsDomain
standard_label: Other Commitments [Domain]
documentation: Other future obligation.

name: OtherCommitmentsFutureMinimumPaymentsRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
documentation: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

name: OtherCommitmentsLineItems
standard_label: Other Commitments [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: OtherCommitmentsTable
standard_label: Other Commitments [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about obligations resulting from other commitments.

name: OtherCommitmentsTableTextBlock
standard_label: Other Commitments [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of information about obligations resulting from other commitments.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAmortizationOfDefinedBenefitPlanNetPriorServiceCostCreditRecognizedInNetPeriodicBenefitCostBeforeTax
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The change in other comprehensive income due to the amortization of the net prior service costs (credit) into net periodic pension costs.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAmortizationOfDefinedBenefitPlanNetPriorServiceCostRecognizedInNetPeriodicPensionCostNetOfTax
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The adjustment out of other comprehensive income for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost during the period, after tax.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAmortizationOfDefinedBenefitPlanNetPriorServiceCostRecognizedInNetPeriodicPensionCostTax
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAdjustmentBeforeTaxPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross appreciation or the gross loss in value of the total of unsold available-for-sale securities (except when designated as a fair value hedge or which had been determined to have had an other than temporary decline in fair value below its amortized cost basis). While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAdjustmentBeforeTaxPeriodIncreaseDecreaseAbstract
standard_label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, before Tax [Abstract]

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAdjustmentNetOfTaxPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Gross appreciation or the gross loss in value of the total unsold securities. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAdjustmentNetOfTaxPeriodIncreaseDecreaseAbstract
standard_label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax [Abstract]

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableForSaleSecuritiesTax
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Tax effect of the gross appreciation or the gross loss, net of reclassification adjustment, in the value of the total unsold available-for-sale securities at the end of an accounting period.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableForSaleSecuritiesTaxAbstract
standard_label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax [Abstract]

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesAdjustmentBeforeTaxPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesAdjustmentBeforeTaxPortionAttributableToParent
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesAdjustmentBeforeTaxPortionAttributableToParentAbstract
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesAdjustmentNetOfTaxPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesAdjustmentNetOfTaxPortionAttributableToParent
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesAdjustmentNetOfTaxPortionAttributableToParentAbstract
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsaleSecuritiesTaxPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

name: OtherUnderwritingExpense

standard_label: Other Units, Other Ownership Interests' Capital Account [Abstract]

name: OverAllotmentOptionMember

name: OverTheCounterMember

name: OverfundedPlanMember

name: OwnedPropertyManagementCosts

name: OwnershipDomain

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementCollateral

documentation: The amount of collateral required to be received or received by the entity from the counterparty (share borrower) in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDefaultAbstract

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDefaultChangesInValueAbstract

documentation: This item represents, in periods subsequent to the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default, the change in the amount of probable recoveries which the entity has recognized in earnings for the period.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDefaultChangesInValueShares
standard_label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Changes in Value, Shares
documentation: This item represents, in periods subsequent to the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default, the amount of change in the fair value of the entity's shares, associated with an own-share lending arrangement, recognized in earnings for the period.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDefaultEarningsPerShareShares
standard_label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Earnings Per Share, Shares
documentation: In periods in which default, by a counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement, is probable, but has not yet occurred, this item represents the number of the entity's shares related to the share-lending arrangement that will be reflected in basic and diluted earnings per share when the counterparty (share borrower) default does occur.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDefaultPeriodOfDefaultExpense
standard_label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Period of Default, Expense
documentation: The amount of default related expense recognized in earnings in the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementDescription
standard_label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Description
documentation: A description of any outstanding share-lending arrangement on the entity's own stock including all significant terms such as the number of shares lent, the term of the arrangement, the circumstances under which cash settlement would be required, and any requirements for the counterparty (share borrower) to provide collateral.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementDividendsNotReimbursed

documentation: The amount of dividends paid to holders of record of shares of the entity's stock associated with an own-share lending arrangement in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, which will not be reimbursed by the counterparty (share borrower) to the arrangement.

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementEarningsPerShareTreatment

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementSharesIssued

name: OwnshareLendingArrangementSharesOutstanding

name: ParentMember

name: PartnersCapitalAccountDistributionPerUnitOfLimitedPartnerInterest

name: PartnersCapitalAccountDistributions

name: PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSaleOfUnitsNetOfOfferingCosts

documentation: Amount, after offering cost, from issuance of new unit of limited partnership interest in public offering.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountRedemptions
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions
documentation: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountRestatementAdjustment
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Restatement Adjustment (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the restatement of a prior period. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCapital
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
documentation: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnits
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units
documentation: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnitsAbstract

name: PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUnitsPurchases
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
documentation: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUnitsReissued
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Reissued
documentation: Value of units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the monetary value of these units which were reissued during the period.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedCompensation
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnits
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units
documentation: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAcquisitions
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Acquisitions
documentation: Change in the number of units for each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsContributed
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Contributed
documentation: Units contributed by each class of partners during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsConverted
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Converted
documentation: The number of units converted into shares of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Total net change in the units of each class of partners' capital accounts during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsRedeemed
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed
documentation: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSaleOfUnits
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units
documentation: Total units issued during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSaleOfUnitsAbstract
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units [Abstract]

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldInPrivatePlacement
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Private Placement
documentation: The number of units sold in a private placement of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldInPublicOffering
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
documentation: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreasury
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Purchased
documentation: Units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreasuryUnitsReissued
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Reissued
documentation: Units that were previously issued and then were repurchased and classified as treasury units. This element represents the number of these units which were reissued during the period.

name: PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsUnitbasedCompensation
standard_label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Number of Units
documentation: Number of units issued for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

name: PartnersCapitalAdjustedBalance
standard_label: Partners' Capital, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount of partners' capital net of the cumulative effect of prospective application of a new accounting principle on the beginning balance of equity.

name: PartnersCapitalAdjustedBalance1
standard_label: Partners' Capital, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount of partners' capital after the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

name: PartnersCapitalAllocatedForIncomeTaxAndOtherWithdrawals
standard_label: Partners' Capital Allocated for Income Tax and Other Withdrawals
documentation: Amount of partnership capital allocated for income tax and other withdrawals.

name: PartnersCapitalAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Partners' Capital Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).

documentation: Description of distribution policies and requirements by unit class including dates and amounts of required payments, methods for determining distribution amounts such as an allocation percentage of net income, and other details of distributions.

name: PartnersCapitalIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

standard_label: Passenger [Member]
documentation: Person traveling between destinations and not involved in operation of conveyance, including, but not limited to, train, bus, boat and automobile.

name: PatentsMember

documentation: Exclusive legal right granted by the government to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law.

name: PatientAccountsReceivableMember
standard_label: Health Care Patient [Member]
documentation: Represents all in-patients, staff out-patients, emergency room patients, patients of private diagnostic services, and all other individuals receiving billable and billed services of the hospital or other provider of health services.

name: PatronEconomicallyDependentDescription
standard_label: Patron Economically Dependent, Description
documentation: Description of the transaction with an economically dependent patron on an agricultural cooperative.

name: PatronageRefunds
standard_label: Patronage Refunds
documentation: Amount of earnings distributed to patrons of the agricultural cooperative.

name: PatronageSourceEarnings
standard_label: Patronage Source Earnings
documentation: Amount of revenue in excess of cost resulting from transactions for or with patrons.

name: PayableCommonStockRedeemed
standard_label: Payable, Common Stock Redeemed
documentation: Amount of payable for common stock reacquired. Includes, but is not limited to, unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

name: PayableInvestmentPurchase
standard_label: Payable, Investment, Purchase
documentation: Amount of payable for purchase of investment.

name: PayablePreferredStockRedeemed
standard_label: Payable, Preferred Stock Redeemed
documentation: Amount of payable for preferred stock reacquired. Includes, but is not limited to, unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

standard_label: Payables for Congressionally Mandated Assessments
documentation: Amount payable for Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments, for example, but not limited to, Resolution Funding Corporation (REFCORP) assessments.

name: PayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingOrganizations
standard_label: Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
documentation: Amount payable to broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-receive, certain deposits received for securities loaned, open transactions, and floor-brokerage payables.

standard_label: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Other Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization [Abstract]

standard_label: Payables to Customers
documentation: Amounts payable to customers at the balance sheet date. documentation: Information by credit rating.

name: PaymentDeferralMember
standard_label: Payment Deferral [Member]
documentation: Loan modification for a temporary postponement of loan payments.

name: PaymentForAcquisitionCryptoAsset
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Crypto Asset
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to acquire crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

name: PaymentForAdministrativeFees
standard_label: Payment for Administrative Fees
documentation: Amount paid to managing member or general partner, affiliate of managing member or general partner, or affiliate of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP) for administrative services provided to the LLC or LP, for example, but not limited to, salaries, rent, or overhead costs.

name: PaymentForAdvanceForConstructionFinancingActivity
standard_label: Payment for Advance for Construction, Financing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as financing activity.

name: PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabilityFinancingActivities
standard_label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

name: PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabilityInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.

name: PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabilityOperatingActivities
standard_label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

name: PaymentForIncentiveFee
standard_label: Payment for Incentive Fee
documentation: Amount paid for incentive rights held by the managing member or general partner, of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

name: PaymentForManagementFee
standard_label: Payment for Management Fee
documentation: Amount paid to managing member or general partner for management of the day-to-day business functions of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

name: PaymentGuaranteeMember
standard_label: Payment Guarantee [Member]
documentation: A contract that contingently requires the guarantor to make payments (either in cash, financial instrument, other assets, shares of its stock, or provision of services) to the guaranteed party based on changes in an underlying that is related to an asset, a liability, or an equity security of the guaranteed party.

name: PaymentInKindPIKNoteMember
standard_label: Payment in Kind (PIK) Note [Member]
documentation: A payment in kind note accrues interest over the term of the note and is repaid at maturity or upon refinancing. A PIK loan is typically unsecured.

name: PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs
documentation: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.

name: PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCostsAbstract
standard_label: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs [Abstract]

name: PaymentToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicyOperatingActivities
standard_label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Operating Activities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as operating activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

name: PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate
standard_label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
documentation: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

name: PaymentsForAffordableHousingPrograms
standard_label: Payment for Affordable Housing Program Obligation by Federal Home Loan Bank
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for payment made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

name: PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOtherOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks
standard_label: Payments for Bonds Transferred to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
documentation: Amount of cash outflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability of consolidated obligations to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

name: PaymentsForBrokerageFees
standard_label: Payments for Brokerage Fees
documentation: The amount of cash paid for brokerage fees during the current period. This element is intended to represent the brokerage fees paid by and between financial industry participants.

name: PaymentsForCapitalImprovements
standard_label: Payments for Capital Improvements
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

name: PaymentsForCommissions
standard_label: Payments for Commissions
documentation: The amount of cash paid for commissions during the current period.

name: PaymentsForCongressionallyMandatedFederalHomeLoanBankAssessments
standard_label: Payments for Congressionally Mandated Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for payments made by the Federal Home Loan Banks for Congressionally mandated assessments.

name: PaymentsForConstructionInProcess
standard_label: Payments for Construction in Process
documentation: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

name: PaymentsForDelayedTaxExemptExchange
standard_label: Payments for Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
documentation: Cash outflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

name: PaymentsForDemandSideManagementProgram
standard_label: Payments for Demand Side Management Program (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The cash outflow related to any range of actions associated with reducing demand for electricity, gas, or other utilities and efforts to shift demand from peak to off-peak times.

name: PaymentsForDeposits
standard_label: Payments for Deposits
documentation: The amount of cash paid for deposits on goods and services during the period; excludes time deposits and deposits with other institutions, which pertain to financial service entities.

name: PaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebtRetirements
standard_label: Payments for Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
documentation: Cash outflow during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed by the entity.

name: PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisitions
standard_label: Payments for Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
documentation: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

name: PaymentsForDepositsWithOtherInstitutions
standard_label: Payments for Deposits with Other Institutions
documentation: Cash paid to make deposits at other institutions during the period.

name: PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentFinancingActivities
standard_label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
documentation: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

name: PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
documentation: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

name: PaymentsForEnvironmentalLiabilities
standard_label: Payments for Environmental Liabilities
documentation: Cash outflows made during the period for environmental remediation activities.

name: PaymentsForExploitationLiabilities
standard_label: Payments for Exploitation Liabilities (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Cash payments related to exploitation costs.

name: PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances
standard_label: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

name: PaymentsForFees
standard_label: Payments for Other Fees
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.
