name: PaymentsForFlightEquipment
standard_label: Payments for Flight Equipment
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

name: PaymentsForHedgeFinancingActivities
standard_label: Payments for Hedge, Financing Activities
documentation: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

name: PaymentsForHedgeInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payments for Hedge, Investing Activities
documentation: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

name: PaymentsForInvestingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Payment for Investing Activity [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForInvestmentInRestrictedCashFromPollutionControlBond
standard_label: Payments for Investment in Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
documentation: The cash outflow for investments in restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

name: PaymentsForLeaseCommissions
standard_label: Payment for Lease Commission, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for lease commission incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

name: PaymentsForLeasingCosts
standard_label: Payment for Initial Direct Cost, Lease, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost of lease incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

name: PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissionsAndTenantImprovements
standard_label: Payment for Initial Direct Cost and Leasehold Improvement for Lease, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost and cost for leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

name: PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissionsAndTenantImprovementsAbstract
standard_label: Payment for Initial Direct Cost and Leasehold Improvement for Lease, Investing Activity [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForLegalSettlements
standard_label: Payments for Legal Settlements
documentation: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

name: PaymentsForLoans
standard_label: Payments for Loans
documentation: Cash payments for and related to principal collection on loans related to operating activities.

name: PaymentsForLossesAndLossAdjustmentExpense
standard_label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid
documentation: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

name: PaymentsForManufacturingCosts
standard_label: Payments for Manufacturing Costs (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Cash payments related to film manufacturing costs.

name: PaymentsForMergerRelatedCosts
standard_label: Payments for Merger Related Costs
documentation: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

name: PaymentsForMortgageDeposits
standard_label: Payments for Mortgage Deposits
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for advance payment to show intention to complete mortgage financing.

name: PaymentsForNuclearFuel
standard_label: Payments for Nuclear Fuel
documentation: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

name: PaymentsForOperatingActivities
standard_label: Payments for Operating Activities
documentation: Total amount of cash paid for operating activities during the current period.

name: PaymentsForOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for Operating Activities [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchasesOfLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Payment for Origination and Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

name: PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchasesOfLoansHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Payment for Origination and Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Payment for Origination, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

name: PaymentsForOtherDeposits
standard_label: Payments for Other Deposits
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

name: PaymentsForOtherOperatingActivities
standard_label: Payment for Other Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for operating activity, classified as other.

name: PaymentsForOtherTaxes
standard_label: Payments for Other Taxes
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for taxes classified as other.

name: PaymentsForParticipationLiabilities
standard_label: Payments for Participation Liabilities
documentation: Cash payments related to participation costs.

name: PaymentsForPostemploymentBenefits
standard_label: Payments for Postemployment Benefits
documentation: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

name: PaymentsForPreviousAcquisition
standard_label: Payments for Previous Acquisition
documentation: Cash outflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromAvailableforsaleSecuritiesShortterm
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Available-for-Sale Securities, Short-Term
documentation: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term available-for-sale securities.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinessesAndInterestInAffiliates
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinessesAndInterestInAffiliatesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptExchange
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
documentation: Net cash outflow or inflow from a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as tax deferred exempt exchange.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositOnLoan
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisitions
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
documentation: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentFinancingActivities
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentFinancingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentInvestingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankStock
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
documentation: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankStockAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalReserveBankStock
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Reserve Bank Stock
documentation: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition or sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalReserveBankStockAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Reserve Bank Stock [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivities
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
documentation: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromHeldtomaturitySecuritiesShortterm
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Held-to-Maturity Securities, Short-Term
documentation: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term held-to-maturity securities.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestments
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
documentation: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestmentsAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments, Alternative [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePoliciesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLimitedPartnership
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Limited Partnership
documentation: Net cash outflow or inflow from limited partnership investments held by the entity for investment purposes.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeases
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeasesAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
documentation: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivableAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable, Alternative [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLongtermInvestments
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-Term Investments
documentation: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of long-term investments which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromLongtermInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-Term Investments [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageDeposits
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Deposits
documentation: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the mortgage.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageServicingRights
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Servicing Rights
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with acquisition or sale of mortgage servicing rights which is the net carrying value of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageServicingRightsAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Servicing Rights [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromNuclearFuel
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Nuclear Fuel
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromNuclearFuelAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Nuclear Fuel [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherDeposits
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits
documentation: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherDepositsAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInterestEarningAssets
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Interest Earning Assets
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in other interest earning assets not separately disclosed.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoansAndLeases
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherRealEstatePartnerships
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Real Estate Partnerships
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from other real estate partnerships not otherwise defined in the taxonomy (buyouts, other agreements).

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromPolicyLoans
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Policy Loans
documentation: Net amount paid or received by the entity associated with issuance or collection of loans made to policy holders, principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromPolicyLoansAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Policy Loans, Alternative [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromPreviousAcquisition
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromPreviousAcquisitionAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinvestmentAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Payment for (Proceeds from) Real Estate, Held-for-Investment, Alternative [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
documentation: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstateHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Payment for (Proceeds from) Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with the purchase (sale) of real estate held for investment, as opposed to operating, purposes.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstatePartnershipInvestmentNet
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstatePartnershipInvestmentNetAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCosts
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCostsAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTermInvestments
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-Term Investments
documentation: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTermInvestmentsAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-Term Investments [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForProceedsFromTenantAllowance
standard_label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Tenant Allowance
documentation: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

name: PaymentsForPurchaseOfInvestmentOperatingActivity
standard_label: Payment for Purchase, Investment, Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for acquisition of investment, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, funding, origination, drawdown, and participation in investment.

name: PaymentsForPurchaseOfOtherAssets
standard_label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Cash paid to purchase assets other than those represented by other elements (securities, loans, mortgages, real estate).

name: PaymentsForPurchaseOfOtherAssets1
standard_label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets
documentation: Amount of cash paid to purchase other assets as part of operating activities.

name: PaymentsForPurchaseOfSecuritiesOperatingActivities
standard_label: Payments for Purchase of Securities, Operating Activities
documentation: Cash paid to purchase debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

name: PaymentsForReinsurance
standard_label: Payments for Reinsurance
documentation: Cash payments made for reinsurance during the current period.

name: PaymentsForRemovalCosts
standard_label: Payments for Removal Costs
documentation: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

name: PaymentsForRent
standard_label: Payments for Rent
documentation: Cash payments to lessor's for use of assets under operating leases.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStockForEmployeeTaxWithholdingObligations
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock for Employee Tax Withholding Obligations (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for repurchase of common stock to satisfy employee tax withholding obligations for stock issued as part of an employee benefit plan.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfConvertiblePreferredStock
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity
documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquityAbstract
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfInitialPublicOffering
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Initial Public Offering
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEquity
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPreferredStockAndPreferenceStock
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPrivatePlacement
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Private Placement
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableConvertiblePreferredStock
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferredStock
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
documentation: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfTrustPreferredSecurities
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Trust Preferred Securities
documentation: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stocks issued by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

name: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfWarrants
standard_label: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
documentation: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

name: PaymentsForRestructuring
standard_label: Payments for Restructuring
documentation: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

name: PaymentsForRoyalties
standard_label: Payments for Royalties
documentation: The amount of cash paid for royalties during the current period.

name: PaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResell
standard_label: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
documentation: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

name: PaymentsForSoftware
standard_label: Payments for Software
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the development, modification or acquisition of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

name: PaymentsForSoftwareAbstract
standard_label: Payments for Software [Abstract]

name: PaymentsForTenantImprovements
standard_label: Payment for Leasehold Improvement, Lessor, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for cost of leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

name: PaymentsForTimeDeposits
standard_label: Payments for Time Deposits
documentation: Cash paid to customers who withdraw money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

name: PaymentsForUnderwritingExpense
standard_label: Payments for Underwriting Expense
documentation: Cash paid for expenses incurred during underwriting activities (the process to review insurance applications, evaluate risks, accept or reject applications, and determine the premiums to be charged) for insurance companies.

name: PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution
standard_label: Payments of Capital Distribution
documentation: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

name: PaymentsOfDebtExtinguishmentCosts
standard_label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

name: PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
documentation: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

name: PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts
standard_label: Payments of Debt Restructuring Costs
documentation: The cash outflow for cost incurred in the modification of term of existing debt agreement in order for the entity to achieve some advantage.

name: PaymentsOfDerivativeIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Payments of Derivative Issuance Costs
documentation: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of a derivative security.

name: PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffiliates
standard_label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
documentation: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

name: PaymentsOfDividends
standard_label: Payments of Dividends
documentation: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

name: PaymentsOfDividendsAbstract
standard_label: Payments of Dividends [Abstract]

name: PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock
standard_label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
documentation: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

name: PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInterest
standard_label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

name: PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStockAndPreferenceStock
standard_label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
documentation: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

name: PaymentsOfFinancingCosts
standard_label: Payments of Financing Costs
documentation: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

name: PaymentsOfFinancingCostsAbstract
standard_label: Payments of Financing Costs [Abstract]

name: PaymentsOfLoanCosts
standard_label: Payments of Loan Costs
documentation: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

name: PaymentsOfMergerRelatedCostsFinancingActivities
standard_label: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
documentation: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

name: PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends
standard_label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
documentation: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

name: PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividendsAbstract
standard_label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends [Abstract]

name: PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs
documentation: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.

name: PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInterestInSubsidiaries
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

name: PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstate
standard_label: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.

name: PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstateAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvestingActivities
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
documentation: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

name: PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecurities
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Available-for-Sale Securities (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The cash outflow to acquire debt and equity securities not classified as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities which would be classified as available-for-sale securities and reported at fair value, with unrealized gains and losses excluded from earnings and reported in a separate component of shareholders' equity.

name: PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebt
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecuritiesEquity
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Available-for-Sale Securities, Equity (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The cash outflow to acquire equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities, because they are not classified as trading securities.

name: PaymentsToAcquireBuildings
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Buildings
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessThreeNetOfCashAcquired
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Business Three, Net of Cash Acquired
documentation: The cash outflow associated with a third acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessTwoNetOfCashAcquired
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
documentation: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndInterestInAffiliates
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndInterestInAffiliatesAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

name: PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquiredAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealEstate
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Commercial Real Estate
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.

name: PaymentsToAcquireEquipmentOnLease
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease
documentation: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.

name: PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

name: PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritiesFvNi
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Equity Securities, FV-NI
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

name: PaymentsToAcquireFederalHomeLoanBankStock
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

name: PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveStock
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

name: PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

name: PaymentsToAcquireFurnitureAndFixtures
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Furniture and Fixtures
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of furniture and fixtures.

name: PaymentsToAcquireHeldForSaleRealEstate
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Real Estate, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

name: PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturitySecurities
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Held-to-Maturity Securities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

name: PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResearchAndDevelopment
standard_label: Payments to Acquire in Process Research and Development
documentation: The cash outflows from the purchase of net carrying value allocated to in-process research and development costs and materials acquired in a business combination.

name: PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
documentation: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

name: PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

name: PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliates
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

name: PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliatesAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Investments
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

name: PaymentsToAcquireInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Investments [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireLand
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Land
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLandHeldForUse
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Land, Held-for-Use
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of land for use; excludes purchases of land held as inventory or as investments.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLeaseReceivables
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Lease Receivables
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Lease, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicies
standard_label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartnershipInterests
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
documentation: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestmentAbstract
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestmentCreditCardSecuritizations
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment, Credit Card Securitization
documentation: The cash outflow from the purchase of securitized credit card receivables which are held for investment purposes. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Long-Term Investments
documentation: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.

name: PaymentsToAcquireManagementContractRights
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Management Contract Rights
documentation: The cash outflow from amounts paid for the rights to manage the property.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: PaymentsToAcquireMineralRights
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Mineral Rights
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a mineral right which is the right to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment, in the form of royalty, for the extraction of minerals.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Mining Assets
documentation: The cash outflow from the purchase of mining and mining related assets during the period.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBSCategorizedAsAvailableForSale
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBSCategorizedAsHeldToMaturity
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) categorized as Held-to-Maturity
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of securities issued by a governmental agency or corporation (for example, GNMA or FHLMC) or by private issuers (for example, banks and mortgage banking enterprises) secured by and repaid from underlying mortgages, which were designated as held to maturity when acquired.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesReceivable
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Notes Receivable
documentation: The cash outflow from the purchase of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate.

name: PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServicingRightsMSR
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
documentation: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable

name: PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable
documentation: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasEquipment
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Equipment
documentation: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset use for the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
documentation: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
documentation: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipmentAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOtherLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Other, Held-for-Investment
documentation: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
documentation: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: PaymentsToAcquireOtherReceivables
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Other Receivables
documentation: Amount of cash outflow from the purchase of receivables classified as other.

name: PaymentsToAcquirePartnersInterestInRealEstatePartnershipNetOfCashAcquired
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Partners Interest in Real Estate Partnership, Net of Cash Acquired
documentation: The cash outflow from the purchase of ownership in a partnership, the purpose of which is to construct, sell, hold or invest in real estate.

name: PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
documentation: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

name: PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireProjects
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Projects
documentation: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

name: PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

name: PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

name: PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRealEstateJointVentures
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

name: PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held for investment purposes.

name: PaymentsToAcquireReceivables
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Receivables
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

name: PaymentsToAcquireReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Receivables [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireResidentialRealEstate
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
documentation: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

name: PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCertificatesOfDeposit
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
documentation: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

name: PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
documentation: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

name: PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireRetainedInterestInSecuritizedReceivables
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of a retained interest in a receivable securitized via a structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

name: PaymentsToAcquireRoyaltyInterestsInMiningProperties
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Royalty Interests in Mining Properties
documentation: The cash outflow from the purchase of royalty interests in mining properties is the amount of cash the mineral producer pays the owner of the mine or mineral resource.

name: PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Short-Term Investments
documentation: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

name: PaymentsToAcquireSoftware
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Software
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

name: PaymentsToAcquireTimberlands
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Timberlands
documentation: The cash outflow for acquisition of timber and timberlands during the period.

name: PaymentsToAcquireTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Payment for Acquisition, Trading Security, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

name: PaymentsToAcquireTrustPreferredInvestments
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Trust Preferred Investments
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of trust preferred securities, which possess characteristics of both equity and debt securities.

name: PaymentsToAcquireUSGovernmentSecuritiesPledgedUnderBondIndenture
standard_label: Payments to Acquire US Government Securities Pledged under Bond Indenture (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The cash outflow from the purchase of US Government Securities Pledged Under Bond Indenture.

name: PaymentsToAcquireWasteWaterSystems
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Waste Water Systems
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

name: PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWaterSystems
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Water and Waste Water Systems
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities; and waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

name: PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWaterSystemsAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Water and Waste Water Systems [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToAcquireWaterSystems
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Water Systems
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

name: PaymentsToDevelopLiquefiedNaturalGasSites
standard_label: Payments to Develop Liquefied Natural Gas Sites (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The cash outflow for exploration and development of liquefied natural gas sites.

name: PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets
standard_label: Payments to Develop Real Estate Assets
documentation: Payments to develop real estate assets is the process of adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements; and are generally classified as cash flow from investing activities.

name: PaymentsToDevelopSoftware
standard_label: Payments to Develop Software
documentation: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

name: PaymentsToEmployees
standard_label: Payments to Employees
documentation: Payments of cash to employees, including wages and salaries, during the current period.

name: PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAndGasProperties
standard_label: Payments to Explore and Develop Oil and Gas Properties
documentation: The cash outflow for exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It includes cash payments related to development of oil and gas wells drilled at previously untested geologic structures (to determine the presence of oil or gas) and wells drilled at sites where the presence of oil or gas has already been established (to extract the oil or gas).

name: PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRelatedParties
standard_label: Payments to Fund Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
documentation: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

name: PaymentsToFundPolicyLoans
standard_label: Payments to Fund Policy Loans
documentation: The initial funding or additional funding of loans receivable to policy holders principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

name: PaymentsToInvestInDecommissioningFund
standard_label: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

name: PaymentsToMinorityShareholders
standard_label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
documentation: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

name: PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: PaymentsToPurchaseMortgageLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash outflow used to purchase loans that are secured with real estate mortgage and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: PaymentsToPurchaseOtherLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash outflow used to purchase loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: PaymentsToSuppliers
standard_label: Payments to Suppliers
documentation: Payments of cash to suppliers for goods and services during the current period.

name: PaymentsToSuppliersAndEmployees
standard_label: Payments to Suppliers and Employees
documentation: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

name: PaymentsToSuppliersAndEmployeesAbstract
standard_label: Payments to Suppliers and Employees [Abstract]

name: PendingLitigationMember
standard_label: Pending Litigation [Member]
documentation: Risk of loss associated with the outcome of pending litigation against the entity, for example, but not limited to, litigation in arbitration or within the trial process.

name: PendingOrThreatenedLitigationMember
standard_label: Pending or Threatened Litigation [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The risk of loss associated with the outcome of pending or threatened litigation against an entity.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostemploymentBenefitPlansLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostemploymentBenefitPlansLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Current
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as current.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostemploymentBenefitPlansLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostemploymentBenefitPlansLiabilitiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as noncurrent.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostemploymentBenefitPlansNoncurrentLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitContributions
standard_label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitContributionsAbstract
standard_label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpense
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
documentation: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost) [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Retirement Benefits [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for retirement benefits.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsExpenseReversalOfExpenseNoncash
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
documentation: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsExpenseReversalOfExpenseNoncashAbstract
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlansCurrentLiabilities
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlansLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlansLiabilitiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlansLiabilitiesNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlansNoncurrentLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan [Abstract]

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementPlansCostsMember
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Plans Costs [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of pension and other postretirement costs.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementPlansNonpensionBenefitsPolicy
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Plans, Nonpension Benefits, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for plans, other than pension plans, that provide postretirement benefits (including both defined benefit and defined contribution plans). This accounting policy may address (1) the types of plans sponsored by the entity, and the benefits provided by each plan (2) groups that participate in (or are covered by) each plan (3) how plan assets, liabilities and expenses are measured, including the use of any actuaries and (4) significant assumptions used by the entity

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementPlansPensionsPolicy
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Plans, Pensions, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for pension plans. This accounting policy may address (1) the types of plans sponsored by the entity (2) groups that participate in (or are covered by) each plan (3) how plan assets, liabilities and expenses are measured, including the use of any actuaries and (4) significant assumptions used by the entity to value plan assets and liabilities and how such assumptions are derived.

name: PensionAndOtherPostretirementPlansPolicy
standard_label: Pension and Other Postretirement Plans, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for pension and other postretirement benefit plans. This accounting policy may address (1) the types of plans sponsored by the entity, and the benefits provided by each plan (2) groups that participate in (or are covered by) each plan (3) how plan assets, liabilities and expenses are measured, including the use of any actuaries and (4) significant assumptions used by the entity to value plan assets and liabilities and how such assumptions are derived.

name: PensionContributions
standard_label: Payment for Pension Benefits
documentation: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

name: PensionCostMember
standard_label: Pension Cost [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Discloses the amount of regulatory liability arising from the difference between net periodic pension cost, according to US GAAP, and the amount of pension cost considered for rate-making purposes, according the actions of the regulator.

name: PensionCostsMember
standard_label: Pension Costs [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of pension costs.

name: PensionExpense
standard_label: Pension Cost (Reversal of Cost)
documentation: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

name: PensionExpenseReversalOfExpenseNoncash
standard_label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
documentation: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

name: PensionPlansDefinedBenefitMember
standard_label: Pension Plan [Member]
documentation: Plan designed to provide participant with pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

name: PercentageOfAmountAmortizedDuringNextFiveYearsAbstract
standard_label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Next Five Years [Abstract]

name: PercentageOfAmountAmortizedOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearFive
standard_label: Percentage of Amount Amortized of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Five (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Estimated percentage of the ending balance of the present value of the future insurance profits asset acquired in the purchase of an insurance entity to be amortized in the fifth year after the balance sheet date.

name: PercentageOfAmountAmortizedOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearFour
standard_label: Percentage of Amount Amortized of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Four (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Estimated percentage of the ending balance of the present value of the future insurance profits asset acquired in the purchase of an insurance entity to be amortized in the fourth year after the balance sheet date.

name: PercentageOfAmountAmortizedOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearOne
standard_label: Percentage of Amount Amortized of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year One (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Estimated percentage of the ending balance of the present value of future profits asset acquired in the purchase of an insurance entity to be amortized in the first year after the balance sheet date.

name: PercentageOfAmountAmortizedOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearThree
standard_label: Percentage of Amount Amortized of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Three (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Estimated percentage of the ending balance of the present value of the future insurance profits asset acquired in the purchase of an insurance entity to be amortized in the third year after the balance sheet date.

name: PercentageOfAmountAmortizedOfEndingPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsYearTwo
standard_label: Percentage of Amount Amortized of Ending Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Year Two (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Estimated percentage of the ending balance of the present value of the future insurance profits asset acquired in the purchase of an insurance entity to be amortized in the second year after the balance sheet date.

name: PercentageOfDebtHedgedByInterestRateDerivatives
standard_label: Percentage of Debt Hedged by Interest Rate Derivatives
documentation: Percentage of an entity's outstanding debt that is designated as a hedged item in cash flow, fair value, or net investment hedge.

name: PercentageOfFIFOInventory
standard_label: Percentage of FIFO Inventory
documentation: The percentage of FIFO (first in first out) inventory to total inventory as of the balance sheet date if other than 100 percent.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositLiabilitiesToDepositLiabilitiesAbstract
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit Liabilities to Deposit Liabilities [Abstract]

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositLiabilitiesToDepositLiabilitiesDescription
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit Liabilities to Deposit Liabilities, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of the percentage of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities. This disclosure may include methodology and assumptions as well as the percentages of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities for various types of domestic deposits.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDeposits
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsBrokered
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Brokered
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic brokered deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsCertificatesOfDeposit
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Certificates of Deposit
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsChecking
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Checking
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic checking demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsDemand
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Demand
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsMoneyMarket
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Money Market
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsNoticeOfWithdrawal
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Notice of Withdrawal
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic notice of withdrawal demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsOtherTimeDeposit
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Other Time Deposit
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic time deposit liabilities other than certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsRetail
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Retail
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic retail deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsSavings
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Savings
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepositsToDepositsTimeDeposits
standard_label: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Time Deposits
documentation: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic time deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

name: PercentageOfLIFOInventory
standard_label: Percentage of LIFO Inventory
documentation: The percentage of LIFO (last in first out) inventory to total inventory as of the balance sheet date if other than 100 percent.

name: PercentageOfParticipatingPoliciesDisclosure
standard_label: Percentage of Participating Policies, Disclosure (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Text which indicates the relative percentage of participating contracts in force as of the balance sheet date.

name: PercentageOfUnamortizedFilmCosts
standard_label: Percentage of Unamortized Film Costs (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The percentage of unamortized film costs for released films, excluding acquired film libraries, that it expects to amortize within three years from the date of the balance sheet.

name: PercentageOfUnamortizedFilmCostsDescription
standard_label: Percentage of Unamortized Film Costs, Description (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Additional information about the amortization of films costs, including the period required to reach an amortization level of 80 percent, for unamortized film costs for released films, excluding acquired film libraries, that it expects to amortize within three years from the date of the balance sheet.

name: PercentageOfWeightedAverageCostInventory
standard_label: Percentage of Weighted Average Cost Inventory
documentation: The percentage of weighted average cost inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is valued using different valuation methods.

name: PercentageRent
standard_label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Percentage Revenue (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: This element represents the rental revenue earned during the period from lessee-operators based on revenues generated in their operations, generally in excess of a base amount.
