name: PredecessorMember
standard_label: Predecessor [Member] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the designation of financial information as pertaining, but not limited, to a predecessor company or plan as defined in the context of the financial statements.

name: PreferredClassAMember
standard_label: Preferred Class A [Member]
documentation: Outstanding nonredeemable preferred class A stock or outstanding convertible preferred class A stock. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.

name: PreferredClassBMember
standard_label: Preferred Class B [Member]
documentation: Outstanding nonredeemable preferred class B stock or outstanding preferred class B stock. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.

name: PreferredNonConvertibleStockMember
standard_label: Preferred Nonconvertible Stock [Member]
documentation: Preferred shares which, at issuance, may not be exchanged into common shares or other types of securities. Preferred shares may provide a preferential dividend to the dividend on common stock and may take precedence over common stock in the event of liquidation. Preferred shares (which are neither mandatorily redeemable nor redeemable at the option of the holder) typically represent an ownership interest in the entity.

name: PreferredPartnerMember
standard_label: Preferred Partner [Member]
documentation: Partner with preferential rights over the limited partner in areas that could include, but are not limited to, liquidation, redemption, conversion, tax status of distribution or sharing in distributions.

name: PreferredStockAccretionOfRedemptionDiscount
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Accretion of Redemption Discount
documentation: The amount of accretion of the preferred stock redemption discount during the period.

name: PreferredStockAmountOfPreferredDividendsInArrears
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Amount of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
documentation: Aggregate amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

name: PreferredStockCallOrExerciseFeatures
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Call or Exercise Features
documentation: Describe call and/or exercise rights, prices and dates of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer).

name: PreferredStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
documentation: Aggregate number of nonredeemable preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

name: PreferredStockContractTerms
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Contract Terms
documentation: Significant terms of contract to issue additional shares or sinking fund requirements.

name: PreferredStockConversionBasis
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Conversion Basis
documentation: Describe the conversion features of preferred stock if preferred stock is convertible. That is, shares of preferred stock into which another convertible security was converted, or shares of preferred stock into which another class of preferred stock was converted.

name: PreferredStockConversionsInducements
standard_label: Preferred Stock Conversions, Inducements
documentation: The excess of (1) the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in transactions by the registrant to the holders of the convertible preferred stock over (2) the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms, during the accounting period.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleControlOfRightsFixedList
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Control of Rights [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates party controlling conversion right of preferred stock. Acceptable values are "Issuer" and "Holder".

name: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionDate
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Date
documentation: Date when preferred stock can be converted into common shares, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionPrice
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price
documentation: Per share conversion price of preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionPriceDecrease
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price, Decrease
documentation: Per share decrease in conversion price of convertible preferred stock. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionPriceIncrease
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price, Increase
documentation: Per share increase in conversion price of convertible preferred stock. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionRatio
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Ratio
documentation: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion for each share of preferred stock to be converted.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleDownRoundFeatureDecreaseInNetIncomeLossToCommonShareholderAmount
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Down Round Feature, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount

name: PreferredStockConvertibleDownRoundFeatureIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount1
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Down Round Feature, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for convertible preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleDownRoundFeatureTrigger
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Down Round Feature, Trigger [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether down round feature was triggered for convertible preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleSettlementMethodExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Settlement Method [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates method of settlement upon conversion of preferred stock. Includes, but is not limited to, cash, shares, or combination of cash and shares.

name: PreferredStockConvertibleSharesIssuable
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Shares Issuable
documentation: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion of preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockDiscountOnShares
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Discount on Shares
documentation: Discount on preferred shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

name: PreferredStockDividendPaymentRateVariable
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Payment Rate, Variable
documentation: Description of basis of dividend, such as adjustable rate. Excludes percentage rate dividend payments or fixed dollar amounts per share.

name: PreferredStockDividendPaymentTerms
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Payment Terms
documentation: Specific information regarding dividend payment dates or timing and whether or not dividends are paid on a cumulative basis.

name: PreferredStockDividendPreferenceOrRestrictions
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Preference or Restrictions
documentation: Priority of payment of dividends and restrictions on the payment of dividends, indicating the source, pertinent provisions and amount of retained earnings or net income restricted or free of restrictions.

name: PreferredStockDividendRatePerDollarAmount
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Per-Dollar-Amount
documentation: The amount per share used to calculated dividend payments on preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage
documentation: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments
standard_label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
documentation: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

name: PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustmentsAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments [Abstract]

name: PreferredStockDividendsIncomeStatementImpact
standard_label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
documentation: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

name: PreferredStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
documentation: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

name: PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Dividends Per Share, Declared
documentation: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

name: PreferredStockDividendsShares
standard_label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Shares
documentation: Number of shares of preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

name: PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapital
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital
documentation: Aggregate issuance value of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding.

name: PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital [Abstract]

name: PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapitalMember
standard_label: Preferred Stock Including Additional Paid in Capital [Member]
documentation: Preferred stock held by shareholders with par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock).

name: PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapitalNetOfDiscount
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
documentation: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

name: PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapitalNetOfDiscountAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount [Abstract]

name: PreferredStockLiquidationPreference
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share
documentation: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share.

name: PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value
documentation: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

name: PreferredStockMember
standard_label: Preferred Stock [Member]
documentation: Preferred shares may provide a preferential dividend to the dividend on common stock and may take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation. Preferred shares typically represent an ownership interest in the company.

name: PreferredStockNoParValue
standard_label: Preferred Stock, No Par Value
documentation: Face amount per share of no-par value preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockNumberOfSharesParValueAndOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
documentation: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockParticipationRights
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Participation Rights
documentation: Describe the contractual rights of preferred stockholders to receive dividends or returns from the entity's profits, cash flows, or returns on investments.

name: PreferredStockPerShareAmountsOfPreferredDividendsInArrears
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Per Share Amounts of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
documentation: Per share amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

name: PreferredStockReasonWhySecurityIsNotRedeemable
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Reason why Security is Not Redeemable
documentation: If the security is not redeemable currently (for example, because a contingency has not been met), and it is not probable that the security will become redeemable, provide the reason why it is not probable that the security will become redeemable.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmount
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount [Abstract]

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountAfterYearFive
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount, after Year Five
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date, redeemable after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountYearFive
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount, Year Five
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date, redeemable in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountYearFour
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount, Year Four
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date, redeemable in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountYearOne
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount, Year One
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date, redeemable in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountYearThree
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount, Year Three
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date, redeemable in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PreferredStockRedeemableMandatoryRedemptionAmountYearTwo
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable, Mandatory, Redemption Amount, Year Two
documentation: Amount of redemption of preferred stock redeemable at fixed or determinable price on fixed or determinable date, redeemable in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionAmount
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount
documentation: The redemption (or callable) amount of currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not currently declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionAmountFutureRedeemableSecurities
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount, Future Redeemable Securities
documentation: The redemption (or callable) amount of redeemable preferred stock, excluding currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionDate
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Date
documentation: Date the preferred stock has been redeemed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionDiscount
standard_label: Preferred Stock Redemption Discount
documentation: The excess of (1) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet over (2) the fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock, during the accounting period, which will be added to net earnings to arrive at net earnings available to common shareholders in the calculation of earnings per share.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionPremium
standard_label: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
documentation: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionPricePerShare
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share
documentation: The price per share at which the preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity is redeemed or may be called at. The redemption features of this preferred stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockRedemptionTerms
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Terms
documentation: The redemption terms of preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity. The redemption features of this capital stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockShareSubscriptions
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
documentation: The number of nonredeemable preferred stock (shares) (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of preferred stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

name: PreferredStockSharesAuthorized
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
documentation: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

name: PreferredStockSharesAuthorizedUnlimited
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized, Unlimited [Fixed List]
documentation: Indicates whether number of nonredeemable preferred shares, or preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer, permitted to be issued is unlimited. Acceptable value is "Unlimited".

name: PreferredStockSharesIssued
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
documentation: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

name: PreferredStockSharesOutstanding
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
documentation: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

name: PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissuedSubscriptionsReceivable
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
documentation: Amount of subscription receivable from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissuedValue
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Value, Subscriptions
documentation: Amount of subscription received from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

name: PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissuedValueAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Value [Abstract]

name: PreferredStockSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur. These shares 1) provide a specific, fixed, nonfluctuating dividend that is paid before any dividends are paid to common stock holders, 2) take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation, and 3) do not enjoy any of the voting rights of common stockholders.

name: PreferredStockTextBlock
standard_label: Preferred Stock [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for terms, amounts, nature of changes, rights and privileges, dividends, and other matters related to preferred stock.

name: PreferredStockValue
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
documentation: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

name: PreferredStockValueOutstanding
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Value, Outstanding
documentation: Value of nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer, held by shareholders. Excludes preferred shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

name: PreferredStockVotingRights
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Voting Rights
documentation: Description of voting rights of nonredeemable preferred stock. Includes eligibility to vote and votes per share owned. Include also, if any, unusual voting rights.

name: PreferredUnitsAuthorized
standard_label: Preferred Units, Authorized
documentation: The number of preferred units authorized to be issued.

name: PreferredUnitsByNameAxis
standard_label: Preferred Units by Name [Axis]
documentation: Information by type or class of preferred units or special units.

name: PreferredUnitsClassDomain
standard_label: Preferred Units, Class [Domain]
documentation: Type or class of preferred units or special units.

name: PreferredUnitsContributedCapital
standard_label: Preferred Units, Contributed Capital
documentation: The amount of capital contributed by the preferred partners.

name: PreferredUnitsCumulativeCashDistributions
standard_label: Preferred Units, Cumulative Cash Distributions
documentation: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the preferred partners.

name: PreferredUnitsCumulativeNetIncome
standard_label: Preferred Units, Cumulative Earnings
documentation: The amount of aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to preferred partners.

name: PreferredUnitsDescription
standard_label: Preferred Units, Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Description of the various rights, preferences, and privileges of the preferred partners' ownership units including: redemption, conversion, liquidation, tax status of distribution per unit and the sharing in distributions.

name: PreferredUnitsDescriptionAndOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Units Description and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: PreferredUnitsIssued
standard_label: Preferred Units, Issued
documentation: The number of preferred units issued.

name: PreferredUnitsLineItems
standard_label: Preferred Units [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: PreferredUnitsOfferingCosts
standard_label: Preferred Units, Offering Costs
documentation: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the preferred partners.

name: PreferredUnitsOutstanding
standard_label: Preferred Units, Outstanding
documentation: The number of preferred units outstanding.

name: PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAccountAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Account [Abstract]

name: PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAccounts
standard_label: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts
documentation: The amount of the preferred partners' ownership interests.

name: PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAccountsAbstract
standard_label: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts [Abstract]

name: PremiumDeficiencyTestingExpenseLongDurationContractAmount
standard_label: Premium Deficiency Testing Expense, Long-Duration Contract, Amount
documentation: Amount of expense for premium deficiency and loss recognition testing on long-duration contract issued by insurance entity. Excludes closed block.

name: PremiumIncomeSubjectToParticipationThroughReinsurancePercentage
standard_label: Premium Income Subject to Participation Through Reinsurance, Percentage (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Ratio of premium income to reinsurance.

name: PremiumIncomeSubjectToParticipationThroughReinsuranceValue
standard_label: Premium Income Subject to Participation Through Reinsurance, Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Income received through assuming risk from other insurers.

name: PremiumReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossTableTextBlock
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of allowance for credit loss on premium receivable.

name: PremiumReceivableCreditLossExpenseReversal
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
documentation: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on premium receivable.

name: PremiumsAndOtherReceivablesNet
standard_label: Premiums and Other Receivables, Net
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of allowance for doubtful accounts, of all premiums and other types of receivables due from other persons or entities.

name: PremiumsAndOtherReceivablesNetAbstract
standard_label: Premiums and Other Receivables, Net [Abstract]

name: PremiumsEarnedNet
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

name: PremiumsEarnedNetAccidentAndHealth
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Accident and Health (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of accident and health premiums earned.

name: PremiumsEarnedNetAccidentAndHealthAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Accident and Health [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsEarnedNetByBusinessAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, by Business [Abstract] (Deprecated 2025)

name: PremiumsEarnedNetByProductSegmentAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, by Product Segment [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsEarnedNetFinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContracts
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of financial guarantee premiums earned.

name: PremiumsEarnedNetFinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContractsAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsEarnedNetLife
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Life (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of life premiums earned.

name: PremiumsEarnedNetLifeAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Life [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsEarnedNetOtherInsurance
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Other Insurance (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of other types of premiums earned.

name: PremiumsEarnedNetOtherInsuranceAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Other Insurance [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsEarnedNetPropertyAndCasualty
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of property and casualty premiums earned.

name: PremiumsEarnedNetPropertyAndCasualtyAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Earned, Net, Property and Casualty [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsNetLifeInsuranceInForce
standard_label: Premiums, Net, Life Insurance in Force (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of life insurance in force premiums.

name: PremiumsNetLifeInsuranceInForceAbstract
standard_label: Premiums, Net, Life Insurance in Force [Abstract] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

name: PremiumsPercentageAssumedToNet
standard_label: SEC Schedule, 12-17, Insurance Companies, Reinsurance, Premium, Percentage Assumed to Net
documentation: Percentage of assumed premium earned to premium earned after effects of reinsurance, as disclosed in supplementary reinsurance information.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccounts
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
documentation: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsAdditionsForChargesToExpense
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Additions for Charges to Expense (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount of increase in the allowance for premiums receivable from charges to expense.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsEstimationMethodologyPolicy
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Estimation Methodology, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the estimated allowance for doubtful accounts for premium amounts due from policyholders, insureds, and other insurance entities. May include factors that management considered, such as historical loss experience and current economic and competitive conditions.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsProvisionChargedToExpense
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Provision Charged to Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount charged against earnings during the period to provide for known and estimated losses on collections of premiums receivable.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsProvisionChargedToExpense1
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Provision Charged to Expense (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Amount of expense for known and estimated loss on collection of premiums receivable.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRecoveries
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
documentation: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable from recovery.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsRollForward
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsWriteOffsAgainstAllowance
standard_label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
documentation: Amount of writeoff of premium receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

name: PremiumsReceivableAtCarryingValue
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Net
documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, net of the allowance for doubtful accounts.

name: PremiumsReceivableBalanceAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Balance [Abstract]

name: PremiumsReceivableBasisOfAccountingPolicy
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Basis of Accounting, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the gross carrying amount of premiums due from policyholders, insureds, and other insurance entities.

name: PremiumsReceivableDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Receivable Disclosure [Abstract]

name: PremiumsReceivableFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of amount receivable on insurance policies.

name: PremiumsReceivableFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: PremiumsReceivableFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: PremiumsReceivableGainLossOnSaleOfReceivables
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sale of Receivables
documentation: The aggregate amount of gains or losses on transfers of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

name: PremiumsReceivableGross
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Gross
documentation: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, before deducting the allowance for doubtful accounts.

name: PremiumsReceivableMember
standard_label: Premiums Receivable [Member]
documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others.

name: PremiumsReceivableNetAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Net [Abstract]

name: PremiumsReceivableNote
standard_label: Premiums Receivable Note [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for premium amounts receivable by an insurance entity.

name: PremiumsReceivableProceedsFromSaleOfReceivables
standard_label: Premiums Receivable, Proceeds from Sale of Receivables
documentation: The amount of proceeds from the transfer of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

name: PremiumsWrittenAndEarnedAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written and Earned [Abstract]

name: PremiumsWrittenAndEarnedMethodologyAndAssumptions
standard_label: Premiums Written and Earned, Methodology and Assumptions
documentation: Methodology and assumptions regarding premiums written and earned directly by insurer for all insurance and before adding contracts assumed from other insurers or subtracting any amounts ceded to other insurers.

name: PremiumsWrittenAssumedCededAndEarnedAndIndustryRatiosAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Assumed, Ceded and Earned and Industry Ratios [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsWrittenGross
standard_label: Premiums Written, Gross
documentation: Amount of direct and assumed premiums written.

name: PremiumsWrittenGrossAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Gross [Abstract]

name: PremiumsWrittenNet
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net
documentation: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

name: PremiumsWrittenNetAccidentAndHealth
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Accident and Health (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Premiums written for all accident and health insurance and reinsurance contracts after subtracting any amounts ceded to another insurer.

name: PremiumsWrittenNetAccidentAndHealthAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Accident and Health [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsWrittenNetConsolidatedAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net [Abstract]

name: PremiumsWrittenNetFinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContracts
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Premiums written for all financial guarantee insurance contracts and reinsurance contracts after subtracting any amounts ceded to another insurer.

name: PremiumsWrittenNetFinancialGuaranteeInsuranceContractsAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsWrittenNetLife
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Life (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Premiums written for all life insurance and reinsurance contracts after subtracting any amounts ceded to another insurer.

name: PremiumsWrittenNetLifeAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Life [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsWrittenNetOtherInsurance
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Other Insurance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Premiums written for all other insurance and reinsurance contracts after subtracting any amounts ceded to another insurer.

name: PremiumsWrittenNetOtherInsuranceAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Other Insurance [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PremiumsWrittenNetPropertyAndCasualty
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Premiums written for all property and casualty insurance and reinsurance contracts after subtracting any amounts ceded to another insurer.

name: PremiumsWrittenNetPropertyAndCasualtyAbstract
standard_label: Premiums Written, Net, Property and Casualty [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PrepaidAdvertising
standard_label: Prepaid Advertising
documentation: Amount of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidCongressionallyMandatedAssessments
standard_label: Prepaid Congressionally Mandated Assessments (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount prepaid for Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments, for example, but not limited to, Resolution Funding Corporation (REFCORP) assessments.

name: PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssets
standard_label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets.

name: PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets [Abstract]

name: PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current [Abstract]

name: PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsNoncurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: PrepaidExpenseCurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Expense, Current
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidExpenseCurrentAbstract
standard_label: Prepaid Expense, Current [Abstract]

name: PrepaidExpenseCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Expense
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs.

name: PrepaidExpenseNoncurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent
documentation: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidExpenseNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent [Abstract]

name: PrepaidExpenseOtherNoncurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Expense Other, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidExpensesAndOtherCurrentAssetsMember
standard_label: Prepaid Expenses and Other Current Assets [Member] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Primary financial statement caption encompassing prepaid expenses and other current assets.

name: PrepaidInsurance
standard_label: Prepaid Insurance
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidInterest
standard_label: Prepaid Interest
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidMineralRoyaltiesNoncurrent
standard_label: Prepaid Mineral Royalties, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized amounts paid for mineral royalties which will be charged against earnings after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidPensionCosts
standard_label: Prepaid Pension Costs (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Cumulative employer's contributions in excess of net pension cost recognized, before the adoption of the recognition provisions of FAS 158. Under FAS 158, prepaid pension costs are no longer recognized in the statement of financial position. Note that there is a separate concept for noncurrent assets relating to defined benefit pension and other defined benefit postretirement plans for use under the recognition provisions of FAS 158.

name: PrepaidReinsurancePremiums
standard_label: Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
documentation: The unexpired portion of premiums ceded on policies in force as of the balance sheet date.

name: PrepaidReinsurancePremiumsAbstract
standard_label: Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums [Abstract] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

name: PrepaidReinsurancePremiumsMethodologyAndAssumptions
standard_label: Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums, Methodology and Assumptions (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Methodology and assumptions used to determine the amounts paid to the reinsurer relating to the unexpired portion of reinsured contracts.

name: PrepaidRent
standard_label: Prepaid Rent
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidRoyalties
standard_label: Prepaid Royalties
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepaidStoredValueProductsBreakageMethodology
standard_label: Prepaid Stored-value Products, Breakage Methodology
documentation: Description of methodology used to recognize unredeemed portion of dollar value of prepaid stored-value products.

name: PrepaidStoredValueProductsBreakageSignificantJudgment
standard_label: Prepaid Stored-value Products, Breakage, Significant Judgment
documentation: Description of judgment made in applying breakage methodology for unredeemed portion of dollar value of prepaid stored-value products.

name: PrepaidTaxes
standard_label: Prepaid Taxes
documentation: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: PrepayableFinancialAssetClosedPortfolioLastOfLayerAmortizedCost
standard_label: Financial Asset, Closed Portfolio, Portfolio Layer Method, Amortized Cost
documentation: Amortized cost of closed portfolio of financial asset used to designate hedging relationship in which hedged item is expected to be outstanding for designated hedged period.

name: PrepaymentFeesOnAdvancesNet
standard_label: Prepayment Fees on Advances, Net
documentation: Amount of income earned, after hedging basis adjustments, from fees charged for prepayment of certain Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances before original maturity.

name: PrepaymentRiskMember
standard_label: Prepayment Risk [Member]
documentation: The risk associated with the early unscheduled return of principal on a loan or debt security.

name: PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSupplyArrangementsAbstract
standard_label: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements [Abstract]

name: PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSupplyArrangementsAssetForMoldsDiesAndToolsNotOwned
standard_label: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements, Asset for Molds Dies and Tools Not Owned
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of molds, dies, and other tools that the entity does not own which are or will be used in producing goods under a long-term supply arrangement, and for which there is a noncancelable right of use during such arrangement.

name: PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSupplyArrangementsAssetForMoldsDiesAndToolsOwned
standard_label: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements, Asset for Molds Dies and Tools Owned
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of molds, dies, and other tools that will be used in producing products under a long-term supply arrangement.

name: PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSupplyArrangementsCostsCapitalized
standard_label: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements, Costs Capitalized
documentation: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized preproduction costs incurred on long-term supply arrangements, including recoverable costs to design and develop products.

name: PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSupplyArrangementsDisclosures
standard_label: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-term Supply Arrangements Disclosures (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of the nature of preproduction costs incurred on long-term supply arrangements to design and develop products, and to build the molds, dies, and tools that will be used to produce the products. Such design work can occur for several years before the commencement of actual production. These arrangements are also known as tooling.

name: PrerequisitesForBillingLongTermContracts
standard_label: Prerequisites for Billing, Long-Term Contracts
documentation: General description of the prerequisites for billing under the terms of long-term contracts.

name: PrescriptionDrugBenefitEffectOfSubsidyOnNetPeriodicPostretirementBenefitCost
standard_label: Prescription Drug Benefit, Effect of Subsidy on Net Periodic Postretirement Benefit Cost (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the effect of the government subsidy for prescription drug benefits on the measurement of net periodic postretirement benefit cost for the current period. That effect includes (1) any amortization of the actuarial experience gain, (2) the reduction in current period service cost due to the subsidy, and (3) the resulting reduction in interest cost on the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation as a result of the subsidy. Disclosure relates to the first period in which an employer

name: PrescriptionDrugBenefitEffectOfSubsidyOnNetPeriodicPostretirementBenefitCost1
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit, Net Periodic Postretirement Benefit Cost, (Increase) Decrease for Subsidy
documentation: Amount of (increase) decrease in net periodic benefit cost from government subsidy for prescription drug benefits.

name: PrescriptionDrugBenefitReductionInAccumulatedPostretirementBenefitObligationForSubsidy
standard_label: Prescription Drug Benefit, Reduction in Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation for Subsidy (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the reduction in the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for the government subsidy related to prescription drug benefits attributed to past service. Disclosure relates to the first period in which an employer includes the effects of the subsidy in measuring the accumulated postretirement benefit obligation and net periodic postretirement benefit cost.

name: PrescriptionDrugBenefitSubsidyEffectNotDetermined
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit Subsidy, Effect Not Determined [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act exists and accumulated postretirement benefit obligation or net periodic postretirement benefit cost (credit) does not reflect amount associated with government subsidy for prescription drug benefit because employer is unable to conclude whether benefit provided by plan is actuarially equivalent to Medicare Part D under Act.

name: PrescriptionDrugSubsidyReceiptsAfterYearFive
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, after Year Five
documentation: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PrescriptionDrugSubsidyReceiptsFiveFiscalYearsThereafter
standard_label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Five Fiscal Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Aggregate amount for the next five fiscal years following the first five fiscal years (that is the aggregate of fiscal years six through ten) following the balance sheet date of the prescription drug subsidy receipts expected to be received.

name: PrescriptionDrugSubsidyReceiptsNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts to be received in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: PrescriptionDrugSubsidyReceiptsNextTwelveMonths
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year One
documentation: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

name: PrescriptionDrugSubsidyReceiptsRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Remainder of Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount of the prescription drug subsidy receipts to be received in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

documentation: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

name: PrincipalTransactionsRevenueAbstract
standard_label: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net [Abstract]

name: PrincipleTransactionRevenueDescriptionOfReportingCategoryAxis
standard_label: Principal Transaction Revenue, Description of Reporting Category [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Information by reporting category or type of financial instruments related to a group of items that represent revenue.

name: PrincipleTransactionRevenueLineItems
standard_label: Principal Transaction Revenue [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: PrincipleTransactionRevenueTable
standard_label: Principal Transaction Revenue [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about revenue from trading for broker-dealer's own account by reporting category or type of financial instrument, including, but not limited to, derivative. Excludes dividend and interest.

name: PriorInabilityToDeliverOrMeetOilAndGasDeliveryCommitmentsAndContracts
standard_label: Prior Inability to Deliver or Meet Oil and Gas Delivery Commitments and Contracts (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: If within the last three years any significant delivery obligation has been unmet, the circumstances and impact concerning such event.

name: PriorPeriodAdjustmentAbstract
standard_label: Prior Period Adjustment [Abstract]

name: PriorPeriodReclassificationAdjustment
standard_label: Prior Period Reclassification Adjustment
documentation: The amount of a reclassification adjustment made to prior period financial statement amounts.

name: PriorPeriodReclassificationAdjustmentAbstract
standard_label: Prior Period Reclassification Adjustment [Abstract] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

name: PriorPeriodReclassificationAdjustmentDescription
standard_label: Reclassification, Comparability Adjustment [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for reclassification affecting comparability of financial statement. Excludes amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, and correction of error.

name: PrivateCompanyAccountsReceivableAndContractAssetCreditLossCurrentSubsequentCollectionActivityDate
standard_label: Private Company, Accounts Receivable and Contract Asset from Contract with Customer, Credit Loss, Current, Subsequent Collection Activity, Date
documentation: Date through which subsequent collection activity is considered by private company when developing estimate of expected credit loss for accounts receivable and contract asset from contract with customer, classified as current, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: PrivateCompanyAccountsReceivableAndContractWithCustomersCreditLossCurrentPolicyElection
standard_label: Private Company, Accounts Receivable and Contract Asset from Contract with Customer, Credit Loss, Current, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company, that elected practical expedient to assume current condition as of statement of financial position date does not change for remaining life of asset, elected accounting policy to consider collection activity after statement of financial position date but before financial statement is available to be issued when developing estimate of expected credit loss for accounts receivable and contract asset from contract with customer, classified as current.

name: PrivateCompanyBusinessCombinationEntityUnderCommonControlElection
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to apply accounting alternative for not evaluating nonconsolidated entity under common control for application of variable interest entity (VIE) guidance.

name: PrivateCompanyBusinessCombinationIdentifiableIntangibleAssetElection
standard_label: Private Company, Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to apply accounting alternative for not recognizing eligible intangible asset separately from goodwill in transaction applying acquisition method for business combination, applying equity method of accounting, adopting fresh-start reporting in reorganization, or accounting for formation of joint venture.

name: PrivateCompanyDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationGoodwillAfterAmortizationExpenseAndImpairmentLoss
standard_label: Private Company, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, after Amortization Expense and Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount, after amortization expense and impairment loss, of goodwill of private company attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

name: PrivateCompanyDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationGoodwillAmortizationExpenseAndImpairmentLoss
standard_label: Private Company, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Amortization Expense and Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of amortization expense and impairment loss for goodwill of private company attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

name: PrivateCompanyFranchisorPreopeningServiceDistinctPolicyElection
standard_label: Private Company, Franchisor, Preopening Service, Distinct from Franchise License, Practical Expedient Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected practical expedient to account for preopening service as distinct from franchise license.

name: PrivateCompanyFranchisorPreopeningServiceSinglePerformanceObligationPolicyElection
standard_label: Private Company, Franchisor, Preopening Service, Single Performance Obligation, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to recognize preopening service as single performance obligation.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAccumulatedAmortization
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, Accumulated Amortization
documentation: Amount of accumulated amortization of goodwill of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAfterAmortizationExpenseAndImpairmentLoss
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, after Accumulated Amortization Expense and Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount, after accumulated amortization expense and impairment loss, of goodwill of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAfterAmortizationExpenseAndImpairmentLossAbstract
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, after Accumulated Amortization Expense and Impairment Loss [Abstract]

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAmortizationElection
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill Amortization, Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to amortize goodwill.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAmortizationExpense
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill Amortization Expense
documentation: Amount of amortization expense for goodwill of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAmortizationExpenseAndImpairmentLoss
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill Amortization Expense and Impairment Loss
documentation: Amount of amortization expense and impairment loss for goodwill of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAmortizationExpenseAndImpairmentLossAbstract
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill Amortization Expense and Impairment Loss [Abstract]

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAmortizationPeriod
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, Amortization Period
documentation: Period of amortization for goodwill of private company, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillAmortizationPeriodWeightedAverage
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, Amortization Period, Weighted-Average
documentation: Weighted-average period of amortization of goodwill of private company, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillDerecognized
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, Derecognized
documentation: Amount of goodwill derecognized that was not previously reported in disposal group by private company.

name: PrivateCompanyGoodwillImpairmentLossAllocationMethodToAmortizableUnitDescription
standard_label: Private Company, Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Allocation Method to Amortizable Unit, Description
documentation: Description of method used to allocate impairment loss to amortizable unit of goodwill of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyIncomeTaxReconcilingItemDescription
standard_label: Private Company, Income Tax Reconciling Item, Description
documentation: Description of nature and effect of reconciling item and jurisdiction for private company resulting in difference between statutory and effective tax rate.

name: PrivateCompanyLeaseEntityUnderCommonControlPolicyElection
standard_label: Private Company, Lease, Entity under Common Control, Practical Expedient Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected practical expedient to use written terms and conditions of related party arrangement for entity under common control to determine if arrangement is or contains lease.

name: PrivateCompanyLeaseRiskFreeRatePolicyElection
standard_label: Private Company, Lease, Risk-Free Rate, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to use risk-free rate as discount rate for lease arrangement.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlDescription
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control, Description
documentation: Description of nature and risk associated with private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative and how involvement affects financial position, financial performance, and cash flow.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlExcessExposureDescription
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control, Excess Exposure, Description
documentation: Description of excess exposure to loss associated with private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative. Includes, but is not limited to, terms of arrangement, financial support requirement, and event or circumstance that could cause exposure to loss.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlLineItems
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlMaximumLossExposureAmount
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
documentation: Amount of maximum exposure to loss from private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlMaximumLossExposureNotQuantified
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control, Maximum Loss Exposure, Not Quantified [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether maximum exposure to loss cannot be quantified from private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlMember
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control [Member]
documentation: Nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative by private company.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlTable
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlTableTextBlock
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative.

name: PrivateCompanyNonconsolidatedEntityUnderCommonControlTextBlock
standard_label: Private Company, Nonconsolidated Entity under Common Control [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for private company involvement with nonconsolidated entity under common control for which variable interest entity (VIE) guidance is not applied under accounting alternative.

name: PrivateCompanyRevenueEconomicFactorDescription
standard_label: Private Company, Revenue, Economic Factor, Description
documentation: Description of how economic factor affects nature, amount, timing, and uncertainty of revenue and cash flow of private company. Includes, but is not limited to, type of customer, geographical location of customer, and type of contract.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementCalculatedValueAssumptionHistoricalVolatilityDescription
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Calculated Value Assumption, Historical Volatility, Description
documentation: Description of reason it is impracticable to estimate expected volatility of share price and for selecting industry sector index, and how index was used to calculate historical volatility for award under share-based payment arrangement of private company using calculated value.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementCalculatedValueAssumptionHistoricalVolatilityIndustrySectorSelectedExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Calculated Value Assumption, Historical Volatility, Industry Sector [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates industry sector used to estimate volatility of award under share-based payment arrangement of private company using calculated value.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementCalculatedValueAssumptionValuationTechniqueExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Calculated Value Assumption, Valuation Technique [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates valuation technique used to estimate calculated value of award under share-based payment arrangement of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementCalculatedValueMeasurementInput
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Calculated Value, Measurement Input
documentation: Value of input used to measure calculated value of award under share-based payment arrangement of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementCalculatedValueMeasurementInputExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Calculated Value, Measurement Input [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates measurement input used to estimate calculated value of award under share-based payment arrangement of private company.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementCurrentPriceInputPracticalExpedientElection
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Current Price Input, Practical Expedient Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to apply practical expedient for reasonable valuation method as current price of its underlying share for determining fair value of award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementEstimateExpectedTermPracticalExpedientElection
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Estimate Expected Term, Practical Expedient Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to apply practical expedient to estimate expected term of award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementLiabilityIntrinsicValueElection
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Liability, Intrinsic Value Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to use intrinsic value to measure liability of award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: PrivateCompanyShareBasedPaymentArrangementOptionsGrantsInPeriodGrantDateCalculatedValue
standard_label: Private Company, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Grant-Date Calculated Value, Per Share
documentation: Per-share calculated value at grant date of award under share-based payment arrangement of private company.

name: PrivateCompanySimplifiedHedgeAccountingApproachPolicyElection
standard_label: Private Company, Simplified Hedge Accounting Approach, Policy Election [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether private company elected to apply simplified hedge accounting approach to cash flow hedge of variable-rate borrowing with receive-variable, pay-fixed interest rate swap.

name: PrivateCompanySimplifiedHedgeAccountingApproachSettlementValueAssetAfterOffset
standard_label: Private Company, Simplified Hedge Accounting Approach, Settlement Value, Asset, after Offset
documentation: Settlement value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of asset for cash flow hedge of variable-rate borrowing with receive-variable, pay-fixed interest rate swap under simplified hedge accounting approach used by private company.

name: PrivateCompanySimplifiedHedgeAccountingApproachSettlementValueAssetBeforeOffset
standard_label: Private Company, Simplified Hedge Accounting Approach, Settlement Value, Asset, before Offset
documentation: Settlement value, before effect of master netting arrangement, of asset for cash flow hedge of variable-rate borrowing with receive-variable, pay-fixed interest rate swap under simplified hedge accounting approach used by private company.

name: PrivateCompanySimplifiedHedgeAccountingApproachSettlementValueLiabilityAfterOffset
standard_label: Private Company, Simplified Hedge Accounting Approach, Settlement Value, Liability, after Offset
documentation: Settlement value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of liability for cash flow hedge of variable-rate borrowing with receive-variable, pay-fixed interest rate swap under simplified hedge accounting approach used by private company.

name: PrivateCompanySimplifiedHedgeAccountingApproachSettlementValueLiabilityBeforeOffset
standard_label: Private Company, Simplified Hedge Accounting Approach, Settlement Value, Liability, before Offset
documentation: Settlement value, before effect of master netting arrangement, of liability for cash flow hedge of variable-rate borrowing with receive-variable, pay-fixed interest rate swap under simplified hedge accounting approach used by private company.

name: PrivateCompanySupplementalAbstract
standard_label: Private Company Supplemental [Abstract]

name: PrivateEquityFundsDomesticMember
standard_label: Private Equity Funds, US [Member]
documentation: Private equity fund investing in company domiciled in United States of America (US).

name: PrivateEquityFundsForeignMember
standard_label: Private Equity Funds, Non-US [Member]
documentation: Private equity fund investing in company not domiciled in United States of America (US).

name: PrivateEquityFundsMember
standard_label: Private Equity Funds [Member]
documentation: Investments held in private equity funds.

name: PrivatePlacementMember
standard_label: Private Placement [Member]
documentation: A private placement is a direct offering of securities to a limited number of sophisticated investors such as insurance companies, pension funds, mezzanine funds, stock funds and trusts.

name: ProFormaMember
standard_label: Pro Forma [Member]
documentation: Financial information that is based on fully or partially assumed figures or facts. For example, but not limited to, pro forma disclosure of a change in accounting principle of what earnings would have been if the new principle had been applied. Excludes forecasts.

name: ProFormaWeightedAverageSharesOutstandingDiluted
standard_label: Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
documentation: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

name: ProceedsAccountsReceivablePreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Accounts Receivable, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of accounts receivable previously written off.

name: ProceedsAndExcessTaxBenefitFromSharebasedCompensation
standard_label: Proceeds and Excess Tax Benefit from Share-Based Compensation (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: The aggregate cash inflow comprised of the amount received from (a) employees to acquire the entity's shares under incentive awards, including stock option exercises and restricted stock arrangements, and (b) the excess tax benefit arising from such transactions.

name: ProceedsContractWithCustomerAssetPreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Contract with Customer, Asset, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, previously written off.

name: ProceedsDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSalePreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), previously written off.

name: ProceedsDebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityPreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), previously written off.

name: ProceedsDirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLeasePreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in direct financing lease, previously written off.

name: ProceedsFinancialAssetPreviouslyWrittenOffRecoveryAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds, Financial Asset, Previously Written off, Recovery [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromAccountsReceivableSecuritization
standard_label: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization
documentation: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

name: ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContributionInAidOfConstructionFinancingActivity
standard_label: Proceeds from Advance for and Contribution in Aid of Construction, Financing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from advance for and contribution in aid of construction, classified as financing activity.

name: ProceedsFromAdvancesForConstruction
standard_label: Proceeds from Advance for Construction, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, borrowing from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

name: ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertificates
standard_label: Proceeds from Annuities and Investment Certificates
documentation: The cash inflow from an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

name: ProceedsFromBankDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Bank Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

name: ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFromOtherOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks
standard_label: Proceeds from Bonds Transferred from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability for consolidated obligations of another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

name: ProceedsFromCollaborators
standard_label: Proceeds from Collaborators
documentation: Cash received from collaborators during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceToAffiliate
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
documentation: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfFinanceReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfLeaseReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
