documentation: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Held-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongtermLoansToRelatedParties
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
documentation: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes loans that are not mortgages.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Other Receivables
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfPaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRelatedPartiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-Term Loans to Related Parties [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfPolicyLoans
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Policy Loans
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the collection of policy loans receivable.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterestInSecuritizedReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterestInSecuritizedReceivablesCategorizedAsAvailableForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterestInSecuritizedReceivablesCategorizedAsHeldToMaturity
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Held-to-Maturity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at amortized cost.

name: ProceedsFromCommissionsReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Commissions Received
documentation: Cash received for commissions during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromConstructionLoansPayable
standard_label: Proceeds from Construction Loans Payable
documentation: The cash inflow from borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

name: ProceedsFromContributedCapital
standard_label: Proceeds from Contributed Capital
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received by a corporation from a shareholder during the period.

name: ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfConstruction
standard_label: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from contribution in aid of construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, contribution from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

name: ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates
standard_label: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates
documentation: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

name: ProceedsFromContributionsFromParent
standard_label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
documentation: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

name: ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ProceedsFromCryptoAssetOperatingActivity
standard_label: Proceeds from Crypto Asset, Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of crypto asset received as noncash consideration in ordinary course of business and converted nearly immediately into cash. Includes, but is not limited to, in exchange for product and service transferred to customer. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

name: ProceedsFromCustomers
standard_label: Proceeds from Customers
documentation: Cash receipts from customers during the current period which are usually for sales of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromCustomersForProgressPayments
standard_label: Proceeds from Customers for Progress Payments
documentation: Cash received from customers as progress payments on projects that have been partially completed.

name: ProceedsFromDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonths
standard_label: Proceeds from Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes proceeds from long-term and short-term debt.

name: ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts
standard_label: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
documentation: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

name: ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund
standard_label: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

name: ProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptExchange
standard_label: Proceeds from Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
documentation: Cash inflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

name: ProceedsFromDemandSideManagementProgram
standard_label: Proceeds from Demand Side Management Program (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: The cash inflow related to any range of actions associated with reducing demand for electricity, gas, or other utilities and efforts to shift demand from peak to off-peak times.

name: ProceedsFromDepositsAppliedToDebtRetirements
standard_label: Proceeds from Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
documentation: Cash inflow received during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed to the entity.

name: ProceedsFromDepositsFromCustomers
standard_label: Proceeds from Deposits from Customers
documentation: Cash received from customers for deposits on goods or services during the period; excludes deposits with other institutions and time deposits, which pertain to financial services entities.

name: ProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstateSales
standard_label: Proceeds from Deposits on Real Estate Sales
documentation: Cash inflow related to amounts received in advance from a potential buyer showing or confirming an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

name: ProceedsFromDepositsWithOtherInstitutions
standard_label: Proceeds from Deposits with Other Institutions
documentation: Cash received from refund of deposits with other institutions during the period.

name: ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentFinancingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
documentation: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

name: ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentInvestingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
documentation: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

name: ProceedsFromDisposalCryptoAsset
standard_label: Proceeds from Disposal, Crypto Asset
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from disposal of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

name: ProceedsFromDispositionOfInvestmentOperatingActivity
standard_label: Proceeds from Disposition of Investment, Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, repayment, principal payment, paydown, and maturity of investment.

name: ProceedsFromDistributionOfRestrictedCashFromPollutionControlBond
standard_label: Proceeds from Distribution of Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
documentation: The cash inflow from amounts received from distributions of restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

name: ProceedsFromDistributionsReceivedFromRealEstatePartnerships
standard_label: Proceeds from Distributions Received from Real Estate Partnerships
documentation: The cash inflow from earnings received from real estate partnerships.

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesAndInterestsInAffiliates
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesAndInterestsInAffiliatesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOfCashDivested
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
documentation: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOfCashDivestedAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInConsolidatedSubsidiaries
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJointVenture
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliates
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsidiariesAndAffiliatesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromDivestitureOfRealEstatePartnership
standard_label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Real Estate Partnership
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of interest in partnership during the period.

name: ProceedsFromDividendsReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Dividends Received
documentation: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributionsReturnOfCapital
standard_label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
documentation: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances
standard_label: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

name: ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowings
standard_label: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

name: ProceedsFromFeesReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Fees Received
documentation: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

name: ProceedsFromFinancingRevenueReceivedUnderLeases
standard_label: Proceeds from Financing Revenue Received under Leases (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Financing revenue received under leases during the current period by an entity that provides financial services.

name: ProceedsFromGrantors
standard_label: Proceeds from Grantors
documentation: Cash received from grantors during the current period related to operating activities. This element represents receipts from a guarantor for the amount of guarantee provided.

name: ProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
documentation: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

name: ProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
documentation: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

name: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundFederal
standard_label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, Federal
documentation: Amount of cash received from federal tax jurisdiction for refund of tax on income. Includes, but is not limited to, national tax received for non-U.S. jurisdiction.

name: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundForeign
standard_label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, Foreign
documentation: Amount of cash received from foreign tax jurisdiction for refund of tax on income.

name: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundStateAndLocal
standard_label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, State and Local
documentation: Amount of cash received from state and local tax jurisdictions for refund of tax on income.

name: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds
standard_label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
documentation: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

name: ProceedsFromInsurancePremiumsCollected
standard_label: Proceeds from Insurance Premiums Collected
documentation: Cash received as payments for insurance premiums during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvestingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementOperatingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

name: ProceedsFromInterestAndDividendsReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received
documentation: Cash received for dividends and interest on the entity's equity and debt investments during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromInterestAndDividendsReceivedAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromInterestReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Interest Received
documentation: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromInvestingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Investing Activity [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOffering
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
documentation: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonLimitedPartnersUnits
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
documentation: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStockDividendReinvestmentPlan
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferredStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
documentation: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFinancialServicesObligations
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Financial Services Obligations
documentation: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing issued by the entity involved in financial services operations.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFirstMortgageBond
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of First Mortgage Bond
documentation: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt instrument secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecuritiesNet
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecuritiesNetAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMandatoryRedeemableCapitalSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of an equity security that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the security by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-Term Note
documentation: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-Term Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredLimitedPartnersUnits
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndPreferenceStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
documentation: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockPreferenceStockAndWarrants
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
documentation: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockPreferenceStockAndWarrantsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemableConvertiblePreferredStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemablePreferredStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredTaxExemptDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Tax Exempt Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term tax exempt debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-Term Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncentiveAndShareBasedCompensationPlans
standard_label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncentiveAndShareBasedCompensationPlansIncludingStockOptions
standard_label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncentiveAndShareBasedCompensationPlansIncludingStockOptionsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSubordinatedLongTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-Term Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfTrustPreferredSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Trust Preferred Securities
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredTaxExemptDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Tax Exempt Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term tax exempt debt that is not secured by collateral.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfWarrants
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

name: ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquityAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromLeasePaymentSalesTypeAndDirectFinancingLeasesInvestingActivity
standard_label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Investing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from principal payment received from sales-type and direct financing leases classified as investing activity.

name: ProceedsFromLeasePayments
standard_label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from lease payment, classified as operating activity.

name: ProceedsFromLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Lease, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

name: ProceedsFromLegalSettlements
standard_label: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
documentation: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from License Fees Received
documentation: Cash received from licensees for license fees during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies
standard_label: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
documentation: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

name: ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Limited Partnership Investments
documentation: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.

name: ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit
standard_label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

name: ProceedsFromLinesOfCreditAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndPrincipalCollections
standard_label: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The cash inflow or outflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections. It is through the origination process that the terms of the mortgage agreement (amount of loan, interest rate, compounding frequency, etc) or lease are established and the involved parties legally bind themselves to the transaction.

name: ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndPrincipalCollections1
standard_label: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
documentation: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

name: ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndPrincipalCollectionsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromLoanOriginations
standard_label: Proceeds from Loan Originations (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination. It is through this process that the terms of the mortgage agreement (amount of loan, interest rate, compounding frequency, and so forth) or lease are established and the involved parties legally bind themselves to the transaction.

name: ProceedsFromLoanOriginations1
standard_label: Proceeds from Loan Originations
documentation: Cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination.

name: ProceedsFromLoans
standard_label: Proceeds from Loans
documentation: Cash received from principal payments made on loans related to operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromLongTermCapitalLeaseObligations
standard_label: Proceeds from Long-Term Capital Lease Obligations (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to a long-term capital lease obligation.

name: ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit
standard_label: Proceeds from Long-Term Lines of Credit
documentation: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfAvailableForSaleSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfHeldToMaturitySecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-Maturity Securities
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfLongtermInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Long-Term Investments
documentation: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBS
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
documentation: The cash inflow from the maturity (principal due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of a loan financed by home mortgage payments classified as held to maturity.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfOtherInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfSecuritiesOperatingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Securities, Operating Activities
documentation: Cash received from maturities, prepayments and calls of trading securities and other securities, classified as operating.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCallsOfShorttermInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-Term Investments
documentation: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

name: ProceedsFromMaturitiesRepaymentsAndCallsOfTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Maturity, Repayment, and Call, Debt Security, Trading, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

name: ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders
standard_label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

name: ProceedsFromMortgageDeposits
standard_label: Proceeds from Mortgage Deposits
documentation: Cash inflow received in association with a commitment to issue a mortgage.

name: ProceedsFromNotesPayable
standard_label: Proceeds from Notes Payable
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

name: ProceedsFromNotesPayableAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Notes Payable [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromNuclearFuel
standard_label: Proceeds from Nuclear Fuel
documentation: Cash inflow resulting from the sale of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

name: ProceedsFromOperatingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Operating Activities
documentation: Total amount of cash received from operating activities during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromOperatingActivitiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Operating Activities [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromOtherDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Other Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromOtherDeposits
standard_label: Proceeds from Other Deposits
documentation: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromOtherEquity
standard_label: Proceeds from Other Equity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromOtherOperatingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from operating activity, classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Other Short-Term Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromPartnershipContribution
standard_label: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
documentation: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebtRetirements
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from payments to deposit account and application of deposits to retire or pay down debt during the period.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebtRetirementsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResellNet
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
documentation: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResellNetAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInterestBearingDepositsInBanks
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchase
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
documentation: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermLoansForRelatedParties
standard_label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
documentation: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFinancingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResell
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
documentation: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResellAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsForTradingSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Trading Securities, Short-Term
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from sales and purchases of trading securities.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholders
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

name: ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholdersAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromPollutionControlBond
standard_label: Proceeds from Pollution Control Bond
documentation: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

name: ProceedsFromPreviousAcquisition
standard_label: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
documentation: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

name: ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsOnLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Principal Repayment, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

name: ProceedsFromRealEstateAndRealEstateJointVentures
standard_label: Proceeds from Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

name: ProceedsFromRecoveriesOfLoanPreviouslyChargedOff
standard_label: Proceeds, Financing Receivable, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of financing receivable, previously written off.

name: ProceedsFromRecoveriesOfLoansPreviouslyChargedOff
standard_label: Proceeds from Recoveries of Loans Previously Charged off (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The cash inflow from loans reinstated and recovered that were previously deemed uncollectible.

name: ProceedsFromRefundsFromSuppliersOfMaterial
standard_label: Proceeds from Refunds from Suppliers of Material
documentation: Cash received for refunds from suppliers during the current period. This element includes refunds from suppliers of materials; it excludes refunds from providers of fixed assets.

name: ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Related Party Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.

name: ProceedsFromRemovalCosts
standard_label: Proceeds from Removal Costs
documentation: Cash inflow resulting from recoveries, by any means, against the cost of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

name: ProceedsFromRentsReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Rents Received
documentation: Cash received for rents during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansByEmployeeStockOwnershipPlans
standard_label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
documentation: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansToPurchaseCommonStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans to Purchase Common Stock
documentation: Cash inflow from repayment of loans for purchasing common stock.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSecuritization
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization
documentation: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSecuritizationAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfBankOverdrafts
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaper
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
documentation: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaperAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebtAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebtAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt, Alternative [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonths
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes long-term debt and short-term debt.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonthsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBond
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) First Mortgage Bond
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit
documentation: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPayable
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebtAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-Term Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfPollutionControlBond
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Pollution Control Bond
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from a long-term debt instrument issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities, sewage, or solid waste disposal facilities.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRestrictedCashFinancingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Restricted Cash, Financing Activities (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow from cash and cash items that are not available for withdrawal or usage.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonths
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonthsAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months, Alternative [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThreeMonthsOrLess
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

name: ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThreeMonthsOrLessAlternativeAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less, Alternative [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

name: ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquityAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferredStock
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
documentation: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

name: ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferredStockAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPreferredSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities
documentation: The cash inflow from issuance of trust preferred securities, net of the cash outflow for repurchasing trust preferred securities, by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

name: ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPreferredSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromRoyaltiesReceived
standard_label: Proceeds from Royalties Received
documentation: Cash received for royalties during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfFinanceReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfFinanceReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLeaseReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLeaseReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansHeldforsale
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection, Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansHeldforsaleAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection, Loan, Held-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansReceivableAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfMortgageNotesReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfNotesReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfNotesReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfOtherReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale and collection of receivables classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfOtherReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivablesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableForSaleSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHeldToMaturitySecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-Maturity Securities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHeldToMaturitySecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-Maturity Securities [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturities, repayments and calls of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

name: ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestmentAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfLongtermInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-Term Investments
documentation: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

name: ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfLongtermInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-Term Investments [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfShorttermInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-Term Investments
documentation: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

name: ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfShorttermInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-Term Investments [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOfInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-Sale Securities (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of debt and equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesEquity
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-Sale Securities, Equity (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity securities classified as available-for-sale securities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfBuildings
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Buildings
documentation: The cash inflow from sale of buildings.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfDonorRestrictedAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Donor Restricted Assets (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Amount of receipts from contributions and investment income with restrictions stipulated by the donor for the purpose of acquiring, constructing, or improving property, plant, equipment, or other long-lived assets, or establishing, or increasing a permanent endowment or term endowment.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuritiesFvNi
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Securities, FV-NI
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalHomeLoanBankStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalReserveStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfFlightEquipment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Flight Equipment
documentation: Cash received from sales of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfFurnitureAndFixtures
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Furniture and Fixtures
documentation: The cash inflow from sale of furniture and fixtures.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturitySecurities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-Maturity Securities
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
documentation: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInCorporateUnit
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Corporate Unit
documentation: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of an interest in a corporate unit during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfInterestInPartnershipUnit
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Partnership Unit
documentation: The proceeds from the sale of an interest in a unit of partnership.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfInvestmentProjects
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldForUse
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Land, Held-for-Use
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Land, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for investment; excludes sales of land held as inventory or productive use.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLeaseReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestmentAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Held-for-Investment
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSaleAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Held-for-Sale [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Long-Term Investments
documentation: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfMachineryAndEquipment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
documentation: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBSCategorizedAsAvailableForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRightsMSR
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Va

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfNotesReceivable
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Notes Receivable
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEquipment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
documentation: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Cash received from sales of assets, other than those represented by other elements (securities, loans, mortgages, real estate).

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssets1
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInvestingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiveAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
documentation: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstateHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Other, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate held for investment not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherReceivables
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssetsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Property, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstate
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
documentation: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
documentation: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinvestmentAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfSecuritiesOperatingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities
documentation: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInvestments
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-Term Investments
documentation: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfTradingSecuritiesHeldforinvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
documentation: Amount of cash inflows from the sale of trust assets to pay trust expenses.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfWasteWaterSystems
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Waste Water Systems (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The cash inflow from sale of waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterAndWasteWaterSystems
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Water and Waste Water Systems (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The cash inflow from sale of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities; and waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterAndWasteWaterSystemsAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Water and Waste Water Systems [Abstract] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterSystems
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Water Systems
documentation: The cash inflow from sale of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

name: ProceedsFromSaleOfWhollyOwnedRealEstateAndRealEstateAcquiredInSettlementOfLoans
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
documentation: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

name: ProceedsFromSalesOfAssetsInvestingActivities
standard_label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
documentation: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers.
