This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

name: ProceedsFromSalesOfBusinessAffiliateAndProductiveAssets
standard_label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
documentation: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

name: ProceedsFromSecuredLinesOfCredit
standard_label: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
documentation: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

name: ProceedsFromSecuredNotesPayable
standard_label: Proceeds from Secured Notes Payable
documentation: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

name: ProceedsFromSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResell
standard_label: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
documentation: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

name: ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfConsumerLoans
standard_label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Consumer Loans
documentation: The cash inflow from the securitization of receivables for loans to consumers. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

name: ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCreditCards
standard_label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Credit Cards
documentation: The cash inflow from the securitization of credit card receivables. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

name: ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoansHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Securitization, Loan, Held-for-Investment
documentation: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

name: ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoansHeldForInvestmentAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Securitization, Loan, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoansHeldForSale
standard_label: Proceeds from Securitization, Loan, Held-for-Sale
documentation: The cash inflow from securitizing loans held with the intention to resell in the near future.

name: ProceedsFromShortTermCapitalLeaseObligations
standard_label: Proceeds from Short-Term Capital Lease Obligations (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to capital lease obligation.

name: ProceedsFromShortTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: ProceedsFromShortTermDebtAbstract
standard_label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt [Abstract]

name: ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeMonths
standard_label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

name: ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInThreeMonthsOrLess
standard_label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
documentation: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

name: ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised
standard_label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

name: ProceedsFromStockPlans
standard_label: Proceeds from Stock Plans
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

name: ProceedsFromSubordinatedShortTermDebt
standard_label: Proceeds from Subordinated Short-Term Debt
documentation: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

name: ProceedsFromTimeDepositsAccepted
standard_label: Proceeds from Time Deposits Accepted
documentation: Cash received from customers who deposit money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

name: ProceedsFromUnsecuredLinesOfCredit
standard_label: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
documentation: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

name: ProceedsFromUnsecuredNotesPayable
standard_label: Proceeds from Unsecured Notes Payable
documentation: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

name: ProceedsFromWarrantExercises
standard_label: Proceeds from Warrant Exercises
documentation: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock warrants.

name: ProceedsNetInvestmentInLeasePreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Net Investment in Lease, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, previously written off.

name: ProceedsOfOtherLoansAndLeasesHeldForInvestment
standard_label: Proceeds from Sale or Securitization, Loan and Lease, Other, Held-for-Investment
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

name: ProceedsSalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeasePreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
standard_label: Proceeds, Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Previously Written off, Recovery
documentation: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in sales-type lease, previously written off.

name: ProductAndServiceOtherMember
standard_label: Product and Service, Other [Member]
documentation: Article or substance produced by nature, labor or machinery and act of providing assistance, classified as other.

name: ProductConcentrationRiskMember
standard_label: Product Concentration Risk [Member]
documentation: Reflects the percentage that revenues during the period from a specified product are to a specified benchmark, such as total net revenues, segment revenues or product line revenues. May also reflect the percentage contribution the product made to operating results. Risk is materially adverse effects of a loss of sales of a significant product or line of products, which could occur upon loss of rights to sell, distribute or license others; loss of patent or copyright protection; or technological

name: ProductFinancingArrangementMember
standard_label: Product Financing Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Arrangement that in form is a sale with full right of return but in substance is a financing in that the financier is not the end customer, is not at risk other than credit risk similar to any other form of lending arrangement, and typically is repaid from collections of sales made to actual customers including an amount that constitutes interest.

name: ProductInformationLineItems
standard_label: Product Information [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ProductLiabilityAccrualComponentAmount
standard_label: Product Liability Accrual, Component Amount
documentation: Recorded amount of the accrual for a material component of a product liability contingency.

name: ProductLiabilityAccrualMaterialComponents
standard_label: Product Liability Accrual, Material Components
documentation: Describes the material components of a loss accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es).

name: ProductLiabilityAccrualPeriodExpense
standard_label: Product Liability Accrual, Period Expense
documentation: The amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability.

name: ProductLiabilityAccrualPeriodExpenseCaption
standard_label: Product Liability Accrual, Period Expense, Caption (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the income statement line item in which the amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability is reflected.

name: ProductLiabilityContingenciesTextBlock
standard_label: Product Liability Contingencies [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of exposure to material amount of loss arising from allegations of damages pertaining to and arising from one or more of the entity's products.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualAssumptions
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Assumptions
documentation: Describes the important assumptions underlying the estimate of the product liability loss, and may describe any changes in the assumptions made since the last reporting period.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualCaption
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Caption (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the balance sheet line item in which the accrual for the product liability loss contingency is reflected.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualDiscountAmount
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Discount Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce (reconcile) the estimated aggregate undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) to the present value recognized on the balance sheet (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualDiscountRate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Discount Rate
documentation: Rate applied to the undiscounted amount of estimated damages for product liability to arrive at the present value recorded as of the balance sheet date.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualPresentValue
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Present Value (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Present value of the accrual for product liability loss contingencies as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyCircumstancesImpactingPrecisionOfEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Circumstances Impacting Precision of Estimate
documentation: Circumstances affecting the reliability and precision of damages estimates for a specified product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyDescription
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Description
documentation: Describes the damages allegedly caused by appropriate use of the product, such as death from a drug and injury from a toy, which the damaged party reasonably believed was attributable to dangers for which no warning or inadequate warning was provided, such as defects in labeling, construction, and inappropriate (impurities in) processing.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyDisbursementPeriodEstimateAccrued
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Disbursement Period, Estimate, Accrued
documentation: Period of disbursement over which accrued amount may be paid out for damage to product, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyDisbursementPeriodEstimateUnrecognized
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Disbursement Period, Estimate, Unrecognized
documentation: Period of disbursement over which unrecognized amount may be paid out for damage to product, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyFactorsChangingEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Factors Changing Estimate (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Factors that may cause a change in an estimate of a loss that exceeds: the amount accrued for the contingency, a recognized asset for third-party recoveries, an estimated loss contingency that has not been accrued, or a disclosed gain contingency.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyGeographicAreas
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Geographic Areas (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the geographic areas in which the damages were alleged to have occurred.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyIndicationAccrualMayChange
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Indication Accrual May Change (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure that it is reasonably possible that a change in an estimate of the obligation will occur in the near term when information available prior to issuance of the financial statements indicates that it is at least reasonably possible that the product liability accrual estimate will change due to one or more future confirming events.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLineItems
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualBestEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Best Estimate
documentation: Best estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for damages pertaining to a specified product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualDescription
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Description (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Nature of the reasonably possible loss contingency and estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for damages pertaining to a specified product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualHighEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High-end of the range estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for damages pertaining to a specified product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualLowEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low-end of the range estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for damages pertaining to a specified product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedBestEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Best Estimate
documentation: Best estimate of the loss exposure for a reasonably possible liability for product liability damages for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedDescription
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Description
documentation: Nature of the reasonably possible allegations of damages and estimate of the loss exposure for product liability for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedHighEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High-end of the range estimate for a reasonably possible liability for product liability damages for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedLowEstimate
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low-end of the range estimate for a reasonably possible liability for product liability damages for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedThirdPartyRecoveryCommentary
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Third-Party Recovery Commentary
documentation: Describes the extent to which disclosed but not recognized contingent losses from product liability damages are expected to be recoverable through insurance, indemnification arrangements, or other sources, and any material limitations of that recovery.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossInestimableExplanation
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Inestimable Explanation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Reason(s) why an estimate of the probable or reasonably possible loss or range of loss for product liability damages cannot be made.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyLossInestimableStatement
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Inestimable Statement (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Statement to the effect that an estimate of the probable or reasonably possible loss or range of loss for product liability damages cannot be made.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyManagementAssessmentProcess
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Management Assessment Process (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Describes management's process to evaluate allegations of damages pertaining to a product and to estimate the impact on the financial statements and ongoing operations.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyTable
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about product liability contingency arising from reasonably possible loss from liability related to individual product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyThirdPartyRecovery
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Third-Party Recovery
documentation: Amount of the estimated recovery from third parties recorded in the period pertaining to product liability damages from specified products.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyThirdPartyRecoveryPercentage
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Third-Party Recovery, Percentage
documentation: Percentage of the estimated recovery from third parties recorded in the period pertaining to product liability damages from specified products.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyTimeFrameOfDisbursements
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Time Frame of Disbursements (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Estimated time frame of disbursements over which the accrued or presently unrecognized amounts may be paid out for damages pertaining to a specified product.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyUnassertedClaims
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Unasserted Claims
documentation: Extent to which unasserted claims are reflected in an accrual or may affect the magnitude of the product liability contingency.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyUncertaintiesFromInsurance
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Uncertainties from Insurance
documentation: Uncertainties with respect to the legal sufficiency of insurance claims or the solvency of carriers for product liability damages.

name: ProductLiabilityContingencyUncertaintiesFromJointAndSeveralLiability
standard_label: Product Liability Contingency, Uncertainties from Joint and Several Liability
documentation: Uncertainties with respect to joint and several liability that may affect the magnitude of the contingency.

name: ProductMember
standard_label: Product [Member]
documentation: Article or substance produced by nature, labor or machinery.

name: ProductOrServiceAxis
standard_label: Products and Services [Axis]
documentation: Information by products and services or groups of similar products and services.

name: ProductRecallAxis
standard_label: Product Recall [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information about a request for a batch or an entire production run of a product to be returned to the manufacturer.

name: ProductRecallDomain
standard_label: Product Recall [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Requests for batches or entire production runs of products to be returned to the manufacturer.

name: ProductRecallMember
standard_label: Product Recall [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: A request for a batch or an entire production run of a product be returned to the manufacturer, usually due to the discovery of safety issues.

name: ProductWarrantiesDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Product Warranties Disclosures [Abstract]

name: ProductWarrantyAccrual
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsFromBusinessAcquisition
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
documentation: Amount of increase in liability for standard and extended product warranty acquired in business combination.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualBalanceSheetClassificationAbstract
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Balance Sheet Classification [Abstract]

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualClassifiedCurrent
standard_label: Product Warranty Accrual, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualCurrencyTranslationIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Product Warranty Accrual, Currency Translation, Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Total Increase or Decrease in the standard and extended product warranty liability due to currency translation.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualNoncurrent
standard_label: Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualPayments
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
documentation: Amount of decrease in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard and extended product warranty.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty liability.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistingIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties.

name: ProductWarrantyAccrualWarrantiesIssued
standard_label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
documentation: Amount of increase in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued.

name: ProductWarrantyDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Product Warranty Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for standard and extended product warranties and other product guarantee contracts, including a tabular reconciliation of the changes in the guarantor's aggregate product warranty liability for the reporting period.

name: ProductWarrantyExpense
standard_label: Product Warranty Expense
documentation: The expense charged against earnings for the period pertaining to standard and extended warranties on the entity's goods and services granted to customers.

name: ProductWarrantyLiabilityLineItems
standard_label: Product Warranty Liability [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ProductWarrantyLiabilityTable
standard_label: Product Warranty Liability [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about product warranty liability, including, but not limited to, reductions in the liability for payments made under the warranty, changes in the liability for accruals related to product warranties issued, and changes in the liability for accruals related to preexisting warranties.

name: ProductWarrantyLiquidationProceedsAmount
standard_label: Product Warranty, Liquidation Proceeds, Amount
documentation: Amount of proceeds from liquidation of asset held as collateral or by third party expected to cover maximum potential future payment for product warranty. Includes, but is not limited to, separately price extended warranty, product maintenance contract, and warranty obligation incurred in connection with agreed upon specifications.

name: ProductWarrantyLiquidationProceedsPercentage
standard_label: Product Warranty, Liquidation Proceeds, Percentage
documentation: Percentage of proceeds from liquidation of asset held as collateral or by third party expected to cover maximum potential future payment for product warranty. Includes, but is not limited to, separately price extended warranty, product maintenance contract, and warranty obligation incurred in connection with agreed upon specification.

name: ProductWarrantyObligationTerm
standard_label: Product Warranty Obligation, Term
documentation: Term of warranty or group of similar warranties, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: ProductionAndDistributionCosts
standard_label: Production and Distribution Costs
documentation: Amount of expense related to the production and distribution of goods or services to customers and clients.

name: ProductionAndDistributionCostsMember
standard_label: Production and Distribution Costs [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Expenses related to the production and distribution of goods or services to customers and clients.

name: ProductionAndPropertyTaxExpenseMember
standard_label: Production and Property Tax Expense [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Tax assessed on oil and gas production and real estate. The tax is usually based on the value of property and land owned.

name: ProductionBarrelsOfOilEquivalents
standard_label: Production, Barrels of Oil Equivalents (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the number of barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) which is a measurement used by oil and gas companies as a way of combining oil and natural gas reserves and production into a single measurement. Natural gas volumes are converted to BOE based on the energy content of 6,000 cubic feet of gas to one barrel of oil.

name: ProductionBarrelsOfOilEquivalents1
standard_label: Production, Barrels of Oil Equivalents
documentation: Energy measure of oil and natural gas production reserves.

name: ProductionCosts
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Production Cost, Period Cost
documentation: Amount of capitalized production cost incurred during period for oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes cost incurred to operate and maintain well and related equipment and facility.

name: ProductionCostsCumulative
standard_label: Production Costs, Cumulative (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: The capitalized costs incurred (excluded from amortization), as of the date of the balance sheet, to operate and maintain wells and related equipment and facilities, including depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of operating and maintaining those wells and related equipment and facilities. They become part of the cost of oil and gas produced. Examples of production costs (sometimes called lifting costs) are: costs of labor to operate th

name: ProductionRelatedImpairmentsOrCharges
standard_label: Production Related Impairments or Charges
documentation: Nonrecurring impairment charges related to the write-off of production-related equipment and inventory. This tag is used when an Entity charges this cost to cost of goods sold.

name: ProductionRelatedImpairmentsOrChargesAbstract
standard_label: Production Related Impairments or Charges [Abstract]

name: ProductionTaxExpense
standard_label: Production Tax Expense
documentation: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.

name: ProductionTypeDomain
standard_label: Production Type [Domain] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The type of production (for example, oil and natural gas liquids, or natural gas).

name: ProductiveGasWellsNumberOfWellsGross
standard_label: Productive Gas Wells, Number of Wells, Gross
documentation: The total number of producing gas wells and gas wells capable of production, in which the entity owns an undivided working interest.

name: ProductiveGasWellsNumberOfWellsNet
standard_label: Productive Gas Wells, Number of Wells, Net
documentation: The total number of producing gas wells and gas wells capable of production, in which the entity owns a fractional working interest.

name: ProductiveGasWellsNumberOfWellsWithMultipleCompletionsGross
standard_label: Productive Gas Wells, Number of Wells with Multiple Completions, Gross (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The total number of productive gas wells and gas wells capable of production which access multiple reservoirs through one well bore, in which the entity owns an undivided working interest.

name: ProductiveGasWellsNumberOfWellsWithMultipleCompletionsNet
standard_label: Productive Gas Wells, Number of Wells with Multiple Completions, Net (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The total number of productive gas wells and gas wells capable of production which access multiple reservoirs through one well bore, in which the entity owns a fractional working interest.

name: ProductiveLandMember
standard_label: Productive Land [Member]
documentation: Land containing resources that are subject to depletion. Examples include, but are not limited to, mines, timberland and landfills.

name: ProductiveOilWellsNumberOfWellsGross
standard_label: Productive Oil Wells, Number of Wells, Gross
documentation: The total number of producing oil wells and oil wells capable of production, in which the entity owns an undivided working interest.

name: ProductiveOilWellsNumberOfWellsNet
standard_label: Productive Oil Wells, Number of Wells, Net
documentation: The total number of producing oil wells and oil wells capable of production, in which the entity owns a fractional working interest.

name: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentUsefulLifeMaximum

documentation: The maximum useful life of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include land, buildings, machinery and equipment, and other types of furniture and equipment including, but not limited to, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment and software.

name: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentUsefulLifeMinimum

documentation: Table of comparison between amounts disclosed under previous guidance and new guidance.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedOilAndGasReserveQuantitiesTable
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Oil and Gas Reserve Quantities [Table]
documentation: Detailed information on net quantities of proved reserves by geographic area.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveEnergyRollForward
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve (Energy) [Roll Forward]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveExtensionAndDiscoveryEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Extension and Discovery (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of increase in quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas resulting from the extension of the proved acreage of previously discovered reservoir or discovery of new field with proved reserve or of new reservoir of proved reserve in old field, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveImprovedRecoveryEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Improved Recovery (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of increase in quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas resulting from application of improved recovery techniques, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveNetEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Net (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of proved reserve of oil and gas, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveNetEnergyPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Net (Energy), Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Energy measure of increase (decrease) of quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveProductionEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Production (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of decrease in quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas resulting from production, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservePurchaseOfMineralInPlaceEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Purchase of Mineral in Place (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of increase in quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas resulting from purchase of mineral in place, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReserveRevisionOfPreviousEstimateEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserve, Revision of Previous Estimate (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of increase (decrease) in quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas related to revision of a previous estimate resulting from new information, except for an increase in proved acreage, or change in economic factors, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesExtensionsDiscoveriesAndAdditions
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Extensions, Discoveries, and Additions
documentation: Additions to proved reserves that result from (1) extension of the proved acreage of previously discovered (old) reservoirs through additional drilling in periods after discovery and (2) discovery of new fields with proved reserves or of new reservoirs of proved reserves in old fields.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesImprovedRecovery
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Improved Recovery
documentation: Changes in proved reserve estimates resulting from application of improved recovery techniques.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesNet
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Net
documentation: The net quantity of proved reserves as of the balance sheet date. Proved oil reserves are the estimated quantities of crude oil and natural gas liquids which geological and engineering data demonstrate with reasonable certainty to be recoverable.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesNetPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Net, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Volume increase (decrease) of proved reserves of oil and gas.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesProduction
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Production
documentation: Production of proved reserves.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesPurchasesOfMineralsInPlace
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Purchases of Minerals in Place
documentation: Purchase of minerals in place.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesRevisionsOfPreviousEstimatesIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Revisions of Previous Estimates
documentation: Revisions represent changes in previous estimates of proved reserves, either upward or downward, resulting from new information (except for an increase in proved acreage) normally obtained from development drilling and production history or resulting from change in economic factors.

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesSaleOfMineralInPlaceEnergy
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Sale of Mineral in Place (Energy)
documentation: Energy measure of decrease in quantity of proved reserve of oil and gas resulting from sale of mineral in place, stated in a unit of energy. For example, but not limited to, barrel of oil equivalents (BOE) or one thousand cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (Mcfe).

name: ProvedDevelopedAndUndevelopedReservesSalesOfMineralsInPlace
standard_label: Proved Developed and Undeveloped Reserves, Sales of Minerals in Place
documentation: Sales of minerals in place.

name: ProvedUndevelopedReserveVolume

standard_label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
documentation: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

name: PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionCapitalizedInterest
standard_label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Interest
documentation: Amount capitalized of allowance for funds used during construction.

name: PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionNetIncreaseAbstract

name: PublicUtilitiesApprovedRateIncreaseDecreaseAmount

name: PublicUtilitiesApprovedRateIncreaseDecreasePercentage

name: PublicUtilitiesApprovedReturnOnEquityPercentage

name: PublicUtilitiesDescriptionOfSpecificRegulatoryLiabilities

name: PublicUtilitiesDisclosureOfRateMatters

Specifics may include quantifications related to rates, costs, and earnings. Events may relate to rate moratoriums or price caps.

name: PublicUtilitiesDisclosureOfRegulatoryMattersPending
standard_label: Public Utilities, Disclosure of Regulatory Matters Pending

standard_label: Receivable from Officers and Directors for Issuance of Capital Stock
documentation: Amounts receivable from officers and directors resulting from the sale of stock to officers or directors before the cash payment is received.

name: ReceivableFromShareholdersOrAffiliatesForIssuanceOfCapitalStock
standard_label: Receivable from Shareholders or Affiliates for Issuance of Capital Stock
documentation: Amount due from owner or affiliate of reporting entity for issuance of shares. Includes, but is not limited to, amount due for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount due from officer or director.

name: ReceivableInvestmentSale

documentation: Amount of receivable from sale of investment.

name: ReceivableTypeDomain

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestDescription
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Description
documentation: The description of the receivable with imputed interest.

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestDiscount
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Discount
documentation: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the discount on the note or receivable which is deducted from the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is the difference between the present value and the face amount.

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestDueDates
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Due Date
documentation: Date the receivable or note with imputed interest is due, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestEffectiveYieldInterestRate
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Effective Yield (Interest Rate)
documentation: Yield on the receivable, on which interest has been imputed, as calculated from its issuance value or purchase price. The calculated effective interest rate considers factors such as the issued face value or price paid for the receivable, the time period between payments, and the time until maturity [full receipt] of the receivable.

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestFaceAmount
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Face Amount
documentation: The principal amount of the receivable or note before consideration of the discount or premium.

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestNetAmount
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Net Amount
documentation: The receivable or note face amount less the unamortized discount or premium.

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestNetAmountAbstract
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Net Amount [Abstract]

name: ReceivableWithImputedInterestPremium
standard_label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Premium
documentation: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the premium on the note or receivable which is added to the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is defined as the difference between the present value and the face amount.

documentation: Acquired receivables with deteriorated credit quality.

name: ReceivablesChangeInMethodOfCalculatingImpairmentRecordedInvestment
standard_label: Receivables, Change in Method of Calculating Impairment, Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount of receivables for which the allowance for credit losses had previously been measured under a general allowance for credit losses methodology, and are now identified as troubled debt restructurings.

name: ReceivablesCreditCardThirdPartyIntermediariesArrangementsDescription
standard_label: Receivables, Credit Card, Third-Party Intermediaries, Arrangements, Description (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: This element represents a description of arrangements with third-party service providers with which the entity processes or transacts credit card sales. name: ReceivablesFairValueDisclosure
standard_label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure
documentation: Fair value portion of receivables, including, but not limited to, trade account receivables, note receivables, and loan receivables.

name: ReceivablesFairValueDisclosureAbstract
standard_label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

name: ReceivablesFairValueDisclosureMethodology
standard_label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure, Methodology (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents management's methodology (for example, procedures or techniques) for estimating the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: ReceivablesFairValueDisclosureSignificantAssumptions
standard_label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure, Significant Assumptions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the significant assumptions used by management to estimate the fair value as of the balance sheet date of the financial instrument (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined).

name: ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearingOrganizations
standard_label: Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
documentation: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

name: ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearingOrganizationsAbstract

name: ReceivablesFromCustomers
standard_label: Receivable from Customer in Brokerage
documentation: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

name: ReceivablesFromStockholderMember
standard_label: Receivables from Stockholder [Member]
documentation: Category of equity that is due from owners or affiliates of the reporting entity (including due from officers or directors) resulting from the sale of stock before the cash payment is received.

name: ReceivablesHeldForSaleLowerOfCostOrFairValuePolicy

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the lower of cost or fair value for trade accounts receivable.

name: ReceivablesHeldForSalePolicyAbstract
standard_label: Receivables Held-for-sale, Policy [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: ReceivablesLongTermContractsOrPrograms
standard_label: Receivables, Long-Term Contracts or Programs
documentation: Amount to be collected within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from customers in accordance with the contractual provisions of long-term contracts or programs including amounts billed and unbilled as of the balance sheet date.

name: ReceivablesLongTermContractsOrProgramsAbstract
standard_label: Receivables, Long-Term Contracts or Programs [Abstract]

name: ReceivablesNetCurrent
standard_label: Receivables, Net, Current
documentation: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

name: ReceivablesNetCurrentAbstract

standard_label: Receivables, Other, Related Parties and Retainage [Abstract]

name: ReceivablesTradeAndOtherAccountsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPolicy
standard_label: Receivables, Trade and Other Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the allowance for doubtful accounts for trade and other accounts receivable balances, and when impairments, charge-offs or recoveries are recognized.

standard_label: Receivables with Imputed Interest, Amortization Amount

name: ReceivablesWithImputedInterestAmortizationDescription
standard_label: Receivables with Imputed Interest, Amortization Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The description of amortization of the discount or premium on the note or receivable which was the result of the determination of present value in cash or noncash transactions, including the amount of amortization expense recognized in the statement of operations for the period.

name: ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeCurrentPeriodNetOfTax

documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodBeforeTaxAttributableToParent
standard_label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

name: ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodNetOfTaxAttributableToParent
standard_label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent

standard_label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax [Abstract]

standard_label: Reclassification of Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) [Abstract]

name: ReclassificationTable

name: ReclassificationToUnappropriatedRetainedEarnings

documentation: Amount reclassified to unappropriated retained earnings from accumulated increase (decrease) in the fair value of the financial assets (liabilities) of the collateralized financing entity.

standard_label: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Reclassification Based on Determination of Proved Reserve
documentation: Amount of reclassification of capitalized exploratory well cost to well, facility, and equipment based on determination of proved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities.

name: ReclassificationTypeAxis
standard_label: Reclassification, Type [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of reclassification adjustment affecting comparability of financial statement. Excludes amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, and correction of error.

name: ReclassificationTypeDomain
standard_label: Reclassification, Type [Domain]
documentation: Type of reclassification adjustment affecting comparability of financial statement. Excludes amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, and correction of error.

name: ReclassificationTypeExtensibleList

documentation: Indicates type of reclassification adjustment affecting comparability of financial statement. Excludes amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, and correction of error.

name: Reclassifications
standard_label: Reclassifications [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for classifying current financial statements, which may be different from classifications in the prior year's financial statements. Disclose any material changes in classification including an explanation of the reason for the change and the areas impacted.

name: ReclassificationsBetweenTemporaryAndPermanentEquity
standard_label: Reclassifications Between Temporary and Permanent Equity
documentation: Describe contract reclassifications (including partial reclassifications) between temporary and permanent equity, the reason for the reclassification, and the impact on the issuer's financial statements for freestanding derivative contracts that are indexed to, and potentially settled in, the company's own stock. Includes also a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement.

name: ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPermanentEquity
standard_label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
documentation: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

name: RecognitionOfAssetAndLiabilityForLeaseOfAcquireePolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Business Combination, Acquired Lease of Acquiree, Recognition of Asset and Liability [Policy Text Block]

name: RecognitionOfDeferredRevenue

documentation: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period.
