standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseAsset
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Asset Offset
documentation: Amount of asset associated with funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseAverageAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Average Amount Outstanding
documentation: Average amount outstanding of securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseCollateralRightToReclaimCash
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash Not Offset
documentation: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseCollateralRightToReclaimSecurities
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Security Not Offset
documentation: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseCounterpartyNameExtensibleList
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Counterparty Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates name of counterparty to security sold under agreement to repurchase. Counterparty is other party participating in financial transaction. Example includes, but is not limited to, name of financial institution.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseFairValueOfCollateral
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value of Collateral
documentation: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseGross
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset
documentation: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseGrossIncludingNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
documentation: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseGrossIncludingNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMeasurementDifferenceDescription
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Measurement Difference Description
documentation: Description of measurement difference between recognized amounts and resulting measurement differences for securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMember
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase [Member]
documentation: The securities that an institution sells and agrees to repurchase (the identical or substantially the same securities) as a seller-borrower at a specified date for a specified price, also known as a repurchase agreement, or repo. Most repos involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, and negotiable certificates of deposit, are sometimes used in repos.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
documentation: Amount of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementDeduction
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseOffsetAgainstCollateralNetOfNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementPolicyElection
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, offset against a right to receive collateral.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseOffsetAgainstCollateralNetOfNotSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementPolicyElectionAbstract
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseSetoffRightsDescription
standard_label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Setoff Rights, Description
documentation: Description of rights of setoff associated with the entity's recognized securities sold under agreements to repurchase subject to an enforceable master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellNotOffsetPolicyElectionDeduction
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
documentation: Amount of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security sold under agreement to repurchase.

name: SecuritiesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Securities Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
documentation: Securities issued in the form of shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur.

name: SecuritizationFinancialAssetForWhichTransferIsAccountedAsSaleAxis
standard_label: Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangements, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale by Type [Axis] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The gains or losses recognized when a transfer is accounted for as a sale, by type of financial asset in a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer.

name: SecuritizationFinancialAssetForWhichTransferIsAccountedAsSaleGainLossOnSale
standard_label: Securitization or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale, Gain (Loss) on Sale
documentation: Reflects, by transferred financial asset type, the amount of sales proceeds in excess of or deficient from the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs, including those transactions in which the seller/transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

name: SecuritizationFinancialAssetForWhichTransferIsAccountedAsSaleLineItems
standard_label: Securitization or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SecuritizationFinancialAssetForWhichTransferIsAccountedAsSaleOtherGainLossDisclosuresOnSecuritizations
standard_label: Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale, Other Gain (Loss) Disclosures on Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of other gains or losses pertaining to a transfer of financial assets in a securitization or asset-backing financing arrangement accounted for as a sale.

name: SecuritizationFinancialAssetForWhichTransferIsAccountedAsSaleTable
standard_label: Schedule of Securitization or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangements, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about gain (loss) from sale of transferred financial asset relating to transferor's continuing involvement in securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, and similar transfer.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherAverageBalanceDuringPeriod
standard_label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Average Balance During Period (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: This is the average principal amount (during the year) of the securitized and unsecuritized financial assets.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherByTypeOfFinancialInstrumentAxis
standard_label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together by Type [Axis] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Pertinent financial information for securitized or asset-backed financing arrangement assets that continue to be recognized and any other financial assets that are managed together, by type of financial instrument.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherDelinquentAmountAtEndOfPeriod
standard_label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Delinquent Amount at End of Period
documentation: Amount of transferred financial asset that continues to be recognized and other financial asset managed together with transferred financial asset, considered to be delinquent.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherLineItems
standard_label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherNetCreditLossesDuringPeriod
standard_label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Net credit losses are charge-offs and are based on total loans outstanding during the period.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherPrincipalAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Continuing Involvement with Continued to be Recognized Transferred Financial Assets, Amount Outstanding
documentation: Amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction that continue to be recognized in the statement of financial position. Includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

name: SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAssetsManagedTogetherTable
standard_label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Transferred Financial Assets and Other Financial Assets Managed Together [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about transferred financial assets that continue to be recognized and other financial assets that it manages together with them. Includes, but is not limited to, credit delinquencies and credit losses, after recoveries.

name: SecuritizedRegulatoryTransitionAssetsNoncurrent
standard_label: Securitized Regulatory Transition Assets, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value of the regulatory asset that represents capitalized stranded costs that have been securitized (financed with debt) and are expected to be recoverable through a transition charge after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer). A transition charge is a charge approved by a regulator that allows deregulated utilities to recover investments in certain assets, such as power plants, over a transition period leading into a deregulated market.

name: SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Excludes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]

name: SecurityDeposit
standard_label: Security Deposit
documentation: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

name: SecurityDepositLiability
standard_label: Security Deposit Liability
documentation: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.

name: SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Excludes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]

name: SecurityOwnedAndPledgedAsCollateralAssociatedLiabilitiesFairValue
standard_label: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Associated Liabilities, Fair Value
documentation: Fair value of liabilities arising from or related to a financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) which has been pledged to counterparties.

name: SecurityOwnedAndPledgedAsCollateralFairValue
standard_label: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Fair Value (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Fair value of financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes that are carried at fair value and pledged to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions.

name: SecurityOwnedAndPledgedAsCollateralFairValueAbstract
standard_label: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Fair Value [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchasedAtFairValueAxis
standard_label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value [Axis]
documentation: Information by financial instrument held by broker-dealer for its own account for trading or investment purposes and carried at fair value. Includes, but is not limited to, security sold, not yet purchased.

name: SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchasedAtFairValueLineItems
standard_label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchasedAtFairValueTable
standard_label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about financial instrument held by broker-dealer for its own account for trading or investment purposes and carried at fair value. Includes, but is not limited to, security sold, not yet purchased.

name: SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchasedFairValueSecurityNameDomain
standard_label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased Fair Value, Security Name [Domain]
documentation: Type of financial instrument held by a broker-dealer for their own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes that are carried at fair value including securities sold, not yet purchased.

name: SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchasedFairValueSecurityOwned
standard_label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased Fair Value, Security Owned
documentation: Fair value of financial instruments held by a broker-dealer for their own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes determined by management based upon quoted prices of a financial instrument with similar characteristics or on a valuation technique or model.

name: SecurityOwnedAndSoldNotYetPurchasedFairValueSecuritySoldNotYetPurchased
standard_label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased Fair Value, Security Sold, Not yet Purchased
documentation: Fair value of financial instruments sold short by a broker-dealer for their own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes determined by management based upon quoted prices of a financial instrument with similar characteristics or on a valuation technique or model.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableAxis
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable [Axis]
documentation: Information by name of not readily marketable security.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableDescription
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Description
documentation: Description of the security category or actual security title.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableFairValue
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
documentation: Value of the not readily marketable security or category which has been determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques and is included in the schedule of financial condition or the balance sheet.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableLineItems
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableNameDomain
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Name [Domain]
documentation: Name of the security category or actual security title.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableQuotedValue
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Quoted Price
documentation: Amount of not readily marketable security or investment measured by quoted price.

name: SecurityOwnedNotReadilyMarketableTable
standard_label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about not readily marketable securities and investments including, but not limited to, description of security or investment, fair value and value as measured by quoted price.

name: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]

name: SecuritySoldShortAbstract
standard_label: Security Sold Short [Abstract]

name: SecuritySoldShortAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeRealizedGainLossOperatingBeforeTax
standard_label: Realized Gain (Loss), Security Sold Short and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from security sold short and foreign currency transaction on security sold short from change in market price, classified as operating.

name: SecuritySoldShortAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeUnrealizedGainLossOperatingBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Security Sold Short and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from security sold short and foreign currency transaction on security sold short from change in market price, classified as operating.

name: SecuritySoldShortIdentifierAxis
standard_label: Security Sold Short, Identifier [Axis]
documentation: Identification of security sold short, including, but not limited to, name of issuer, title of issue, and other identifying information.

name: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]

name: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
documentation: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

name: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangementAbstract
standard_label: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]

name: SegmentContinuingOperationsMember
standard_label: Continuing Operations [Member]
documentation: Component of an entity expected to operate in the foreseeable future.

name: SegmentDiscontinuedOperationsMember
standard_label: Discontinued Operations [Member]
documentation: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, classified as held-for-sale or disposed of by sale or by means other than sale, and business and nonprofit activity on acquisition and upon joint venture formation, classified as held-for-sale.

name: SegmentDomain
standard_label: Segments [Domain]
documentation: Components of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.

name: SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLongLivedAssets
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Long-Lived Asset, Expenditure for Addition
documentation: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived asset included in determination of segment asset by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Long-lived asset excludes financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

name: SegmentExtensibleList
standard_label: Segment [Extensible Enumeration] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Indicates component of entity engaging in business activity from which revenue is recognized and expense is incurred. Includes, but is not limited to, transaction with another component of same entity.

name: SegmentGeographicalDomain
standard_label: Geographical [Domain]
documentation: Geographical area.

name: SegmentGeographicalGroupsOfCountriesGroupOneMember
standard_label: Segment, Geographical, Groups of Countries, Group One [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A specified group of foreign countries about which segment information is provided by the entity. The entity is expected to change the standard label to identify the specified group.

name: SegmentGeographicalGroupsOfCountriesGroupTwoMember
standard_label: Segment, Geographical, Groups of Countries, Group Two [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A second specified group of foreign countries about which segment information is provided by the entity.

name: SegmentInterestRevenueReportedNetOfInterestExpense
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Interest Revenue Reported Net of Interest Expense [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether interest revenue is reported net of interest expense for reportable segment.

name: SegmentOperatingActivitiesDomain
standard_label: Operating Activities [Domain]
documentation: Operations of an entity including continuing and discontinued operations.

name: SegmentReportingAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting [Abstract]

name: SegmentReportingAssetReconcilingItemLineItems
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Asset Reconciling Item [Line Items] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SegmentReportingCodmIndividualTitleAndPositionOrGroupOrCommitteeNameExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Segment Reporting, CODM, Individual Title and Position or Group Name [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates title and position of individual or name of group identified as chief operating decision maker (CODM) for segment reporting.

name: SegmentReportingCodmProfitLossMeasureHowUsedDescription
standard_label: Segment Reporting, CODM, Profit (Loss) Measure, How Used, Description
documentation: Description of how chief operating decision maker (CODM) uses reported segment profit (loss) measure to assess performance and allocate resource.

name: SegmentReportingDescriptionOfAllOtherSegments
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Revenue, Source, Other Category, Description
documentation: Description of source of revenue included in other segment reporting category.

name: SegmentReportingDisclosureOfEntitysReportableSegmentsAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Descriptive Information [Abstract]

name: SegmentReportingDisclosureOfMajorCustomers
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Customer, Extent of Reliance, Description
documentation: Description of extent of reliance on customer. Includes, but is not limited to, revenue from transaction with single customer that is 10 percent or more than consolidated revenue and segment reporting revenue from such customer.

name: SegmentReportingDisclosureOfOtherInformationAboutEntitysReportableSegmentsAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Disclosure of Other Information about Entity's Reportable Segments [Abstract]

name: SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Segment Reporting [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for segment reporting.

name: SegmentReportingExpenseInformationUsedByCodmBudgetMember
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Expense Information Used by CODM, Budget [Member]
documentation: Budgeted expense information for segment used by chief operating decision maker (CODM) to manage operation.

name: SegmentReportingExpenseInformationUsedByCodmConsolidatedMember
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Expense Information Used by CODM, Consolidated [Member]
documentation: Consolidated expense information used by chief operating decision maker (CODM) to manage operation.

name: SegmentReportingExpenseInformationUsedByCodmDescription
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Expense Information Used by CODM, Description
documentation: Description of nature of expense information used by chief operating decision maker (CODM) to manage operation when segment expense information by category is not disclosed.

name: SegmentReportingExpenseInformationUsedByCodmForecastMember
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Expense Information Used by CODM, Forecast [Member]
documentation: Forecasted expense information for segment used by chief operating decision maker (CODM) to manage operation.

name: SegmentReportingExpenseInformationUsedByCodmTypeDomain
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Expense Information Used by CODM, Type [Domain]
documentation: Type of expense information used by chief operating decision maker (CODM) to manage operation when segment expense information by category is not disclosed.

name: SegmentReportingExpenseInformationUsedByCodmTypeExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Expense Information Used by CODM, Type [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of expense information used by chief operating decision maker (CODM) to manage operation when segment expense information by category is not disclosed.

name: SegmentReportingGeneralInformation
standard_label: Segment Reporting, General Information (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: General information about (a) factors used to identify reportable segments, including the basis of organization (for example, whether management has chosen to organize the enterprise around differences in products and services, geographic areas, regulatory environments, or a combination of factors and whether operating segments have been aggregated to reportable segments) and (b) types of products and services from which each reportable segment derives its revenues.

name: SegmentReportingGeographicalLongLivedAssetInformationImpracticable
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Geographical Area, Long-Lived Asset, Information Impracticable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether it is impracticable to provide geographical information about long-lived asset. Long-lived asset excludes financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

name: SegmentReportingGeographicalRevenueInformationImpracticable
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Geographical Area, Revenue, Information Impracticable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether it is impracticable to provide geographical information about revenue.

name: SegmentReportingInformationAdditionalElementsForBankPresentationAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Bank Presentation, Supplemental [Abstract]

name: SegmentReportingInformationAdditionalInformationAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: SegmentReportingInformationAverageAssets
standard_label: Segment Reporting Information, Average Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of average assets attributed to the reportable segment.

name: SegmentReportingInformationIncomeLossBeforeIncomeTaxesAbstract
standard_label: Segment Reporting, Income (Loss) before Income Tax [Abstract]

name: SeniorDebtObligationsMember

name: SeniorLoansMember
standard_label: Senior Loans [Member]
documentation: A senior loan takes priority over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors.

name: SeniorLongTermNotes
standard_label: Senior Notes, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

name: SeniorLongtermNotesCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Senior Notes [Abstract]

name: SeniorNotes
standard_label: Senior Notes
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

name: SeniorNotesCurrent
standard_label: Senior Notes, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term notes having the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. name: SeniorNotesMember
standard_label: Senior Notes [Member]
documentation: Bond that takes priority over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior debt holders receive priority for (must receive) repayment prior to (relative to) junior and unsecured (general) creditors.

name: SeniorSubordinatedLoansMember
standard_label: Senior Subordinated Loans [Member]
documentation: A senior subordinated loan takes priority over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior subordinated debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors. name: SeniorSubordinatedNotesMember
standard_label: Senior Subordinated Notes [Member]

In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior subordinated debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors. However senior subordinated notes are junior to Senior Notes and Senior bond holders.

name: ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChangesThatAffectBalance
standard_label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Other Changes that Affect Balance
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

name: ServicingLiabilityAtFairValuePeriodIncreaseDecrease

name: ServicingLiabilityChangeInValuationTechnique

name: ServicingLiabilityChangeInValuationTechniqueReasonExtensibleList

name: ServicingLiabilityFairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelExtensibleList

name: ServicingLiabilityMeasurementInput

name: ServicingLiabilityMeasurementInputExtensibleList

name: ServicingLiabilityTypeExtensibleList

name: ServicingLiabilityValuationTechniqueExtensibleList

documentation: Indicates valuation technique for measuring servicing liability.

name: SettledLitigationMember

name: SettlementLiabilitiesCurrent
standard_label: Settlement Liabilities, Current

name: SettlementOfAssetRetirementObligationsThroughNoncashPayments
standard_label: Settlement of Asset Retirement Obligations Through Noncash Payments, Description (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of asset retirement obligations settled through noncash transactions. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

name: SettlementOfAssetRetirementObligationsThroughNoncashPaymentsAmount
standard_label: Settlement of Asset Retirement Obligations Through Noncash Payments, Amount
documentation: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled through noncash transactions. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

name: SettlementOfDebtMember

documentation: An agreement between a borrower and a lender to reduce the amount due the lender.

name: SettlementOfLitigationMember
standard_label: Settlement of Litigation [Member] (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Resolution of pending or threatened litigation after the balance sheet date.

name: SettlementWithTaxingAuthorityMember
standard_label: Settlement with Taxing Authority [Member]
documentation: Settlement reached with a taxing authority.

name: SeveranceCosts
standard_label: Severance Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The charge against earnings in the period for known and estimated costs of termination benefits provided to current employees that are involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination or a discontinued operation as defined by generally accepted accounting principles and costs associated wi

name: SeveranceCosts1
standard_label: Severance Costs
documentation: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

name: SfpLocationActivityAccrualAxis

documentation: Information by location in statement of financial position line item where disaggregated accrual activity is included.

name: SfpLocationActivityCapitalizationAxis
standard_label: Location, Statement of Financial Position, Activity, Capitalization [Axis]
documentation: Information by location in statement of financial position line item where disaggregated capitalized activity is included.

name: ShareBasedArrangementsToObtainGoodsAndServicesAbstract
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Disclosure [Abstract]

name: ShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
documentation: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

name: ShareBasedCompensationAbstract
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense [Abstract]

name: ShareBasedCompensationAllocationAndClassificationInFinancialStatementsAbstract
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Recognized Amount [Abstract]

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAcceleratedCompensationCost
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Accelerated Cost
documentation: Amount of additional cost recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement from occurrence of event accelerating recognition of cost.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAdditionalGeneralDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Additional General Disclosures [Abstract]

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardExpirationDating
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Expiration Date (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The date when the equity-based award expires as specified in the award agreement, which may be presented in a variety of ways (for example, year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter of a year).

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardRequisiteServicePeriod
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Requisite Service Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Description of the estimated period of time over which an employee is required to provide service in exchange for the equity-based payment award, which often is the vesting period. This period may be explicit or implicit based on the terms of the award, and may be presented in a variety of ways (for example, year, month and year, day, month and year, quarter of a year).

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardRequisiteServicePeriod1
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Requisite Service Period
documentation: Estimated period when employee is required to provide service in exchange for share-based payment arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Description of the period of time over which an employee's right to exercise an award is no longer contingent on satisfaction of either a service condition, market condition or a performance condition, which may be expressed in a variety of ways (for example, in years, month and year).

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriod1
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period
documentation: Period over which grantee's right to exercise award under share-based payment arrangement is no longer contingent on satisfaction of service or performance condition, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, combination of market, performance or service condition.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriodMaximum
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The maximum vesting term over which an employee's right to exercise an award is no longer contingent on satisfaction of either a service condition, market condition or a performance condition.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPeriodMinimum
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Period, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The minimum vesting term over which an employee's right to exercise an award is no longer contingent on satisfaction of either a service condition, market condition or a performance condition.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingRights
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Award Vesting Rights
documentation: Description of service or performance condition required to be met for earning right to award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, combination of market, performance or service condition.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardCompensationCost
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Compensation Cost (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Equity-based compensation cost during the period with respect to the award, which will be recognized in income (as well as the total recognized tax benefit) or capitalized as part of the cost of an asset.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardDescription
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Description
documentation: Description of terms of share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, type of award or grantee and reason for issuance.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardDiscountFromMarketPriceOfferingDate
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Offering Date
documentation: Discount rate from fair value on offering date that participants pay for shares.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardDiscountFromMarketPricePurchaseDate
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Purchase Date
documentation: Discount rate from fair value on purchase date that participants pay for shares.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityConvertedInPeriod
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Converted in Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The decrease in the number of shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance pertaining to outstanding equity-based awards for which the grantee exercised or converted the award into shares, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsAdditionalDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeitedInPeriod
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeitedInPeriodIntrinsicValue
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period, Intrinsic Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The intrinsic value of equity-based payment equity instruments, excluding stock or unit options, that were forfeited during the reporting period, as calculated by applying the disclosed pricing methodology.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeitedInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect during the reporting period as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event specified in the contractual agreement of the plan.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeituresIntrinsicValue
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
documentation: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award forfeited under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsForfeituresWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
documentation: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
documentation: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriodIntrinsicValue
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
documentation: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
documentation: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedIntrinsicValue
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instrument Other than Option, Nonvested, Intrinsic Value
documentation: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedIntrinsicValueRollForward
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share [Abstract]

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedNumber

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedRollForward

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsNonvestedWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValueRollForward
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value [Abstract]
documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsOutstandingWeightedAverageRemainingContractualTerm
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The weighted average period between the balance sheet date and expiration for equity-based awards other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan), which may be expressed in a decimal value for number of years.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsOutstandingWeightedAverageRemainingContractualTerms
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Outstanding, Weighted-Average Remaining Contractual Term
documentation: Weighted-average contractual term remaining for equity-based award excluding option, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: The net total number of shares (or other type of equity) under an equity-based award plan, other than a stock option plan, that were granted, vested and forfeited during the reporting period.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseIntrinsicValue
standard_label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease), Intrinsic Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Change in the intrinsic value of nonvested awards on equity-based plans excluding option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, revenue or profit achievement stock award plan).

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsShareBasedLiabilitiesPaid
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-Based Liabilities Paid

standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExercisePrice
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Exercise Price
documentation: Agreed-upon price for the exchange of the underlying asset relating to the share-based payment award.

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedDividendPayments
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Payments

name: ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsRiskFreeInterestRateMinimum
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Minimum
