documentation: Undiscounted amount, after reinsurance, of incurred claims and allocated claim adjustment expense used in claims development for short-duration insurance contracts. Excludes unallocated claim adjustment expense.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndAllocatedClaimAdjustmentExpenseNet
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Allocated Claim Adjustment Expense, Net
documentation: Undiscounted amount, after reinsurance, of the liability for unpaid claims and allocated claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts. Excludes unallocated claim adjustment expense.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndAllocatedClaimAdjustmentExpenseNetAbstract
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Allocated Claim Adjustment Expense, Net [Abstract]

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndAllocatedClaimAdjustmentExpenseNetNotSeparatelyPresented
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Allocated Claim Adjustment Expense, Net, Not Separately Presented
documentation: Undiscounted amount, after reinsurance, of the liability for unpaid claims and allocated claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts for accident years not separately presented in claim development information. Excludes unallocated claim adjustment expense.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimAdjustmentExpenseAggregateReconcilingItems
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claim Adjustment Expense, Aggregate Reconciling Items
documentation: Amount of aggregate reconciling items for the reconciliation of the liability in the disclosure of claims development (in excess of) less than the liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimAdjustmentExpenseOtherReconcilingItem
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claim Adjustment Expense, Other Reconciling Item
documentation: Amount of reconciling item for the reconciliation of the liability in the disclosure of claims development (in excess of) less than the liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts, classified as other.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAccumulatedForeignExchange
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Accumulated Foreign Exchange
documentation: Amount of accumulated increase (decrease) to the liability for unpaid claims and claim adjustment expenses used for claim development from a foreign exchange rate (gain) loss.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseAccumulatedUnallocatedClaimAdjustmentExpense
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Accumulated Unallocated Claim Adjustment Expense
documentation: Amount of liability for unallocated claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseDescriptionOfChangeInAssumptions
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Description of Change in Assumptions
documentation: Description of changes in assumptions made in calculating the liability for unpaid claims and claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts. Includes, but is not limited to, the reasons for the change and the effects on the financial statements.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseDescriptionOfChangeInMethodologies
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Description of Change in Methodologies
documentation: Description of changes in methodologies made in calculating the liability for unpaid claims and claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts. Includes, but is not limited to, the reasons for the change and the effects on the financial statements.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsNumberOfReportedClaims
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contract, Cumulative Number of Reported Claims
documentation: Cumulative number of reported claims for short-duration insurance contracts.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsReconciliationOfClaimsDevelopmentToLiabilityLineItems
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Reconciliation of Claims Development to Liability [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsReconciliationOfClaimsDevelopmentToLiabilityTable
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Reconciliation of Claims Development to Liability [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about the reconciliation of claims development to the liability for unpaid claims and claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsReconciliationOfClaimsDevelopmentToLiabilityTableTextBlock
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Reconciliation of Claims Development to Liability [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure for the reconciliation of claims development to the liability for unpaid claims and claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts.

name: ShortdurationInsuranceContractsScheduleOfHistoricalClaimsDurationTableTextBlock
standard_label: Short-Duration Insurance Contracts, Schedule of Historical Claims Duration [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of average annual percentage payout of incurred claims by age, after reinsurance, for short-duration insurance contracts.

name: ShorttermDebtAverageOutstandingAmount
standard_label: Short-Term Debt, Average Outstanding Amount
documentation: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, average borrowings during the period.

name: ShorttermDebtFairValue
standard_label: Short-Term Debt, Fair Value
documentation: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the

name: ShorttermDebtMaximumAmountOutstandingDuringPeriod
standard_label: Short-Term Debt, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
documentation: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, the maximum amount borrowed at any time during the period.

name: ShorttermDebtMaximumMonthendOutstandingAmount
standard_label: Short-Term Debt, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
documentation: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, maximum month-end borrowings during the period.

name: SifmaMunicipalSwapRateMember
standard_label: SIFMA Municipal Swap Rate [Member]
documentation: Fixed rate on US dollar, constant-notional interest rate swap with its variable-rate leg referenced to Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) Municipal Swap Index with no additional spread over SIFMA Municipal Swap Index on its variable-rate leg.

name: SignageRevenue
standard_label: Signage Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from renting space for public and private signs (for example, advertising on taxies, buses, subways and billboards).

name: SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock
standard_label: Significant Accounting Policies [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for all significant accounting policies of the reporting entity.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsAcquisitionCostsOrSaleProceeds
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Acquisition Costs or Sale Proceeds (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The value of all consideration given or received by the Entity in the significant acquisition or disposal.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsByTransactionAxis
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals by Transaction [Axis] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the categories of acquisition and disposal transactions that affect property, plant and equipment.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsDateOfTransactionForAcquisitionsOrDisposals
standard_label: Acquisitions and Disposals, Date of Transaction for Acquisition or Disposal (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Date of acquisition or disposal, in CCYY-MM-DD format.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsDescription
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Disclose applicable facts, circumstances and descriptions pertaining to acquisitions or disposals of fixed assets.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsGainLossOnSaleOrDisposalNetOfTax
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Gain (Loss) on Sale or Disposal, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The difference between the value of the consideration received by the Entity on the sale or disposal and the consideration received by the Entity, including any tax related impact.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsGainLossOnSaleOrDisposalPretax
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Gain (Loss) on Sale or Disposal, Pretax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The difference between the value of the consideration received by the Entity on the sale or disposal and net book value of assets sold or disposed, before any tax related impact.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsLineItems
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals [Line Items] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsRestrictionOnAmountOfProceedsFromDonatedPropertyPlantAndEquipment
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Restriction on Amount of Proceeds from Donated Property, Plant, and Equipment (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The amount of the restriction on the proceeds from the disposition of donated property, plant, and equipment which was purchased with cash restricted for acquisitions of long-lived assets.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsTerms
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Terms (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Significant aspects of the transaction which have been mutually agreed upon by the Entity and all other involved parties.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsTransactionDomain
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Transaction [Domain] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of the specific acquisition or disposal transaction, which distinguishes it from similar transactions.

name: SignificantAcquisitionsAndDisposalsType
standard_label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Type (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: A single word or group of words that defines whether a transaction is an acquisition or a disposal.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleAmountOfUnrecordedBenefit
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Amount of Unrecorded Benefit
documentation: The amount of the unrecognized tax benefit of a position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount thereof will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleEstimatedRangeNotPossible
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range Not Possible
documentation: A statement that a range of reasonably possible change cannot be made for a tax position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount of unrecognized tax benefit will significantly increase or decrease within 12 months of the balance sheet date.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleEstimatedRangeOfChangeLowerBound
standard_label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Lower Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount of (increase) decrease reasonably possible in the estimated lower bound of the unrecognized tax benefit for a tax position taken or expected to be taken.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleEstimatedRangeOfChangeUpperBound
standard_label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Upper Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount of (increase) decrease reasonably possible in the estimated upper bound of the unrecognized tax benefit for a tax position taken or expected to be taken.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleLineItems
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleNatureOfUncertaintyDomain
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Nature of Uncertainty [Domain]
documentation: The nature of the uncertainty for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount of the unrecognized tax benefit will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleOtherInformation
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Other Information
documentation: Other information relative to a tax position which it is reasonably possible that the total amount of the unrecognized tax benefit will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIsReasonablyPossibleTable
standard_label: Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefit, Reasonably Possible [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about unrecognized tax benefit for which significant change is reasonably possible within 12 months. Includes, but is not limited to, nature of uncertainty, nature of event that could cause significant change within 12 months, and estimate of range of reasonably possible change or statement of fact that estimate of range cannot be made.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsNatureOfEvent
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Nature of Event
documentation: This element provides a description of the nature of the event that could occur within twelve months of the reporting date that would cause a significant increase or decrease in the related unrecognized tax benefit.

name: SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsNatureOfUncertainty
standard_label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Nature of Uncertainty (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This element provides a description of the nature and other information deemed necessary to provide an understanding of the uncertain tax position or contingency giving rise to the significant expected increase or decrease within twelve months of the reporting date in the related unrecognized tax benefit.

name: SignificantChangesFrachisedOutletsInOperation
standard_label: Significant Changes, Franchised Outlets in Operation
documentation: The number of franchised outlets in operation at the balance sheet date when there are significant changes in franchisor-owned outlets or franchised outlets during the period.

name: SignificantChangesFrachisorOutletsInOperation
standard_label: Significant Changes, Franchisor Outlets in Operation
documentation: The number of franchisor-owned outlets in operation at the balance sheet date when there are significant changes in franchisor-owned outlets or franchised outlets during the period.

name: SignificantChangesFranchisesPurchasedDuringPeriod
standard_label: Significant Changes, Franchises Purchased During Period
documentation: The number of franchises purchased during the period when there are significant changes in franchisor-owned outlets or franchised outlets during the period.

name: SignificantChangesFranchisesSold
standard_label: Significant Changes, Franchises Sold
documentation: The number of franchises sold during the period when there are significant changes in franchisor-owned outlets or franchised outlets during the period.

name: SignificantChangesInOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Significant Changes in Operations [Abstract]

name: SignificantChangesInReserves
standard_label: Significant Changes in Reserves
documentation: Description of significant changes to reserve quantities during the period including, but not limited to, changes in the following: revisions of previous estimates, revisions of estimates from application of improved recovery techniques, purchases of minerals in place, extensions and discoveries made, production, and sales of minerals in place.

name: SignificantCostsIncurredToAcquireMineralInterestOfProvedReserves
standard_label: Significant Costs Incurred to Acquire Mineral Interest of Proved Reserves (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Significant costs that have been incurred, including capitalized costs and costs charged to expense, to acquire mineral interests that have proved reserves.

name: SignificantEconomicInterestInStandardizedMeasureOfDiscountedFutureNetCashFlowsAttributableToConsolidatedSubsidiaryIesWithSignificantMinorityInterests
standard_label: Significant Economic Interest in Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flows Attributable to Consolidated Subsidiary(ies) with Significant Noncontrolling Interests
documentation: If a significant portion of the economic interest in the consolidated standardized measure of discounted future net cash flows reported is attributable to a consolidated subsidiary(ies) in which there is a significant noncontrolling interest, that fact and the approximate portion is disclosed here.

name: SignificantMattersUnresolvedSinceBankruptcyEmergence
standard_label: Significant Matters Unresolved Since Bankruptcy Emergence (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: To: Description of significant matters that have not been resolved since emergence from bankruptcy.

name: SignificantMattersUnresolvedSinceBankruptcyEmergenceDescriptionOfMatters
standard_label: Significant Matters Unresolved Since Bankruptcy Emergence, Description of Matters (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of significant matters remaining to be resolved.

name: SignificantMattersUnresolvedSinceBankruptcyEmergenceProcessForResolutionOfRemainingClaims
standard_label: Significant Matters Unresolved Since Bankruptcy Emergence, Process for Resolution of Remaining Claims (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Description of process for resolution of remaining claims by prepetition creditors.

name: SignificantPurchaseAndSupplyCommitmentExcludingLongtermCommitmentTextBlock
standard_label: Purchase and Supply Commitment, Excluding Long-Term Commitment [Text Block] (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: The entire disclosure for arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or service from one or more suppliers, or to commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers. May include identification of the goods or services to be purchased, the goods or services to be furnished, identity of the buyer or seller, pricing, effects on pricing (such as penalties) of failing to reach minimum quantities required to be purchased, effects on pricing (such as

name: SignificantPurchaseCommitmentDescription
standard_label: Purchase Commitment, Description
documentation: Excluding long-term commitments, description of arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from one or more suppliers, which may include identification of the goods or services to be purchased, identity of the seller, pricing, effects on pricing (such as penalties) of failing to reach minimum quantities required to be purchased, cancellation rights, and termination provisions.

name: SignificantPurchaseCommitmentRemainingMinimumAmountCommitted
standard_label: Purchase Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The floor amount as of the balance sheet date that the entity must expend to satisfy the terms of disclosed arrangements (excluding long-term commitments) in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from one or more suppliers, other than under a long-term purchase commitment or an unconditional purchase obligation.

name: SignificantSourcesOfTheExposureToLossQualitative
standard_label: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Determination Factors
documentation: Describes and explains the significant sources of the reporting entity's exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

name: SignificantSupplyCommitmentDescription
standard_label: Supply Commitment, Description
documentation: Excluding long-term commitments, description of arrangements in which the entity must commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers, which may include identification of the goods or services to be furnished, identity of the buyer, pricing, effects on pricing (such as penalties) of failing to deliver minimum quantities required to be furnished, cancellation rights, and termination provisions.

name: SignificantSupplyCommitmentRemainingMinimumAmountCommitted
standard_label: Supply Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
documentation: The floor amount as of the balance sheet date that the entity must expend to satisfy the terms of disclosed arrangements (excluding long-term commitments) in which the entity must commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers.

name: SignificantlyUndercapitalizedMember
standard_label: Prompt Corrective Action Category, Significantly Undercapitalized [Member]
documentation: Significantly undercapitalized category under prompt corrective action framework.

name: SingleEmployerPlansAccountedForAsMultiEmployerAbstract
standard_label: Multiple-Employer Plan Accounted for as Multiemployer Plan [Abstract]

name: SingleEmployerPlansAccountedForAsMultiemployerPlanContributions
standard_label: Single Employer Plans Accounted for as Multi-Employer, Plan Contributions (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Amount of contributions to a pension or other postretirement plan which is not defined as a multiemployer plan but is accounted for as a multiemployer plan.

name: SingleEmployerPlansAccountedForAsMultiemployerPlanName
standard_label: Multiple-Employer Plan Accounted for as Multiemployer Plan, Plan Name
documentation: Name of defined benefit plan, defined as multiple-employer plan but accounted for as multiemployer plan, in which entity participates.

name: SingleFamilyMember
standard_label: Single Family [Member]
documentation: Individual, freestanding, unattached residential building.

name: SingleStockFutureMember
standard_label: Single-Stock Future [Member]
documentation: A standardized contract, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell a certain stock, at a specified future date in the future, at a certain price.

name: SiteContingencyAccrualAssumptions
standard_label: Site Contingency, Accrual, Assumptions (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes the important assumptions underlying the estimate of the remediation loss, and may describe any changes in the assumptions made since the last reporting period.

name: SiteContingencyAccrualCaption
standard_label: Site Contingency, Accrual, Caption (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the balance sheet line item in which the accrual for the environmental loss contingency for an individual site is reflected.

name: SiteContingencyAccrualDiscountAmount
standard_label: Site Contingency, Accrual, Discount Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce the expected undiscounted amount of the accrual for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site to the present value recognized on the balance sheet for that site (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

name: SiteContingencyAccrualDiscountRate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Accrual, Discount Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Rate applied to the undiscounted amount of environmental loss contingencies at an individual site to arrive at the present value recorded as of the balance sheet date.

name: SiteContingencyAccrualPresentValue
standard_label: Site Contingency, Accrual, Present Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Present value of the accrual for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

name: SiteContingencyAccrualUndiscountedAmount
standard_label: Site Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Estimated undiscounted amount of the accrual for the environmental loss contingencies at an individual site as of the balance sheet date.

name: SiteContingencyByNatureAxis
standard_label: Environmental Remediation Site [Axis] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Information by environmental remediation site.

name: SiteContingencyCircumstancesImpactingPrecisionOfEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Circumstances Impacting Precision of Estimate
documentation: Circumstances affecting the reliability and precision of loss estimates for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyDisbursementPeriodEstimateAccrued
standard_label: Site Contingency, Disbursement Period, Estimate, Accrued
documentation: Period of disbursement over which accrued amount may be paid out for an individual site or group of sites, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: SiteContingencyDisbursementPeriodEstimateUnrecognized
standard_label: Site Contingency, Disbursement Period, Estimate, Unrecognized
documentation: Period of disbursement over which unrecognized amount may be paid out for an individual site or group of sites, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: SiteContingencyEnvironmentalRemediationCostsRecognized
standard_label: Site Contingency, Environmental Remediation Costs Recognized
documentation: Description of costs recognized in the balance sheet and income statement in the period for known or estimated future costs arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyEstimatedTimeFrameToResolveContingency
standard_label: Site Contingency, Estimated Time Frame to Resolve Contingency
documentation: Estimated time frame for resolution of the uncertainty as to the loss for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyFactorsChangingEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Factors Changing Estimate (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Factors that may cause a change in an estimate of a possible loss exposure that exceeds the amount accrued for the loss contingency, a recognized asset for third-party recoveries, an estimated loss contingency that has not been accrued, or a disclosed gain contingency for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyIndicationAccrualMayChange
standard_label: Site Contingency, Indication Accrual May Change (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Disclosure that it is reasonably possible that a change in an estimate of the obligation will occur in the near term when information available prior to issuance of the financial statements indicates that it is at least reasonably possible that the site accrual estimate will change due to one or more future confirming events.

name: SiteContingencyLineItems
standard_label: Site Contingency [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualBestEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Best Estimate
documentation: Best estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualDescription
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Description
documentation: Nature of the reasonably possible loss contingency and estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualHighEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High-end of the range estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureInExcessOfAccrualLowEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low-end of the range estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedBestEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Best Estimate
documentation: Best estimate of the loss exposure for reasonably possible environmental contingencies at an individual site for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedDescription
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Description (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Nature of the reasonably possible remediation loss contingency and estimate of the loss exposure at an individual site for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedHighEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: High-end of the range estimate of the loss exposure for reasonably possible environmental contingencies at an individual site for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedLowEstimate
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Low-end of the range estimate of the loss exposure for reasonably possible environmental contingencies at an individual site for which no accrual has been recorded.

name: SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedThirdPartyRecoveryCommentary
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Third-Party Recovery Commentary
documentation: Describes the extent to which disclosed but not recognized contingent remediation losses are expected to be recoverable through insurance, indemnification arrangements, or other sources, and any material limitations of that recovery.

name: SiteContingencyLossInestimableExplanation
standard_label: Site Contingency, Loss Inestimable Explanation
documentation: Reason(s) why an estimate of the probable or reasonably possible loss or range of loss at an individual site cannot be made.

name: SiteContingencyManagementAssessmentProcess
standard_label: Site Contingency, Management Assessment Process (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Describes management's process to evaluate the site contingency matter and to estimate the impact on the financial statements and ongoing operations.

name: SiteContingencyNameOfSite
standard_label: Site Contingency, Name of Site
documentation: Name of the individual site or other grouping of the contingency.

name: SiteContingencyNamesOfOtherPotentiallyResponsibleParties
standard_label: Site Contingency, Names of Other Potentially Responsible Parties (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Names of other potentially responsible parties for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyNatureAndTermsOfCostSharingRelationships
standard_label: Site Contingency, Nature and Terms of Cost Sharing Relationships
documentation: Nature and terms of cost-sharing arrangements with other potentially responsible parties for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyNatureOfContingencyDomain
standard_label: Site Contingency, Nature of Contingency [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Nature of the environmental remediation obligation or asset related to an individual site or other grouping of the contingency.

name: SiteContingencyRecoveryFromThirdPartyOfEnvironmentalRemediationCost
standard_label: Site Contingency, Recovery from Third Party of Environmental Remediation Cost
documentation: Amount of the estimated recovery from third parties recorded in the period for an individual site that reduces environmental remediation expense.

name: SiteContingencySoldStatus
standard_label: Site Contingency, Sold Status (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Discloses that the site or business containing the site has been sold and when the sale occurred.

name: SiteContingencyStatusOfRegulatoryProceedings
standard_label: Site Contingency, Status of Regulatory Proceedings
documentation: Status of regulatory proceedings associated with remediation of an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyTable
standard_label: Site Contingency [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about loss contingency for environmental remediation. Includes, but is not limited to, recognized loss and additional reasonably possible loss.

name: SiteContingencyTimeFrameForRecognizedProbableRecoveries
standard_label: Site Contingency, Time Frame for Recognized Probable Recoveries
documentation: Estimated time frame for realization of recognized probable recoveries for an individual site, if realization is not expected in the near term.

name: SiteContingencyTimeFrameOfDisbursements
standard_label: Site Contingency, Time Frame of Disbursements (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Estimated time frame of disbursements over which the accrued or presently unrecognized amounts may be paid out for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyUnassertedClaims
standard_label: Site Contingency, Unasserted Claims
documentation: Extent to which unasserted claims are reflected in an accrual or may affect the magnitude of the site contingency.

name: SiteContingencyUncertaintiesFromInsurance
standard_label: Site Contingency, Uncertainties from Insurance
documentation: Uncertainties with respect to the legal sufficiency of insurance claims or the solvency of carriers for an individual site.

name: SiteContingencyUncertaintiesFromJointAndSeveralLiability
standard_label: Site Contingency, Uncertainties from Joint and Several Liability
documentation: Uncertainties with respect to joint and several liability that may affect the magnitude of the contingency, including disclosure of the aggregate expected cost to remediate particular sites that are individually material if the likelihood of contribution by the other significant parties has not been established.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrual
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual
documentation: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsFromBusinessAcquisition
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
documentation: Amount of increase in liability for standard product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for extended warranty acquired in business combination.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualBalanceSheetCaption
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Balance Sheet Caption (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describes the line item on the balance sheet where the aggregate standard product warranty liability is recorded.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualBalanceSheetClassificationAbstract
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Balance Sheet Classification [Abstract]

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualCurrencyTranslationIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Currency Translation, Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Increase or Decrease in standard product warranty liability due to currency translation. Does not include any Increase or Decrease in an extended product warranty liability due to currency translation.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualCurrent
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Current
documentation: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualForeignCurrencyTranslationGainLoss
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
documentation: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualNoncurrent
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
documentation: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability that is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPayments
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
documentation: Amount of decrease in the standard product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard product warranty. Excludes extended product warranties.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistingIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes extended product warranties.

name: StandardProductWarrantyAccrualWarrantiesIssued
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
documentation: Amount of increase in the standard product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes extended product warranties.

name: StandardProductWarrantyDescription
standard_label: Standard Product Warranty Description
documentation: Describes the nature of the product warranty, including the approximate term of the product warranty, how the product warranty arose, and the events or circumstances that would require the warrantor to perform under the product warranty.

name: StandardizedMeasureOfDiscountedFutureNetCashFlowsRelatingToProvedOilAndGasReserves

name: StatutoryAccountingPracticesStatutoryCapitalAndSurplusRequired

documentation: Amount of net income for the period determined using accounting principles prescribed or permitted by insurance regulators.
