standard_label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory to GAAP, Amount of Reconciling Item (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: The amount of the specified reconciling item as of the balance sheet date reconciling the financial statements which use generally accepted accounting principles and the statutory financial statements which use statutory accounting practices prescribed or permitted by the state or country in which the filing is made.

name: StatutoryAccountingPracticesStatutoryToGAAPDescriptionOfReconcilingItem
standard_label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory to GAAP, Description of Reconciling Item
documentation: Description of the difference as of the balance sheet date between the financial statements which use generally accepted accounting principles and the statutory financial statements which use statutory accounting practices prescribed or permitted by the state or country in which the filing is made.

name: StatutoryAccountingPracticesTable
standard_label: Statutory Accounting Practices [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about statutory financial reporting and difference between reporting under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and result based on prescribed and permitted accounting practice of state or country of domicile in which statutory financial statements are required or National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) prescribed practice, or both.

name: StatutoryCapitalAndSurplusApplyingNationalAssociationOfInsuranceCommissionersNAICPractices
standard_label: Statutory Capital and Surplus Applying National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Practices
documentation: Amount of statutory capital and surplus computed using statutory accounting practices prescribed by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners.

name: StatutoryDividendPaymentRestrictionsDisclosure
standard_label: Statutory Dividend Payment Restrictions Disclosure
documentation: Disclosure of statutory restrictions on the payment of dividends as prescribed by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners or state regulatory authorities, amounts not available for future dividend payments, and amount of dividends paid.

name: SteamPlantMember
standard_label: Steam Plant [Member]
documentation: Plant used in connection with steam-power generation of electricity.

name: StepsTakenToEnsureOilAndGasDeliveryCommitments
standard_label: Steps Taken to Ensure Oil and Gas Delivery Commitments (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: The steps taken to ensure available reserves and supplies are sufficient to meet such commitments. Such future information is generally provided for an appropriate period of one to three years.

name: StockAndWarrantsIssuedDuringPeriodValuePreferredStockAndWarrants
standard_label: Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
documentation: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

name: StockAppreciationRightsSARSMember
standard_label: Stock Appreciation Rights (SARs) [Member]
documentation: Right to receive cash or shares equal to appreciation of predetermined number of grantor's shares during predetermined time period.

name: StockCompensationPlanMember
standard_label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Share-based payment arrangement in which award of equity shares are granted. Arrangement includes, but is not limited to, grantor incurring liability for product and service based on price of its shares.

name: StockDistributionMember
standard_label: Stock Distribution [Member]
documentation: Distribution of stock made by the entity based on a contractual agreement such as a partnership or employment agreement.

name: StockDividendsShares
standard_label: Stock Dividends, Shares
documentation: Number of shares of common and preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

name: StockDividendsSharesAbstract
standard_label: Stock Dividends, Shares [Abstract]

name: StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensation
standard_label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
documentation: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensationForfeited
standard_label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
documentation: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensationGross
standard_label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
documentation: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedCompensationNetofForfeituresAbstract
standard_label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]

name: StockIssued1
standard_label: Stock Issued
documentation: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharebasedCompensationAbstract
standard_label: Shares Granted or Issued, Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Abstract]

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcquisitions
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
documentation: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionOfConvertibleSecurities
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
documentation: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionOfUnits
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
documentation: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDividendReinvestmentPlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
documentation: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeBenefitPlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan
documentation: Number of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeStockOwnershipPlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
documentation: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeStockPurchasePlans
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
documentation: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForCash
standard_label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Shares, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Number of shares issued as consideration for cash for development stage entities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForNoncashConsideration
standard_label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Shares, Issued for Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Number of shares issued for noncash consideration for development stage entities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForServices
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
documentation: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
documentation: Number of new stock issued during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOther
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
documentation: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPurchaseOfAssets
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Purchase of Assets
documentation: Number of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardForfeited
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
documentation: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardGross
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
documentation: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardNetOfForfeitures
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
documentation: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardNetOfForfeituresAbstract
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesReverseStockSplits
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
documentation: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
documentation: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedCompensationForfeited
standard_label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
documentation: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedCompensationGross
standard_label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
documentation: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedCompensationNetofForfeituresAbstract
standard_label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised
standard_label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
documentation: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockSplits
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
documentation: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesTreasuryStockReissued
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
documentation: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcquisitions
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
documentation: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOfConvertibleSecurities
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
documentation: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOfConvertibleSecuritiesNetOfAdjustments
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments
documentation: The net amount of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities, net of adjustments (for example, to additional paid in capital) including the write-off of an equity component recognized to record the convertible debt instrument as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This item is meant to disclose the value of shares issued on conversion of convertible securities that were recorded as two separate (debt and equity) components.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOfConvertibleSecuritiesNetOfAdjustmentsAbstract
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments [Abstract]

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOfUnits
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
documentation: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDividendReinvestmentPlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
documentation: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeBenefitPlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
documentation: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStockOwnershipPlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
documentation: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStockPurchasePlan
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
documentation: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssuedForCash
standard_label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Value of shares issued as consideration for cash for development stage entities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssuedForNoncashConsiderations
standard_label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Value of shares issued for noncash consideration for development stage entities.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssuedForServices
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services
documentation: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
documentation: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueOther
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other
documentation: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValuePurchaseOfAssets
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
documentation: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedStockAwardForfeitures
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
documentation: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedStockAwardGross
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
documentation: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedStockAwardNetOfForfeitures
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
documentation: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedStockAwardNetOfForfeituresAbstract
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensation
standard_label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
documentation: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensationForfeited
standard_label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
documentation: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensationGross
standard_label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
documentation: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensationNetOfForfeituresAbstract
standard_label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockDividend
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend
documentation: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockOptionsExercised
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
documentation: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockOptionsExercisedNetOfTaxBenefitExpense
standard_label: Stock Issued, Value, Stock Options Exercised, Net of Tax Benefit (Expense)
documentation: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options, after deduction of related income tax (expense) benefit.

name: StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueTreasuryStockReissued
standard_label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
documentation: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockMarketPriceGuaranteeMember
standard_label: Stock Market Price Guarantee [Member]
documentation: A guarantee of the market price of the common stock of the guaranteed party.

name: StockOptionDownRoundFeatureDecreaseInNetIncomeLossToCommonShareholderAmount
standard_label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, Decrease in Net Income to Common Shareholder, Amount
documentation: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockOptionDownRoundFeatureIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount
standard_label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, (Increase) Decrease in Equity, Amount (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Amount of (increase) decrease in equity for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes stock option granted for share-based compensation.

name: StockOptionDownRoundFeatureIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount1
standard_label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, Increase (Decrease) in Equity, Amount
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockOptionDownRoundFeatureTrigger
standard_label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, Trigger [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether down round feature was triggered for option classified as equity. Excludes stock option granted for share-based compensation.

name: StockOptionExercisePriceDecrease
standard_label: Stock Option, Exercise Price, Decrease
documentation: Per share decrease in exercise price of option. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision and option granted under share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockOptionExercisePriceIncrease
standard_label: Stock Option, Exercise Price, Increase
documentation: Per share increase in exercise price of option. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision and option granted under share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockOptionMember
standard_label: Equity Option [Member]
documentation: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific quantity of stock at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option).

name: StockOptionPlanExpense
standard_label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
documentation: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

name: StockOptionsMember
standard_label: Stock Options [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Contract that gives the holder the right, but not the obligation, either to purchase or to sell a certain number of shares of stock at a predetermined price for a specified period of time.

name: StockOrUnitsAvailableForDistributions
standard_label: Stock or Units Available for Distributions
documentation: Number of stock or units eligible for distribution to members or limited partners of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

name: StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodShares
standard_label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares
documentation: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

name: StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodValue
standard_label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
documentation: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount
standard_label: Stock Repurchase Program, Authorized Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of a stock repurchase plan authorized by an entity's Board of Directors.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1
standard_label: Stock Repurchase Program, Authorized Amount
documentation: Amount of stock repurchase plan authorized.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramExpirationDate
standard_label: Stock Repurchase Program Expiration Date
documentation: Expiration date for the purchase of an entity's own shares under a stock repurchase plan, in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramNumberOfSharesAuthorizedToBeRepurchased
standard_label: Stock Repurchase Program, Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
documentation: The number of shares authorized to be repurchased by an entity's Board of Directors under a stock repurchase plan.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramPeriodInForce
standard_label: Stock Repurchase Program, Period in Force (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The number of years over which shares may be purchased under a stock repurchase plan authorized by an entity's Board of Directors.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramPeriodInForce1
standard_label: Share Repurchase Program, Period in Force
documentation: Period share may be purchased under authorized share repurchase plan, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorizedRepurchaseAmount
standard_label: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount remaining of a stock repurchase plan authorized by an entity's Board of Directors.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorizedRepurchaseAmount1
standard_label: Share Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized, Amount
documentation: Amount remaining authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

name: StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingNumberOfSharesAuthorizedToBeRepurchased
standard_label: Share Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized, Number of Shares
documentation: Number of shares remaining authorized to be purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

name: StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodShares
standard_label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
documentation: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

name: StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodValue
standard_label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
documentation: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

name: StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares
standard_label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
documentation: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

name: StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue
standard_label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
documentation: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

name: StockTransactionsParentheticalDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Stock Transactions, Parenthetical Disclosure [Abstract]

name: StockholdersEquity
standard_label: Equity, Attributable to Parent
documentation: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

name: StockholdersEquityAbstract
standard_label: Equity, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

name: StockholdersEquityAttributableToParentNotAllowableForNetCapital
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Not Allowable for Net Capital (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount of stockholders' equity attributable to the parent entity not allowable for net capital computed in accordance and used for compliance with regulatory requirements.

name: StockholdersEquityAverageAmountOutstanding
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Average Amount Outstanding
documentation: Average amount outstanding of stockholders' equity.

name: StockholdersEquityBeforeTreasuryStock
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity before Treasury Stock
documentation: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

name: StockholdersEquityChangeInReportingEntity
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Change in Reporting Entity (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Impact on total stockholders' equity of cumulative effect of change in reporting entity. A change in reporting entity is considered as follows: (1) presenting consolidated statements in place of the financial statements of individual reporting entities; (2) changing the combination of subsidiaries that make up the group for which the consolidated financial statements are presented; and (3) changing the entities included in the combined financial statements. A business combination accounted for u

name: StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
standard_label: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
documentation: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

name: StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterestAbstract
standard_label: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

name: StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterestAdjustedBalance
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount of stockholders' equity attributable to parent entity and noncontrolling interests (previously referred to as minority interests) net of the cumulative effect of prospective application of a new accounting principle on the beginning balance of equity.

name: StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterestAdjustedBalance1
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Amount of stockholders' equity including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interests, after the cumulative effect adjustment of a new accounting principle applied in the period of adoption.

name: StockholdersEquityNotAllowableForNetCapital
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Not Allowable for Net Capital (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Deduct stockholders' equity not allowable for net capital.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteAbstract
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note [Abstract]

name: StockholdersEquityNoteChangesInCapitalStructureRetroactiveImpact
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Changes in Capital Structure, Retroactive Impact
documentation: Description of the total capital structure change due to a stock dividend, stock split and reserve split occurring after the balance sheet date but prior to the later of the issuance of financial statement or the effective date of registration statement.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteChangesInCapitalStructureSubsequentChangesToNumberOfCommonShares
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Changes in Capital Structure, Subsequent Changes to Number of Common Shares
documentation: Change in number of shares issued and outstanding as a result of capital structure change to a stock dividend, stock split or reserve split occurring after the balance sheet date but prior to the later of the issuance of financial statements or the effective date of registration statement.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteDerivativeTransactionsConnectedWithContingentlyConvertibleSecurities
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Derivative Transactions Connected with Contingently Convertible Securities
documentation: Information regarding derivative transactions entered into in connection with the issuance of contingently convertible securities that may be useful in explaining the potential impact of the contingently convertible securities. This information may include the terms of the derivative transaction (including settlement terms), how the transactions relate to the contingently convertible securities, and the number of shares underlying the derivatives.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Equity [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for equity.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteImpactOfConversionOfContingentlyConvertibleSecuritiesOnDilutedEarningsPerShare
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Impact of Conversion of Contingently Convertible Securities on Diluted Earnings Per Share
documentation: Description of reason for including or excluding share issuable in conversion of contingently convertible security in calculation of diluted earnings per share.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteRedeemablePreferredStockIssuePolicy
standard_label: Preferred Stock, Redeemable [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for redeemable preferred stock issued. This disclosure may include the accounting treatment for the difference, if there is any, between the carrying value and redemption amount. For example, describe whether the issuer accretes changes in the redemption value.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteSpinoffTransaction
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction
documentation: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplit
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split
documentation: Description of the stock split arrangement. Also provide the retroactive effect given by a stock split that occurs after the balance date but before the release of financial statements.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: This item represents the conversion ratio used in the calculation of a stock split.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio
documentation: Ratio applied to the conversion of stock split, for example but not limited to, one share converted to two or two shares converted to one.

name: StockholdersEquityNoteSubscriptionsReceivable
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Subscriptions Receivable
documentation: Note received instead of cash as contribution to equity. The transaction may be a sale of capital stock or a contribution to paid-in capital.

name: StockholdersEquityNumberOfSharesParValueAndOtherDisclosuresAbstract
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

name: StockholdersEquityOther
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
documentation: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

name: StockholdersEquityOtherShares
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
documentation: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

name: StockholdersEquityPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.

name: StockholdersEquityPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for its capital stock transactions, including dividends and accumulated other comprehensive income.

name: StockholdersEquityQualifiedForNetCapital
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Qualified for Net Capital (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount of stockholders' equity attributable to the parent entity that is computed in accordance and used for compliance with regulatory requirements.

name: StockholdersEquityQualifiedForNetCapitalAbstract
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Qualified for Net Capital [Abstract] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

name: StockholdersEquityReverseStockSplit
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Reverse Stock Split
documentation: Description of the reverse stock split arrangement. Also provide the retroactive effect given by the reverse split that occurs after the balance sheet date but before the release of financial statements.

name: StockholdersEquityTotalMember
standard_label: Stockholders' Equity, Total [Member]
documentation: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of total stockholders' equity, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation. Also called Net Assets.

name: StormCostsMember
standard_label: Storm Costs [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs for expected future uninsured storm damage.

name: StormDamageProvision
standard_label: Storm Damage Provision
documentation: A noncash adjustment to the provision established for storm damage by an oil, gas, or utility company.

name: StraightLineDepreciationMethodMember
standard_label: Depreciation Method, Straight-Line [Member]
documentation: Method of calculating depreciation equally over useful life.

name: StraightLineRent
standard_label: Straight Line Rent
documentation: Difference between actual rental income due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.

name: StraightLineRentAdjustments
standard_label: Straight Line Rent Adjustments
documentation: Amount of the adjustment to rental revenues to measure escalating leasing revenues on a straight line basis.

name: StrandedCostsMember
standard_label: Stranded Costs [Member]
documentation: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of stranded costs.

name: StructuredFinanceMember
standard_label: Structured Finance [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about generally complex financial arrangement used to help transfer risk, also referred to as structured debt.

name: StructuredSettlementAnnuitiesInterestRateHighEnd
standard_label: Structured Settlement Annuities, Interest Rate, High End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Maximum interest rate in the range of interest rates used to calculate future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process of structured settlement annuities.

name: StructuredSettlementAnnuitiesInterestRateLowEnd
standard_label: Structured Settlement Annuities, Interest Rate, Low End (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Minimum interest rate in the range of interest rates used to calculate future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process of structured settlement annuities.

name: StructuredSettlementAnnuitiesInterestRates
standard_label: Structured Settlement Annuities Interest Rates (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Relevant interest rate assumptions that are an integral part of the methodology used in calculating the future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process for Structu

name: StructuredSettlementAnnuityMember
standard_label: Structured Settlement Annuity [Member]
documentation: Contract providing periodic payments to a policyholder as agreed in settlement of a lawsuit.

name: StudentLoanMember
standard_label: Student Loan [Member]
documentation: Loan to finance tuition costs.

name: SubadvisoryFeesForMutualFunds
standard_label: Subadvisory Fees for Mutual Funds
documentation: Subadvisory fees that the funds adviser pays for out of the management fee, which it receives from the fund.

name: SubleaseIncome
standard_label: Sublease Income
documentation: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingAxis
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing [Axis]
documentation: Information by name of borrowing under subordinated debt agreement.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingDueDate
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing, Due Date
documentation: Date the payments are due on subordinated debt, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingInterestRate
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing, Interest Rate
documentation: Stated interest rate of the subordinated debt.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingLineItems
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingNameDomain
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing, Name [Domain]
documentation: Name of the borrowing under subordinated debt agreements, including exchange memberships contributed for the use of the Company.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingTable
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about borrowing under subordinated debt agreement that qualifies as available in computing net capital under U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) uniform net capital rule. Includes, but is not limited to, restrictive covenant, collateral, interest rate, due date, and amount due by date and owed in total.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingTermsAndConditions
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing Terms and Conditions
documentation: Terms and conditions of borrowings under subordinated debt agreements that qualify as available in computing net capital under SEC's uniform net capital rule, including restrictive covenants, collateral, and disclosure of the amount for which six months' notice has been given of intent to withdraw.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingWithSixMonthNoticeOfIntentToWithdraw
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowing with Six Month Notice of Intent to Withdraw (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Amount of subordinated debt for which six months notice of intent to withdraw has been provided.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingsAbstract
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowings [Abstract]

name: SubordinatedBorrowingsAllowableInComputationOfNetCapital
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowings Allowable in Computation of Net Capital (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: Amount of subordinated borrowings included in the computation of allowable capital for compliance with regulatory requirements.

name: SubordinatedBorrowingsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Subordinated Borrowings Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for borrowings under subordinated debt agreements that qualify as available in computing net capital under SEC's uniform net capital rule, including restrictive covenants, collateral, interest rates and due dates, amounts due by date and amount owed in total.

name: SubordinatedDebenturesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember
standard_label: Subordinated Debentures Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
documentation: A debt instrument that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur. This instrument is not secured by physical assets or other collateral and is backed only by the general creditworthiness and reputation of the issuer. Subordinated debentures are debt securities with a current interest rate that is senior in liquidation preference to all equit

name: SubordinatedDebt
standard_label: Subordinated Debt
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

name: SubordinatedDebtCurrent
standard_label: Subordinated Debt, Current
documentation: The portion of the carrying value of subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle, if longer. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

name: SubordinatedDebtMember
standard_label: Subordinated Debt [Member]
documentation: This element represents domestic or foreign subordinated debt. Subordinated debt has a lower priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

name: SubordinatedDebtObligationsMember
standard_label: Subordinated Debt Obligations [Member]
documentation: Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment and ahead of general creditors in a liquidation of the entity's assets.

name: SubordinatedLiabilitiesAdditions
standard_label: Subordinated Liabilities, Additions
documentation: New liabilities assumed during the reporting period that are subordinated to claims of general creditors.

name: SubordinatedLiabilitiesExtinguished
standard_label: Subordinated Liabilities, Extinguished
documentation: Liabilities that are subordinated to claims of general creditors and were paid or extinguished during the reporting period.

name: SubordinatedLiabilitiesPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Subordinated Liabilities, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in subordinated debt.

name: SubordinatedLongTermDebt
standard_label: Subordinated Long-Term Debt, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of collateralized/uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind the primary lender of the company.

name: SubordinatedLongtermDebtCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Subordinated Debt [Abstract]

name: SubordinatedNotesToFinanceLeveragedBuyout
standard_label: Subordinated Notes to Finance Leveraged Buyout (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Issuance of subordinated notes to finance leveraged buyout transaction.

name: SubprimeMember
standard_label: Subprime [Member]
documentation: Credit rating classification of borrowers with weak credit histories, including but not limited to, payment delinquencies, bankruptcies, foreclosures and high default rates.

name: SubscriptionAndCirculationMember
standard_label: Subscription and Circulation [Member]
documentation: Right to receive or access periodic material for specified period of time.

name: SubscriptionArrangementMember
standard_label: Subscription Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein a subscribers pay in advance for media (TV, newspaper, magazine, internet), which will generally be recognized as revenue as the media is delivered.

name: SubscriptionRevenue
standard_label: Subscription and Circulation Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Revenue from circulation or sale of subscriptions (for example, but not limited to, subscriptions to a magazine or newspaper).

name: SubsegmentsAxis
standard_label: Subsegments [Axis]
documentation: Information by business subsegments.

name: SubsegmentsConsolidationItemsAxis
standard_label: Subsegments Consolidation Items [Axis]
documentation: Information by subsegments, eliminations and reconciling items used in consolidating a reportable segment and its subsegments.

name: SubsegmentsConsolidationItemsDomain
standard_label: Subsegments Consolidation Items [Domain]
documentation: Subsegments, eliminations and reconciling items used in consolidating a reportable segment and its subsegments.

name: SubsegmentsDomain
standard_label: Subsegments [Domain]
documentation: Divisions of a component of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.

name: SubsequentEventAmount
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the known or estimated financial effect of the event, or transaction that occurred between the balance sheet date and the date the financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventAmountHigherRange
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Amount, Higher Range (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The highest estimated amount of the financial effect of the event or transaction that occurred between the balance sheet date and the date the financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventAmountInestimable
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Amount Inestimable (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: This element represents a statement that an identified subsequent is incapable of being estimated and the reasons therefore.

name: SubsequentEventAmountInestimable1
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Financial Effect, Inestimable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether estimate of financial effect cannot be made for nonrecognized subsequent event.

name: SubsequentEventAmountLowerRange
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Amount, Lower Range (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The lowest estimated amount of the financial effect of the event or transaction that occurred between the balance sheet date and the date the financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventDateEvaluated
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Evaluated (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The date through which subsequent events have been evaluated if the entity is not required to furnish financial statements with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or if an entity is subject to Section 12(i) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the appropriate agency under that section.

name: SubsequentEventDateEvaluatedDescription
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Evaluated, Description (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A description detailing whether the date through which subsequent events have been evaluated is the date the financial statements were issued or the date financial statements were available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventDateEvaluationEnded
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Evaluation Ended (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the actual date on which management's evaluation of the impact of subsequent events on the entity's financial statements ended.

name: SubsequentEventDateEvaluationEnded1
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Evaluation Ended (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Date management's evaluation of the impact of subsequent events on the entity's financial statements ended, in CCYY-MM-DD format.

name: SubsequentEventDateFinancialStatementsAvailableForIssuance
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Financial Statements Available for Issuance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The date the financial statements were available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventDateFinancialStatementsIssued
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Financial Statements Issued (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the date on which management issued the entity's financial statements.

name: SubsequentEventDateFinancialStatementsIssued1
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date Financial Statements Issued (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Date management issued the entity's financial statements, in CCYY-MM-DD format.

name: SubsequentEventDateThroughWhichEvaluated
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date through which Evaluated (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Describes whether subsequent events have been evaluated through (1) the date the financial statements were issued or (2) the date the financial statements were available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventDescription
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Description
documentation: Describes the event or transaction that occurred between the balance sheet date and the date the financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventEffectOfChangeInTaxStatus
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Effect of Change in Tax Status
documentation: Monetary effect of a change in the tax status effective after year-end but before the financial statements for the reporting period are issued or available to be issue by the entity.

name: SubsequentEventLineItems
standard_label: Subsequent Event [Line Items]
documentation: Detail information of subsequent event by type. User is expected to use existing line items from elsewhere in the taxonomy as the primary line items for this disclosure, which is further associated with dimension and member elements pertaining to a subsequent event.

name: SubsequentEventMember
standard_label: Subsequent Event [Member]
documentation: Identifies event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventProFormaBusinessCombinations
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Pro Forma Business Combinations or Disposals [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for pro forma information for significant acquisitions or disposals that occurred or are probable to occur after the balance sheet date.

name: SubsequentEventProFormaImpact
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Pro Forma Impact (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: Identifies the affected financial statement caption and sets forth the effect on the reported amount that a subsequent event would have had if the event had occurred as of the date of the balance sheet.

name: SubsequentEventRevisedFinancialStatementsDateEvaluated
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Revised Financial Statements, Date Evaluated (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The date through which subsequent events have been evaluated for the revised financial statements if the entity is not required to file or furnish financial statements with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or if an entity is subject to Section 12(i) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the appropriate agency under that section.

name: SubsequentEventRevisedFinancialStatementsDateEvaluatedDescription
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Revised Financial Statements, Date Evaluated, Description (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: A description detailing whether the date through which subsequent events have been evaluated for revised financial statements is the date the financial statements were issued or the date financial statements were available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventTable
standard_label: Subsequent Event [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about significant event or transaction occurring between statement of financial position date and date when financial statements were issued.

name: SubsequentEventTermOfContract
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Term of Contract (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Period the contract is outstanding, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: SubsequentEventTypeAxis
standard_label: Subsequent Event Type [Axis]
documentation: Information by event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventTypeDomain
standard_label: Subsequent Event Type [Domain]
documentation: Event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

name: SubsequentEventsAbstract
standard_label: Subsequent Events [Abstract]

name: SubsequentEventsDate
standard_label: Subsequent Event, Date
documentation: Date the event occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issues or available to be issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: SubsequentEventsPolicyPolicyTextBlock
standard_label: Subsequent Events, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for reporting subsequent events.

name: SubsequentEventsTextBlock
standard_label: Subsequent Events [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for significant events or transactions that occurred after the balance sheet date through the date the financial statements were issued or the date the financial statements were available to be issued. Examples include: the sale of a capital stock issue, purchase of a business, settlement of litigation, catastrophic loss, significant foreign exchange rate changes, loans to insiders or affiliates, and transactions not in the ordinary course of business.

name: SubservicingOfFinancialAssetsAgreementsDescription
standard_label: Subservicing of Financial Assets Agreements, Description (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Describes the significant terms of each agreement under which the entity is obligated to perform some or all of the customary procedures for servicing financial assets that the entity transferred or sold, or pertaining to servicing rights that it transferred or sold, including the anticipated risks and rewards, whether any yield guarantee, financing guarantee, or indemnifications from loss are given, and how revenue or loss is expected to be recognized. Subservicing rights are included in the co

name: SubsidiariesAndOtherInvestmentsOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipAbstract
standard_label: Subsidiaries and Other Investments of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership [Abstract] (Deprecated 2015-01-31)

name: SubsidiariesMember
standard_label: Subsidiaries [Member]
documentation: Entity owned or controlled by another entity.

name: SubsidiaryIssuerMember
standard_label: Subsidiary Issuer [Member]
documentation: A company controlled, directly or indirectly, by its parent, which has issued securities and those securities are guaranteed by its parent and another subsidiary of the parent.

name: SubsidiaryOfCommonParentMember
standard_label: Subsidiary of Common Parent [Member]
documentation: Refers to an entity under the control of the same parent as another entity (that is, a sister company).

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipBusinessPurpose
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Business Purpose
documentation: Description of business purpose of the subsidiary of the limited liability company or limited partnership, for example, its day-to-day operating functions and whether it acts as a holding or operating company.

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipDate
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Date
documentation: Date the subsidiary of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP) was formed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipLineItems
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipManagingMemberOrGeneralPartner
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Managing Member or General Partner
documentation: Individual, partnership, corporation, or other entity that is responsible for the day-to-day administration of the subsidiary of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP). May also include a description of the compensation or fee arrangements--such as incentive compensation--of the managing member or general partner as related to the performance of the subsidiary of the LLC or LP.

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipOwnershipInterest
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Ownership Interest
documentation: The number of units or percentage investment held in the subsidiary by the limited liability company or limited partnership.

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipState
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, State
documentation: State in which the subsidiary of the limited liability company or limited partnership was organized.

name: SubsidiaryOfLimitedLiabilityCompanyOrLimitedPartnershipType
standard_label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Type (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Indication of the legal form of the subsidiary of the limited liability company or limited partnership and whether it is public or private. If public, indication of the exchange on which the units are listed and traded.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeCumulativeNumberOfSharesIssuedForAllTransactions
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Number of Shares Issued for All Transactions
documentation: Cumulative number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee on all stock transactions.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeCumulativePercentageOwnershipAfterAllTransactions
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Percentage Ownership after All Transactions
documentation: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity method investee's stock owned by parent immediately after all stock transactions.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeCumulativeProceedsReceivedOnAllTransactions
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Proceeds Received on All Transactions
documentation: Cumulative amount of cash and other consideration received by subsidiary or equity method investee in exchange for shares or stock issued or sold. Include amounts of cash received, fair value of non-cash assets received, fair value of liabilities assumed, and fair value of any other forms of consideration.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeCumulativeProceedsReceivedOnAllTransactionsDescription
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Proceeds Received on All Transactions, Description (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: Describe the nature of the cumulative cash and other consideration received by subsidiary or equity method investee in exchange for shares or stock issued or sold. Items for which descriptions may be provided include descriptions of the amounts of cash, non-cash assets, liabilities assumed, and any other forms of consideration.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeDeferredIncomeTaxProvisionOnCumulativeGainLossRecognized
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Deferred Income Tax Provision on Gain (Loss) Recognized [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether deferred income tax has been provided for gain (loss) recognized in income from issuance of shares by subsidiary or equity method investee.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeDeferredIncomeTaxProvisionOnCumulativeGainLossRecognizedAmount
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Deferred Income Tax Provision on Gain (Loss) Recognized, Amount
documentation: The amount provided for deferred income taxes in relation to any gain (loss) recognized in income of the entity resulting from the issuance of shares by a subsidiary or equity method investee.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeLineItems
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeMinorityInterestInIncomeOfSubsidiary
standard_label: Subsidiary, Redeemable Preferred Stock Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Dividend
documentation: The dividends from redeemable preferred stock of a subsidiary that are accounted for as a noncontrolling interest in income of a subsidiary in a parent's consolidated financial statements.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeNatureOfOperations
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Nature of Operations
documentation: Description of the major products or services that a subsidiary or equity investee sells or provides and its principal markets, including locations of those markets.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteePricePerShare
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Price-Per-Share (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Price-per-share of common or preferred stock issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeReasonForOmittingDeferredIncomeTaxProvisionOnCumulativeGainLossRecognized
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Reason for Omitting Deferred Income Tax Provision on Gain (Loss) Recognized (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: If no provision for deferred income taxes in relation to any gain (loss) recognized in income of the entity resulting from the issuance of shares by a subsidiary or equity method investee has been recorded, this item represents an explanation as to the reasons for the omission of such deferred income taxes.

name: SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeSaleOfStockBySubsidiaryOrEquityInvesteeTable
standard_label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Sale of Stock, Type [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about sale of stock made by subsidiary or equity method investee to investor outside consolidated group by type of sale. Includes, but is not limited to, stock issued in business combination in exchange for share of acquired entity.

name: SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis
standard_label: Sale of Stock [Axis]
documentation: Information by type of sale of the entity's stock.

name: SubsidiarySaleOfStockLineItems
standard_label: Subsidiary, Sale of Stock [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: SubstandardMember
standard_label: Substandard [Member]
documentation: A category of financing receivables that are inadequately protected by the current sound worth and paying capacity of the obligor or of the collateral pledged, if any. Loans so classified have a well-defined weakness or weaknesses that jeopardize the liquidation of the debt. They are characterized by the distinct possibility that the creditor will sustain some loss if the deficiencies are not corrected.

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernConditionsOrEvents
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern, Conditions or Events
documentation: Description of principal conditions or events that raised substantial doubt about the ability to continue as a going concern.

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernManagementsEvaluation
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern, Management's Evaluation
documentation: Description of management's evaluation of the significance of conditions or events in relation to the ability to meet its obligations.

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernManagementsPlansSubstantialDoubtAlleviated
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern, Management's Plans, Substantial Doubt Alleviated
documentation: Description of management's plans that alleviated substantial doubt about the ability to continue as a going concern.

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernManagementsPlansSubstantialDoubtNotAlleviated
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern, Management's Plans, Substantial Doubt Not Alleviated
documentation: Description of management's plans that are intended to mitigate the conditions or events that raise substantial doubt about the ability to continue as a going concern.

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernResolutionOfConditionsOrEvents
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern, Resolution of Conditions or Events
documentation: Description of how the conditions or events that raised substantial doubt were resolved in a subsequent period.

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernTextBlock
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure when substantial doubt is raised about the ability to continue as a going concern. Includes, but is not limited to, principal conditions or events that raised substantial doubt about the ability to continue as a going concern, management's evaluation of the significance of those conditions or events in relation to the ability to meet its obligations, and management's plans that alleviated or are intended to mitigate the conditions or events that raise substantial doubt abou

name: SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernWithinOneYear
standard_label: Substantial Doubt about Going Concern, within One Year [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether there was substantial doubt about ability to continue as going concern within one year after date financial statements are issued.

name: SuccessorMember
standard_label: Successor [Member] (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
documentation: This element represents the designation of financial information as pertaining, but not limited, to a successor company or plan as defined in the context of the financial statements.

name: SummaryInvestmentHoldingsTextBlock
standard_label: Summary Investment Holdings [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the summary of investment holdings.

name: SummaryOfCashFlowHedgeActivityAbstract
standard_label: Summary of Cash Flow Hedge Activity [Abstract]

name: SummaryOfCreditDerivativesAbstract
standard_label: Summary of Credit Derivatives [Abstract]

name: SummaryOfDeferredTaxLiabilityNotRecognizedTextBlock
standard_label: Summary of Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of deferred tax liabilities not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes, including a description of the temporary differences, events that would cause the temporary differences to become taxable, the cumulative amounts of the temporary differences and the amounts not recognized as deferred tax liabilities or a statement that the determination of the deferred tax liabilities is not practicable.

name: SummaryOfDerivativeInstrumentsAbstract
standard_label: Summary of Derivative Instruments [Abstract]

name: SummaryOfDerivativeInstrumentsByHedgeDesignationAbstract
standard_label: Summary of Derivative Instruments by Hedge Designation [Abstract]

name: SummaryOfDerivativeInstrumentsByRiskExposureAbstract
standard_label: Summary of Derivative Instruments by Risk Exposure [Abstract]

name: SummaryOfDerivativeInstrumentsImpactOnResultsOfOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Summary of Derivative Instruments Impact on Results of Operations [Abstract]

name: TransferredAtPointInTimeMember

name: TransferredOverTimeMember

documentation: Contract with customer in which good or service is transferred over time.

name: TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowingsAssetsCarryingAmount
standard_label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Assets, Carrying Amount

name: TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowingsAssociatedLiabilitiesCarryingAmount

documentation: Carrying amount of liabilities associated with financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

name: TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowingsClassificationAssets
standard_label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Classification, Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The classification in the transferor's statement of financial position as of the end of the period for transfers of financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings.

name: TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowingsClassificationAssociatedLiabilities
standard_label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Classification, Associated Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The classification in the transferor's statement of financial position as of the end of the period for the liabilities, if any, associated with transfers of financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings.

standard_label: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets, Servicing of Financial Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for servicing assets and liabilities including, but not necessarily limited to: (a) how a servicing asset or servicing liability is initially recognized and measured, (b) management's basis for determining its classes of servicing assets and servicing liabilities, (c) where contractually specified fees, late fees or ancillary fees are reported in the statement of income, (d) how the entity subsequently measures each class of servicing assets and servicing liabilit

standard_label: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for a transferor's continuing involvement in financial assets that it has transferred in a securitization or asset-backed financing arrangement, the nature of any restrictions on assets reported by an entity in its statement of financial position that relate to a transferred financial asset (including the carrying amounts of such assets), how servicing assets and servicing liabilities are reported, and (for securitization or asset-backed financing arrangements accounted for

standard_label: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets, Transfers of Financial Assets, Aggregation, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for aggregating similar transfers. Disclosures may be aggregated for similar transfers if separate reporting of each transfer would not provide more useful information to financial statement users. Describes how an entity determines how much detail it must provide and how it information for assets with different risk characteristics.

name: TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialAssetsTransfersOfFinancialAssetsFinancingsPolicy
standard_label: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets, Transfers of Financial Assets, Financings, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing whether a transfer of a financial asset is accounted for as a financing, and its initial and subsequent accounting for such a transaction.

name: TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialAssetsTransfersOfFinancialAssetsPolicy
standard_label: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets, Transfers of Financial Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for transfers of financial assets, including securitization transactions. The disclosure is generally expected to include how the entity determines whether a transaction is accounted for as a sale or financing, and the initial and subsequent accounting for such a transaction. standard_label: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets, Transfers of Financial Assets, Sales, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing whether a transfer of a financial asset qualifies for sale treatment, and its initial and subsequent accounting for a sale transaction.
