name: TypeOfRestructuringDomain
standard_label: Type of Restructuring [Domain]
documentation: Identification of the types of restructuring costs.

name: TypeOfRevenueExtensibleList
standard_label: Revenue, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates type of revenue from product and service. Includes, but is not limited to, revenue from contract with customer and other sources.

name: TypesOfCommercialAircraftAbstract
standard_label: Types of Commercial Aircraft [Abstract] (Deprecated 2022)

name: TypesOfCommercialAircraftTable
standard_label: Types of Commercial Aircraft [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about type of commercial aircraft.

name: TypesOfCommercialAircraftTableTextBlock
standard_label: Types of Commercial Aircraft [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of information by type of commercial aircraft.

name: TypesOfCostsForRecovery
standard_label: Types of Costs for Recovery (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Describes the costs that may be recovered by rates (for example, decommissioning, environmental, legal, income taxes). May also include procedures for estimating costs and the applicable accounting.

name: TypesOfCreditRiskDerivativesUsed
standard_label: Types of Credit Risk Derivatives Used (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of the types of credit risk derivative instruments used. For example, credit default swaps, total return swaps, credit spreadlocks, and so forth.

name: TypesOfForeignCurrencyDerivativesUsed
standard_label: Types of Foreign Currency Derivatives Used (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the types of foreign currency exchange rate derivative instruments used. For example, forward contracts, options, and so forth.

name: TypesOfInterestRateDerivativesUsed
standard_label: Types of Interest Rate Derivatives Used (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the types of interest rate derivative instruments used. For example, swaps, caps, floors, collars, and so forth.

name: TypesOfItemsHedgedByCreditRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Types of Items Hedged by Credit Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Description of the instruments designated as hedged items in hedges involving credit risk derivatives.

name: TypesOfItemsHedgedByForeignCurrencyDerivatives
standard_label: Types of Items Hedged by Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of hedged items in foreign currency hedges.

name: TypesOfItemsHedgedByInterestRateDerivatives
standard_label: Types of Items Hedged by Interest Rate Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of the instruments designated as hedged items in hedges involving interest rate derivatives.

name: TypesOfItemsHedgedByPriceRiskDerivatives
standard_label: Types of Items Hedged by Price Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Description of the instruments designated as hedged items in hedges involving price risk derivatives. For example, a forecasted purchase of commodity inventory or the fair value of equity securities held.

name: TypesOfNetRegulatoryAssetsEarningReturns
standard_label: Types of Net Regulatory Assets Earning Returns
documentation: Identifies what net regulatory assets are earning a return through rate billings.

name: TypesOfPriceRiskDerivativesUsed
standard_label: Types of Price Risk Derivatives Used (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the types of price risk derivative instruments used. For example, forwards, options, swaps, caps, floors, collars, and so forth. Includes the nature of underlyings on the derivatives, such as commodity forward purchase contracts or put options on equity securities.

name: USGovernmentAgenciesDebtSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Government Agencies Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Debentures, notes, and other debt securities issued by US government agencies, for example, but not limited to, Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae). Excludes US treasury securities and debt issued by government-sponsored Enterprises (GSEs), for example, but is not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

name: USGovernmentAgenciesSecuritiesAtCarryingValue
standard_label: Cash Equivalent, US Government Agency Security, Carrying Value
documentation: Debt securities issued by a United States government agency such as Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac), and Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae), which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with origi

name: USGovernmentAgenciesShorttermDebtSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Government Agencies Short-Term Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Debt securities issued by US government agencies, for example, but not limited to, Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae) which have maturities of one year or less. Excludes US Treasury securities and debt issued by Government-sponsored Enterprises (GSEs), for example, but not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae).

name: USGovernmentAndGovernmentAgenciesAndAuthoritiesMember
standard_label: US Government and Government Agencies and Authorities [Member] (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: This category includes investments in debt securities issued by: (1) the United States Department of the Treasury and backed by the United States government. Such securities primarily consist of treasury bills (short-term maturities - one year or less), treasury notes (intermediate term maturities - two to ten years), and treasury bonds (long-term maturities - ten to thirty years) and (2) US Government Corporations and Agencies. Such US Government Corporations may include debt securities issued

name: USGovernmentCorporationsAndAgenciesSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Government Corporations and Agencies Securities [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about debt issued by US Government Corporations and Agencies. Investments in such US Government Corporations may include debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae) and by the Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) and the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac).

name: USGovernmentDebtSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Government Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Debt securities issued by the United States government.

name: USGovernmentSecuritiesAtCarryingValue
standard_label: Cash Equivalent, US Government Security, Carrying Value
documentation: Debt (bills, notes or bonds) that are issued by the government of the United States which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment.

name: USGovernmentSponsoredEnterprisesDebtSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Government-sponsored Enterprises Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by US government sponsored entities (GSEs), for example, but not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB). Excludes debt issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).

name: USStatesAndPoliticalSubdivisionsMember
standard_label: US States and Political Subdivisions Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Bonds or similar securities issued by state, city, or local US governments or the agencies operated by state, city, or local governments. Debt securities issued by state governments may include bond issuances of US state authorities including, for example, but not limited to, housing authorities, dormitory authorities, and general obligations while debt securities issued by political subdivisions of US states would include, for example, debt issuances by county, borough, city, or municipal gover

name: USTreasuryAndGovernmentMember
standard_label: US Treasury and Government [Member]
documentation: This category includes investments in debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury, US Government Agencies and US Government-sponsored Enterprises. Such securities may include treasury bills (short-term maturities - one year or less), treasury notes (intermediate term maturities - two to ten years), and treasury bonds (long-term maturities - ten to thirty years), debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae) and debt securities issu

name: USTreasuryAndGovernmentShorttermDebtSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Treasury and Government Short-Term Debt Securities [Member]
documentation: Debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury, US Government Agencies and US Government-sponsored Enterprises (GSEs). Includes, but not limited to, treasury bills, debt securities issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), and debt securities issued by the Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae) or the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac) which securities have maturities of one year or less.

name: USTreasuryBillSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Treasury Bill Securities [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about negotiable debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury which generally have maturities of one year or less, are interest bearing, and are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government.

name: USTreasuryBondSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Treasury Bond Securities [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about negotiable debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury which generally have maturities greater than ten and as long as thirty years, are interest bearing, and are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government.

name: USTreasuryNotesSecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Treasury Notes Securities [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about negotiable debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury which generally have maturities of one to ten years, are interest bearing, and are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government.

name: USTreasurySecuritiesMember
standard_label: US Treasury Securities [Member]
documentation: This category includes information about debt securities issued by the United States Department of the Treasury and backed by the United States government. Such securities primarily consist of treasury bills (short-term maturities - one year or less), treasury notes (intermediate term maturities - two to ten years), and treasury bonds (long-term maturities - ten to thirty years).

name: UnallocatedAmountToSegmentMember
standard_label: Unallocated Amount to Segment [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Corporate headquarter items not allocated to segments. Reconciliation of the total of reportable segments' amounts of revenues, measures of profits or loss, assets, or amounts for every other significant item of information disclosed, to the consolidated amount.

name: UnallocatedFinancingReceivablesMember
standard_label: Unallocated Financing Receivables [Member]
documentation: Financing receivables that have not been allocated to a portfolio segment.

name: UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedExceedCeilingLimitationsAbstract
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost, Cost Center Ceiling Limitation [Abstract]

name: UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDeferredIncomeTaxesExceedCeilingLimitationExpense
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost in Excess of Cost Center Ceiling Limitation, Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for excess of unamortized cost capitalized within cost center, less related deferred income tax, over cost center ceiling limitation for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

name: UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDeferredIncomeTaxesExceedCeilingLimitationsCostCenter
standard_label: Unamortized Costs Capitalized Less Related Deferred Income Taxes Exceed Ceiling Limitations, Cost Center (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: The cost center for which unamortized costs capitalized less related deferred income taxes exceed the cost center ceiling limitation for oil and gas producing companies that use full cost method of accounting for investments in oil and gas producing properties.

name: UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDeferredIncomeTaxesExceedCeilingLimitationsExplanationOfExpenseNotCharged
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost in Excess of Cost Center Ceiling Limitation, Expense Not Charged, Description
documentation: If as of an entity's fiscal year-end, its capitalized costs exceed the limitation prescribed, but events occur subsequent to year end that if the full cost ceiling limitation were recomputed giving effect to those factors as of year end, the ceiling would more than cover the costs, and the excess was not charge against earnings, this disclosure would provide the explanation.

name: UnamortizedDebtIssuanceExpense
standard_label: Unamortized Debt Issuance Expense
documentation: The remaining balance of debt issuance expenses that were capitalized and are being amortized against income over the lives of the respective bond issues. This does not include the amounts capitalized as part of the cost of the utility plant or asset.

name: UnamortizedDiscountsOnAcceptancesExecuted
standard_label: Unamortized Discounts on Acceptances Executed
documentation: The amount of the unearned (fee) income on the financial institution's issuance of short-term negotiable time drafts (also known as Banker's Acceptances).

name: UnamortizedDiscountsOnAcceptancesResold
standard_label: Unamortized Discounts on Acceptances Resold
documentation: The amount of the unamortized discount or expense related to the financial institution's sale of short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by the institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances) in the secondary market.

name: UnamortizedLoanCommitmentAndOriginationFeesAndUnamortizedDiscountsOrPremiums
standard_label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums
documentation: Amount of deferred fees paid by borrowers and unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

name: UnamortizedLoanCommitmentAndOriginationFeesAndUnamortizedDiscountsOrPremiumsAbstract
standard_label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: UnamortizedLoanCommitmentAndOriginationFeesAndUnamortizedDiscountsOrPremiumsCommercial
standard_label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of fees paid by commercial borrowers which have not yet been taken into income and unamortized costs incurred to originate commercial loans and leases, unamortized commercial loan commitments and commercial loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of commercial loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield.

name: UnamortizedLoanCommitmentAndOriginationFeesAndUnamortizedDiscountsOrPremiumsConsumer
standard_label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of fees paid by consumer borrowers which have not yet been taken into income and unamortized costs incurred to originate consumer loans and leases, unamortized consumer loan commitments and consumer loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of consumer loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield.

name: UnamortizedLoanCommitmentAndOriginationFeesAndUnamortizedDiscountsOrPremiumsForeign
standard_label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of fees paid by foreign borrowers which have not yet been taken into income and unamortized costs incurred to originate foreign loans and leases, unamortized foreign loan commitments and foreign loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of foreign loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield.

name: UnamortizedLoanCommitmentAndOriginationFeesAndUnamortizedDiscountsOrPremiumsOther
standard_label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Reflects the cumulative amount of fees paid by borrowers, which relationship is not otherwise defined (such as commercial, consumer, or foreign), which have not yet been taken into income and unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, not otherwise categorized (such as commercial, consumer, or foreign), unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of loans, not otherwise categorized (such as commercial, consumer, or forei

name: UnamortizedLossReacquiredDebtNoncurrent
standard_label: Unamortized Loss Reacquired Debt, Noncurrent
documentation: Unamortized Loss on Reacquired Debt is the loss incurred upon reacquisition or refinancing of debt, is treated as a deferred charge and amortized over the life of the new debt issued.

name: UnapprovedChangeOrdersAmount
standard_label: Construction Contractor, Contract Cost, Subject to Uncertainty, Amount
documentation: Amount of cost incurred on construction contract for unapproved change order, claim, or similar item subject to uncertainty.

name: UnapprovedChangeOrdersDescription
standard_label: Contract Cost, Unapproved Change Order, Description (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of nature and status of item comprising cost incurred on construction contract for unapproved order and basis on which item is recorded.

name: UnassertedClaimMember
standard_label: Unasserted Claim [Member]
documentation: A claim for damages that is likely to be made and for which it is reasonably possible that there will be an unfavorable outcome, such as a likelihood that lawsuits from parties as yet unidentified will be filed alleging injury from using a product when other parties have successfully sued the entity for such use.

name: UnassumedDebtOfSubsidiaryAbstract
standard_label: Unassumed Debt of Subsidiary [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: UnbilledChangeOrders
standard_label: Unbilled Change Orders
documentation: Total amount of unbilled change orders from customers under long-term contracts or programs associated with unpriced change orders or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization.

name: UnbilledChangeOrdersAbstract
standard_label: Unbilled Change Orders [Abstract]

name: UnbilledChangeOrdersAmountExpectedToBeCollectedAfterOneYear
standard_label: Unbilled Change Orders, Amount Expected to be Collected after One Year
documentation: Amount of unbilled change orders from customers under long-term contracts or programs associated with unpriced change orders or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization which is expected to be collected after one year from the balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledChangeOrdersAmountExpectedToBeCollectedWithinOneYear
standard_label: Unbilled Change Orders, Amount Expected to be Collected within One Year
documentation: Amount of unbilled change orders from customers under long-term contracts or programs associated with unpriced change orders or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization which is expected to be collected within one year from the balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledContractsReceivable
standard_label: Unbilled Contracts Receivable
documentation: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the entity and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts associated with contracts or programs where the recognized revenue for performance thereunder exceeds the amounts billed under the terms thereof as of the date of the balance sheet.

name: UnbilledReceivablesCurrent
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Current
documentation: Amount received for services rendered and products shipped, but not yet billed, for non-contractual agreements due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAmountExpectedToBeCollectedAfterNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected after Next Rolling 12 Months
documentation: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected after the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAmountExpectedToBeCollectedInNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected in Next Rolling 12 Months
documentation: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAmountExpectedToBeCollectedInRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected in Remainder of Fiscal Year
documentation: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAtBalanceSheetDate
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable
documentation: Amount of unbilled receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAtBalanceSheetDateAbstract
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAtBalanceSheetDateAmountExpectedToBeCollectedAfterOneYear
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected after Next 12 Months
documentation: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected after the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAtBalanceSheetDateAmountExpectedToBeCollectedWithinOneYear
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected in Next 12 Months
documentation: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected in the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableAtBalanceSheetDateDescriptionOfPrerequisitesForBillings
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable at Balance Sheet Date, Description of Prerequisites for Billings (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: A general description of the prerequisites for billing for amounts recognized under contracts that have not been billed and were not billable at the date of the balance sheet.

name: UnbilledReceivablesNotBillableRollingMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Rolling Maturity [Abstract]

name: UnbilledRevenuesMember
standard_label: Unbilled Revenues [Member]
documentation: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or products shipped. This element is distinct from unbilled contracts receivables because this is based on noncontract transactions.

name: UncertaintiesAbstract
standard_label: Uncertainties [Abstract] (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

name: UncertaintyContinuedMarketabilityOfGoodsAndServices
standard_label: Uncertainty, Continued Marketability of Goods and Services (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Describes uncertainties pertaining to economic life of products, which is normal in high-tech industries, or services.

name: UncertaintyRegulatoryOversight
standard_label: Uncertainty, Regulatory Oversight (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of uncertainties that arise due to the entity being subject to regulatory oversight. At a minimum, the description informs financial statement users of the general nature of the uncertainty.

name: UnclassifiedIndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsMember
standard_label: Unclassified Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets [Member]
documentation: Costs of contractual or legal rights meeting the criteria for capitalization as intangible assets apart from goodwill, which have indefinite life and that are not otherwise specified in the taxonomy.

name: UncollateralizedMember
standard_label: Uncollateralized [Member]
documentation: No pledge of specific property to serve as protection or security against default.

name: UncollectibleReceivablesMember
standard_label: Uncollectible Receivables [Member]
documentation: A revision in the estimated reserve needed to reduce the carrying amount of accounts receivable to net realizable value with respect to credit and collection risk.

name: UncompletedWellsEquipmentAndFacilitiesMember
standard_label: Uncompleted Wells Equipment and Facilities [Member]
documentation: Equipment, facilities and wells that have not been completed and installed.

name: UnconditionalPurchaseObligationCategoryOfGoodsOrServicesAcquiredDomain
standard_label: Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Category of Goods or Services Acquired [Domain]
documentation: General description of the goods or services to be purchased from the counterparty to the unconditional purchase arrangement.

name: UnconditionalPurchaseObligationsExcludingCapitalStockRedemptionsAbstract
standard_label: Unconditional Purchase Obligations (Excluding Capital Stock Redemptions) [Abstract]

name: UnconsolidatedPropertiesMember
standard_label: Unconsolidated Properties [Member]
documentation: Represents real estate properties and units within those properties that are partially owned that are not consolidated within the entity's financial statements.

name: UnconsolidatedPropertyAndCasualtyInsuranceEntityMember
standard_label: Unconsolidated Property and Casualty Insurance Entity [Member]
documentation: A noncontrolled subsidiary that is a property and casualty insurance underwriter, and which does not separately file financial schedules with the SEC.

name: UndercapitalizedMember
standard_label: Prompt Corrective Action Category, Undercapitalized [Member]
documentation: Undercapitalized category under prompt corrective action framework.

name: UnderfundedPlanMember
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Underfunded Plan [Member]
documentation: Defined benefit plan in which retirement benefits are payable directly from plan assets segregated and restricted to provide such benefits and for which benefit obligation exceeds plan assets available to provide retirement benefits.

name: UnderlyingAssetClassAxis
standard_label: Underlying Asset Class [Axis]
documentation: Information by underlying asset class.

name: UnderlyingAssetClassDomain
standard_label: Underlying Asset Class [Domain]
documentation: Major types of referenced/underlying asset classes (for example, corporate debt, sovereign debt, and structured finance).

name: UnderlyingDerivative
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingDerivativeAsset
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative Asset (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative asset contract but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingDerivativeEnergyMeasure
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative Energy Measure
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in energy volume but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingDerivativeFlowRate
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative Flow Rate
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in flow rate but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingDerivativeLiability
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative Liability (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative liability contract but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingDerivativeMass
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative Mass
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in mass but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingDerivativeVolume
standard_label: Underlying, Derivative Volume
documentation: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in volume but not the derivative contract itself.

name: UnderlyingOtherMember
standard_label: Underlying, Other [Member]
documentation: Represents a subset of hybrid instruments that have embedded credit derivatives with an underlying(s) other than corporate or sovereign debt or a structured finance product.

name: UnderwritingCommitments
standard_label: Underwriting Commitments
documentation: Disclose the effect on the financial statements of underwriting commitments open at year-end and subsequently settled.

name: UnderwritingExpenseRatio
standard_label: Underwriting Expense Ratio
documentation: Ratio of non-life acquisition expenses and certain non-life general and administrative expenses, to non-life net premiums earned.

name: UnderwritingIncomeLoss
standard_label: Underwriting Income (Loss)
documentation: The difference between the price paid by the public and the contract price less the related expenses. A broker-dealer may underwrite a security offering by contracting to buy the issue either at a fixed price or a price based on selling the offering on a best-effort basis.

name: UndistributedContinuingOperationEarningsLossAllocationToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Continuing Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

name: UndistributedContinuingOperationEarningsLossAllocationToParticipatingSecuritiesDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Continuing Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations allocated to participating securities for diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

name: UndistributedContinuingOperationEarningsLossBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Continuing Operation Earnings (Loss), Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations, allocated to common stock and participating securities, as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedContinuingOperationEarningsLossDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Continuing Operation Earnings (Loss), Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations, allocated to common stock and participating securities, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedDiscontinuedOperationEarningsLossAllocationToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

name: UndistributedDiscontinuedOperationEarningsLossAllocationToParticipatingSecuritiesDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to participating securities for diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

name: UndistributedDiscontinuedOperationEarningsLossBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations, allocated to common stock and participating securities, as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedDiscontinuedOperationEarningsLossDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations, allocated to common stock and participating securities, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedDomesticEarningsMember
standard_label: Undistributed Domestic Earnings [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Undistributed earnings of a domestic subsidiary or a domestic corporate joint venture that is essentially permanent in duration that arose in fiscal years beginning on or before December 15, 1992; a last-in, first-out (LIFO) pattern determines whether reversals pertain to differences that arose in fiscal years beginning on or before the date specified.

name: UndistributedEarnings
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings, Basic
documentation: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed.

name: UndistributedEarningsAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings, Basic [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsAllocatedToParticipatingSecurities
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings Allocated to Participating Securities (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Earnings allocated (not distributed) to participating securities under the two-class method to the extent that participating securities may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed.

name: UndistributedEarningsDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings, Diluted
documentation: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed. Includes the adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

name: UndistributedEarningsDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings, Diluted [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesBasicAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Basic [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Diluted [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAvailableToCommonShareholdersBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to common stock as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAvailableToCommonShareholdersBasicAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Basic [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAvailableToCommonShareholdersDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss), allocated to common stock, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAvailableToCommonShareholdersDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAvailableToCommonShareholdersOperationsBasicAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Basic, Operations [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossAvailableToCommonShareholdersOperationsDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted, Operations [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsLossFromContinuingOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations allocated to common stock as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossFromContinuingOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations, allocated to common stock, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersBasic
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to common stock as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedEarningsLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsAvailableToCommonShareholdersDiluted
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations, allocated to common stock, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

name: UndistributedEarningsOfDomesticSubsidiaries
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings of Domestic Subsidiaries
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings of domestic subsidiaries or domestic joint ventures intended to be permanent.

name: UndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiaries
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
documentation: Amount of undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries intended to be permanently reinvested outside the country of domicile.

name: UndistributedEarningsOperationsBasicAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings, Basic, Operations [Abstract]

name: UndistributedEarningsOperationsDilutedAbstract
standard_label: Undistributed Earnings, Diluted, Operations [Abstract]

name: UndistributedIncomeFromOtherThanGainOrLossOnSaleOfProperties
standard_label: Undistributed Income from Other than Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the balance as of the reporting date of undistributed income derived from other than the gain (loss) on sale of properties which is otherwise disclosed. The purpose of separately disclosing such information is to distinguish between income generated from the operation of a real estate investment trust's property portfolio and the gain (loss) attributable to the sale of such properties.

name: UndistributedIncomeFromOtherThanGainOrLossOnSaleOfPropertiesMember
standard_label: Undistributed Income from Other than Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties [Member] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the balance as of the reporting date of undistributed income derived from other than the gain (loss) on sale of properties which is otherwise disclosed.

name: UndistributedNetRealizedGainOrLossOnSaleOfProperties
standard_label: Undistributed Net Realized Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the accumulated amount as of the reporting date of undistributed income derived from the gain (loss) on sale of properties which is otherwise disclosed. The purpose of separately disclosing such information is to distinguish between income generated from the gain (loss) attributable to the sale of a real estate investment trust's portfolio properties and the operation of such properties.

name: UndistributedNetRealizedGainOrLossOnSaleOfPropertiesMember
standard_label: Undistributed Net Realized Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties [Member] (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: This element represents the accumulated amount as of the reporting date of undistributed income derived from the gain (loss) on sale of properties which is otherwise disclosed.

name: UndividedInterestMember
standard_label: Undivided Interest [Member]
documentation: Ownership arrangement in which two or more parties jointly own property, and title is held individually to the extent of each party's interest.

name: UnearnedESOPShares
standard_label: Unearned ESOP Shares
documentation: Fair value of unearned shares for all classes of common stock and nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes the sale of shares or the issuance treasury shares to an ESOP.

name: UnearnedPremiums
standard_label: Unearned Premiums
documentation: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

name: UnearnedPremiumsLongDurationMember
standard_label: Unearned Premiums, Long Duration [Member] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein premiums written are initially booked as unearned and are generally recognized as revenue over the expected term of the long-duration insurance contract. A long-duration contract is generally not subject to unilateral changes in its provisions, such as a noncancelable or guaranteed renewable contract, and requires the performance of various functions and services (including insurance protection) for an extended period.

name: UnearnedPremiumsShortDurationMember
standard_label: Unearned Premiums, Short Duration [Member] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein premiums written are initially booked as unearned and are generally recognized as revenue over the expected term of the short-duration insurance contract. A short-duration contract provides insurance protection for a fixed period of short duration and enables the insurer to cancel the contract or to adjust the provisions of the contract at the end of any contract period, such as adjusting the amount of premiums charged or coverage provided.

name: UnfavorableRegulatoryActionMember
standard_label: Unfavorable Regulatory Action [Member]
documentation: Enacted or proposed action, ruling, or regulation that is likely to, or possibly, will have adverse effect on financial position or result of operation. Excludes income tax matter.

name: UnfundedLoanCommitmentMember
standard_label: Unfunded Loan Commitment [Member]
documentation: Undisbursed funds of a credit facility in which the borrower may draw upon.

name: UnfundedPlanMember
standard_label: Defined Benefit Plan, Unfunded Plan [Member]
documentation: Defined benefit plan in which retirement benefits are payable directly from general assets of employer sponsoring plan.

name: UninsuredRiskMember
standard_label: Uninsured Risk [Member]
documentation: Risk arising from insurance deductibles, self-insurance, or no insurance.

name: UnionizedEmployeesConcentrationRiskMember
standard_label: Unionized Employees Concentration Risk [Member]
documentation: Reflects the percentage that unionized employees, in either labor costs for the period or number of personnel as of the balance sheet date or on average for the period, are to a specified benchmark, such as total operating expenses, total labor costs, total corresponding number of personnel. Risk is the materially adverse effects of strikes and unfavorable contract negotiations with employees covered by collective bargaining arrangements.

name: UnitDistributionMember
standard_label: Unit Distribution [Member]
documentation: Distribution of units made by the entity based on a contractual agreement such as a partnership or employment agreement.

name: UnitedStateDistrictCourtCentralDistrictOfCaliforniaMember
standard_label: United States District Court, Central District of California [Member]
documentation: Trial court of U.S. federal judiciary in central district of California.

name: UnitedStateDistrictCourtDistrictOfArizonaMember
standard_label: United States District Court, District of Arizona [Member]
documentation: Trial court of U.S. federal judiciary in Arizona.

name: UnitedStatesPensionPlansOfUSEntityDefinedBenefitMember
standard_label: United States Pension Plan of US Entity [Member] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Plan designed to provide participants with a benefit at retirement, that is U.S.-based. Excludes other postretirement benefit plans.

name: UnitedStatesPostretirementBenefitPlansOfUSEntityDefinedBenefitMember
standard_label: United States Postretirement Benefit Plan of US Entity [Member] (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: Plan designed to provide participants with a benefit, other than a pension benefit, at retirement, that is U.S.-based.

name: UnitrancheDebtMember
standard_label: Unitranche Debt [Member]
documentation: Financing that combines senior debt, second lien loans, subordinated debt or preferred stock into one financing transaction. May include fixed or floating rate loan (combining senior, mezzanine and equity type returns into one rate) to multiple tranches of financing in a single transaction.

name: UnitsOfPartnershipInterestAmount
standard_label: Units of Partnership Interest, Amount
documentation: The number of units or equivalent units outstanding for all classes.

name: UnitsOfPartnershipInterestDescription
standard_label: Units of Partnership Interest, Description
documentation: Description of the ownership interests of the partnership which are represented by units. There may be different classes of units which have different preferences and conversion rights to stock or cash. Also includes a discussion of each class of members' interests and respective rights, preferences and privileges.

name: UnitsOfProductionDepreciationMethodMember
standard_label: Depreciation Method, Units-of-Production [Member]
documentation: Method of calculating depreciation based on actual usage.

name: UniversalLifeMember
standard_label: Universal Life [Member]
documentation: Life insurance contract under which premiums are generally flexible, the level of death benefits may be adjusted, and mortality expense, and other charges may vary.

name: UnlikelyToBeCollectedFinancingReceivableMember
standard_label: Unlikely to be Collected Financing Receivable [Member]
documentation: Financing arrangement that represents a contractual right to receive money either on demand or on fixed or determinable dates that are considered uncollectible or of little value. Excludes no recovery or salvage value.

name: UnpaidPolicyClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpensePolicy
standard_label: Unpaid Policy Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for estimating the ultimate cost of settling insurance claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the statement of financial position date). The estimated liability includes the amount of money that will be required for future payments of (a) claims that have been reported to the insurer, (b) claims related to insured events that have occurred but that have not been reported to the insurer as of the date the li

name: UnpatentedTechnologyMember
standard_label: Unpatented Technology [Member]
documentation: Technology-based innovations or scientific advances that have not been patented.

name: UnprovedOilAndGasPropertyOrMajorProjectDomain
standard_label: Unproved Oil and Gas Property or Major Project [Domain] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Unproved properties and major development projects that are excluded from the capitalized costs being amortized.

name: UnprovedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethod
standard_label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Unproved Property, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Impairment
documentation: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment, of oil and gas properties with unproved reserve accounted for under successful efforts method.

name: UnprovedPropertiesDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Unproved Properties Disclosure [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
documentation: Tabular disclosure of unproved oil and gas property.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingAfterTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingAfterTaxAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction, Operating, after Tax [Abstract]

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, before Tax [Abstract]

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, Tax Expense (Benefit)
documentation: Amount of tax expense (benefit) from unrealized gain (loss) from investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndForeignCurrencyTransactionOperatingAfterTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction, Operating, after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeOperatingAfterTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, after Tax
documentation: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeOperatingBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax
documentation: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

name: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeOperatingBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax [Abstract]

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnCashFlowHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2025)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, recorded in results of operations to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be ineffective.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnCommodityContracts
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Commodity Contracts
documentation: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives
documentation: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of derivative instruments, including options, swaps, futures, and forward contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesAndCommodityContracts
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
documentation: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivativesAndCommodityContractsAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts [Abstract]

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnEnergyContracts
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Energy Contracts
documentation: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell energy at some future point, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativesNetBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
documentation: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativesNetBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax [Abstract]

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnHybridInstrumentNet
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hybrid Instrument, Net
documentation: Amount of the unrealized gain (loss) in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value on hybrid instruments measured at fair value.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnInterestRateCashFlowHedgesPretaxAccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLoss
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges, Pretax, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the increase or decrease in fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which was recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge was determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestmentsTableTextBlock
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of unrealized gains and losses on investments.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnMarketableSecuritiesCostMethodInvestmentsAndOtherInvestments
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The aggregate net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of marketable securities categorized as trading held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period, which may have arisen from (a) securities classified as trading, (b) the unrealized holding gain (loss) on held-to-maturity securities transferred to the trading security category, and (c) the cumulative unrealized gain (loss) which was included in

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnMarketableSecuritiesCostMethodInvestmentsAndOtherInvestmentsAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments [Abstract] (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivativesBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) arising from the change in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivativesBeforeTaxAbstract
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax [Abstract]

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskFairValueHedgingInstruments
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOnSecurities
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Securities (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in the income statement on unsold other securities.

name: UnrealizedGainLossOrWriteDownMember
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss or Write-down) [Member] (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: The change in the value of the assets which have not become actual but would happen if the investor sold the security or asset that an entity currently holds. Increases and decreases in equity (net assets) from the change in fair value of peripheral or incidental transactions of an entity except those that result from revenues or investments by owners.

name: UnrealizedGainLossSecuritySoldShortOperating
standard_label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Security Sold Short, Operating
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from security sold short, classified as operating.

name: UnrealizedGainOnForeignCurrencyDerivativesBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain related to the increase in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedGainOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivativesBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Gain on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
documentation: Amount of unrealized gain from the increase in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedGainOnSecurities
standard_label: Unrealized Gain on Securities (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The increase (decrease), resulting in a gain, in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of securities held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

name: UnrealizedLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativesBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Loss on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
documentation: Amount of unrealized loss recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income pertaining to the decrease in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments to the extent that a cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivativesBeforeTax
standard_label: Unrealized Loss on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
documentation: Amount of unrealized loss related to the decrease in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

name: UnrealizedLossOnSecurities
standard_label: Unrealized Loss on Securities (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: The increase (decrease), resulting in a loss, in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of securities held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

name: UnrecognizedDeferredTaxLiabilityDeterminationImpracticable
standard_label: Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Determination, Impracticable [true false]
documentation: Indicates (true false) whether determination of unrecognized deferred tax liability for temporary difference for investments in foreign subsidiary and foreign corporate joint venture that are permanent in duration, is impracticable.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefits
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
documentation: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultingFromAcquisition
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Acquisition
documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultingFromCurrentPeriodTaxPositions
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultingFromForeignCurrencyTranslation
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultingFromPriorPeriodTaxPositions
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultingFromSettlementsWithTaxingAuthorities
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAccrued
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Accrued
documentation: Amount of statutory penalties accrued for a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed by the entity, in its tax return.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccrued
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
documentation: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestAccruedAbstract
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued [Abstract]

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpense
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense [Abstract]

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesExpense
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Expense
documentation: Amount of expense for penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultingFromAcquisition
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultingFromCurrentPeriodTaxPositions
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultingFromForeignCurrencyTranslation
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultingFromPriorPeriodTaxPositions
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultingFromSettlementsWithTaxingAuthorities
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
documentation: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsInterestOnIncomeTaxesAccrued
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Accrued
documentation: Amount of interest expense accrued for an underpayment of income taxes.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsInterestOnIncomeTaxesExpense
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Expense
documentation: Amount of interest expense for an underpayment of income taxes.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsPeriodIncreaseDecrease
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Period Increase (Decrease)
documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in unrecognized tax benefits attributable to uncertain tax positions taken in tax returns.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsReductionsResultingFromLapseOfApplicableStatuteOfLimitations
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
documentation: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsResultingInNetOperatingLossCarryforward
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits Resulting in Net Operating Loss Carryforward (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
documentation: Amount of an unrecognized tax benefit that is directly related to a position taken in a tax year that results in a net operating loss carryforward. This amount is presented as a reduction of the related deferred tax asset in the balance sheet if that deferred tax asset is not used. This amount is presented separately from the deferred tax asset for a net operating loss carryforward if this unrelated tax benefit is associated with a different tax position.

name: UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsThatWouldImpactEffectiveTaxRate
standard_label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
documentation: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationAbstract
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceOnFifthAnniversary

Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceOnFourthAnniversary
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
documentation: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceOnSecondAnniversary
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two

Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceOnThirdAnniversary
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
