Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceSheetAmount
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
documentation: Amount of unrecorded obligation to transfer funds in future for fixed or minimum amount or quantity of product and service at fixed or minimum price. Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced and take-or-pay and throughput contracts.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation by Category of Item Purchased [Axis]
documentation: Information by category of product and service for unrecorded unconditional purchase arrangement to acquire product or service or both.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationCategoryExtensibleEnumeration
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Category [Extensible Enumeration]
documentation: Indicates category of product and service for unrecorded unconditional purchase arrangement to acquire product or service.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationChangeOfAmountAsResultOfVariableComponents
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Change of Amount as Result of Variable Components
documentation: Amount of change that payments under a contractual obligation might vary as facts and circumstances change.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationContractQuantityReceived
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Contract Quantity Received (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
documentation: The number of units that have been purchased from inception to date, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDate
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Date (Deprecated 2026)
documentation: End date of the unrecognized unconditional purchase obligation, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDescription
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Description
documentation: Describes the nature of an unconditional purchase obligation that is not recognized as a liability on the balance sheet.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueAfterFiveYears
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
documentation: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInNextRollingTwelveMonths
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Next Rolling 12 Months
documentation: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInRemainderOfFiscalYear
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
documentation: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInRollingAfterYearFive
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling after Year Five
documentation: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInRollingYearFive
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Five
documentation: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInRollingYearFour
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Four
documentation: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInRollingYearThree
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Three
documentation: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationDueInRollingYearTwo
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Two
documentation: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationImputedInterest
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Imputed Interest
documentation: If disclosed, the amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce an unconditional purchase obligation to present value on an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationLineItems
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationMaximumQuantity
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Maximum Quantity
documentation: Maximum number of units that may be acquired, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationMinimumQuantityRequired
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Minimum Quantity Required
documentation: The minimum number of units that must be purchased, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationNatureOfVariableComponents
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Nature of Variable Components
documentation: Description of reasons for changes in the amount of payments under a contractual obligation.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationPeriodQuantityPurchased
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Period Quantity Purchased
documentation: The number of units that have been purchased during the period, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationPurchases
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Purchases
documentation: The amount purchased during the period under an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation (for example, under the take-or-pay or throughput contract).

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationRollingMaturityAbstract
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Rolling Maturity [Abstract]

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationTable
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation arrangement to purchase product and service. Includes, but is not limited to, information about asset pledged to secure payment and payment due in each of next five years and thereafter.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationTerm
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Term
documentation: Term of unrecognized unconditional purchase obligation, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

name: UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligations Disclosure [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of unconditional purchase obligation not recognized as liability.

name: UnrecoveredCostsForPurchasedGasAmount
standard_label: Unrecovered Costs for Purchased Gas Amount
documentation: Discloses the amount of unrecovered costs for purchased gas.

name: UnrecoveredProductionCostsExcessOfEstimatedAverageUnitCost
standard_label: Unrecovered Production Costs, Excess of Estimated Average Unit Cost
documentation: The aggregate amount of manufacturing or production costs and any related deferred costs (for example, initial tooling costs) that exceeds the aggregate estimated cost of all in-process and delivered units on the basis of the estimated average cost of all units expected to be produced under long-term contracts and programs not yet complete.

name: UnrecoveredProductionCostsExcessUnrecoverableUnderExistingFirmOrders
standard_label: Unrecovered Production Costs, Excess Unrecoverable under Existing Firm Orders
documentation: The portion of the aggregate amount of manufacturing or production costs and any related deferred costs (for example, initial tooling costs) that exceeds the aggregate estimated cost of all in-process and delivered units on the basis of the estimated average cost of all units expected to be produced under long-term contracts and programs not yet complete, which would not be absorbed in cost of sales based on existing firm orders at the latest balance sheet date.

name: UnregulatedOperatingRevenue
standard_label: Unregulated Operating Revenue
documentation: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

name: UnregulatedOperationMember
standard_label: Unregulated Operation [Member]
documentation: Operation of entity not regulated by governmental or other regulatory organizations.

name: UnremittedEarningsInForeignInvestmentPolicy
standard_label: Unremitted Earnings in Foreign Investment, Policy [Policy Text Block]
documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for tax treatment of unremitted earnings in a foreign investment.

name: UnsecuredDebt
standard_label: Unsecured Debt
documentation: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

name: UnsecuredDebtCurrent
standard_label: Unsecured Debt, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, uncollateralized debt obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

name: UnsecuredDebtMember
standard_label: Unsecured Debt [Member]
documentation: Debt obligation not collateralized by pledge of, mortgage of or other lien on the entity's assets.

name: UnsecuredLongTermDebt
standard_label: Unsecured Long-Term Debt, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

name: UnsecuredLongtermDebtCurrentAndNoncurrentAbstract
standard_label: Unsecured Debt [Abstract]

standard_label: Unsolicited Tender Offer Costs
documentation: Costs incurred in connection with an unsolicited tender offer (one where the Entity being sought has not requested the offer). These would include costs relating to evaluation and dissemination of information regarding an unsolicited tender offer. A tender offer is a broad solicitation by an Entity or a third party to purchase a substantial percentage of another entity's shares or units for a limited period of time. name: UnusedCommitmentsToExtendCredit
standard_label: Unused Commitments to Extend Credit
documentation: Unused amount of commitments to extend credit to customers.

name: UnusedLinesOfCreditMember
standard_label: Unused lines of Credit [Member]
documentation: The unused portion of a line of credit that is available to the borrower to withdrawn upon.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemAxis
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both [Axis]
documentation: Information by an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemDescriptionOfContingencies
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, Description of Contingencies (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Description of the contingencies arising from material events or transactions (that would not reasonably be expected to recur in the foreseeable future) that possesses a high degree of abnormality and are clearly unrelated to, or incidentally related to, the ordinary and typical activities of the entity, that have not yet been recognized in the financial statements but are reasonably expected to impact the entity's financial statements in the near term; for example, but not limited to, future lo

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemDomain
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both [Domain]
documentation: Event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemEarningsPerShareImpactGross
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Earnings Per Share Impact, Gross
documentation: Per share amount of earnings, before tax, of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemEarningsPerShareImpactNet
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Earnings Per Share Impact, Net
documentation: Per share amount of earnings, after tax, of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemFourthQuarter
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, Fourth Quarter (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: Unusual or infrequent items recognized in the fourth quarter in the absence of either a fourth-quarter report or disclosure in the annual report for the fourth quarter.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemGainGross
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Gain, Gross
documentation: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemGross
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, Gross (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
documentation: The gross gain (loss) income statement effect of each material event or transaction (that would not reasonably be expected to recur in the foreseeable future) that possesses a high degree of abnormality and are clearly unrelated to, or incidentally related to, the ordinary and typical activities of the entity.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemGross1
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
documentation: Amount before insurance proceeds of gain (loss) income statement effect of each material event or transaction (that would not reasonably be expected to recur in the foreseeable future) that possesses a high degree of abnormality and are clearly unrelated to, or incidentally related to, the ordinary and typical activities of the entity.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemInsuranceProceeds
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Insurance Proceeds
documentation: Amount of insurance proceeds for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemLineItems
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemLossGross
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Loss, Gross
documentation: Amount, before deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemMember
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both [Member]
documentation: Event or transaction that is abnormal and unrelated to ordinary and typical activities or is not reasonably expected to recur in the foreseeable future, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemNatureOfEventOrTransaction
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Nature of Event or Transaction
documentation: Description of the nature of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemNetGainLoss
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net (Gain) Loss
documentation: Amount of (gain) loss for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or occurs infrequently, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemNetGainLossAbstract
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net (Gain) Loss [Abstract]

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemNetOfInsuranceProceeds
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net of Insurance Proceeds
documentation: Amount, after deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemNetOfInsuranceProceedsAbstract
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net of Insurance Proceeds [Abstract]

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemTable
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about the nature and financial statement effect of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentItemsDisclosureTextBlock
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Items, or Both, Disclosure [Text Block]
documentation: The entire disclosure for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualOrInfrequentTaxEffect
standard_label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Tax Effect
documentation: Amount of tax related to an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

name: UnusualRiskOrUncertaintyByNatureAxis
standard_label: Unusual Risk or Uncertainty, Nature [Axis]
documentation: Information by nature of risk and uncertainty, for example, but not limited to, threat of expropriation of its assets by a foreign government, rapid technological obsolescence in the industry, risk of natural disaster from earthquake or weather events, and availability of or continuation of a labor force at a reasonable cost.

name: UnusualRiskOrUncertaintyImpact
standard_label: Unusual Risk or Uncertainty, Impact
documentation: Describes the potential impact of the occurrence of the defined risk or adverse resolution of an uncertainty on the entity's financial statements, including a range of potential loss if reasonably estimable.

name: UnusualRiskOrUncertaintyLineItems
standard_label: Unusual Risk or Uncertainty [Line Items]
documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

name: UnusualRiskOrUncertaintyNatureDomain
standard_label: Unusual Risk or Uncertainty, Nature [Domain]
documentation: Describes the nature of the unusual risk or uncertainty, such as the threat of expropriation of its assets by a foreign government, rapid technological obsolescence in the industry, risk of natural disaster from earthquake or weather events, and availability of or continuation of a labor force at a reasonable cost.

name: UnusualRiskOrUncertaintyTable
standard_label: Unusual Risk or Uncertainty [Table]
documentation: Disclosure of information about unusual risk or uncertainty or both and their financial impact or potential financial impact.

name: UnusualRisksAndUncertaintiesTextBlock
standard_label: Unusual Risks and Uncertainties [Table Text Block]
documentation: Tabular disclosure of the nature of the unusual risk or uncertainty, if estimable, such as the threat of expropriation of its assets by a foreign government, rapid technological obsolescence in the industry, risk of natural disaster from earthquake or weather events, and availability of or continuation of a labor force at a reasonable cost.

name: UpFrontPaymentArrangementMember
standard_label: Up-front Payment Arrangement [Member]
documentation: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein all amount due is received from customer before delivery of goods or services, and revenue will be recognized upon customer acceptance of delivered goods or services.

name: UpstreamEquipmentMember
standard_label: Upstream Equipment [Member]
documentation: Equipment used in the search, development, extraction, and production of natural resources.

name: UsGovernmentAgencyInsuredLoansMember
standard_label: US Government Agency Insured Loans [Member]
documentation: Guarantee by US government agencies, including but not limited to, Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA) and Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) for government insured loans.

name: UsGovernmentInsuredLoanProgramMember
standard_label: US Government Insured Loan Program [Member]
documentation: Guarantee by government programs for US government insured loans.

name: UsGovernmentSponsoredEnterpriseInsuredLoansMember
standard_label: US Government Sponsored-Enterprise Insured Loans [Member]
documentation: Guarantee by US government-sponsored enterprises, including but not limited to, Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA) or Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC) for government insured loans.

name: UsTreasuryUstInterestRateMember
standard_label: US Treasury (UST) Interest Rate [Member]
documentation: Interest rate on direct treasury obligation of U.S. government (UST).

name: UseDividendsAxisWhenDividendDateInformationIsReportedOrWhenReportingSummaryDividendInformationGuidance

name: UseFinancialStatementLineItemElementsWithDimensionElementsForBalancesOfVariableInterestEntityVieGuidance
standard_label: Use financial statement line item elements with dimension elements for balances of Variable Interest Entity (VIE) [Guidance]

name: UseFinancialStatementLineItemElementsWithDimensionElementsForEffectOfAmendmentFromAccountingStandardsUpdateGuidance
standard_label: Use financial statement line item elements with dimension elements for effect of amendment from Accounting Standards Update [Guidance]

name: UseOfEstimates

documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for the use of estimates in the preparation of financial statements in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles.

name: UseOfEstimatesQuarterlyChangesInEstimates
standard_label: Use of Estimates, Quarterly Changes in Estimates (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
documentation: For quarterly periods, provides an entity's disclosure of any significant changes in estimates.

name: UseOfRestrictedCashForAcquisitionOfOilAndGasProperty
standard_label: Use of Restricted Cash for Acquisition of Oil and Gas Property (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
documentation: The cash outflow from the amount of cash specifically reserved for the acquisition of oil and gas property.

name: UseRightsMember

documentation: Legal right to use or benefit from the use of natural resources or access. Examples include, but are not limited to, drilling rights, water rights, air rights, timber cutting rights and route authorities.

name: UsefulLifeDescriptionOfTermDomain
standard_label: Useful Life, Term, Description [Domain]
documentation: Description of term of useful life when not stated as numeric value.

name: UsefulLifeShorterOfTermOfLeaseOrAssetUtilityMember
standard_label: Useful Life, Shorter of Lease Term or Asset Utility [Member]
documentation: Useful life extending over term of lease or utility of asset whichever is shorter.

name: UsefulLifeTermOfLeaseMember
standard_label: Useful Life, Lease Term [Member]
documentation: Useful life over term of lease.

name: UtilitiesCosts
standard_label: Utilities Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
documentation: Utilities costs incurred during the reporting period for services, such as water, sewer, gas, electricity and telephone required to operate a building.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpense
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense
documentation: Amount of operating expense of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseAbstract
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense [Abstract]

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseDepreciationAndAmortization

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseFuelUsed
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Fuel Used
documentation: Amount of operating expense for fuel used by regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseGasAndPetroleumPurchased
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Gas and Petroleum Purchased
documentation: Amount of operating expense for purchased gas and petroleum of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseImpairments
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Impairments
documentation: Amount of operating expense for impairments of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenance
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance
documentation: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance and repairs of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenanceAndOperations
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations
documentation: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance, repairs and operations of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseMaintenanceAndOperationsAbstract
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations [Abstract]

standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance, Operations, and Other Costs and Expenses
documentation: The amount of operating expenses for the period that are associated with the utility's normal revenue producing operation; including selling, general, and administrative expenses, costs incurred for routine plant repairs and maintenance, and operations.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseOperations
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Operations
documentation: Amount of operating expense for routine operations of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseOther
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Other
documentation: Amount of other operating expense of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseProductsAndServices
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Products and Services
documentation: Amount of operating expense for products and services of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchasedPower
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Purchased Power
documentation: Amount of operating expense for purchased power of regulated operation.

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpensePurchasedPowerUnderLongTermContracts

name: UtilitiesOperatingExpenseTaxes
standard_label: Utilities Operating Expense, Taxes
documentation: Amount of operating expense for taxes other than income taxes of regulated operation.

name: UtilityRevenueAbstract

name: ValuationAllowanceByDeferredTaxAssetAxis

name: VariableLeaseIncome

name: VariableLeasePayment

documentation: Amount of cash outflow for variable lease payment excluded from lease liability.

name: VariableLifeMember

name: VariableRateAxis

name: WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingMeasurementInput

name: WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingTerm

name: WarrantsAndRightsOutstandingTypeExtensibleList

documentation: Indicates type of outstanding warrant and right embodying unconditional obligation requiring redemption by transferring asset at specified or determinable date or upon event certain to occur.

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfShareOutstandingBasicAndDiluted
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted (Deprecated 2022)
documentation: Average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS).

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesCommonStockSubjectToRepurchaseOrCancellation
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Common Stock Subject to Repurchase or Cancellation
documentation: Number of shares of common stock subject to repurchase or cancellation determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Common stock subject to repurchase are outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall).

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesContingentlyIssuable
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Contingently Issuable
documentation: Shares issuable for little or no cash consideration upon the satisfaction of certain conditions (contingently issuable shares) are considered outstanding common shares and included in the computation of basic Earnings Per Share as of the date that all necessary conditions have been satisfied (in essence, when issuance of the shares is no longer contingent). name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesEmployeeStockOwnershipPlanSharesNotCommittedToBeReleased
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Shares Not Committed to be Released
documentation: Number of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) shares that have not been committed to be released determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesIssuedBasic
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
documentation: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingAbstract

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
documentation: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasicAbstract

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasicAndDiluted

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingDilutedDisclosureItemsAbstract

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesRestrictedStock
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Restricted Stock
documentation: Number of shares of restricted stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that restricted shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Restricted shares are subject to sales, contractual, regulatory or other restrictions that prevent or inhibit the holder from freely disposing of them before the restriction ends.

name: WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesTreasuryStock
standard_label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Treasury Stock
documentation: Number of shares of treasury stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that treasury shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Treasury stock is stock that the Entity has issued but subsequently reacquired.

name: WeightedAverageNumerDilutedLimitedPartnershipUnitsOutstandingAdjustment
standard_label: Weighted Average Number Diluted Limited Partnership Units Outstanding Adjustment
documentation: The sum of dilutive potential limited partnership units used in the calculation of the diluted per-unit computation.

name: WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositMoneyMarket

name: WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositCertificatesOfDeposit

name: WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositChecking

name: WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositRetail

documentation: Cost incurred related to well drilled or completed for the purpose of supporting production.

documentation: Wells and the equipment and facilities used to drill and equip exploratory wells. name: WellsInProcessOfDrilling

documentation: The number of wells in the process of being drilled in each geographic area as of the date listed.

name: WellsTemporarilySuspended
standard_label: Wells Temporarily Suspended
documentation: The number of wells temporarily suspended in each geographic area as of the date listed.

name: WestRegionMember
standard_label: US West Region [Member]
documentation: Region of United States of America (US) designated as West.

name: WholeLifeInsuranceMember
standard_label: Whole Life Insurance [Member]
documentation: Contract providing payment over life of insured and upon death of insured.

name: WhollyOwnedPropertiesMember
standard_label: Wholly Owned Properties [Member]
documentation: Real estate properties and units within those properties that are wholly owned.

name: WithdrawalFromContractHoldersFunds
standard_label: Withdrawal from Contract Holders Funds
documentation: The cash outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

name: WithdrawalFromMultiemployerDefinedBenefitPlanMember
standard_label: Withdrawal from Multiemployer Defined Benefit Plan [Member]
documentation: Obligation(s) resulting from employer withdrawal from a multiemployer 1) pension plan under circumstances that would give rise to an obligation or (b) other postretirement benefit plan under circumstances that would give rise to an obligation or an increase in the contribution to the fund during the remainder of the contract period to make up a shortfall necessary to fund the vested and negotiated benefits.

name: WorkersCompensationDiscountAbstract
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Discount [Abstract]

name: WorkersCompensationDiscountAmount
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Discount, Amount (Deprecated 2023)
documentation: Current year monetary amount of the change in worker's compensation reserve liability resulting from the discount applied to reduce the reserve to present value.

name: WorkersCompensationDiscountDescription
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Discount, Description (Deprecated 2020)
documentation: Description of the percent discount applied to worker's compensation reserve liability to reduce the reserve to present value.

name: WorkersCompensationDiscountPercent
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Discount, Percent
documentation: Percent discount applied to worker's compensation reserve liability to reduce the reserve to present value.

name: WorkersCompensationDiscountPriorYearAmount
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Discount, Prior Year Amount
documentation: Prior year monetary amount of the change in worker's compensation reserve liability resulting from the discount applied to reduce the reserve to present value.

name: WorkersCompensationInsuranceMember
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Insurance [Member]
documentation: Contract providing insurance coverage for employer's liability related to injury, disability, or death.

name: WorkersCompensationLiabilityCurrent
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Liability, Current
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

name: WorkersCompensationLiabilityCurrentAndNoncurrent
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Liability
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature.

name: WorkersCompensationLiabilityNoncurrent
standard_label: Workers' Compensation Liability, Noncurrent
documentation: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the noncurrent portion of the liabilities (due beyond one year; or beyond one operating cycle if longer).

name: WorkforceSubjectToCollectiveBargainingArrangementsExpiringWithinOneYearMember
standard_label: Workforce Subject to Collective-Bargaining Arrangements Expiring within One Year [Member]
documentation: The number of employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement that will expire within one year after the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

name: WorkforceSubjectToCollectiveBargainingArrangementsMember
standard_label: Workforce Subject to Collective-Bargaining Arrangements [Member]
documentation: The number of employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement as of the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

name: WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost
standard_label: Deferred Debt Issuance Cost, Writeoff
documentation: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.

name: WrittenLoanCommitmentFairValueOptionMember
standard_label: Written Loan Commitment, Fair Value Option [Member]
documentation: This element represents a written loan commitment that would otherwise not be recognized in the issuers or borrowers financial statements as the loan has not yet been funded, but which meets the definition of a financial asset or liability for eligibility of applying the fair value option.

name: YearEndAdjustmentMember
standard_label: Year-End Adjustment [Member]
documentation: A significant favorable or unfavorable adjustment of revenue or expenses made at year-end, possibly arising from an audit. Examples of such items include changes in estimates, such as inventory shrinkage, allowance for uncollectible accounts, allowance for quantity discounts, and management decisions near the balance sheet date that impact reported results of operations.

name: YearEndAdjustmentsEffectOfFourthQuarterEventsDescription
standard_label: Effect of Fourth Quarter Events, Description
documentation: Description of a transaction recognized in the fourth quarter. Includes, but is not limited to, the disposal of a component of an entity, an unusual or infrequently occurring item, or both, effect from a change in accounting estimate, and effect of a year-end adjustment.

name: YearFounded
standard_label: Year Founded
documentation: Year the entity was founded, in YYYY format.
